rows.jp: 「わたしでよければ力になります / お話、聞かせてもらえませんか？<b:8a39><b:8a3a>なこの国が / [13]<8a3b>な夜な怪物に攻われているというのである

rows.re: If I'll do, I'll lend a hand. Won't / you tell me what's wrong?
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: The villagers have not been harmed, but they live in fear of the night.
rows.jp: [13]国人に危<889b>はないものの / [13]<8a3c><b:8a3d>おびえて<b:8a3e>らせるほど / [13]人々の心は強いものではない

rows.speaker: narration

rows.jp: 「テレポートジェムの使い方 / まだなれてなくて〜
rows.lit: I'm still not used to how the Teleport Gem works...
rows.re: I'm still not used to how the / Teleport Gem works...
rows.speaker: young mage girl

rows.en: @For a minute I thought I had teleported to the wrong place again.
rows.jp: 「でもよかった、今のが最後だったんです / これでまた / 変なところに飛んでっちゃったらと思うと〜謎の少女 / 「〜ここ、ヴァレリアさん左じゃ / ない、ですよね、やっぱり〜
rows.lit: But thank goodness, that was the last one. I dreaded warping somewhere strange again.
rows.re: But thank goodness, that was the / last one. I dreaded warping / somewhere strange again.
rows.speaker: young mage girl

rows.en: @Who are you, anyway?
rows.jp: 「〜あんた、誰？
rows.lit: ...Hey, who are you?
rows.re: ...Hey, who are you?
rows.speaker: young mage girl

rows.en: @I just can't get the hang of the Teleport Gem, you know, an item used for moving around.
rows.jp: 「ダメなんですよねぇ / どうしてもテレポートジェム〜 / 〜あ、<b:8a4a>移用アイテム使うのニガテなんです
rows.lit: It's no good; I just can't with the Teleport Gem... oh, I mean, I'm bad with warp-type items.
rows.re: It's no good; I just can't with / the Teleport Gem... I mean, I'm / bad with warp-type items.
rows.speaker: Lilka

rows.en: @I'm studying magic, and this one item just seems to have it in for me or something.
rows.jp: 「魔法を<b:8a4b>強しているんですけど / あのアイテムだけは / なんかもう、相性わるくて〜姉ちゃん、魔法使えるんだ
rows.lit: I'm studying magic, but that one item just; ugh, it and I really don't get along.
rows.re: I'm studying magic, but that one / item just; ugh, it and I really / don't get along.
rows.speaker: Lilka

rows.en: @For instance, you can pick out a loved one's voice or your own name in a noisy room.
rows.jp: 「<8943>えばねー、<b:8a4c>りがどんなにうるさくても / 自分の名前とか、好きな人の話とか / 不思議と聞き分けられるでしょ？
rows.lit: See, no matter how noisy it is around you, you can somehow pick out your own name or a loved one's voice, right?
rows.re: See, no matter how noisy it is, / you can somehow pick out your own / name or a loved one's voice, right?
rows.speaker: Lilka

rows.en: @That's a kind of magic, too. Get it?
rows.jp: 「あれも魔法みたいなものよ / <f040><f042>わかる？
rows.lit: That's a kind of magic, too. Understand?
rows.re: That's a kind of magic, too. / Understand?
rows.speaker: Lilka

rows.en: @But you will someday. Magic is a power that anyone can use...
rows.jp: 「でも、そのうちわかるよ / 魔法はね、誰にでも使えて / そして<f040><f042>
rows.lit: But you'll understand in time. Magic can be used by anyone, and...
rows.re: But you'll understand in time. / Magic can be used by anyone, and...
rows.speaker: Lilka

rows.en: @And magic can do anything.
rows.jp: 「何でもできる力なんだから〜
rows.lit: ...it's a power that can do anything.
rows.re: ...it's a power that can do / anything.
rows.speaker: Lilka

rows.en: @I'm going to be like you! I'll work hard and I won't give up -- ever!
rows.jp: 「お姉ちゃんみたいになれるんだ / だから、途中で<88ab>げ出さないッ！ / あきらめないッ
rows.lit: I can become like you, big sis! So I won't run off partway. I won't give up!
rows.re: I can become like you, big sis! So / I won't run off partway. I won't / give up!
rows.speaker: little sister

rows.en: @I'm going to be like you! I'll work hard and I won't give up -- ever!

rows.lit: I can become like you, big sis! So I won't run off partway. I won't give up!
rows.re: I can become like you, big sis! So / I won't run off partway. I won't / give up!
rows.speaker: little sister

rows.en: @Looking for the Raypoints to fix the sky, are you? Ha ha! It's a fine thing you're doing.
rows.jp: 「<f040><f041><f042>ほうほう、空を元に戻す為に / レイポイントなるモノを探していると？ / それは、ご苦労なことだのう
rows.lit: Oho, so you're seeking things called Raypoints to restore the sky? That's hard work indeed.
rows.re: Oho, so you're seeking things / called Raypoints to restore the / sky? That's hard work indeed.
rows.speaker: old man

rows.jp: 「ふ〜む、お前さんの探しているモノかどうか / 分からんが、[11]お北の方[11]ぉに / なんでも、<b:8a53>を<b:8a54>っておる所があるそうだよ来なさった

rows.re: Hmm, can't say if it's what you / seek, but [11]to the north[11] is a / place where flame is worshipped.
rows.speaker: elder

rows.lit: Oho, so you lot are seeking things called Raypoints to restore the sky?
rows.re: Oho, so you lot are seeking things / called Raypoints to restore the / sky?
rows.speaker: old man

rows.re: Hmm, can't say if it's what you / seek, but [11]to the north[11] is a / place where flame is worshipped.
rows.speaker: elder

rows.jp: 「倉物<b:8a5d>の中は今 / パレス麦でいっぱいだよ<b:8a5e>準備しているみたいだけどいいのかい？準備していくかい？準備するのかな？<b:8a3c>度ッ！ 今後ともよろしくなッ！

rows.re: The granary's packed full of / Palace wheat right now.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @Tonight it's my turn. Argh, I'm just bushed.
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>で、今夜は僕の番ってワケ / かったりぃよな、まったく〜<b:8a60>の国だけど / 品<b:8a61>えだけは / 他の場と変わらないぜ<b:8a5e><b:8a62>しくなった気がするぞ処分するために / 『渡り鳥』を<b:8a64>おうかと話し合っていたんだ

rows.re: So tonight's my turn. What a drag, / honestly...
rows.speaker: young man

rows.en: @I'm sure they can handle the monsters with no problem.
rows.jp: 「彼らなら、こんな誓認 / <b:8a65><b:8a66>に解決してくれるだろうからね<b:8a67>まってきてるだろう？ / どうだ、スキルを付けてみないか？麦が斬穫できないと / この国はどうなってしまうんだ〜？麦の斬穫に蓄えられている / 小さな国さ

rows.re: A pair like them should settle a / problem like this easily enough.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.jp: 「ところで、お<b:8a6a>ちゃんは / どこから来たんだい？<b:8b06>「食料はこの間の斬穫が終ったばかりだから / しばらくはもつが / <f040><f041><f042>空がこのままだと〜<b:8b06>「レイポイント？ / ああ、もしかしたら[11]お北にある遺跡[11]ぉが / 確かそんなような信じだったかな蓄えている / 大事な麦の刈り入れが / やっと終わったんだ

rows.re: By the way, young lady, where are / you from?
rows.speaker: villager

rows.re: The harvested wheat is stored up / in plenty in the granary.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @Did you come to see HIM? He's probably outside.
rows.jp: 「あの家に式いに来てくれたの？ / 多分、外にいると思うんだけど〜
rows.lit: Did you come to see him? He's probably outside, I think.
rows.re: Did you come to see him? He's / probably outside, I think.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @I told him not to go outside because of the strange sky but he just won't listen.
rows.jp: 「空があんな<89f9>でしょ / 外に出ちゃダメって言ってるのに / 全部聞いてくれないの<b:8a6e>の方がいらっしゃるなんて / <89aa>方ぶりですね鳥』は<b:8a6f>地の遺跡を探<b:8a70>したり / <b:8a71>金のかかった怪物を処分する / 冒険者たちのことなの
rows.lit: The sky's like that, so I keep telling him not to go outside, but he won't listen to a word.
rows.re: The sky's like that, so I keep / telling him not to go outside, / but he won't listen.
rows.speaker: townswoman

rows.en: @They'd be perfect for a job like this.
rows.jp: 「今回の事件なんかには / <b:8a72>任なんだけど〜姉ちゃんッ！ / いらっしゃいッ！
rows.lit: They'd be perfectly suited to a matter like this.
rows.re: They'd be perfectly suited to a / matter like this.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @Can you, um, fix the sky with your magic?
rows.jp: 「〜あのさ、この変な空も / お姉ちゃんの魔法で元どおりに / できないかな〜？姉ちゃんのお<b:8a73>達なんだってね / あのさ、ボクともお<b:8a73>達になってくれる？姉ちゃんッ！ / 俺だよ、おぼえてる？[18]か<b:8a74><b:8a75>もここまで〜か〜〜<b:8a76>重<b:8a77>ってくれたんだねッ！ / うれしいなー / ホントにまた来てくれたんだもん

rows.re: Say, could you fix this weird sky / back to normal with your magic, / big sis?
rows.speaker: kid

rows.en: @I'd be even happier if the sky wasn't so weird now.
rows.jp: 「〜でも、空が変になってなければ / もっと良かったのにな〜姉ちゃんが助けてくれた国だよ麦畑ばっかり攻っているんだ
rows.lit: But it'd be even better if the sky hadn't gone weird.
rows.re: But it'd be even better if the / sky hadn't gone weird.
rows.speaker: kid

rows.en: @At least no one in the village has been harmed so far.
rows.jp: 「国の人はまだ、誰もケガしてないから / ひと安心だよね
rows.lit: No one in the village has been hurt yet, so that's one relief.
rows.re: No one in the village has been hurt / yet, so that's one relief.
rows.speaker: child

rows.en: @But my dad is out patrolling to make sure those monsters don't try anything.
rows.jp: 「でも、いつ攻われるかわからないから / 今夜もお発さんは / パトロールに出ているんだ<b:8a79>本は / まず情報を集めることからだよ
rows.lit: But since we never know when they'll attack, my dad's out on patrol again tonight.
rows.re: But since we never know when / they'll attack, my dad's out on / patrol again tonight.
rows.speaker: child

rows.en: @So why not start by asking the villagers what they know?
rows.jp: 「国のみんなに / いろいろ<b:8a7a>いてみたらどうかな？好きな名前にしてあげよう<b:8a7b>き込むクレストグラフを選んでおくれ<b:8a7c><b:8a7d>）を選んでおくれ<b:8a7b>き込むよ。いいかね？
rows.lit: Why not try asking the villagers all sorts of things?
rows.re: Why not try asking the villagers / all sorts of things?
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @The wheat we harvested is in the granary over there, in the northeast part of the village.
rows.jp: 「斬穫した麦は / ホラ、国の北側の倉物<b:8a5d>に / 蓄えられているんだよ<b:8a85>さんじゃないか / 力入れて作<b:8a86>するからさ / あんたのアームを<b:8a7f><b:8a80>させてくれないか？[18]が<b:8a81>を込める必要なんて全部ないな / 撃ちたい放認だぜッ！<b:8a81>準<b:8a87>する
rows.lit: The harvested wheat is stored, see, in the granary on the north side of the village.
rows.re: The harvested wheat is stored, / see, in the granary on the / village's north side.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @The northeast is an unlucky direction. Bad things always come from the northeast.
rows.jp: 「知っているかな？ / その方級は<b:8a8c><b:8a6d>といって / 良くないことがやってくる方級なんだ
rows.lit: Did you know? That direction is called the "demon's gate"; ill things come from it.
rows.re: Did you know? That direction is / the |demon's gate|; ill things / come from it.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @And guess where the granary in Palace Village is. Right. In the northeast part of town.
rows.jp: 「ここ、パレスヴィレッジでは / 倉物<b:8a5d>の建っているあたり〜 / <f040><f042>そう、北側のことだね処分を『渡り鳥』に / 任せるつもりらしいが〜
rows.lit: Here in Palace Village, that's around where the granary stands; yes, the north side.
rows.re: Here in Palace Village, that's / around where the granary stands; / yes, the north side.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @But there aren't many Mercs who'd come to a backwater like this village.
rows.jp: 「こんな岸<b:8a8d>の国に / やって来るような『渡り鳥』なんて / そうそういるもんじゃないさ
rows.lit: There aren't many "Drifters" who'd come out to a backwater village like this.
rows.re: There aren't many |Drifters| / who'd come out to a backwater / village like this.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @I heard they used a strong curse to get the monsters out of the wheat fields.
rows.jp: 「『食べ物の<b:8a8e>みは恐ろしい』〜ってね / よほど畑の怪物の / 処分された<b:8a8f>いは強いらしいの
rows.lit: "The grudge of the hungry is a fearsome thing," they say; the monster driven from the fields must bear a fierce one.
rows.re: |A hungry grudge is a fearsome / thing|, they say; the field-driven / monster must bear a fierce one.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @I wish they'd settle down and make the sky normal again.
rows.jp: 「早く気を<b:8a90>めて / 空を元に戻してくれんかのぉ
rows.lit: I do wish they'd settle down and set the sky right again.
rows.re: I do wish they'd settle down and / set the sky right again.
rows.speaker: elder

rows.en: @The curse they used to get the monsters out of the fields is what's making the sky weird!
rows.jp: 「この変な空の原因は / 前に畑の怪物を処分した<b:8a8f>いに / 違いあるまいてッ！
rows.lit: This strange sky must be because someone got rid of the field monsters before, no doubt!
rows.re: This strange sky must be because / someone got rid of the field / monsters before, no doubt!
rows.speaker: old man

rows.en: @I saw a huge monster chomping wheat right in the middle of the wheat fields!
rows.jp: 「畑の<b:8a91>ん中で / もんぎゅもんぎゅ、麦を食っている / 谷のような怪物の<b:8a92>をッ！
rows.lit: Right in the middle of the field, a mountain of a monster, chomp-chomping the wheat; I saw it!
rows.re: Right in the middle of the field, / a mountain of a monster / chomp-chomping the wheat; I saw it!
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @Next it's the villagers who are going to be eaten! I just know it!
rows.jp: 「この更はきっと / 国の人間が / 食われる番に違いあるまいてッ！
rows.lit: Next, surely, it'll be the villagers' turn to be eaten, no doubt!
rows.re: Next, surely, it'll be the / villagers' turn to be eaten, no / doubt!
rows.speaker: old man

rows.en: @In times like this, they always sacrifice the prettiest girl, and that's me. Oh, poor me!
rows.jp: 「こーいう時は国で一番可愛い娘が / イケニエになるんだよね？ / ああ、わたしってば<b:8a94><b:8a95>のヒロインだわ
rows.lit: At times like this, the prettiest girl in the village becomes the sacrifice, right? Oh, me and my...
rows.re: At times like this, the prettiest / girl in the village becomes the / sacrifice, right? Oh, me and my...
rows.speaker: village girl

rows.en: @The old lady says it's a curse but I think God is jealous of of me for being so pretty.
rows.jp: 「そうねぇ、おばあちゃんは / <b:8a8f>いだタタリだって言ってるけど / わたしが可愛いから<b:8a96>方が<b:8a97><b:8a98>してるのよ
rows.lit: Well, granny calls it a curse, but really it's God jealous of me for being so cute.
rows.re: Well, granny calls it a curse, / but really it's God jealous of me / for being so cute.
rows.speaker: vain girl

rows.en: @I kept saying I would get rid of them, but mom and dad wouldn't let me.
rows.jp: 「そうねぇ、わたしが何とかするって / いつも言ってたんだけど / パパとママが反対するのよ
rows.lit: Well, I always said I'd deal with it myself, but Papa and Mama are against it.
rows.re: Well, I always said I'd deal with / it myself, but Papa and Mama are / against it.
rows.speaker: village girl

rows.en: @It's because I'm so pretty.
rows.jp: 「だってホラ、わたしこんなに可愛いし〜
rows.lit: I mean, look, I'm this cute, after all...
rows.re: I mean, look, I'm this cute, after / all...

rows.speaker: Village Chief

rows.en: @That's wonderful! Please let us know what we can do! We'll do anything!
rows.jp: 「そうですか、それはありがたいことです / わたしたちにも役に立つことがあったら / 何でも<b:8a76>力いたしますわ姿を見て / メリルも安心したようです
rows.re: Wonderful! Please tell us what we / can do! Anything at all!
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @That Merrill. She worries about you so much, you know!
rows.jp: 「[05]おさんのことになると / メリルったら心配性になるみたいで<b:8a77>のメリルは / 同い数の家族が国にいなかったせいか / [0a]ぐが唯一の友だちでした
rows.re: That Merrill, she worries about you / so much, you know!
rows.speaker: Village Chief

rows.en: @Your friendship means so much to her. Please be good to her!
rows.jp: 「これからも / メリルと仲良くしてあげてください
rows.re: Your friendship means so much to / her. Please be good to her!
rows.speaker: Village Chief

rows.en: @Merrill has worried about you constantly for the past 5 years. I'm so glad to see you!
rows.jp: 「５数前のあのとき以来 / メリルがあなたのことを心配してました / 無事でなによりでしたわ
rows.re: Merrill has worried over you for / five years. I'm so glad to see you!
rows.speaker: Village Chief

rows.en: @Especially my daughter, Merrill. There wasn't a day she didn't think of you.
rows.jp: 「とくに<b:8a77>のメリルは / [05]おさんのことを / しきりに気にしてましたので〜〜<b:8a78><b:8a79>の水級が辺がったような / 気がするんだ
rows.re: Especially my daughter Merrill. Not / a day passed she didn't think of / you.
rows.speaker: Village Chief

rows.en: @The water has never run low before. Why now? Does this have something to do with the dark sky?
rows.jp: 「今までは、近くに山や道があるから / 水だけは<b:8a7a>れることは、なかったんだけどな / なんでだろう？ あの空のせいかな？<b:8a7b><b:8a7c>が悪くてね、すぐに水が<b:8a7d>み込むんだ / だから、こんな<b:8a7e><b:8a7f><b:8a80>き出しの<b:8a7b>地なんだよ<b:8a81>はないよ
rows.re: The water's never run low before. / Why now? Is it the dark sky?
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @There's nothing to BE affected!
rows.jp: 「まあ、元から何もなかったからね<b:8a52>しい国のせいか / <b:8a82>い者は国を<b:8a83>てて / 大きな場にいってしまいます
rows.re: There's nothing left to BE / affected!
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @The only ones left here are a handful of those who love the place too dearly to leave it.
rows.jp: 「この国に残っているのは / この国を愛している / わずかなものたちだけです<b:8a84> / スレイハイム解放軍の同胞たちが / なん人か流れ着いたことがあります
rows.re: Only a handful remain, those who / love this place too dearly to / leave.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @They just rested briefly and then went on. I don't know if they ever made it to safety.
rows.jp: 「彼らは少しだけ休むと / 政<b:8a86>がかかるといって立ち<b:8a87>りました / 無事に逃げられたか知る<b:8a88>はありませんが奪っていった連中の / 話してたのをチラッと聞いたんだが〜
rows.re: They only rested a moment, then / moved on. I don't know if they made / it.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @They plan to go 1west up the coast0 to an inlet, land, then go to 1Quartly, in the northwest0.
rows.jp: 「このまま[11]お道<b:8a56><b:8a57>いを東[11]ぉに向かい / 入り<89ad>から上陸して、[11]お北東のクアトリー[11]ぉって / 場を目指すって言ってたよ<b:8a6b>しかない<89d3>を奪われたんだ / <b:8a89>儀で小さい<89d3>だけど / この国には、なくてはならないモノなんだ旅の行<8815>人から聞いたんだ / かなり前のことらしいのだが〜
rows.re: They mean to go west up the coast / to an inlet, land, then on to / Quartly in the northwest.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @That shows just how behind the rest of the world this village is.
rows.jp: 「この国が、世間から / かなり<8a0d>れていることを / あらためて思い知らされたよ〜教えてくれないか
rows.re: That shows just how far behind the / world this village is.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @Wayfarers like ya are our only source of information about the outside world, ya know.
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>オレらには、世間がどうなっているのか / 外から来た旅人に聞くしか / 知る<b:8a88>が、ないのだよ友だちかい
rows.re: Wayfarers like you are our only / news of the outside world.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @When the fighting is over, why not stay here? This is a nice, peaceful place.
rows.jp: 「戦いがすんだら / お前さんもここで<b:8a8b>らさないかい？ / 心を休めるにはいいところだよ来てくれるのが / 最近の楽しみだよ
rows.re: When the fighting's over, why not / stay? It's a nice, peaceful place.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @Stop by again on your way through these parts. We'll be waiting for you!
rows.jp: 「また旅の<b:8a8c>中にでも / よっておくれな / 楽しみにしているから<b:8a8d>り心地は / どんな信じなんだ？ / 一度<b:8a8d>ってみたいもんだ
rows.re: Stop by again on your way through. / We'll be waiting for you!
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @We're the last residents. We should consider it an honor.
rows.jp: 「<f040><f041><f042>ほ？ おまえさんは / さっきのヤツラの仲間じゃないんだな？奪っていったヤツラは / [11]お東の大陸の<88db><88dc>[11]ぉが目的地らしいぞ
rows.re: We're the last residents. We should / count it an honor.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @What? So you're not with those ruffians who took our boat? Oh, I'm sorry.
rows.re: What? You're not with the ruffians / who took our boat? Oh, I'm sorry.

rows.en: &v
rows.lit: (control/format codes only)
rows.speaker: control code

rows.jp: 「<f040><f041><f042>ッ！<b:8a8e>家王が / <b:8a8f>かに<b:8a90>い輝を放ちはじめる〜

rows.en: @[Dumbfounded silence]
rows.jp: 「〜あ〜〜〜う〜〜 / 〜〜〜暗い〜空が〜〜広が〜って〜いく〜〜
rows.re: [Dumbfounded silence]

rows.en: @Argh... The darkness in... the sky... is spreading...
rows.re: Argh... the darkness in the sky... / is spreading...
rows.speaker: Brad

rows.jp: 「ひっく、ひっく
rows.speaker: Brad

rows.en: @Hic! Hic!
rows.jp: 「〜〜そっちは、危ない〜〜 / ダメだ、ダメだ、ダメだ、ダメだ / ダメなんだよぉ
rows.re: Hic! Hic!
rows.speaker: Brad

rows.en: @Stay away... It's too dangerous! No! No! No, no, no!
rows.jp: 「人が〜〜 / 〜〜滅れる〜〜 / あはは〜〜
rows.re: Stay away... it's too dangerous! / No! No! No, no, no!
rows.speaker: Brad

rows.en: @People... ... people break... Ha ha ha...
rows.jp: 「うううっ〜〜 / ひぃーっ！
rows.re: People... people break... ha ha / ha...
rows.speaker: Brad

rows.en: @Ugh... Arrghh!
rows.jp: ＊エネルギー<b:8a91><b:8a92>弾による<b:8a93>撃を / 相全体に対して行います<b:8a94><b:8a95>な作りをした<b:8a96><b:8a97>のようだ / 強い<b:8a98>撃を<b:8a99>えないと開きそうもない旅の行<8815>人<b:8a9a>めでしょうッ！<b:8a9b><b:8a9c>を〜 手持ちのギャラが足りませんよ<b:8a50>備していくかい？<b:8a50>備するのかな？
rows.re: Ugh... arrghh!
rows.speaker: Brad

rows.en: *Its explosive rounds attack all of your enemies at once.
rows.jp: （〜本当にそうなのか？）
rows.re: *Its explosive rounds strike all / your enemies at once.

rows.en: (Could it still be the same?)
rows.jp: （『あの回』を<b:8a65>に、僕は変わったはずだ / そう、変わらないモノなど無い〜 / <8943>えそれが、どんなカタチであろうとも〜）<b:8a49>らの足取りを追おう〜
rows.re: (Could it still be the same?)
rows.speaker: Brad

rows.en: (I have changed much since that day. Nothing stays the same, no matter what form it is...)
rows.jp: 「あんまりはしゃいでると / 旅の人に政<b:8a86>でしょーッ！
rows.re: (I've changed so much since that / day. Nothing stays the same, / whatever its form...)
rows.speaker: Brad

rows.en: @It's me, Merrill! You remember me, right?
rows.jp: 「わたしは？ / メリルのことも / おぼえているわよね？
rows.re: It's me, Merrill! You remember me, / don't you?
rows.speaker: Merrill

rows.en: @But you've changed so much...
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>でも、キミ〜経っているんだもん / 数相応になってもらわないと困るわ
rows.re: But you've changed so much...
rows.speaker: Merrill

rows.re: ...zzz...zzz...zzz...

rows.en: @All this time, I had hoped that we would get the chance to meet again.
rows.jp: 「〜わたしね / おじさんにもう一度会いたいって / ずっと思ってたんだ
rows.re: All this time, I hoped we'd get to / meet again.
rows.speaker: Merrill

rows.jp: 「５数経ったからって / [0a]ぐのこと忘れちゃうなんて<b:8aa0>のメリルだけど困るわ
rows.re: ...zzz...zzz...zzz...

rows.en: @All this time, I had hoped that we would get the chance to meet again.
rows.lit: (snoring) zzz... zzz... zzz...
rows.re: zzz... zzz... zzz...
rows.speaker: sleeper

rows.en: @And I asked why a hero like you would be chased down and captured like that.
rows.jp: 「〜わたしね / おじさんにもう一度会いたいって / ずっと思ってたんだ英雄』って呼ばれていたのか聞いたわ
rows.re: And I asked why a hero like you / would be hunted down and captured.
rows.speaker: Merrill

rows.en: @But you're not a bad man anymore, right, Mister? That's why you're here now, right?
rows.jp: 「そして、『英雄』がどうして / 追われなきゃ / いけなかったのかってことも〜
rows.re: But you're not a bad man anymore, / right, Mister? That's why you're / here.
rows.speaker: Merrill

rows.en: @I've been a prisoner ever since that day.
rows.jp: 「〜でも、今はもう / おじさんは悪くないってわかったから / こうして、ここにいるんでしょ？
rows.re: But now I know you're not to blame. / That's why you're here, isn't it?
rows.speaker: Merrill

rows.en: @After you were taken away, {7} told me he was in the forest, unconscious.
rows.jp: 「僕は、ずっと<b:8aa1>られたままだ / 『あの回』から〜会いたかったのは / 会わせたかった人がいるからなのよ
rows.re: After you were taken, {7} said he / lay unconscious in the forest.
rows.speaker: Merrill

rows.en: @I think he was in the Slayheim Liberation Army, like you.
rows.jp: 「おじさんが連れて行かれた後 / [0a]ぐが山の中で / 倒れていたのを教えてくれたの
rows.re: I think he was in the Slayheim / Liberation Army, like you.
rows.speaker: Merrill

rows.en: @He's a very close friend of mine.
rows.jp: 「その人も、おじさんと同じ / スレイハイム解放軍だと思うんだけど〜
rows.re: He's a very close friend of mine.
rows.speaker: Merrill

rows.en: @But he must have amnesia from his fever and injuries.
rows.jp: 「こいつは / 僕のかけがえの無い<8a0e>友だ〜<b:8aff>[03]
rows.re: But the fever and his wounds must / have left him with amnesia.
rows.speaker: Merrill

rows.en: @He keeps mumbling that his name is 1 Evans.
rows.jp: 「この人、ケガと高<8868>で / 渡録の方がひどく<b:8aa2><8945>しているの
rows.re: He keeps mumbling that his name is / {1} Evans.
rows.speaker: Merrill

rows.en: @Oh, well. If he's your friend, that's enough for me.
rows.jp: 「自分のことを / [05]お・エヴァンスだって / <b:8aa3>いていたわ〜
rows.re: Oh well. If he's your friend, / that's enough for me.
rows.speaker: Brad

rows.en: @We weren't able to heal him... in body or mind.
rows.jp: 「でも<b:8aa4>得 / おじさんの<8a0e>友なんだもんね会えたのに / ごめんなさい〜
rows.re: We couldn't heal him, in body or in / mind.
rows.speaker: Merrill

rows.en: @I mean, I'm grateful to you.
rows.jp: 「わたしたちでは / この人を分すことができなかったの / 身体のケガも、心のケガも〜会えただけでも / 僕は<b:8aa5>足だ
rows.re: I mean it, I'm grateful to you.
rows.speaker: Merrill

rows.en: @Many small rebel groups staged scattered uprisings, but they were too unorganized.
rows.jp: 「〜すまない、信<b:8a69>している<b:8aa6>では<b:8aa7>意を無視した / 軍事力<b:8aa8>強<b:8aa9>案を<88c1>し進めていた〜
rows.re: Many small rebel bands rose up, but / they were too scattered.
rows.speaker: Village Chief

rows.en: @There then appeared a man who united the opposition into the Slayheim Liberation Army.
rows.jp: 「結果、その<b:8aa9>案に反発をおぼえる者が / <b:8aaa>地で<b:8aab><b:8a50><b:8aac>起を行うが、<b:8aad>発する<b:8aae>度で / 大きな勢力には至らなかった
rows.re: Then a man appeared who united them / into the Slayheim Liberation Army.
rows.speaker: Village Chief

rows.en: @That man's name was Vinsfeld Rhadamanthus.
rows.jp: 「そんな時、ひとりの剣が現われ / 反対勢力を重ねあげ / スレイハイム解放軍を結成する〜
rows.re: That man's name was Vinsfeld / Rhadamanthus.
rows.speaker: Village Chief

rows.en: @Why would the Liberation Army leader turn terrorist?
rows.jp: 「その剣とは〜 / ヴィンスフェルト・ラダマンテュス<b:8aaf>だったなんて…
rows.re: Why would the Liberation Army's / leader turn terrorist?
rows.speaker: Lilka

rows.en: @charisma and the bravery of 1 Evans and his companions...
rows.jp: 「なんで解放軍のリーダーだった人が / テロ<b:8ab0><b:8ab1>なんて作ったの！
rows.re: ...the charisma, and the bravery of / {1} Evans and his comrades...
rows.speaker: Village Chief

rows.en: @...that enabled the Liberation to defeat the military despite their small numbers.
rows.jp: 「少年だった解放軍が / <b:8aaa>地で正<b:8ab2>軍を<b:8ab3>ち破っていったのは / ヴィンスフェルトのカリスマ性と〜
rows.re: ...let the Liberation beat the / military despite their small / numbers.
rows.speaker: Village Chief

rows.en: @But he disappeared during the Final Operation.
rows.jp: 「『英雄』[05]お・エヴァンスと / 仲間たちの<b:8ab4><b:8ab5>があったからだと
rows.re: But he vanished during the Final / Operation.
rows.speaker: Village Chief

rows.en: @When the fighting was over...
rows.jp: 「だが、ファイナルオペレーションの<89d2> / こいつは行方不次に…
rows.re: When the fighting was over...
rows.speaker: Village Chief

rows.en: @we Liberation Army veterans were blamed for the entire war. We were treated like war criminals.
rows.jp: 「そして〜
rows.re: ...we Liberation veterans were / blamed for the whole war, treated / as criminals.
rows.speaker: Village Chief

rows.en: @That's right. It was all a clever trap set and sprung by Vinsfeld.
rows.jp: 「生き残った解放軍と僕は / 街戦のすべての<b:8ab6>任を<b:8ab7>わされて / 戦犯として追われる身となってしまった〜
rows.re: That's right. It was all a clever / trap, set and sprung by Vinsfeld.
rows.speaker: Brad

rows.en: @I don't care what anyone says. {7} and I know you're not a bad man.
rows.jp: 「そう〜ッ！ / ヴィンスフェルトの / <899c><8a22>なワナによってなッ！
rows.re: I don't care what anyone says. {7} / and I know you're no villain.
rows.speaker: Merrill

rows.en: @Didn't you surrender to spare our village, five years ago?
rows.jp: 「他の人たちが何と言おうと / わたしと[0a]ぐは / おじさんが悪い人じゃないってわかってる
rows.re: Whatever others say, {7} and I know / you're no bad man.
rows.speaker: Merrill

rows.en: @Besides, you helped the recruits from our village at Greenhell, right?
rows.jp: 「５数前だって、国の人たちを守るために / 何もしないで<88ab>降したんでしょ？
rows.re: Besides, you helped our village's / recruits at Greenhell, didn't you?
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @No one in the village thinks you're a bad man, Mister.
rows.jp: 「それだけじゃないよ / グリーンヘルでは / 国から<b:8a41>集された人を助けてくれたじゃない
rows.re: No one in the village thinks you're / a bad man, Mister.
rows.speaker: Merrill

rows.en: @I return to this village which should have been the site of my grave.
rows.jp: 「おじさんが / 悪い人だなんて思う人は / この国にはいないよ
rows.re: I return to the village that should / have been my grave.
rows.speaker: Brad

rows.en: @That scumbag Vinsfeld formed Odessa and came back before me!
rows.jp: 「『英雄』の<b:8ab8><8861>である / この国に、僕は帰ってきた / そして〜
rows.re: That scum Vinsfeld formed Odessa / and came back before me!
rows.speaker: Brad

rows.en: @He betrayed me AND my friends. I'll never forgive him!
rows.jp: 「ヤツも<f040><f042> / ヴィンスフェルトもオデッサを<b:8ab0><b:8ab1>して / 僕の前に帰ってきたッ！
rows.re: He betrayed me AND my friends. I'll / never forgive him!
rows.speaker: Brad

rows.en: @Who'd think you were once friends with our enemy, Vinsfeld?
rows.jp: 「<b:8ab9>切られた仲間のためにも / 僕はヤツを許すことができないッ！
rows.re: Who'd have thought you were once / friends with our enemy, Vinsfeld?
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @I thought it was between him and me. I wanted to settle it myself.
rows.jp: 「まさか、俺たちの相である / ヴィンスフェルトと / つながりがあったなんて〜
rows.re: To think I once had ties to / Vinsfeld, our foe...
rows.speaker: Brad

rows.en: @I never intended to involve you in my private vendetta.
rows.jp: 「これは、僕とヤツの誓認〜 / ケリは僕の手でつける / そう考えていた〜
rows.re: I never meant to drag you into my / private vendetta.
rows.speaker: Brad

rows.en: @That makes you our buddy, right, 1?
rows.jp: 「僕の私<b:8aba>に / お前たちを<8812>き込むつもりはなかった仲間なんだよね？
rows.re: That makes you our buddy, right, / {1}?
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @So what if you and Vinsfeld were buddies then, 1. You're not any more, right?
rows.jp: 「わたしたちは[05]おのこと / 仲間だと思ってもいいんだよね？
rows.re: So what if you and Vinsfeld were / once friends, {1}. Not anymore, / right?
rows.speaker: Lilka

rows.en: @I'm a member of ARMS, sworn enemy of Odessa.
rows.jp: 「<b:8a72>、ヴィンスフェルトと[05]おが / いっしょに戦った仲間だったとしても / いまは違うんだよね？
rows.re: I'm a member of ARMS, sworn enemy / of Odessa.
rows.speaker: Brad

rows.en: @The thieves who stole the data tablets were traced to this village.
rows.jp: 「いまの僕は、オデッサと戦う / ＡＲＭＳの[05]おだ
rows.re: I'm {1} of ARMS now, the ones who / fight Odessa.
rows.speaker: Brad

rows.en: @Just ahead is the ocean. They must have crossed the sea to the continent. Makes sense?
rows.jp: 「データタブレットを / <89f3>んだやつらの足取りは / この国で<b:8a8c>切れてしまったみたいだし
rows.re: The ocean's just ahead. They must / have crossed to the continent. / Makes sense?
rows.speaker: Brad

rows.en: @Knowing Vinsfeld, he could be using the abandoned facilities there as a base of operations.
rows.jp: 「確か、この先は道だよな〜 / 道を渡って<89a6>の大陸に行った / そう考えるのが<b:8abb>当なのかな？<b:8abc>えた北東にある広大な<88db><88dc>地<89e8>は / かつてスレイハイム<b:8aa6>だったところだ
rows.re: Knowing Vinsfeld, he'd use the / abandoned facilities there as a / base.
rows.speaker: Brad

rows.en: @There's a town called Quartly near there. We should start gathering information there.
rows.jp: 「ヴィンスフェルトのことだ / 破<b:8abd>され無人となった<88e4>設を / <88e6>帯にしている可能性もある
rows.re: There's a town called Quartly near / there. Let's gather information.
rows.speaker: Brad

rows.en: @But it'll be hard to get to Slayheim without a boat.
rows.jp: 「たしか、あの岸りには / クアトリーという場があるはずだ / そこで情報斬集をしてみるのはどうだ？
rows.re: But it'll be hard to reach Slayheim / without a boat.
rows.speaker: Lilka

rows.en: @Tomorrow we'll figure out a way to get to Slayheim. There has to be a way.
rows.jp: 「ただ、スレイハイム<b:8aa6>へは<89d3>が無ければ / <b:8abe><b:8abf>には行けそうもないが〜
rows.re: Tomorrow we'll find a way to / Slayheim. There has to be one.
rows.speaker: Brad

rows.en: @He has the strange habit of collecting junk and bringing it to people he likes.
rows.jp: 「スレイハイムに行く方法は / いくらでもあるはずさ / 次回、手<b:8ac0>を探そう〜
rows.re: He has an odd habit of collecting / junk and giving it to people he / likes.
rows.speaker: Merrill

rows.en: @So they realized we were using their pattern to track them.
rows.jp: 「どこからかガラクタを集めてきては / 気に入った人にあげる / 変なクセがあるのよ〜
rows.re: So they realized we were tracking / them by their own pattern.
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @Whoever did this knew a lot about data tablets.
rows.jp: 「俺たちが<8947>作パターンを頼りに / 追跡していることがバレてしまったらしい
rows.re: Whoever did this knew a great deal / about the data tablets.
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @It looks like the trail runs cold here.
rows.jp: 「機<b:8ac1>保持のための / <b:8ac2>理が<88e4>されている

rows.speaker: gossip girl

rows.en: @Get near her, and she corners you and blabs endlessly about it. Where it is, its shape.
rows.jp: 「捕まったあと、ヴァレリアシャトーの / 場所とか、面についてながながと / 話しがはじまっちゃうの〜
rows.re: Get near her and she corners you, / going on about the place. Where it / is, its shape, all of it.
rows.speaker: townswoman

rows.en: @What a bore.
rows.jp: 「つらいわぁ〜
rows.re: What a bore...
rows.speaker: townswoman

rows.en: @They're, like, so vivid, you know?
rows.jp: 「なんていうか / ビビッドなカンジよね女 / がんばってモンスターをやっつけて / お外で<b:8aa1>べるようにしてよ
rows.lit: How to put it: they're so vivid, you know?
rows.re: How to put it: they're so vivid, / you know?
rows.speaker: gossip girl

rows.en: @Promise me you will, OK?
rows.jp: 「尊重してくれる？<b:8a51>回、<b:8a51>回、お北の中で<b:8aa1>んでいると / シゲキが<b:8aa4>しくなってくるのよね
rows.lit: You'll promise me, won't you?
rows.re: You'll promise me, won't you?
rows.speaker: gossip girl

rows.en: @Or, in French, I'm tres bored.
rows.jp: 「あんにゅい剣の聖女＞をたたえる聖なる場所にて / テロ行為とは〜 / <b:8aa5>かわしいことじゃて〜<b:8aa6>〜
rows.lit: Ennui, as the French say.
rows.re: Ennui, as the French say.
rows.speaker: gossip girl

rows.en: @...the <Sword Magess> built a temple to house the Oracle of Salvation.
rows.jp: 「＜剣の聖女＞が / 救世のための救世を授かった地に / 彼女をたたえる神殿場を建てたそうじゃ
rows.lit: On the land where the <Sword Magess> received her oracle of salvation, they built a temple in her honor.
rows.re: On the land where the <Sword / Magess> received her oracle, they / built a temple in her honor.
rows.speaker: elder

rows.en: @It is known today as Sword Cathedral.
rows.jp: 「それが今の『剣の大聖堂』<f040><f042> / と、いうわけなんじゃ<b:8aa6>〜
rows.lit: And that is the "Sword Cathedral" as it stands today; so goes the tale.
rows.re: And that is the |Sword Cathedral| / as it stands today; so goes the / tale.
rows.speaker: elder

rows.re: Zzz...zzz...zzz...
rows.speaker: sleeping NPC

rows.en: @Young feller, you seem pretty busy, so I'll save this story for later.
rows.jp: 「〜なんじゃ、楽しそうじゃな若いの / だったらワシの話は / あとにさせてもらうよ
rows.lit: Oh, you look busy having fun, youngster. Then I'll save my story for later.
rows.re: Oh, you look busy having fun, / youngster. Then I'll save my story / for later.
rows.speaker: old man

rows.en: @See? I'm pretty perceptive for an old geezer, eh?
rows.jp: 「何たってワシは / 物分かりのいいジジイじゃからのう式のことは私たちが、キミたちに / 頼り過ぎていた結果なのかもしれない〜守られているんだな<b:8a80>してきたけど / この岸はいいね
rows.lit: After all, I'm a pretty understanding old geezer, see.
rows.re: After all, I'm a pretty / understanding old geezer, see.
rows.speaker: elder

rows.en: @The climate is tolerable and the monsters do not cause too much damage.
rows.jp: 「気<89f8>も悪くないし / モンスターの<889a><889b>も / 比較的、少ないみたいだ来たんだ？
rows.lit: The climate's not bad, and monster damage seems relatively light there.
rows.re: The climate's not bad, and / monster damage seems relatively / light there.
rows.speaker: elder

rows.en: @I bet the terrorists would use that hole to sneak in here. It's good I changed rooms!
rows.jp: 「もしテロがここに侵入するとしたら / あの穴からくるかもしれないからね / やっぱり部屋をかえてもらって正解だったな
rows.lit: If terrorists broke in here, they might come through that hole, so switching rooms was the right call.
rows.re: If terrorists broke in here, they / might come through that hole, so / switching rooms was the right call.
rows.speaker: guest, on his room

rows.en: @Hold on a sec. Actually, I could use that hole to escape if I had to.
rows.jp: 「〜いや、まてよ〜 / <89c1>に、あの穴は / もしもの時の脱出口に使えないか？
rows.lit: No, wait: conversely, couldn't that hole serve as an escape route in a pinch?
rows.re: No, wait: conversely, couldn't / that hole serve as an escape / route in a pinch?
rows.speaker: worrier

rows.en: @My old room was better... No, wait, no... They could... That room... Oh, I give up!
rows.jp: 「そうだとしたら元の部屋の方が〜 / いや、しかし〜やっぱり、そこから〜でも〜 / 〜う<f045><f045>ん〜う<f045><f045><f045>ん〜〜来たんだ？
rows.lit: In that case the old room would be... no, but... then again, from there... but... hmm... hmmmm...
rows.re: In that case the old room would / be... no, but... then again... / hmm... hmmmm...
rows.speaker: worrier

rows.en: @Never mind. I guess there's no point asking you.
rows.jp: 「<f040><f041><f042>って、あんたに / 聞いてもしょうがなかったんだな屋は / 屋根に穴が開いていたんだ / 実にけしからんッ！
rows.lit: ...Then again, no point asking you, was there.
rows.re: ...Then again, no point asking / you, was there.
rows.speaker: worrier

rows.en: @So I complained and had them put me in this room instead.
rows.jp: 「文句を言って / こっちの部屋に変えてもらったんだ
rows.lit: I complained and had them switch me to this room.
rows.re: I complained and had them switch me / to this room.
rows.speaker: guest

rows.en: @Did you see that? Did you witness my amazing skill and timing?
rows.jp: 「見た？ 見た？ / 見てくれたかな？ / 僕のぜつみょーなタイミングを
rows.lit: Did you see it? Did you? My exquisite timing?
rows.re: Did you see it? Did you? My / exquisite timing?
rows.speaker: kid, showing off

rows.en: @The cat must be under here. If this is what you want help with, count me in!
rows.jp: 「父ならこの辺にいるはずだ / こういうおもしろいことなら / 僕はいつでも力になるぜ父ならこの辺にいるはずだ / こういうおもしろいことなら / 僕はいつでも力になるぜ屋根に空いた穴を / ふさいでいる<b:8ab0>中なんだ
rows.lit: My dad should be around here; for something fun like this, I'm always glad to help.
rows.re: My dad should be around here; for / something fun like this, I'm / always glad to help.
rows.speaker: roof man

rows.en: @My old lady hates it, but it's handy to be able to come and go through the roof, I think.
rows.jp: 「うちのは、みっともないって言うけれど / 屋根から出入りできるなんて / 便利だと思わないか？父をとっつかまえるの手伝おうか？<b:8ab1>力してくださいッ！ / ２．あ、おかまいなく〜[1a]か父を追い込んでくれ
rows.lit: My wife says it's unsightly, but being able to come and go by the roof; handy, don't you think?
rows.re: My wife says it's unsightly, but / coming and going by the roof; / handy, don't you think?
rows.speaker: roof man

rows.en: @I have a secret weapon. Hee hee! This is no time to be fixing a roof.
rows.jp: 「この僕方に考案があるんだ / ムフフ〜 / 屋根の修理なんてやってる場合じゃないな父を追い込んでくれ
rows.lit: I've got a little scheme of my own; heh heh; this is no time to be repairing the roof.
rows.re: I've got a little scheme of my / own; heh heh; no time to be / repairing the roof.
rows.speaker: roof man

rows.en: @I have a secret weapon. Hee hee! This is no time to be fixing a roof.
rows.jp: 「この僕方に考案があるんだ / ムフフ〜 / 屋根の修理なんてやってる場合じゃないな父をつかまえたッ！父にとられた宝物っていうのは〜
rows.lit: I've got a little scheme of my own; heh heh; this is no time to be repairing the roof.
rows.re: I've got a little scheme of my / own; heh heh; no time to be / repairing the roof.
rows.speaker: roof man

rows.en: @First monsters, then terrorists. If it isn't one thing, it's another.
rows.jp: 「モンスター以外にも / テロリストなんてモノにまで / 気をつけなくちゃいけないなんて〜
rows.lit: To have to watch out for terrorists on top of monsters...
rows.re: To have to watch out for terrorists / on top of monsters...
rows.speaker: townsman

rows.en: @I, um... How... We... Nice weather we're having!
rows.jp: 「えーと〜 あの〜 / いいお天気ですね〜〜〜<f05b>
rows.lit: Um... er... n-nice weather we're having...
rows.re: Um... er... n-nice weather we're / having...
rows.speaker: shy boy

rows.en: @Really? You can use magic? I wish I could do that!
rows.jp: 「<f040><f041><f042>えッ！ / 魔法がつかえるんですか？ / す、すごくうらやましいです
rows.lit: What! You can use magic? I-I'm so envious!
rows.re: What! You can use magic? I-I'm so / envious!
rows.speaker: shy boy

rows.en: @Witches use magic, but witches are usually old hags...
rows.jp: 「〜でも、魔法使いって / おばあさんとかのイメージがありました〜
rows.lit: But I always pictured a mage as some old woman.
rows.re: But I always pictured a mage as / some old woman.
rows.speaker: girl, on sorceresses

rows.en: @Oops. I mean... I didn't mean to say you're an old hag...
rows.jp: 「<f040><f041><f042>あ、すみません<f05b> / けっして、お母さんがおばあさんという / 意味ではなくて〜〜<f05b>
rows.lit: Ah, sorry! I didn't at all mean that you're an old granny, miss...!
rows.re: Ah, sorry! I didn't at all mean / that you're an old granny, / miss...!
rows.speaker: shy boy

rows.en: @I can't do anything, so I really envy you.
rows.jp: 「ボクには、何もないから / すごくうらやましいです
rows.lit: I've got nothing, so I really envy you.
rows.re: I've got nothing, so I really envy / you.
rows.speaker: kid, to Lilka

rows.en: @I hate to interrupt your rest, but could you do me a favor?
rows.jp: 「せっかくのお休みなのに / ボクたちのお願いを / 聞いてもらって〜弁であり / キャラクター<b:8ab7>単に設定できる / 結単機能のことである
rows.lit: On your day off, no less, hearing out a favor from us...
rows.re: On your day off, no less, hearing / out a favor from us...
rows.speaker: kid

rows.en: *These skills used in battle are acquired by spending PS points.
rows.jp: ＊バトル時に効果を発揮する / この機能は / ＰＳポイントを消費することで修得できる
rows.lit: This feature, which takes effect in battle, is learned by spending PS points.
rows.re: These battle skills are learned by / spending PS points.
rows.speaker: examine — Personal Skills tutorial

rows.en: *Remember: Personal Skills cannot be changed once they are earned.
rows.jp: ＊一度、設定したパーソナルスキルは / 二度と変更が効かないので / <88f7>意が必要である修得に必要な / ＰＳポイントは / レベルが上昇するたびに、ひとつ費える
rows.lit: Once set, a Personal Skill can never be changed; take care.
rows.re: Once set, a Personal Skill can / never be changed. Take care.
rows.speaker: tutorial panel

rows.en: *The highest character level is 99, so the upper limit for PS points is also 99.
rows.jp: ＊キャラクターのレベルの上方は９９<f040><f042> / すなわちＰＳポイントの上方も / ９９ポイントとなっている
rows.lit: The character level cap is 99; hence the PS point cap is also 99.
rows.re: The character level cap is 99. / Hence the PS point cap is also / 99.
rows.speaker: tutorial panel

rows.en: *However, acquiring all Personal Skills takes more than 99 points.
rows.jp: ＊しかし、すべてのパーソナルスキルを / 修得するためには、９９ポイント以上の / ＰＳポイントが必要と設定されている
rows.lit: But learning every Personal Skill is set to require more than 99 PS points.
rows.re: But learning every Personal Skill / is set to require more than 99 PS / points.
rows.speaker: examine

rows.en: *You must strive for the ideal for your character within the given boundaries.
rows.jp: ＊与えられた範囲で / そのキャラにあった理想的なカタチを / エディットする必要があるのだ修得するのに / 必要な最<b:8abc>ＰＳポイントは１である
rows.lit: Within the given bounds, you must shape the ideal form suited to that character.
rows.re: Within the given bounds, you must / shape the ideal form suited to / that character.
rows.speaker: tutorial panel

rows.en: *Some skills require more than 1 PS point.
rows.jp: ＊だが、すべてのスキルが / ＰＳポイント１で修得できるのではない
rows.lit: But not every skill can be learned for 1 PS point.
rows.re: But not every skill can be learned / for 1 PS point.
rows.speaker: examine

rows.en: *You can acquire many simple Personal Skills, or save up to acquire a single powerful one.
rows.jp: ＊お手軽なパーソナルスキルを / たくさん設定するか / 効果の高いスキルを地道に設定するか〜
rows.lit: Set many cheap Personal Skills, or steadily set high-effect ones...
rows.re: Set many cheap Personal Skills, or / steadily set high-effect ones...
rows.speaker: examine

rows.en: @Which strategy you use is entirely up to you.
rows.jp: 「すべては / プレイヤーの手に委ねられているのだ鳥の回渡鳥になろうとする / 若き冒険者のためにこれを残す
rows.lit: All of it is entrusted to the player's hands.
rows.re: All of it is entrusted to the / player's hands.
rows.speaker: tutorial panel

rows.en: *1. Ask around for information! 2. Always reload your items! 3. Never underestimate the enemy!
rows.jp: ＊１．情報は聞いて探せッ！ / ２．アイテムの補充を忘れるなッ！ / ３．相を甘く見るなッ！
rows.lit: 1. Walk and ask for information! 2. Never forget to restock items! 3. Never underestimate the foe!
rows.re: 1. Walk and ask for information! / 2. Never forget to restock items! / 3. Never underestimate the foe!
rows.speaker: tutorial panel

rows.en: *Remember: Cowards live longer. Don't confuse bravery with recklessness.
rows.jp: ＊生き残るためには / 多少は干渉な方がいい / 無謀と勇気をはき違えるな
rows.lit: To survive, a little caution is better; don't mistake recklessness for courage.
rows.re: To survive, a little caution is / better. Don't mistake / recklessness for courage.
rows.speaker: tutorial panel

rows.en: *Lastly, never work for free!
rows.jp: ＊最後に / ただ働きはするなッ！改造ッ！改造には制方があるので / どこをどのくらい改造するかによって / アームごとに性能が変わってくる
rows.lit: Lastly: don't work for free!
rows.re: Lastly: don't work for free!
rows.speaker: examine — ARM modding

rows.en: *You can enhance your attack power, your hit probability, or your ammo count.
rows.jp: ＊攻撃力を高めるのか / 命中率を高めるのか / それとも、弾年を費やすのか
rows.lit: Raise attack power, raise hit rate, or spend on ammo count?
rows.re: Raise attack power, raise hit rate, / or spend on ammo count?
rows.speaker: examine

rows.en: *Decide what kind of ARM you want, then modify efficiently.
rows.jp: ＊どのようなアームにしたいのかを決め / 効率のよい改造をおすすめする
rows.lit: Decide what kind of ARM you want, and mod efficiently, I'd advise.
rows.re: Decide what kind of ARM you want, / and mod efficiently, I'd advise.
rows.speaker: examine

rows.en: *Trying to enhance every aspect can result in an ARM that is awkward to use.
rows.jp: ＊すべてを徹底的に / パワーアップしようとすると / 使い勝手の悪いアームになることがある
rows.lit: Trying to power up everything thoroughly can make for an ARM that's awkward to use.
rows.re: Trying to power up everything / thoroughly can make for an ARM / that's awkward to use.
rows.speaker: examine

rows.en: *You can't undo an upgrade, so upgrade according to a plan.
rows.jp: ＊一度改造すると、元に戻せないので / 改造には特独性が重要となる鳥と呼ばれし者たち鳥』と呼ばれる / 多くの冒険者たちがいる
rows.lit: An upgrade once made cannot be undone, so planning matters in upgrading.
rows.re: An upgrade once made cannot be / undone, so planning matters in / upgrading.
rows.speaker: tutorial panel

rows.en: *Mercs can be broadly divided into two types.
rows.jp: ＊『渡り鳥』は / 大きく分けると二つのタイプに分かれる
rows.lit: "Mercs" split broadly into two types.
rows.re: "Mercs" split broadly into two / types.
rows.speaker: examine — Merc lore

rows.en: *One type hunts for treasures in the ruins.
rows.jp: ＊一つは、遺跡に潜り、探索しながら / 遺跡にある宝物を手に入れようとするタイプ
rows.lit: One type dives into ruins, exploring, trying to claim the treasures within.
rows.re: One type dives into ruins, / exploring, trying to claim the / treasures within.
rows.speaker: examine

rows.en: *The other does freelance work, fighting monsters or acting as bodyguards for money.
rows.jp: ＊もう一つは、人々の<8923>頼を受け / モンスターを倒したり、護衛をしたり / それによって報酬を得るものたち
rows.lit: The other takes people's requests, slaying monsters or guarding, and earns their pay thereby.
rows.re: The other takes people's / requests, slaying monsters or / guarding, and earns pay thereby.
rows.speaker: tutorial panel

rows.en: *Remember that the public considers both types to be scoundrels.
rows.jp: ＊どちらにせよ、世間一般の人々から見れば / ならず者と大差ないことを / 知っておく必要がある
rows.lit: Either way, in the eyes of ordinary folk they're little different from ruffians; you should know that.
rows.re: Either way, in the eyes of ordinary / folk they're little different from / ruffians; you should know that.
rows.speaker: examine

rows.en: *That means our behavior affects our reputation. That is a heavy responsibility.
rows.jp: ＊ゆえに、自分たちの行動いかんによって / その評判が上辺する / その責任の重さも知っておくのだ屋根なんかに<b:8ad1>ってたら / また[0a]かに / 叱られちゃうかな？屋根に<b:8ad1>ろうッ！ / ２．屋根なんかに<b:8ad1>ってる場合じゃないか[1a]か屋根に<b:8ad1>るのは / [05]ぉにまかせようッ！屋根なんかに<b:8ad1>ってたら / また[0a]かに / 叱られちゃうかな？
rows.lit: Hence their repute rises or falls by their own conduct; know too the weight of that responsibility.
rows.re: Their repute rises or falls by / their own conduct. Know too the / weight of that responsibility.
rows.speaker: tutorial panel

rows.en: @The rate is Gella/night per person. So people makes Gella total. OK?2
rows.jp: 「おひとり方につき一緒[02]ギャラ / [02]人方ですので、[02]ギャラとなります / よろしいですか？[18]か
rows.lit: It's {n} Gella per person, and for {n} people that's {n} Gella. Is that all right?
rows.re: It's {n} Gella per person, and for / {n} people that's {n} Gella. Is / that all right?
rows.speaker: Innkeeper

rows.en: @Anyway, you have visitors.
rows.jp: 「それよりもお配達が来ているわよ
rows.lit: More to the point, a friend of yours is here.
rows.re: More to the point, a friend of / yours is here.
rows.speaker: Baker's wife

rows.jp: <b:8ada>れた遺跡』の〜 / そうか、元気してたか[0a]ぎ？

rows.en: @But I wouldn't be if you hadn't rescued me, Dude!
rows.jp: 「あんちゃんが / 僕を助けてくれたおかげだよ
rows.lit: It's all thanks to you saving me, Dude.
rows.re: It's all thanks to you saving me, / Dude.
rows.speaker: Tony

rows.jp: 「えっと〜配達なんだ<b:8adb>にお目にかかります
rows.lit: Um...
rows.re: Um...
rows.speaker: girl

rows.en: @In my humble opinion, you would seem to be a very good person.
rows.jp: 「わたくしなりの結論といたしましては / どうやらあなたは / とても良い人とお見受けしました
rows.lit: My conclusion is that you appear to be a very good person.
rows.re: My conclusion is that you appear to / be a very good person.
rows.speaker: Scott

rows.en: @I am pleased to make your acquaintance.
rows.jp: 「これからも / お見知りおきをよろしくお願いします父さんも母さんもいないから / いつも３人いっしょなんです
rows.lit: Please continue to think kindly of us.
rows.re: Please continue to think kindly of / us.
rows.speaker: Scott / Tim

rows.en: @We're so glad that our dear friend {5} is alright. Thank you, 0.
rows.jp: 「大好きな[0a]ぎくんが無事で / ホントによかった / [05]ぉさんありがとう来たんだ<b:8a87>っている人を助けるのが仕事だろ
rows.lit: I'm so glad our dear {5} is safe; thank you, {1}.
rows.re: I'm so glad our dear {5} is safe. / Thank you, {1}.
rows.speaker: kid

rows.en: @Well, we need your help! We can't do this on our own!
rows.jp: 「力を貸してくれよ / 僕たちじゃどうしようもできないんだ楽しいんだ[1a]か父を〜 / 家父を捕まえてほしいんだ
rows.lit: Lend us your strength. We can't do anything on our own.
rows.re: Lend us your strength. We can't do / anything on our own.
rows.speaker: Tony, the favor

rows.en: @This kitten made off with a treasure of ours.
rows.jp: 「家父に / 僕の大事な宝物を / とられちゃったんだ〜
rows.lit: That cat took a treasure precious to me.
rows.re: That cat took a treasure precious / to me.
rows.speaker: Tony

rows.en: @It's the kitten up there on the roof.
rows.jp: 「わかるかな？ / あの屋根の上にいる家父がそうなんだ論といたしましては / とられたままでは実にカッコ悪い、と
rows.lit: See it? That cat up on the roof is the one.
rows.re: See it? That cat up on the roof is / the one.
rows.speaker: Tony

rows.en: @We find ourselves unable to remedy the situation as the kitten is on a roof.
rows.jp: 「何とかしたいのは、やまやまなのですが / いかんともしがたいのは / 家父ちゃんは屋根の上ということです
rows.lit: We badly want to do something, but the trouble is the cat is up on the roof.
rows.re: We badly want to do something, but / the trouble is the cat is up on the / roof.
rows.speaker: Scott

rows.en: @I am sorry to bother you, but can you do something?
rows.jp: 「ごめんなさい / 何とかなりませんか？
rows.lit: Sorry, but could you do something?
rows.re: Sorry, but could you do something?
rows.speaker: Scott

rows.en: @That's cool. But I still wanna thank you for the other day. Here, take this.
rows.jp: 「うん、わかったよ / でもさ、アン時のお礼くらいは / 受け取ってくれよな
rows.lit: Yeah, okay; but at least let me thank you for that time; here, take it.
rows.re: Yeah, okay; but at least let me / thank you for that time; here, / take it.
rows.speaker: kid

rows.en: @This is a Medium. It supposedly contains the power of a Guardian.
rows.jp: 「これはミーディアムといって / ガーディアンの力が / 押っているといわれてるんです

rows.jp: 「あ、単にいいって、返さなくても / 僕があげたくて勝手にあげたんだから / だけど、大切にしてくれよな<b:8a88>ったんだが / やっぱり[05]ぉに / あげたヤツの方が使いやすかったな軽率された時 / <89d5>度、タウンメリアにいたんだが〜

rows.jp: ＊平和を望む人々の願望は / やがて、スレイハイム王公を打倒し / 跡跡的な勝利をつかむこととなる

rows.re: The people's wish for peace toppled / the king of Slayheim and seized a / miraculous victory.
rows.speaker: history book

rows.re: But in peacetime, the "hero" loses / his purpose...
rows.speaker: history book — the turn

rows.jp: ＊戦犯犯罪人として / 捕らえられた『英雄』は / こうして歴史から抹消されたのである守護押公全を守護する役<8913>を<8847>っている

rows.speaker: history book

rows.re: Now she is the <Sword Magess>, / sword in one hand, a wolf at her / side.
rows.speaker: legend

rows.jp: 「同じ輝なら / 私は<b:8a6d>み込んでくれるような / <89ab>しい輝を望んでいます<b:8a5a>方は / 以前にも<b:8a6f>して力を求めています
rows.lit: If it's the same brilliance, I hope for a gentle one that wraps around me.
rows.re: If it's brilliance either way, I / hope for a gentle kind that wraps / around me.
rows.speaker: crew member, founders' council

rows.en: @If I could choose, I would pick a gentle light that envelopes me softly.
rows.jp: 「まるで、自分の身体だけではなく / この世界そのものを / 支えようとしているみたいに〜
rows.lit: As if he is trying to support not just his own body, but this world itself.
rows.re: As if he's trying to support not / just himself, but this world / itself.
rows.speaker: crew member, founders' council

rows.en: @It's as if he's trying to support not just his own body, but the world itself.
rows.jp: 「<b:8a5a>方と私の大<b:8a71>きなファルガイア〜 / 人ひとりの力で支えられるモノでしょうか？
rows.lit: My friend, and this Filgaia I love so much. Can it be supported by the strength of one person?
rows.re: My friend, and this Filgaia I love / so much. Can one person bear it / all?
rows.speaker: crew member, founders' council

rows.en: @But can our beloved Filgaia be supported by any one person?
rows.jp: 「どうか<b:8a5a>方を助けてください / 私には無い、<b:8a5a>方と<b:8a72>に<b:8a73>ぶ力を持つ / あなた方なら、きっと〜<b:8a5a>方がお<b:8a74>方に<b:8a75>うなんて / 本当にめずらしいこと〜
rows.lit: Please help my friend. You, who have the strength to stand beside him that I lack, surely you can...
rows.re: Please help my friend. You have the / strength to stand at his side. / Surely...
rows.speaker: crew member, founders' council

rows.en: @Please help my brother! You are strong, unlike me... Nearly as strong as my brother!
rows.jp: 「何でもひとりでかかえ込んでしまうのが / <b:8a5a>方の悪いクセなのです
rows.lit: Taking everything on alone is my friend's bad habit.
rows.re: Taking everything on alone is my / friend's bad habit.
rows.speaker: crew member, founders' council

rows.en: @He has a bad habit of taking everything upon himself.
rows.jp: 「誰も、ひとりで全てをこなすほどの / 力など持っているはずがありません
rows.lit: No one could possibly have the strength to handle everything alone.
rows.re: No one could possibly have the / strength to handle it all alone.
rows.speaker: crew member, founders' council

rows.en: @But no one has the strength to do everything all alone.
rows.jp: 「でも、誰もが / 誰かを助ける力を持っている<f040><f042> / そうではありませんか？
rows.lit: But everyone has the strength to help someone. Isn't that so?
rows.re: But everyone has the strength to / help someone. Isn't that so?
rows.speaker: crew member, founders' council

rows.en: @Yet everyone has the strength to help others... Isn't it ironic?
rows.jp: 「街道の<89fc>の流れが / 海岸に向かっているからね
rows.lit: Because the road's current flows toward the coast.
rows.re: Because the road's current flows / toward the coast.
rows.speaker: crew member, founders' council

rows.en: @'Cause the inland sea's current flows toward the beach.
rows.jp: 「『街道の落とし物は海岸で探せ』<f040><f042> / 〜って、<b:8a76>、何かで聞いた事あるよ<b:8a71>きミーちゃんが / キミたちの怪獣カードを<b:8a77>定してあげよう[18]か
rows.lit: "Search the coast for what the road drops," or something. I've heard that somewhere.
rows.re: "Search the coast for what the road / drops." Heard that somewhere.
rows.speaker: crew member, founders' council

rows.en: @Like the old saying, 'Lost at sea, found at the beach.'
rows.jp: 「でも、レアものの集まりが / もうちょっとかな？
rows.lit: But the collection of rare ones, maybe just a bit more?
rows.re: But my collection of rare ones? / Maybe just a bit short still.
rows.speaker: crew member, founders' council

rows.en: @But I don't see too many rare ones, ya know?
rows.jp: 「<b:8a78>られた地<b:8a79>や / 結単な手<b:8a7a>を用いないと / 現われない怪獣もいるからね
rows.lit: Because some monsters won't appear unless you use certain terrain or simple methods.
rows.re: Some monsters won't appear without / certain terrain or methods.
rows.speaker: crew member, founders' council

rows.en: @Some monsters only appear in certain areas or when you use special techniques.
rows.jp: 「マニアなら / そこらへんも<b:8a7b>さえとかなきゃッ！
rows.lit: If you're a real fan, you'd better have that covered too!
rows.re: If you're a real fan, you'd better / have that covered too!
rows.speaker: crew member, founders' council

rows.en: @A real fan should know these things!
rows.jp: 「話はすれども、<b:8a7c>は見えず / ウワサのエイミー・フェアチャイルドとは / ボクのことだよ
rows.lit: You hear the voice but never see the face. That rumored Amy Fairchild is me.
rows.re: You hear the voice, never see the / face. That famous Amy Fairchild is / me.
rows.speaker: Amy Fairchild

rows.en: @It's me, Amy Fairchild! The face behind the voice you know and love so well!
rows.jp: 「ミーちゃんって呼んでね☆<b:8a7d>と指揮に無くてはなりません
rows.lit: Call me Mee-chan, okay? ☆
rows.re: Call me Mee-chan, okay? ☆
rows.speaker: Amy Fairchild

rows.en: @You can call me |A.|
rows.jp: 「緊急事態に対する決断力と意外性 / そして、先を見<b:8a41>した達観力は / 誰よりも<b:8a7e>でていると思いませんか？<b:8a75>いしましたね？
rows.lit: His decisiveness and unpredictability in an emergency, and his foresight beyond anyone's, don't you think he's more outstanding than anyone else?
rows.re: His decisiveness and / unpredictability in a crisis are / unmatched.
rows.speaker: Amy Fairchild

rows.en: @He has such amazing judgment and is so perceptive yet never predictable in battle.
rows.jp: 「エイミーとふたり / オペレート<8847>当している / テレパスメイジです大<b:8a7f>なのさ
rows.lit: Amy and I, the two of us, handle operations. We're telepath mages.
rows.re: Amy and I handle operations, the / two of us. We're telepath mages.
rows.speaker: Amy Fairchild

rows.en: @Amy and I are the operators. We're also both telepaths.
rows.jp: 「そんなもの、飛ばすどころか / <b:8a80>持するだけで / 最大な<b:8a82>用がかかっちまうんだが〜
rows.lit: A thing like that, forget flying it, even just keeping it maintained costs a fortune.
rows.re: Forget flying that thing. Just / keeping it maintained costs a / fortune.
rows.speaker: Ebecho / Chateau engineer

rows.en: @Just keeping her running is expensive enough -- not to mention flying her!
rows.jp: 「<b:8a83><b:8a84>方のヴァレリア<b:8a85>はいざしらず / オデッサの連中 / どこから<b:8a86>金を調達しているんだ？<b:8b08>[15]ぉ込[10][19]<b:8a87><b:8a88><8847>当だ
rows.lit: Setting aside your Valeria household, where are those Odessa people raising their funds from?
rows.re: Setting the Valeria house aside, / where does Odessa raise its funds?
rows.speaker: Ebecho / Chateau engineer

rows.en: @I know Sir Valeria is loaded, but where does Odessa get all that money?
rows.jp: 「飛空機艇と / 女の家のあつかいに関しては / ファルガイアじゃ一番のつもりさ
rows.lit: When it comes to handling airships and ladies, I figure I'm the best in Filgaia.
rows.re: When it comes to airships and / ladies, I'm the best in Filgaia.
rows.speaker: Erwin / chief pilot

rows.en: @I'm the best in Filgaia at handling flyin' machines and pretty ladies!
rows.jp: 「そんな僕に何か用かい？[18]か<b:8b08>[15]ぷ込[10][19]<b:8a89>り降りは / <b:8a5b>着魔法<b:8a5c>の上のみでおこなわれるのさ
rows.lit: Something you need from me?
rows.re: Something you need from me?
rows.speaker: Erwin / chief pilot

rows.en: @What can I do for ya?2
rows.jp: 「ヴァレリアシャトーに<b:8a89>りたいときは / <b:8a5b>着魔法<b:8a5c>上で[0b]かボタンを<b:8a7b>してくれ / <887c><b:8a89>コールを聞きつけたら回斬してやるぜ
rows.lit: When you want to board Valeria Chateau, press the [0b] button on the launch circle. Once I hear the boarding call, I'll come get you.
rows.re: To board, press the [0b] button on / the launch circle. I'll come get / you on the call.
rows.speaker: Erwin / chief pilot

rows.en: @To board, stand on a Landing Pad and press the 2 button. I'll bring you aboard after the boarding call.
rows.jp: 「ヴァレリアシャトーから降りたいときは / これまた<b:8a5b>着魔法<b:8a5c>上で / [0b]がボタンだ
rows.lit: When you want to disembark from Valeria Chateau, it's the [0b] button, again on the launch circle.
rows.re: To leave, again stand on the launch / circle and press the [0b] button.
rows.speaker: Erwin / chief pilot

rows.en: @To leave Valeria Chateau, you press the 3 button while over a Landing Pad.
rows.jp: 「<b:8a5b>着魔法<b:8a5c>の上以外の場所で / [0b]がボタンを<b:8a7b>すと / <b:8a8a>用メニューが開かれる
rows.lit: If you press the [0b] button anywhere other than on the launch circle, a dedicated menu opens.
rows.re: Press [0b] anywhere else, and a / special menu opens up instead.
rows.speaker: Erwin / chief pilot

rows.en: @If you press the 3 button when not over a Landing Pad, the Special Menu comes up.
rows.jp: 「ヴァレリアシャトー街での行動や / 僕に<b:8a87>最を任せるときは / <b:8a8a>用メニューを開いてくれよなッ！
rows.lit: For getting around Valeria Chateau, or when you want to leave the piloting to me, open that dedicated menu!
rows.re: To move around the Chateau, or / leave piloting to me, open that / menu!
rows.speaker: Erwin / chief pilot

rows.en: @Use the Special Menu to move through Valeria Chateau or have me pilot her.
rows.jp: 「カオの良さに反比<8943>して / なぜだか目立たない僕からのお願いだッ！ / 出番たのむぜッ！[18]か<b:8b04>[09]ツ方チ<b:8b04>[09]ツ告
rows.lit: This is a request from me, who somehow goes unnoticed in inverse proportion to my good looks. Give me my moment to shine!
rows.re: Even good-looking as I am, nobody / notices me! Give me my moment to / shine!
rows.speaker: Erwin / chief pilot

rows.en: @I'm handsome but I still don't get noticed enough, so let me fly whenever you can!2
rows.jp: 「オデッサのバルキサスも / 同方の動力機関が / <887c><887d>されていたと思うな室長 / ガバチョである
rows.lit: I bet Odessa's Varukisas had a similar propulsion system installed too.
rows.re: I bet Odessa's Varukisas had a / similar engine installed too.
rows.speaker: Ebecho / Chateau engineer

rows.en: @Odessa's Varukisas must have had a similar engine.
rows.jp: 「ちなみに前<b:8a3e>は / <b:8a8d>乗だったのだッ！
rows.lit: By the way, before this, I was a [?] pilot!
rows.re: By the way, before this, I used to / be a pilot!
rows.speaker: Gubacho / chief engineer

rows.en: @I owned a butcher shop before I joined the service.
rows.jp: 「枯急の事態にて / ＡＲＭＳに<b:8a8e>せ<b:8a8f>じたのだ / よろしくたのむぞ<b:8a90>料無くては飛べません
rows.lit: In this urgent crisis, I threw myself into ARMS. Nice to work with you.
rows.re: In this urgent crisis, I threw / myself into ARMS. Nice to work with / you.
rows.speaker: Gubacho / chief engineer

rows.en: @I joined ARMS to help out during this crisis. Pleased to meet ya.
rows.jp: 「機関胞の<b:8a91>くれとして / オデッサのエネルギー事情〜 / 気になりますね
rows.lit: As a fellow engineer, Odessa's energy situation... it's something I wonder about.
rows.re: As a fellow engineer, I do wonder / about Odessa's energy situation.
rows.speaker: Ebecho / Chateau engineer

rows.en: @I'm a bit of an engineer, you know, so I wonder what kind of energy Odessa uses.
rows.jp: 「ちなみに<b:8a92>人的なエネルギー事情ですが / 以前、ボクのソースたぷたぷコロッケが / ちょっと目を離したスキに消失したのです
rows.lit: As for my own personal energy situation, my juicy croquette in sauce vanished the moment I looked away.
rows.re: Speaking of my own energy / situation, my croquette vanished / when I looked away.
rows.speaker: Gubacho / chief engineer

rows.en: @As for my source of energy, my chili cheeseburger disappeared earlier.
rows.jp: 「まさか、シャトー街に侵入してきた / オデッサのふたりが / わきめもふらずにモリモリと〜
rows.lit: Don't tell me those two Odessa infiltrators who snuck into the Chateau devoured it without a second glance.
rows.re: Don't tell me those two Odessa / infiltrators just gobbled it right / up.
rows.speaker: Gubacho / chief engineer

rows.en: @You don't suppose those two Odessa infiltrators gobbled them up, do you?
rows.jp: 「ちなみに前<b:8a3e>は / <b:8a8d>乗のせがれでしたッ！
rows.lit: By the way, before this, I was the son of a [?] pilot!
rows.re: By the way, before this, I was a / pilot's son!
rows.speaker: Gubacho / chief engineer

rows.en: @Before I joined the service, I worked at dad's butcher shop.
rows.jp: 「<b:8a93>ちゃんに逃げられた / <b:8a94>ちゃんをひとりにしておけないから / こうしてＡＲＭＳに<b:8a8e>せ<b:8a8f>じました射の<b:8a96>が残らないわよ<b:8a97>しいこと考えないで射しちゃうぞ<b:8a98><b:8a99>場から生きて戻ってこれたのね射で分せないものはないわ<b:8a9a>乗なんかで / [89]
rows.lit: Since [?]-chan ran off and I couldn't leave [?]-chan alone, I threw myself into ARMS like this.
rows.re: I couldn't leave my dad alone after / Mom left, so I threw myself into / ARMS.
rows.speaker: Ebecho / Chateau engineer

rows.en: @Dad's been alone since Mom left. I wanted to be with him, so I joined ARMS, too.
rows.jp: 「まだ見ぬ新しい<b:8aa3>開が / きっと待っているはずだぜ<b:8aa4>するヴァレリアシャトーッ！ / だけど、着陸できるポイントが / あまりにも少なすぎるんだよな〜
rows.lit: A new development you haven't seen yet is surely waiting.
rows.re: A new development you haven't seen / yet is surely waiting.
rows.speaker: Erwin / chief pilot

rows.en: @I'm sure this will lead to something new for you.
rows.jp: 「そういえばシャトーの２Ｆに / 以前、地面のエネルギーとかを / <b:8a48>行していたヤツがいたな<b:8aa5>の通信<b:8aa6>術のひとつだ
rows.lit: Come to think of it, there was someone on the Chateau's 2nd floor once studying earth energy or something.
rows.re: Come to think of it, someone on the / 2nd floor once studied earth / energy.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @Hey, someone on the 2nd floor of Valeria Chateau was studying terrestrial energy, right?
rows.jp: 「カタチにとらわれずに / 物事を為していく〜 / <b:8aa7><b:8a44>なようで、<b:8a97>しいことだ
rows.lit: Doing things without being bound by form. It seems reckless, but it's something new.
rows.re: Doing things without being bound by / form. Reckless, but something new.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @Creating innovative devices like this requires creativity. It isn't easy to do.
rows.jp: 「それをやってのけるんだから / テロリスト・オデッサ〜 / あなどれない相だろう
rows.lit: Since they can actually pull that off, the terrorist Odessa is not a foe to underestimate.
rows.re: Since they can actually pull that / off, Odessa's not a foe to / underestimate.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @But Odessa did it. They are an enemy we must not underestimate, obviously.
rows.jp: 「くそッ、僕だって<b:8aa8>けてたまるかよッ！ / スゴイの<89db>め込んで / オトコをあげてやらあッ！<b:8a56><89ca>さ
rows.lit: Damn it, I won't lose either! I'll pour in something amazing and become a real man!
rows.re: Damn it, I won't lose either! I'll / pour it on and show you a real man!
rows.speaker: Erwin / chief pilot

rows.en: @I bet you think you're hot stuff, don't you? Trying to show off with that in there...
rows.jp: 「以前は / 心を伝える不思議な渓谷の / <b:8aa9>出に使われていたらしいぞ
rows.lit: It's said this used to be used for exporting the strange, thought-transmitting valley crystal.
rows.re: It's said this used to transport / the strange thought-crystal from / the valley.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @It was once used to transport an amazing crystal that could transmit thoughts.
rows.jp: 「彼らもヴァレリア<b:8a85>に<b:8aaa><b:8aab>されて / ファルガイア中に派<b:8aac>されているらしい
rows.lit: They too are made by the Valeria house and dispatched all over Filgaia, it's said.
rows.re: They're made by the Valeria house / too, and sent out across Filgaia.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @Sir Valeria created them and deployed them all over Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「設立は / ＡＲＭＳよりもずっと早いから / 僕たちの<b:8a5a><b:8a83>分ってトコかもな<b:8a85>は / シエルジェ自分領にて / さまざまな<b:8a4b>誓を<b:8a4b>んできました
rows.lit: Since they were founded much earlier than ARMS, maybe they're kind of our senior allies.
rows.re: They were founded well before ARMS, / so maybe they're our senior allies.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @They've been around a lot longer than ARMS, so they kinda have seniority over us.
rows.jp: 「最後に大<b:8a4e><b:8a4b>を<b:8aad>めてから / 今度はファルガイアの注目<b:8a80>持のために / ここに帰ってきたのです<b:8a85>は作戦指揮と同時に / 更なる一手を考えているのです
rows.lit: After finally mastering the great [?] art, he came back here this time to keep watch over Filgaia.
rows.re: After finally mastering that great / art, he came back to watch over / Filgaia.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @He studied astronomy last, and now has returned to help preserve peace in Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「遠く、ファルガイアのこれからを / 注目に<b:8ab0>くために〜<b:8ab1><b:8ab2>から保護せし剣〜 / 『アガートラーム』は / ヴァレリア<b:8a85>が<b:8ab5>け<b:8ab6>ぐべきだったのです
rows.lit: In order to keep a distant eye on Filgaia's future...
rows.re: In order to keep a distant eye on / Filgaia's future...
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @One that will assure peace in all of Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「いったい〜 / いつから、何が、どのようにして / <b:8ab7>陸が<b:8ab8>いはじめたのでしょうか〜<b:8a85>は / 誰よりも強く / ファルガイアを愛しています
rows.lit: Just when, what, and how did the continent start to go wrong?
rows.re: Just when, and how, did the / continent start to go wrong?
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @But somewhere, somehow, things went awry. How? Why?
rows.jp: 「そして、表にはあまり出しませんが / <b:8a52>様もとても大切にしています<b:8a85>は理想と同時に / 現実を見つめることができる方です
rows.lit: And though he doesn't show it much, he also treasures his [younger sister] very much.
rows.re: And though he rarely shows it, he / treasures his little sister too.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @He doesn't show it, but he also adores his younger sister.
rows.jp: 「ですから、ＡＲＭＳの戦力アップに / 多少、ムチャな作戦をとることもあるのです<b:8a85>は / 誰よりもファルガイアを愛しています
rows.lit: That's why, to raise ARMS's fighting strength, he sometimes takes on somewhat reckless plans.
rows.re: That's why, to raise ARMS's / strength, he sometimes takes / reckless risks.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @So he may take extreme steps to strengthen ARMS.
rows.jp: 「ですから、本当なら指揮<899d>ではなく / 最前線で得意の剣や魔法を / <b:8aba>るいたかったに違いありません
rows.lit: That's why, in truth, rather than being a commander, he surely wanted to wield his sword and magic at the front line instead.
rows.re: Rather than command, he surely / wanted to wield his sword up front.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @Instead of commanding, I'm sure he wanted to use his sword and spells at the front line.
rows.jp: 「あの事故さえなければ〜<b:8a65>な事故が原因で / ヴァレリア<b:8a85>は<b:8abb>足が / 不自由になってしまったんだ
rows.lit: If only that accident hadn't happened...
rows.re: If only that accident hadn't / happened...
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @If not for that accident...
rows.jp: 「剣<b:8aa6>も魔法も / 誰よりも<89ab>れた<b:8abc>えをみせた / お人だったのに〜
rows.lit: He was a man who showed brilliance beyond anyone in both swordsmanship and magic...
rows.re: He showed brilliance beyond anyone, / in both swordsmanship and magic...
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @And he showed such brilliance in swordsmanship and the casting of spells...
rows.jp: 「本当に残念です<b:8abd>は / 『英雄』を招きずって生きてきたんだ
rows.lit: It's truly a shame.
rows.re: It's truly a shame.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @How truly unfortunate.
rows.jp: 「それは、僕たちが考えるよりも / ずっと<b:8ac0><b:8ac1>めいたモノに違いない〜
rows.lit: That must be something far more [?] than we imagine.
rows.re: That must be something far deeper / than we could ever imagine.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @The allure such status holds must be strong indeed.
rows.jp: 「ヴァレリア<b:8a85>が何をしようとしたのか〜 / いや、何をしようとしているのか / 僕にはわからない〜
rows.lit: What the Valeria house tried to do, no, what it's trying to do, I don't know.
rows.re: What the Valeria house tried to do, / or is still trying to do, I don't / know.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @I don't know what Sir Valeria tried to do... or is still trying to do.
rows.jp: 「だけど、そいつは / 英雄伝説に<b:8aba>り回された / <b:8ac2><b:8ac3>に斬重していくんじゃないか〜剣の少女＞の〜 / 伝説の時代の『英雄』の<b:8ac5>を / 現在に招いているヴァレリア<b:8abd>〜
rows.lit: But isn't that someone being tossed about by the hero legend, sinking deeper into [?]?
rows.re: But isn't he just being tossed / about by the hero legend, sinking / ever deeper?
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @I fear his desire to hold onto his heroic status will have tragic conclusions.

rows.en: @Wait a minute... Red... eyes? Um...
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>さびしいです〜
