rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @I miss the activity.
rows.jp: 「何だか、最近、サッパリです〜
rows.re: Somehow, lately, it's / all dried up.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @But now it's deserted.
rows.jp: 「そして、ここから先にあるのは / [0a]お方のお部乗ですけど〜 / お部乗でお見かけすることは〜
rows.re: And ahead from here is / {1}'s room, though I rarely / see her there.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @The southern room is supposed to be {1}'s room, but she's never there.
rows.jp: 「〜あ、いえいえ / けっして立ち聞きしていたわけじゃ / ありませんから〜
rows.re: Ah, no, no. It's not / like I was eavesdropping / or anything.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Huh? Who, me? No, no. I wasn't eavesdropping. No, not me.
rows.jp: 「〜あ、いえいえ / けっして立ち聞きしたわけじゃ / ありませんから〜
rows.re: Ah, no, no. It's not / like I was eavesdropping / or anything.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Huh? Who, me? No, no. I wasn't eavesdropping. No, not me.
rows.jp: 「〜あ、いえいえ / けっして立ち聞きしたわけじゃ / ありませんから〜室と / [0a]ぉ方と[0a]お方の / 私室が用意されています
rows.re: Ah, no, no. It's not / like I was eavesdropping / or anything.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Huh? Who, me? No, no. I wasn't eavesdropping. No, not me.
rows.jp: 「ヴァレリア<b:8a85>はご多少な方です / お部乗にいらっしゃらないようでしたら / 他のフロアかもしれません
rows.re: Sir Valeria is always / busy. If he's not in / his room, try another floor.
rows.speaker: propagated:text

rows.en: @Sir Valeria is always busy. If he is not in his room, he may be on another floor.
rows.jp: 「他のフロアに向かう場合は / 正面のエレベーターを / ご利用ください<b:8b26><b:8a79>というのは / この星の心<b:8b27>部〜 / 中心部分をさしているんだ
rows.re: If you're heading to / another floor, please / use the elevator ahead.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @To get to other floors, please use the elevator straight ahead.
rows.jp: 「古い言い伝えで、ファルガイアの中心には / すべての生命の<b:8b0d>となった / <b:8b28>く<b:8b29>く<b:8b2a>の道が広がっているという〜
rows.re: Old legend says at Filgaia's heart / lies a sea of blue mud, the origin / of all life.
rows.speaker: propagated:text

rows.en: @According to legend, it's a sea of blue mud that is the origin of all life.
rows.jp: 「『グラブ・ル・ガブル』〜 / 命の始<8869>、<b:8b2a>の道にて / ヴァレリア<b:8a85>は、いったい何を〜<b:8ad7>まれていったように / 人々の心も<b:8afa>いあらされていく / 『<b:8b2b>望』という名に<b:8a6b>われていく〜
rows.lit: An old legend says a road of blue mud, the source of all life, spreads at Filgaia's center.
rows.re: Old legend says a road of blue / mud, the source of all life, lies / at Filgaia's heart.
rows.speaker: Chateau NPC

rows.en: @What could Sir Valeria want at 'Glaive Le Gable', the sea of mud, the wellspring of life?
rows.jp: 「まるで『<b:8ace>の<b:8ab1><b:8ab2>』が / ファルガイアを<b:8b2c>き<b:8ae8>くそうとした / 伝<b:8b2d>の時代、そのままに〜<b:8b2e>空にポツンと暗い<b:8b2f>みが落ち / そこから広がるように / 空が<b:8ad7>まれていった〜
rows.lit: "Glaive Le Gable," the mud road where life began; what could Sir Valeria want there?
rows.re: |Glaive Le Gable|, the mud road / where life began. What could Sir / Valeria want there?
rows.speaker: Chateau NPC

rows.en: @It's just like the legendary age when |Blaze of Disaster| tried to burn up Filgaia
rows.jp: 「〜でも、それに先立って / 大きな衛星がファルガイアを / 大切っていったんだ〜
rows.re: But just before that, a great / comet passed close by Filgaia.
rows.speaker: propagated:text

rows.en: @Just before that, a huge comet came very close to Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「空の<b:8b30>失と衛星の搭近〜 / ふたつの間に / 因果関係は無いのだろうか〜<b:8b31><b:8b32>反射のみならず / 駆動<b:8b31>、<8868>反応、視信的捕<8993>〜
rows.re: The sky's loss and the comet's / approach. Is there no link / between them?
rows.speaker: propagated:text

rows.en: @Could the comet's approach be somehow related to the devouring of the sky?
rows.jp: 「あらゆる<887e>相機能から / その存在を消し<b:8a47>る / ウィザードリィステルス〜
rows.lit: The sky's loss and the comet's approach; is there no causal link between the two?
rows.re: The sky's loss and the comet's / approach. Is there no link / between them?
rows.speaker: Chateau NPC

rows.en: @of surveillance: sound, vibration, heat, and visual.
rows.jp: 「だが、存在を消し<b:8a47>れるのは / ステルス対<b:8b33>である / ヘイムダル・ガッツォーのみだッ！
rows.lit: Wizardry Stealth erases its presence from every mode of surveillance.
rows.re: Wizardry Stealth erases it from / every form of surveillance.
rows.speaker: Chateau NPC

rows.en: @But it is designed to work only for Heimdal Gazzo!
rows.jp: 「システムを支える魔界鍵は<8991><8992>同部〜 / それだけに、強力な<b:8ae9>衛星<b:8a5c>を / <b:8b35>いてくるかもしれないな〜<b:8b36>を<b:8aaa><b:8aab>して / アルケミックプラントの / 調査をすすめているんだ
rows.lit: But the only thing it renders invisible is the stealth unit itself, the Heimdal Gazzo!
rows.re: But it only hides the stealth / unit itself, the Heimdal Gazzo!
rows.speaker: Chateau NPC

rows.en: @Diablo Pillar, the system's heart, is exposed, and defenses are sure to be tight.
rows.jp: 「最大<b:8b37>域のエネルギー<b:8b38>だからな / その使い<b:8b39>が気になるだろう？
rows.re: It's a top-tier power plant. Makes / you wonder what it's for, doesn't / it?
rows.speaker: propagated:text

rows.en: @We gotta know what such a huge power plant is being used for.
rows.jp: 「パイプラインの / <89c1>探知をおこなっているんだが〜 / 結果は、もう少しまってくれよ<b:8a79>を<b:8b3a>行することが可能だ
rows.re: We're tracing the pipeline now. / Give us a bit longer for results.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @We're tracing the pipeline right now, but it'll take a little longer.
rows.jp: 「だけど、その着陸可能ポイントの少なさと / サーチシステムが使えない帯が / 不<b:8b3b>といえば不<b:8b3b>だな
rows.re: But so few landing points, / and dead zones for the search / system, are a bit of a nuisance.
rows.speaker: propagated:text

rows.en: @But you can't use the search system, and only a few Landing Pads exist in all Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「<8a12>やかな探<887e>をおこなうなら / ホバークラフトの方に / 分があるってことだな<b:8b3c>国の領空を<b:8b3a>行する<88b2><b:8a78>が / 緊急手配されたらしい
rows.re: If you want a thorough / search, the Hovercraft / has the advantage there.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @The Hovercraft is better for conducting thorough searches.
rows.jp: 「ファルガイア貴族国のうち / ギルドグラードが / どうにもこうにもごねていたらしいが〜
rows.re: Among Filgaia's noble / nations, Guild Galad just / would not budge, it seems.
rows.speaker: propagated:text

rows.en: @Of Filgaia's 3 nations, Guild Galad's representatives bitched and moaned.
rows.jp: 「最終的には / メリアブールとシルヴァラントに / <b:8a7b>し切られるカタチとなったそうだ<b:8ae6>に<b:8a8f><b:8b10>したものの / 戦いはいつも、英雄サマに頼っていたな / だから、どこか空<b:8b3e>で、実信が無い
rows.re: In the end, Meria Boule and / Sylvaland forced the matter / through, it seems.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @But in the end, Meria Boule and Sylvaland somehow wore them down.
rows.jp: 「〜でも、今度は違う / 僕もいっしょに戦っているつもりだ / 僕もファルガイアを保っているつもりだ英雄ってのは / その世界に生きる人間がなるもんだ
rows.re: But this time is different. I mean / to fight beside them, to protect / Filgaia too.
rows.speaker: propagated:text

rows.en: @But this time it's different. I feel like I'm fighting... like I'm protecting Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「だが、そいつひとりの意<b:8ad0>で / 『英雄』になるんじゃない〜
rows.re: But no one becomes a |hero| / by his own will alone.
rows.speaker: propagated:text

rows.en: @But no one can simply decide to become a hero.
rows.jp: 「その世界と / その時代に生きる人間が望むことで / 生み出されていくもんなんだ
rows.re: They're made by the wishes of the / people living in that world, that / age.
rows.speaker: propagated:text

rows.en: @Heroes are created when the people decide that they need heroes.
rows.jp: 「『英雄』は人間がなるもんだ / でも、望んでなるものじゃない / 望まれて生み出されていくものなんだ<b:8b3f>政の時代に人は / 英雄を望み、生み出すもんだ
rows.re: A |hero| is a person made one, / not by wanting it, but by being / wanted.
rows.speaker: propagated:text

rows.en: @A hero must choose to be a hero, but before that, a hero must be chosen by the people.
rows.jp: 「『<b:8ace>の<b:8ab1><b:8ab2>』におびえた / 伝説の時代には＜剣の少女＞を〜
rows.re: In the legend age that feared the / |Blaze of Disaster|, they had the / <Sword Magess>.
rows.speaker: propagated:text

rows.en: @<Sword Magess> came about when |Blaze of Disaster| was feared.
rows.jp: 「スレイハイムの<b:8ade><b:8b40>には / 英雄[05]お・エヴァンスを〜 / <f040><f042>というカンジでな
rows.re: In Slayheim's tyranny, the hero / {1} Evans. That sort of thing.
rows.speaker: propagated:text

rows.en: @In Slayheim's age of tyranny, they created a hero named 1 Evans. And so on.
rows.jp: 「〜空を失った / 現在のファルガイアで / 人はまた英雄を望み、生み出すのだろうか？<b:8ad5><b:8b41>のはじまりは / いつも同じだ
rows.re: In this sky-less Filgaia, will / people again wish a hero into / being?
rows.speaker: propagated:text

rows.en: @Now, Filgaia's sky has been devoured, and again the time is ripe for new heroes.
rows.jp: 「<b:8b42>圧された状況から / 『<b:8b43>命』だの『解放』だの / 理みたいなことを<b:8b45>んで同<b:8ad0>を<b:8b46>るのさ
rows.lit: In this present Filgaia, its sky lost, will people again wish for and create a hero?
rows.re: In this sky-less Filgaia, will / people again wish a hero into / being?
rows.speaker: Chateau NPC

rows.en: @He rallies people against some injustice by spouting speeches about revolution.
rows.jp: 「あいつの理につきあわされて / 最後は、全<b:8b47>で<b:8b48><b:8b49>いを / しなくちゃいけない状況になるんだ
rows.lit: From an oppressed state, he spouts "revolution" and "liberation" and such ideals to rally his fellows.
rows.re: From oppression, he spouts / "revolution" and "liberation" to / rally the others.
rows.speaker: Chateau NPC

rows.en: @Then we get dragged along on his idealistic crusade and end up cleaning up his mess.
rows.jp: 「なんで、あんな現実<b:8a3d>の<b:8b4a>い理想<b:8abd>に / みんなついて行くのだろう〜
rows.lit: We get dragged along with his ideals and end up having to clean up the whole mess together.
rows.re: We get dragged along with his / ideals, then must clean up the / whole mess.
rows.speaker: Chateau NPC

rows.en: @Why do we have to follow a damned dreamer like that?
rows.jp: 「やっぱり、自信ありげに理を<b:8b4b>られると / たとえメッキでも / <b:8b4c>力を信じてしまうのだろうか？<b:8bb7>[06]「解放<b:8ae6>の英雄サマは / 『どんな危機をも<b:8a49>ち<b:8b4d>く<b:8b4e><b:8b4f>の<b:8b50><b:8b51>』を / 持っているんだ〜
rows.re: Preach ideals with confidence and / people believe, even when it's / all a veneer?
rows.speaker: propagated:text

rows.en: @People must have a weak spot for idealism... even when it's just a smokescreen.
rows.jp: 「だいじょうぶだ / 今度もまた、<b:8b50><b:8b51>のマイトグローブで / 跡跡を起こしてくれるさ型機？ / いや、そっくりの暗い飛空機艇を / 解放<b:8ae6>は持っていたんだ
rows.re: It'll be fine. He'll work another / miracle with his left-hand Might / Glove.
rows.speaker: propagated:text

rows.en: @So don't worry. The Might Glove on his left hand will bring about another miracle.
rows.jp: 「もちろん、スレイハイムから / 戦って、<b:8b52>ったんだがな〜
rows.re: Of course, he won it from / Slayheim by fighting for it.
rows.speaker: propagated:text

rows.en: @Of course, they took it from Slayheim.
rows.jp: 「英雄サマの相<b:8b53>に / 機艇の<8a25>いや<b:8a87>最<b:8aa6>術に長けたヤツがいて / そいつがパイロットだったらしいぜ<b:8ae6>とはいっても / <8934>輝谷枯作戦が中心の / ゲリラ部隊だからな〜
rows.lit: Of course, he took it from Slayheim by fighting for it.
rows.re: Of course, he won it from / Slayheim by fighting for it.
rows.speaker: Chateau NPC

rows.en: @The pilot was Mr. Hero's war buddy -- a whiz at machines and flying.
rows.jp: 「みんな置って行<b:8ae6>なんて / 一度も無かったかもしれないな
rows.re: Maybe not once was anyone / ever left behind by him.
rows.speaker: propagated:text

rows.en: @They probably never even marched in formation.
rows.jp: 「かく言う僕も、<b:8ae6>に<b:8a8f><b:8b10>していたんだが / 英雄サマのお探を / 録えているわけじゃないしよ
rows.lit: They probably never once marched in proper formation.
rows.re: They likely never once marched in / proper formation.
rows.speaker: Chateau NPC

rows.en: @I was in the SLA myself, but I don't remember what Mr. Hero looked like.
rows.jp: 「まさか、また / いっしょに戦う回が来ようとはな<b:8a89>って / 失われた空を<b:8b54>駆する<b:8a7c>は / 僕たちに残された、たったひとつの可能性だ
rows.re: To think a day would come to / fight side by side again.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Who ever thought we'd be fighting side by side again?
rows.jp: 「みんなあんたたちに / 未来を<b:8b55>している〜
rows.re: Everyone is entrusting the future / to you.
rows.speaker: propagated:text

rows.en: @Our very future depends on you.
rows.jp: 「そして、自分たちの中にある / ファルガイアを保りたいという想いを / あんたたちに集めているんだ<b:8a62>は / あんたたちの行動<b:8aa1><b:8aa2>を / 格<b:8a7a>に<b:8a6f>やしてくれるはずだ
rows.re: And they gather onto you the wish / within them all, the wish to / protect Filgaia.
rows.speaker: propagated:text

rows.en: @You represent everyone's hopes to defend our dear Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「だけど、シャトーと同じく / サーチ機能が備わっていないから / 結<b:8b57>のところ、地道な探<887e>は変わらないがな
rows.re: But like the Chateau, it has / no search function. In the end, / plain legwork is unchanged.
rows.speaker: propagated:text

rows.en: @Like Chateau, it lacks search features, so you still have to search the old-fashioned way.
rows.speaker: SKIPPED - merged decode overrun (blk6

rows.jp: 「ヴァレリアシャトーより / 着陸可能ポイントに自由がきくぶん / 行動可能<b:8aa1><b:8aa2>が格<b:8a7a>に広がったはずだ

rows.en: @She can land in more places than Valeria Chateau and will give you a wider range of operations.
rows.jp: 「今後のシャトーは、あんたたちの足ではなく / <b:8b5a>間人の安全確保のために / 解放されることになったぜ<b:8b26>ドラゴン、グラウスヴァイン〜 / まったく<8845>いたよな〜 / だって、ドラゴンが実在したんだぜ
rows.re: From now the Chateau won't be / your ride. It's freed to keep / civilians safe.
rows.speaker: propagated:text

rows.en: @Instead of transporting you around, Chateau will now be used to evacuate civilians.
rows.jp: 「何もかもが / 伝説から / 現実のモノへ変わろうとしている〜
rows.re: Everything is turning / from legend / into reality.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @It's like everything from the old legends is becoming reality.
rows.jp: 「ファルガイアを攻う脅威が / 更々と伝説を、現実に<b:8b5b>らせていく〜 / そんな気がしてならないぜ
rows.re: The threat on Filgaia keeps / waking the old legends into / reality. I can't shake it.
rows.speaker: propagated:text

rows.en: @This nightmare that plagues Filgaia is bringing the legends of the past to life!
rows.jp: 「このままじゃ / ファルガイアを保るために / ＜剣の少女＞まで<b:8b5b>るんじゃないか？<b:8b5c>なことがあるか？<b:8b5d>に<b:8a6b>われた滅死の大地より掘り出した / 『<b:8b26>』と呼ばれる幻同<b:8a50>〜
rows.re: At this rate, might even the / <Sword Magess> return to / protect Filgaia?
rows.speaker: propagated:text

rows.en: @I hope that means <Sword Magess> will come to life to protect Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「そいつがヘイムダル・ガッツォーに / <887c><887d>されているのは / ほぼ、まちがいないだろう〜
rows.re: That it's loaded aboard / Heimdal Gazzo is almost / beyond doubt.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @... is almost certainly loaded aboard Heimdal Gazzo.
rows.jp: 「その圧倒的な威力から / 戦<b:8b5e>的にあつかわれることは<b:8a97>くないが〜
rows.re: With power like that, it may / well be treated as a strategic / weapon, but...
rows.speaker: propagated:text

rows.en: @I'm sure Vinsfeld intends to use it as a deterrent...
rows.jp: 「気がかりなのは / 追いつめられたヴィンスフェルトが / いつまで<b:8b5f><b:8b60>な判断を辺せるかということだ型機なんてシロモノ / 今の<b:8aa6>術じゃ / なかなか<b:8b61>りだせないぞ
rows.re: What worries me is how long a / cornered Vinsfeld can keep / judging with a clear head.
rows.speaker: propagated:text

rows.en: @But Vinsfeld has his back to the wall. Can we count on him to continue to act rationally?
rows.jp: 「ギルドグラードじゃドラゴンの合谷を用いて / 機艇<b:8aa6>術が発<b:8aa3>しているらしいが〜
rows.re: In Guild Galad they use Dragon / fossils, and craft technology / has come far, it seems.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Guild Galad has advanced machinery because of the Dragon fossils. Still...
rows.jp: 「機艇と生命体の中間存在 / 幻獣ドラゴンそのものでもない<b:8a78>り / このサイズに飛空機艇をおさめられないぞ<b:8b62>されただけのことはある
rows.re: Half craft, half living thing. / Short of being the Dragon / itself, none fits this small.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Only a monster Dragon - a living machine - could become a flying craft that small.
rows.jp: 「外からドンパチやって落ちねぇのなら / 中に侵入して、街部から破滅する / <b:8b0d>本的なことだが、確実な作戦だ型機の / 発射カタパルトなんだ
rows.re: If blasting it from outside / won't work, get inside and wreck / it there. Basic, but sure.
rows.speaker: propagated:text

rows.en: @Remember: If you can't defeat an enemy from the outside, destroy him from the inside.
rows.jp: 「でも、中心要の小型機が用意されていない / たとえるなら、そう<f040><f042>〜 / 『<b:8b06>人女<b:8b64>のいない<b:8a9a>』ってとこか？
rows.lit: If shooting from outside won't down it, get inside and destroy it from within; basic, but a sure plan.
rows.re: If it won't fall from outside, get / in and wreck it from within. / Basic, but sure.
rows.speaker: Chateau NPC

rows.en: @But there aren't any aircraft. It's like an inn without a pretty proprietress!
rows.jp: 「まあ、どうしてもって言うのなら / あんたたちを / 生身で射出しても構わないんだけどな求めていたのは / 『英雄』の<b:8ac5>なんかじゃない / この脅威を<b:8b65>ってくれる力なんだ
rows.re: Well, if you really insist, I / don't mind launching you out / in the flesh.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Of course, if you want to, you can launch yourselves on this thing.
rows.jp: 「それは、僕たちひとりひとりが / 少しずつ持っているはずの / 大切なモノを保る力だぜ<b:8ab1><b:8ab2>を前にして / 『英雄』を求めるという〜
rows.re: It's a power each of us should / hold a little of. The power to / guard what's precious.
rows.speaker: propagated:text

rows.en: @So we can fight off this threat and protect our loved ones!
rows.jp: 「それは、力無きゆえに / 『英雄』の力を求めているんだ / けっして『英雄』の<b:8ac5>なんかじゃないぜ剣の少女＞と『<b:8ace>の<b:8ab1><b:8ab2>』との戦いの / 渡記を保存したルルドの<89c8>は / 少女の<b:8ac5>を招く者のみに開かれると聞くぜ
rows.lit: It's the power each of us holds a little of, to protect what we treasure.
rows.re: It's the power each of us holds a / little of, to guard what we / treasure.

rows.jp: 「まさか、シャトー街に侵入してきた / オデッサのふたりが / わきめもふらずにモリモリと〜
rows.lit: Don't tell me those two Odessa infiltrators who snuck into the Chateau devoured it without a second glance.
rows.re: Don't tell me those two / Odessa infiltrators just / gobbled it right up.
rows.speaker: Gubacho / chief engineer

rows.en: @You don't suppose those two Odessa infiltrators gobbled them up, do you?
rows.jp: 「ちなみに前<b:8a3e>は / <b:8a8d>乗のせがれでしたッ！
rows.lit: By the way, before this, I was the son of a gunship pilot!
rows.re: By the way, before this, / I was a pilot's son!
rows.speaker: Gubacho / chief engineer

rows.en: @Before I joined the service, I worked at dad's butcher shop.
rows.jp: 「<b:8a93>ちゃんに逃げられた / <b:8a94>ちゃんをひとりにしておけないから / こうしてＡＲＭＳに<b:8a8e>せ<b:8a8f>じました<b:8a95>の<b:8a96>が残らないわよ<b:8a97>しいこと考えないで<b:8a95>しちゃうぞ<b:8a98><b:8a99>場から生きて戻ってこれたのね<b:8a95>で分せないものはないわ<b:8a9a>乗なんかで / [89]
rows.lit: Since [?]-chan ran off and I couldn't leave [?]-chan alone, I threw myself into ARMS like this.
rows.re: I couldn't leave my dad / alone after Mom left, so / I threw myself into ARMS.
rows.speaker: Ebecho / Chateau engineer

rows.en: @Dad's been alone since Mom left. I wanted to be with him, so I joined ARMS, too.
rows.jp: 「まだ見ぬ新しい<b:8aa3>開が / きっと待っているはずだぜ<b:8aa4>するヴァレリアシャトーッ！ / だけど、着陸できるポイントが / あまりにも少なすぎるんだよな〜
rows.lit: A new development you haven't seen yet is surely waiting for our beloved Valeria Chateau! But there are far too few points where she can land.
rows.re: Something new is surely / waiting for this beloved / Chateau, so few landing points.
rows.speaker: Erwin / chief pilot

rows.en: @I'm sure this will lead to something new for you.
rows.jp: 「そういえばシャトーの２Ｆに / 以前、地面のエネルギーとかを / <b:8a48>行していたヤツがいたな<b:8aa5>の通信<b:8aa6><b:8a4c>のひとつだ
rows.lit: Come to think of it, there was someone on the Chateau's 2nd floor once studying earth energy or something.
rows.re: Come to think of it, / someone on the 2nd floor / once studied earth energy.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @Hey, someone on the 2nd floor of Valeria Chateau was studying terrestrial energy, right?
rows.jp: 「カタチにとらわれずに / 物事を為していく〜 / <b:8aa7><b:8a44>なようで、<b:8a97>しいことだ
rows.lit: Doing things without being bound by form. It seems reckless, but it's a hard thing to do.
rows.re: Doing things without / being bound by form. / Reckless, and hard to do.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @Creating innovative devices like this requires creativity. It isn't easy to do.
rows.jp: 「それをやってのけるんだから / テロリスト・オデッサ〜 / あなどれない相だろう
rows.lit: Since they actually pull that off, the terrorist group Odessa is surely a foe not to be underestimated.
rows.re: Since they actually pull / that off, Odessa is a / foe not to be underestimated.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @But Odessa did it. They are an enemy we must not underestimate, obviously.
rows.jp: 「くそッ、僕だって<b:8aa8>けてたまるかよッ！ / スゴイの<89db>め込んで / オトコをあげてやらあッ！<b:8a56><89ca>さ
rows.lit: Damn it, I won't lose either! I'll pour in something amazing and become a real man!
rows.re: Damn it, I won't lose / either! I'll pour it on / and show you a real man!
rows.speaker: Erwin / chief pilot

rows.en: @I bet you think you're hot stuff, don't you? Trying to show off with that in there...
rows.jp: 「以前は / 心を伝える不思議な渓谷の / <b:8aa9>出に使われていたらしいぞ
rows.lit: It's said this used to be used for exporting the strange, thought-transmitting valley crystal.
rows.re: It's said this used to / transport the strange / thought-crystal from the valley.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @It was once used to transport an amazing crystal that could transmit thoughts. .
rows.jp: 「彼らもヴァレリア<b:8a85>に<b:8aaa><b:8aab>されて / ファルガイア中に派<b:8aac>されているらしい
rows.lit: They too are made by the Valeria house and dispatched all over Filgaia, it's said.
rows.re: They're made by the / Valeria house too, and / sent out across Filgaia.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @Sir Valeria created them and deployed them all over Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「設立は / ＡＲＭＳよりもずっと早いから / 僕たちの<b:8a5a><b:8a83>分ってトコかもな大使同時による輝<b:8aad>で / 大地のほとんどが過<b:8aae><b:8aaf>合され / 滅死してしまいました
rows.lit: Since they were founded much earlier than ARMS, maybe they're kind of our senior allies.
rows.re: They were founded well / before ARMS, so maybe / they're our senior allies.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @They've been around a lot longer than ARMS, so they kinda have seniority over us.
rows.jp: 「現在では<b:8ab0>の中に<89db>もれてしまい / 何も無いところだと聞いていますが〜
rows.lit: Now it's said to have been buried away next door, with nothing left there at all.
rows.re: Now it's said to have / been buried away nearby, / with nothing left there.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @He studied astronomy last, and now has returned to help preserve peace in Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「それでも目指すなら / クアトリーの場を中<b:8ab1>地にするのが / まちがいないでしょう
rows.lit: Even so, if you're heading there, using Quartly as a waypoint is surely the way to go.
rows.re: Even so, if you're / heading there, Quartly / is surely the way to go.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @One that will assure peace in all of Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「クアトリーは、[11]お街道の先東[11]ぉに流れ込む / リキキス<89e7>にそって上った先 / <88db>の道にある場です<b:8a85>は / シエルジェ自分領にて / さまざまな<b:8a4b>誓を<b:8a4b>んできました
rows.lit: Quartly is a place upstream along the Rikikis [?], where it flows into the road's far east, on the [?] road.
rows.re: Quartly lies upstream / where the Rikikis flows / into the road's far east.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @But somewhere, somehow, things went awry. How? Why?
rows.jp: 「最後に大<b:8a4e><b:8a4b>を<b:8ab2>めてから / 今度はファルガイアの注目<b:8a80>持のために / ここに帰ってきたのです<b:8a85>は作戦指揮と同時に / 更なる一手を考えているのです
rows.lit: After finally mastering the great war-god arts, he came back here this time to keep watch over Filgaia.
rows.re: After mastering the / great war-god arts, he / came back to watch over Filgaia.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @He doesn't show it, but he also adores his younger sister.
rows.jp: 「遠く、ファルガイアのこれからを / 注目に<b:8ab5>くために〜<b:8ab6><b:8ab7>から保護せし<b:8ab9>〜 / 『アガートラーム』は / ヴァレリア<b:8a85>が<b:8aba>け<b:8ab1>ぐべきだったのです
rows.lit: In order to keep a distant eye on Filgaia's future, a sword protected from swordsmen, "Argetlahm" should have been passed down through the Valeria house.
rows.re: To watch over Filgaia's / future, Argetlahm should / have stayed with the Valeria house.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @So he may take extreme steps to strengthen ARMS.
rows.jp: 「いったい〜 / いつから、何が、どのようにして / <b:8abb>陸が<b:8abc>いはじめたのでしょうか〜<b:8a85>は / 誰よりも強く / ファルガイアを愛しています
rows.lit: Just when, what, and how did the continent start to go wrong? Sir Valeria loves Filgaia more strongly than anyone.
rows.re: Just when, and how, did / the continent go wrong? / Sir Valeria loves Filgaia dearly.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @Instead of commanding, I'm sure he wanted to use his sword and spells at the front line.
rows.jp: 「そして、表にはあまり出しませんが / <b:8a52>様もとても大切にしています<b:8a85>は理想と同時に / 現実を見つめることができる方です
rows.lit: And though he doesn't show it much, he also treasures his kin very much. He is a man who can face reality alongside his ideals.
rows.re: Though he rarely shows it, / he treasures his kin too, / and faces reality alongside ideals.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @If not for that accident...
rows.jp: 「ですから、ＡＲＭＳの戦力アップに / 多少、ムチャな作戦をとることもあるのです<b:8a85>は / 誰よりもファルガイアを愛しています
rows.lit: That's why, to raise ARMS's fighting strength, he sometimes takes on somewhat reckless plans. He loves Filgaia more than anyone.
rows.re: That's why he sometimes / takes reckless risks to / raise ARMS's strength.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @And he showed such brilliance in swordsmanship and the casting of spells...
rows.jp: 「ですから、本当なら指揮<899d>ではなく / 最前<b:8abd>で得意の<b:8ab9>や魔法を / <b:8abe>るいたかったに違いありません
rows.lit: That's why, in truth, rather than being a commander, he surely wanted to wield his sword and magic at the front line instead.
rows.re: Rather than command, / he surely wanted to / wield his sword up front.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @How truly unfortunate.
rows.jp: 「あの事故さえなければ〜<b:8a65>な事故が原因で / ヴァレリア<b:8a85>は<b:8abf>足が / 不自由になってしまったんだ
rows.lit: If only that accident hadn't happened. Because of that unfortunate accident, Sir Valeria's legs became unable to move freely.
rows.re: If only that accident / hadn't happened. It left / Sir Valeria's legs unable to move.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @Gosh... I mean, damn, I know it's not any of my buddies.
rows.jp: 「<b:8ab9><b:8aa6>も魔法も / 誰よりも<89ab>れた<b:8ac0>えをみせた / お人だったのに〜
rows.lit: He was a man who showed brilliance beyond anyone in both swordsmanship and magic...
rows.re: He showed brilliance / beyond anyone, in both / swordsmanship and magic...
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @|Blaze of Disaster| is said to be a renegade Guardian. They were protectors of Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「本当に残念です<b:8ac1>場所〜 / つまり、ヴァレリアシャトーの級置は / 最重要機<b:8ac2>事<b:8ac3>とされていたのに…
rows.lit: It's truly a shame. That place, that is, Valeria Chateau's post, was supposed to be treated as the most vital duty...
rows.re: It's truly a shame. That / post at Valeria Chateau was / meant to be the most vital duty...
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @The Guardians also ruled the world, so |Blaze of Disaster| must have their awesome powers.
rows.jp: 「いったい、どこからどうやって / オデッサに<b:8ac4><b:8ac5>したのだろう？来を<b:8ac6>けて<88f1>突した / ＜<b:8ab9>の少女＞と『<b:8ac8>の<b:8ab6><b:8ab7>』〜
rows.lit: Just where and how did it get passed down to Odessa, I wonder? Splitting the future between them, the <Sword Magess> and the "Swordsman of the Sword" clashed.
rows.re: Just where, and how, did it / reach Odessa? The <Sword / Magess> clashed with the Swordsman.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @They say comets are a bad omen. Perhaps it was warning of Odessa's threat to Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「『<b:8ab6><b:8ab7>』とは / ファルガイアを保護するとされる / ガーディアンの<b:8ac9><b:8aca>体って話だ
rows.lit: They say the "Swordsman of the Sword" is a mutated form of the Guardians said to protect Filgaia.
rows.re: They say the Swordsman / is a mutated form of a / Filgaia Guardian.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @It's the leader of Odessa, the ones who made that declaration. I've seen his face before...
rows.jp: 「ガーディアンとは世界を<b:8a5d>える力と聞く / それと同時の力を持つ『<b:8ab6><b:8ab7>』とは / どれほど恐ろしいモノなんだろう〜衛星だったな、あれは〜
rows.lit: I hear the Guardians are the power that sustains the world. If the "Swordsman" holds power equal to that, how terrifying must it be? That was a comet, wasn't it...
rows.re: Guardians sustain the world. / If the Swordsman holds / that power, how terrifying...
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @I think he was some nation's military leader, or the head of some related organization...
rows.jp: 「衛星は<b:8acd><b:8ace>を示すというが〜 / ファルガイアを<b:8acf>がすオデッサの動<8945>〜 / あれをさしているのだろうか？
rows.lit: They say comets show a bad omen. Was it pointing to Odessa's movements, which now shake Filgaia?
rows.re: Comets are said to be / bad omens. Was it pointing / to Odessa's threat to Filgaia?
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @You are called |hero| because of your extraordinary feats in battle. But that's not all.
rows.jp: 「決起表次をおこなったテロリスト〜 / オデッサの<888a><b:8ad0>のことなんだが / 渡録のどこかに招っかかるんだよな
rows.lit: The terrorists who made that declaration of uprising. It's about Odessa's crest, but it rings a bell somewhere in my memory.
rows.re: The terrorists who made / that declaration. Odessa's / crest rings a bell somehow.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @After the civil war, you let yourself be caught so that your friends could escape pursuit.
rows.jp: 「どこかの国の<b:8ad1>関係者〜 / あるいは、そこに<b:8a38>するような機関〜 / 気になるんだよな〜<b:8ad1>の<b:8ad2><b:8ad3>〜ッ！
rows.lit: Someone connected to some nation's military, or an organization belonging to one. It nags at me.
rows.re: Someone tied to some / nation's military, or an / affiliated group. It nags at me.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @That's why even 5 years later, the people still call you a 'hero'.
rows.jp: 「あんたが<b:8ad2><b:8ad3>と呼ばれたのは / <b:8ad4><b:8a41>した戦<b:8a3c>力と<b:8ad5><b:8ad6> / だが、それだけじゃないと僕は考える
rows.lit: You were called a hero for your outstanding combat prowess and renown, but I think it's more than just that.
rows.re: You're called a hero for / your combat skill and / renown, but it's more than that.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @One theory is that the SLA leader sold out his comrades to save himself.
rows.jp: 「街戦終了後、解放<b:8ad1>を救うために<b:8ad7>力し / ひとり、<8965>われることで / 追手の目が他に<b:8ad8>ぶことを<b:8ad9>いだ〜
rows.lit: After the civil war ended, you cooperated to save the Liberation Army by letting yourself alone be captured, preventing your pursuers' eyes from reaching the others.
rows.re: After the war, you let / yourself get caught alone / so your pursuers missed the rest.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @Now it is our turn to protect Filgaia as members of ARMS.
rows.jp: 「<b:8ada>間を保ることを知っているから / あんたは、街戦が終って<88d2>数年っても / 『<b:8ad2><b:8ad3>』と呼ばれるんだ<b:8ad1>は / 街戦の終了と同時に戦<b:8adc>犯<b:8add>者として / 追われる身になったという
rows.lit: Because you know how to protect your comrades, even five years after the war ended, you're still called a "hero."
rows.re: Because you protect your / comrades, even 5 years later / you're still called a hero.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @Near Baskar Village is one of the most powerful segments of the Raline in all Filgaia!
rows.jp: 「その<b:8ade>実の多くは<b:8adf>の中だが / 一説によると、解放<b:8ad1>リーダーが / 保身のために<b:8ada>間を<b:8ae0>ったって話だぜ<b:8a76>、ファルガイアは / ＜<b:8ab9>の少女＞に保られたんだ
rows.lit: Much of that truth remains in darkness, but one theory says the Liberation Army leader sold out his comrades to save himself.
rows.re: Much of it stays hidden, / but one theory says your / leader sold out his own comrades.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @But the area is covered by a deep, beautiful forest.
rows.jp: 「今度は僕たち、ＡＲＭＳが / ファルガイアを保る番だぜ<b:8ae1>っていたんだ / 単に、観待意<b:8ae2>がそがれた<b:8ae3>ではないぞ最<b:8ae4>に星を駆け<b:8ae5>る / 生命エネルギーのネットワークだ
rows.lit: This time, it's our turn, ARMS's turn, to protect Filgaia.
rows.re: This time it's our turn. / ARMS's turn to protect / Filgaia.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @Prime examples are the Town of Holst and Raline Observatory, where I once worked.
rows.jp: 「バスカーたちが隠れ<b:8ae6>む里の付近は / ファルガイアの中でも / 作年のレイラインが通っているところなんだ
rows.lit: The area near the village where the Baskars live in hiding is, even among all Filgaia, a place where a strong Ley Line runs.
rows.re: Near where the Baskars / live in hiding runs one / of Filgaia's strongest Ley Lines.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @Both can be reached easily, if you use the Live Reflector.
rows.jp: 「だから、里の周囲には / 願く<b:8ae7>しい山が広がっているんだな<b:8ae8>いところから / 掘り出されることが多いんだ
rows.lit: That's why the area around the village is surrounded by deep, [?] mountains. It's often dug up from deep places.
rows.re: That's why deep, harsh / mountains surround the / village all around it.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @For Aguelite, pick 'Ruins Mine' and for Germatron, pick 'Dragon's Vein' and jump in.
rows.jp: 「ホルストの場や / 俺が以前<b:8ae9>めていたレイライン観待<88e4>設は / その<b:8aea><b:8aeb>的なパターンだよ
rows.lit: The Town of Holst, and the Raline Observatory facility I once worked at, are both textbook examples of that pattern.
rows.re: The Town of Holst and the / Raline Observatory are / textbook cases of that pattern.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @From what I hear, they are also powered by life-energy.
rows.jp: 「どちらも / ライブリフレクターを使えば / それほど遠いものではない
rows.lit: Using the Live Reflector, neither of them is all that far away.
rows.re: Using the Live Reflector, / neither of them is all / that far away.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @There's one near here, in 1the woods to the southwest0.
rows.jp: 「アグエライト渓谷なら、『遺跡渓谷』行きに / ゲルマトロン渓谷なら、『枯谷<b:8aec><89f4>』行きに / 飛び込めばすぐだよ<b:8a95>システムなんだ
rows.lit: For Aguelite Valley, jump to "Ruins Valley." For Germatron Valley, jump to "[?] Valley." Just jump in and you're there.
rows.re: For Aguelite Valley, jump to / "Ruins Valley." For / Germatron, jump to the other one.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @The Raline reaches there. That's why it's a suitable location for a Live Reflector.
rows.jp: 「その<b:8aed>動も / 生命エネルギーによって / <b:8a5d>えられているらしいんだな
rows.lit: That movement too is apparently sustained by life energy.
rows.re: That movement too is / apparently sustained / by life energy.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @Such beauty, and so loyal to her brother... Observing her would be a joy.
rows.jp: 「シャトーの近くにも一<b:8aee>あるぞ / [11]お先東の山の中[11]ぉだ
rows.lit: There's one near the Chateau too, in the mountains to the far east.
rows.re: There's one near the / Chateau too, out in the / mountains to the far east.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @I wish I could observe Valeria Chateau's kitchen... as a trained observer, of course.
rows.jp: 「そこにもレイラインが通っているから / ライブリフレクターの<b:8aed>動には / <b:8aef>しているというわけだ<b:8a57>動に役立ちたいと / ご自分から<898d>食当番をかってでられたんだ
rows.lit: A Ley Line runs through there too, which is why it's suited for the Live Reflector's operation. Wanting to help out, he volunteered himself for kitchen duty.
rows.re: A Ley Line runs there too, / suiting the Live Reflector. / He volunteered for kitchen duty.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @But now it's deserted.
rows.jp: 「<b:8a5a>のため、<b:8af0>気に戦<b:8abd>に<b:8a8f><b:8af1>する一<b:8af2>の<b:8af3>〜 / ああ、これからも観待したい〜<b:8af4>集される前の俺は / レイラインという / この星のエネルギーの流れを観待してたんだ
rows.lit: Before I was drafted, I used to observe the flow of life energy through this planet called the Ley Line.
rows.re: Before I was drafted, I used / to watch this planet's / life energy flow, the Ley Line.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @The southern room is supposed to be {1}'s room, but she's never there.
rows.jp: 「でも今は〜 / ヴァレリアシャトーの<b:8af5><b:8af6>を / いやらしくない目で観待したいんだな
rows.lit: But now... I'd like to observe Valeria Chateau's [?] with an innocent eye.
rows.re: But now I'd rather keep / an innocent eye on / Valeria Chateau instead.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @Huh? Who, me? No, no. I wasn't eavesdropping. No, not me.
rows.jp: 「何だか、最近、サッパリです〜
rows.lit: Somehow, lately, it's all dried up.
rows.re: Somehow, lately, it's / all dried up.
rows.speaker: male NPC, eavesdropping beat

rows.en: @Huh? Who, me? No, no. I wasn't eavesdropping. No, not me.
rows.jp: 「そして、ここから先にあるのは / [0a]お方のお部乗ですけど〜 / お部乗でお見かけすることは〜
rows.lit: And what lies ahead from here is {1}'s room, but seeing her in her room...
rows.re: And ahead from here is / {1}'s room, though I rarely / see her there.
rows.speaker: male NPC, eavesdropping beat

rows.en: @Huh? Who, me? No, no. I wasn't eavesdropping. No, not me.
rows.jp: 「〜あ、いえいえ / けっして立ち聞きしていたわけじゃ / ありませんから〜
rows.lit: Ah, no no, it's not that I was eavesdropping at all.
rows.re: Ah, no, no. It's not / like I was eavesdropping / or anything.
rows.speaker: male NPC, eavesdropping beat

rows.en: @Sir Valeria is always busy. If he is not in his room, he may be on another floor.
rows.jp: 「〜あ、いえいえ / けっして立ち聞きしたわけじゃ / ありませんから〜
rows.lit: Ah, no no, it's not that I was eavesdropping at all.
rows.re: Ah, no, no. It's not / like I was eavesdropping / or anything.
rows.speaker: male NPC, eavesdropping beat

rows.en: @To get to other floors, please use the elevator straight ahead.
rows.jp: 「〜あ、いえいえ / けっして立ち聞きしたわけじゃ / ありませんから〜<b:8a8c>と / [0a]ぉ方と[0a]お方の / 私<b:8a8c>が用意されています
rows.lit: Ah, no no, it's not that I was eavesdropping at all. Private rooms have been prepared for both {1} and {0}.
rows.re: Ah, no, no. Not eavesdropping. / Private rooms are set / up for both {1} and {0}.
rows.speaker: male NPC, eavesdropping beat

rows.en: @But you can't use the search system, and only a few Landing Pads exist in all Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「ヴァレリア<b:8a85>はご多少な方です / お部乗にいらっしゃらないようでしたら / 他のフロアかもしれません
rows.lit: Sir Valeria is a very busy man. If he doesn't seem to be in his room, he may be on another floor.
rows.re: Sir Valeria is always / busy. If he's not in / his room, try another floor.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @The Hovercraft is better for conducting thorough searches.
rows.jp: 「他のフロアに向かう場合は / 正面のエレベーターを / ご利用ください<b:8a79>を<b:8af8>行することが可能だ
rows.lit: If you're heading to another floor, please use the elevator up ahead.
rows.re: If you're heading to / another floor, please / use the elevator ahead.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @Of Filgaia's 3 nations, Guild Galad's representatives bitched and moaned.
rows.jp: 「だけど、その着陸可能ポイントの少なさと / サーチシステムが使えない帯が / 不<b:8af9>といえば不<b:8af9>だな
rows.lit: But the small number of landing points, and the areas where the search system can't be used, are inconvenient, if you had to call it something.
rows.re: But so few landing points, / and dead zones for the search / system, are a bit of a nuisance.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @But in the end, Meria Boule and Sylvaland somehow wore them down.
rows.jp: 「<8a12>やかな探<887e>をおこなうなら / ホバークラフトの方に / 分があるってことだな<b:8afa>国の領空を<b:8af8>行する<88b2><b:8a78>が / 緊急手配されたらしい
rows.lit: If you want to do a thorough search, the Hovercraft has the advantage there.
rows.re: If you want a thorough / search, the Hovercraft / has the advantage there.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @Of course, they took it from Slayheim.
rows.jp: 「ファルガイア貴族国のうち / ギルドグラードが / どうにもこうにもごねていたらしいが〜
rows.lit: Among Filgaia's noble nations, Guild Galad apparently just would not budge, no matter what.
rows.re: Among Filgaia's noble / nations, Guild Galad just / would not budge, it seems.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @The pilot was Mr. Hero's war buddy -- a whiz at machines and flying.
rows.jp: 「最終的には / メリアブールとシルヴァラントに / <b:8a7b>し切られるカタチとなったそうだ<b:8aeb>機？ / いや、そっくりの暗い飛空機艇を / 解放<b:8ad1>は持っていたんだ
rows.lit: In the end, it seems the matter was pushed through by Meria Boule and Sylvaland.
rows.re: In the end, Meria Boule and / Sylvaland forced the matter / through, it seems.
rows.speaker: crew member, negotiation history

rows.en: @They probably never even marched in formation.
rows.jp: 「もちろん、スレイハイムから / 戦って、<b:8afc>ったんだがな〜
rows.lit: Of course, they fought their way up from Slayheim and won.
rows.re: Of course, they fought their / way up from Slayheim / and won it.
rows.speaker: crew member, negotiation history

rows.en: @I was in the SLA myself, but I don't remember what Mr. Hero looked like.
rows.jp: 「<b:8ad2><b:8ad3>サマの相<b:8afd>に / 機艇の<8a25>いや<b:8a87>最<b:8aa6><b:8a4c>に長けたヤツがいて / そいつがパイロットだったらしいぜ<b:8ad1>とはいっても / <8934>輝谷枯作戦が中心の / ゲリラ部隊だからな〜
rows.lit: Among the hero's companions was one skilled with craft and the latest tech; that one was the pilot. [twin:6/1068 英雄=hero]
rows.re: The hero had a partner, a whiz / with craft and the newest tech. / That one was the pilot.
rows.speaker: crew member, on Lombardia's pilot

rows.en: @Who ever thought we'd be fighting side by side again?
rows.jp: 「みんな置って行<b:8ad1>なんて / 一度も無かったかもしれないな
rows.lit: Maybe not once was anyone ever left behind.
rows.re: Maybe not once was anyone / ever left behind by him.
rows.speaker: crew member, on the hero

rows.en: @Our very future depends on you.
rows.jp: 「かく言う僕も、<b:8ad1>に<b:8a8f><b:8af1>していたんだが / <b:8ad2><b:8ad3>サマのお探を / 録えているわけじゃないしよ
rows.lit: I too served back then, but I don't really remember the hero's face. [twin:6/10 英雄=hero]
rows.re: I served back then myself, but / I can't say I remember the / hero's face.
rows.speaker: crew member, on the hero

rows.en: @You represent everyone's hopes to defend our dear Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「まさか、また / いっしょに戦う回が来ようとはな<b:8a89>って / 失われた空を<b:8b01>駆する<b:8a7c>は / 僕たちに残された、たったひとつの可能性だ
rows.lit: To think a time would come to fight together again.
rows.re: To think a day would come to / fight side by side again.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @Like Chateau, it lacks search features, so you still have to search the old-fashioned way.
rows.jp: 「みんなあんたたちに / 未来を<b:8b02>している〜
rows.lit: Everyone is entrusting the future to you. [twin:10/2511 託す=entrust]
rows.re: Everyone is entrusting / the future to you.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.jp: 「そして、自分たちの中にある / ファルガイアを保りたいという想いを / あんたたちに集めているんだ<b:8a62>は / あんたたちの行動<b:8aa1>囲を / <b:8b03><b:8a7a>に<b:8a6f>やしてくれるはずだ
rows.speaker: SKIPPED (no content box in the dump; slot absent from the decode. Nothing to translate.

rows.en: @She can land in more places than Chateau and will give you a wider range of operations.
rows.jp: 「だけど、シャトーと同じく / サーチ機能が備わっていないから / 結<b:8b04>のところ、地道な探<887e>は変わらないがな
rows.lit: But like the Chateau it has no search function, so in the end the plain legwork search is unchanged. [twin:10/2513]
rows.re: But like the Chateau, it has / no search function. In the end, / plain legwork is unchanged.
rows.speaker: crew member, on the new craft

rows.en: @Instead of transporting you around, Chateau will now be used to evacuate civilians.
rows.jp: [02][09]とゥ[0e]<b:8b05>良く<b:8a62>を<b:8b06>してくれているか？
rows.speaker: SKIPPED (box is control-code garbage:

rows.en: @It's like everything from the old legends is becoming reality.
rows.jp: 「ヴァレリアシャトーより / 着陸可能ポイントに自由がきくぶん / 行動可能<b:8aa1>囲が<b:8b03><b:8a7a>に広がったはずだ
rows.lit: Since it lands more freely than Valeria Chateau, its range of action should have widened greatly.
rows.re: It lands more freely than the / Chateau, so its range of action / should be far wider.
rows.speaker: crew member, on the new craft

rows.en: @This nightmare that plagues Filgaia is bringing the legends of the past to life!
rows.jp: 「今後のシャトーは、あんたたちの足ではなく / <b:8b07>間人の安全確保のために / 解放されることになったぜ<b:8b08>ドラゴン、グラウスヴァイン〜 / まったく<8845>いたよな〜 / だって、ドラゴンが実在したんだぜ
rows.lit: From now the Chateau is freed up not as your transport, but to secure civilians' safety. [民間人=civilians]
rows.re: From now the Chateau won't be / your ride. It's freed to keep / civilians safe.
rows.speaker: crew member, on the Chateau

rows.en: @I hope that means <Sword Magess> will come to life to protect Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「何もかもが / 伝説から / 現実のモノへ変わろうとしている〜
rows.lit: Everything is turning from legend into reality.
rows.re: Everything is turning / from legend / into reality.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @... is almost certainly loaded aboard Heimdal Gazzo.
rows.jp: 「ファルガイアを攻う脅威が / 更々と伝説を、現実に<b:8b09>らせていく〜 / そんな気がしてならないぜ
rows.lit: The threat assailing Filgaia keeps bringing the legends to life; I can't shake the feeling. [twin:10/2518 蘇る=revive]
rows.re: The threat on Filgaia keeps / waking the old legends into / reality. I can't shake it.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @I can imagine the Nuke being used as a deterrent...
rows.jp: 「このままじゃ / ファルガイアを保るために / ＜<b:8ab9>の少女＞まで<b:8b09>るんじゃないか？<b:8b0a>なことがあるか？<b:8ab0>に<b:8a6b>われた滅死の大地より掘り出した / 『<b:8b08>』と呼ばれる幻同時〜
rows.lit: At this rate, might even the <Sword Magess> revive to protect Filgaia? [twin:10/2519 剣=sword]
rows.re: At this rate, might even the / <Sword Magess> return to / protect Filgaia?
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @But Vinsfeld has his back to the wall. Can we count on him to continue to act rationally?
rows.jp: 「そいつがヘイムダル・ガッツォーに / <887c><887d>されているのは / ほぼ、まちがいないだろう〜
rows.lit: That it's loaded aboard Heimdal Gazzo is almost beyond doubt. [搭載=loaded]
rows.re: That it's loaded aboard / Heimdal Gazzo is almost / beyond doubt.
rows.speaker: crew member, on the Heimdal Gazzo weapon

rows.en: @Guild Galad has advanced machinery because of the Dragon fossils. Still...
rows.jp: 「その圧倒的な威力から / 戦<b:8b0b>的にあつかわれることは<b:8a97>くないが〜
rows.lit: Given its overwhelming power, it's not unlikely it'd be handled as a strategic weapon, but... [戦略=strategy]
rows.re: With power like that, it may / well be treated as a strategic / weapon, but...
rows.speaker: crew member, on the weapon

rows.en: @Only a monster Dragon - a living machine - could become a flying craft that small.
rows.jp: 「気がかりなのは / 追いつめられたヴィンスフェルトが / いつまで<b:8b0c><b:8b0d>な判断を辺せるかということだ<b:8aeb>機なんてシロモノ / 今の<b:8aa6><b:8a4c>じゃ / なかなか<b:8b0e>りだせないぞ
rows.lit: What worries me is how long a cornered Vinsfeld can keep making rational judgments. [冷静/正常=calm/sound]
rows.re: What worries me is how long a / cornered Vinsfeld can keep / judging with a clear head.
rows.speaker: crew member, on Vinsfeld

rows.en: @Remember: If you can't defeat an enemy from the outside, destroy him from the inside.
rows.jp: 「ギルドグラードじゃドラゴンの合谷を用いて / 機艇<b:8aa6><b:8a4c>が発<b:8aa3>しているらしいが〜
rows.lit: In Guild Galad they use Dragon fossils, and craft technology has advanced, it seems. [化石=fossil, 技術=tech]
rows.re: In Guild Galad they use Dragon / fossils, and craft technology / has come far, it seems.
rows.speaker: crew member, on Guild Galad tech

rows.en: @But there aren't any aircraft. It's like an inn without a pretty proprietress!
rows.jp: 「機艇と生命体の中間存在 / 幻獣ドラゴンそのものでもない<b:8a78>り / このサイズに飛空機艇をおさめられないぞ<b:8b0f>されただけのことはある
rows.lit: A being between craft and living creature. Short of being the phantom-beast Dragon itself, you couldn't fit a flying craft this small. [限り=short of]
rows.re: Half craft, half living thing. / Short of being the Dragon / itself, none fits this small.
rows.speaker: crew member, on the Dragon-craft

rows.en: @Of course, if you want to, you can launch yourselves on this thing.
rows.jp: 「外からドンパチやって落ちねぇのなら / 中に侵入して、街部から破滅する / <b:8aee>本的なことだが、確実な作戦だ<b:8aeb>機の / 発<b:8a95>カタパルトなんだ
rows.lit: If blasting from outside won't down it, sneak inside and wreck it from within. Basic, but a sure plan. [内部=inside, 基本=basic]
rows.re: If blasting it from outside / won't work, get inside and wreck / it there. Basic, but sure.
rows.speaker: crew member, plan of attack

rows.en: @So we can fight off this threat and protect our loved ones!
rows.jp: 「でも、中心要の小<b:8aeb>機が用意されていない / たとえるなら、そう<f040><f042>〜 / 『<b:8ae7>人女<b:8b11>のいない<b:8a9a>』ってとこか？
rows.lit: But no small core craft is provided. To put it... like an inn with no lovely proprietress? [小型機/看板女将/宿]
rows.re: But there's no small core craft. / Like, how to put it, an inn / with no lovely hostess?
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @All they ask of the hero is strength. They don't want the hero to sacrifice himself.
rows.jp: 「まあ、どうしてもって言うのなら / あんたたちを / 生身で<b:8a95>出しても構わないんだけどな<b:8a70>めていたのは / 『<b:8ad2><b:8ad3>』の<b:8b12>なんかじゃない / この脅威を<b:8b13>ってくれる力なんだ
rows.lit: Well, if you really insist, I don't mind launching you out in the flesh. [twin:6/1088 射出=launch]
rows.re: Well, if you really insist, I / don't mind launching you out / in the flesh.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @Only kin of the Magess may enter. Frauds pretending to descend from her may not gain entrance.
rows.jp: 「それは、僕たちひとりひとりが / 少しずつ持っているはずの / 大切なモノを保る力だぜ<b:8ab6><b:8ab7>を前にして / 『<b:8ad2><b:8ad3>』を<b:8a70>めるという〜
rows.lit: It's the power each of us should hold a little of, the power to protect what's precious.
rows.re: It's a power each of us should / hold a little of. The power to / guard what's precious.
rows.speaker: crew member, on the hero's strength

rows.en: @They say it's a tough, risky procedure because of the danger of rejection.
rows.jp: 「それは、力無きゆえに / 『<b:8ad2><b:8ad3>』の力を<b:8a70>めているんだ / けっして『<b:8ad2><b:8ad3>』の<b:8b12>なんかじゃないぜ<b:8ab9>の少女＞と『<b:8ac8>の<b:8ab6><b:8ab7>』との戦いの / 渡記を保存したルルドの<89c8>は / 少女の<b:8b12>を招く者のみに開かれると聞くぜ
rows.lit: The powerless seek the "hero's" power. It's never about the "hero's" bloodline. [twin:10/2521 英雄=hero, 血=blood]
rows.re: The powerless seek a "hero's" / strength. It was never about / a "hero's" bloodline.
rows.speaker: crew member, on the hero

rows.en: @So anyone who tries to get a bionic implant must be a really shady character.
rows.jp: 「<b:8ad2><b:8ad3>の<b:8b14><b:8b15>を<b:8b16><895b>する<b:8a9d>や / 人にあらずモノは / <b:8b17><b:8b18>されるらしいが〜<b:8b19>する手<b:8a4c>は非合法な / <b:8adf><b:8b1a><b:8b1b>によってのみ行われていると聞く
rows.lit: Those who falsely claim the hero's lineage, or things that are not human, are turned away. [詐称=false claim, 拒絶=reject]
rows.re: Those who fake the hero's line, / or those who aren't human, / get turned away, they say.
rows.speaker: crew member, hero/bionic lore

rows.en: @I've never heard of someone having healthy limbs replaced intentionally!
rows.jp: 「さらに、本体との<b:8b17><b:8b18>反応もあるため / 非世に過去で / リスキーな手<b:8a4c>とも聞いているぜ
rows.lit: On top of that there's a rejection reaction with the host body, so I hear it's a very harsh, risky procedure. [拒絶反応/非常に/手術]
rows.re: There's also rejection by the / host body, so it's a very harsh, / risky procedure, I hear.
rows.speaker: crew member, on bionic bodies

rows.en: @The heart is the engine. The brain is the cockpit...
rows.jp: 「それでも / 義体を手に入れようとするってヤツは / 相応のワケ作りってことだろうな来 / ケガや渉気で失った身体の一部を / <b:8b1d>うための<b:8aa6><b:8a4c>だぜ
rows.lit: Even so, anyone who'd try to get a bionic body must have a fitting reason. [twin:6/1093 義体=bionic body]
rows.re: Even so, anyone out to get a / bionic body must have quite / a reason for it.
rows.speaker: crew member, on bionic bodies

rows.en: @In short, it is possible to build a human body from mechanical components.
rows.jp: 「<89c1>に、生身を一部残して / そっくり<88fb>発するなんてケースは / 聞いた事も無いぜ<b:8b0e>は<b:8aee>本的に同じようなモノなんだぜ
rows.lit: Conversely, leaving part of the flesh and developing a whole replacement, I've never heard of it. [twin:6/1094 逆/開発]
rows.re: The reverse, keeping some flesh / and building a full replacement, / I've never once heard of.
rows.speaker: crew member, on bionic bodies

rows.en: @Ancient Filgaia also had Industrial Sorcery, which was more complex and powerful.
rows.jp: 「心<b:8b1e>は、エンジン / <b:8b1f><b:8b20>は、コクピットってなカンジだ
rows.lit: The heart is the engine, the brain the cockpit, that sort of thing. [twin:6/1095 心臓/脳]
rows.re: The heart is the engine, / the brain is the cockpit. / That kind of thing.
rows.speaker: crew member, on bionic bodies

rows.en: @We will use Lost Technology to spice it up a bit for you, out of pity for you.
rows.jp: 「言いかえるならば / 人の体も機艇にて構成することも / 可能ってことだぜ<b:8b21>ちゃんのあつかうクレストソーサーは / もっとも一<b:8b22>的な魔法の大<b:8b23>だぜ
rows.lit: In other words, it's possible to build a human body out of craft components too.
rows.re: Put another way, a human body / can be built out of craft / parts too.
rows.speaker: crew member, on bionic bodies

rows.en: @Don't look so skeptical! Leave everything to us!
rows.jp: 「<8995>か<b:8a76>は、もっと<b:8b24><b:8b25>で / さらに強力なインダストリアルソーサーが / ファルガイアにはあったというぜ<b:8b0e>られる機艇同時なんだぜ<b:8b26>ら、相変わらず<b:8b27>相な / マップスコープを使っているようじゃな
rows.lit: Long ago, Filgaia is said to have had even more complex and powerful Industrial Sorcery. [twin:6/1097 複雑=complex]
rows.re: Long ago, Filgaia is said to / have had far more complex and / powerful Industrial Sorcery.
rows.speaker: crew member, on Industrial Sorcery

rows.en: @You will see how Guild Galad's technology can't even hold a candle to ours!
rows.jp: 「わらわが可理想なお<b:8b26>らのために / ちょっとだけロストテクノロジーを使って / キュートでドキドキな<b:8b29><b:8b0e>をしてしんぜよう
rows.lit: For you cute little ones, I shall use a bit of Lost Technology to give you a cute, thrilling makeover. [twin:10/2523 お主ら/改造]
rows.re: For you dear ones, I'll use a / touch of Lost Technology for a / cute, thrilling upgrade.
rows.speaker: Marivel

rows.en: @You say it looks the same? Hmph! Amateur!
rows.jp: 「<f041><f041><f041>なんじゃ、その中いの目は / わらわに任せておけば大<b:8b2b><b:8b2c>じゃ
rows.lit: What's with that doubtful look? Leave it to me and it'll be fine. [疑い/大丈夫]
rows.re: What's with that doubtful look? / Leave it all to me and / it'll be fine.
rows.speaker: Marivel

rows.en: @Now you can view the map in transport by projecting the image onto your retina!
rows.jp: 「ギルドグラードの<b:8aa6><b:8a4c>など / 足元にも<b:8ad8>ばないことを / ちょっぴり見せつけるだけじゃよ<b:8b03><b:8a7a>にパワーアップじゃッ！
rows.lit: I'll just show off a little that Guild Galad's technology can't even come close. [twin:10/2525 技術/及ばない]
rows.re: I'll just show off a little how / Guild Galad's tech can't even / come close to mine.
rows.speaker: Marivel

rows.en: @They were 1surrounded by a valley, mountains, and the sea0.
rows.jp: 「なに、あまり変わったように見えない？ / これだからシロウトは……
rows.lit: What, it doesn't look much different? This is why amateurs...
rows.re: What, it doesn't look any / different? Hmph. This is why / amateurs...
rows.speaker: Marivel

rows.en: @I couldn't help but notice it because of all the sparks. I wonder what it could be.
rows.jp: 「これはな、マップスコープの<b:8b2d><b:8b2e>を / <b:8b2f><b:8b30>に<8865>搭<88ab>起することで / 移動中でもマップを見られるのじゃッ！<b:8b03><b:8a7a>にパワーアップじゃッ！<b:8b31>めていたんだけどさ
rows.lit: By projecting the map scope's image onto your retina, you can view the map even while moving! [twin:10/2527 映像/網膜]
rows.re: By casting the map scope's image / onto your retina, you can read / the map even while moving!
rows.speaker: Marivel, on the mapscope upgrade

rows.en: @1West of there0 I also saw a town 1on a bridge over a deep ravine.0
rows.jp: 「どこかの[11]お願い<b:8b32>と谷と道に囲まれた[11]ぉ場所で / ちょっとした遺跡みたいのが見えたんだ
rows.lit: In a place ringed by |[?]|, a valley and a road, I saw something like a small ruin. [emphasized landmark <b:8b32> unsolved]
rows.re: In a spot ringed by |[?]|, a / valley and a road, I saw / something like a small ruin.
rows.speaker: kid NPC, a sighting

rows.en: @You know that Dragon in the hanger? He looks scary, but he's actually pretty cool.
rows.jp: 「なんか、バチバチ輝っていたから / 結構目立っててさ / 一体、何があるトコなんだろうな？
rows.lit: It was sparking and shining, so it really stood out. What on earth is there?
rows.re: It was sparking and shining, / so it really stood out. What / on earth could be there?
rows.speaker: kid NPC, a sighting

rows.en: @Why would he do that, anyway?
rows.jp: 「<f040><f041><f042>そういえば、[11]おそこから東の方[11]ぉには / [11]お願い<b:8b32>にかかった<89ec>の上[11]ぉに / 場があるのが見えたぜッ
rows.lit: Come to think of it, |to the east of there|, I saw a place |on a bridge spanning the [?]|. [twin:10/2530 橋=bridge]

rows.speaker: Sir Valeria / Irving

rows.en: @Long ago, I was engaged in research in Sielje.
rows.jp: 「タウンメリアの東や、ダムツェンや北東〜 / それ以外には / [11]お街道外縁部の北や東[11]ぉに海岸があったな去の渡録となったか
rows.lit: East of Town Meria, northeast of Damzen. Besides those, there were coasts to the north and east of the road's outer edge.
rows.re: East of Town Meria, northeast of / Damzen. Also coasts north and east / of the road's rim.
rows.speaker: crew member, coast/search lore

rows.en: @Science, sorcery, contact with the spirit world, and astronomy.
rows.jp: 「かつて私も / シエルジェにて修行に / <b:8a69>ち込んだこともあったのだ〜
rows.lit: Once, I too threw myself into training at Sielje.
rows.re: Once, I too threw myself into / training at Sielje, long ago.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @That's where it all started... Everything.
rows.jp: 「<b:8a6a>神、魔術、異界との搭乗術〜 / そして、大戦神〜
rows.lit: Spirit, sorcery, the art of contact with the other world, and the great war-god.
rows.re: Spirit, sorcery, contact with the / other world, and the war-god.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @You must scour the area.
rows.jp: 「すべては〜 / <f040><f042>そう、すべては / そこから始まったのだ〜<b:8a6e>時だぞ[18]か
rows.lit: All of it, yes, all of it, started from there.
rows.re: All of it. Yes, all of it started / from there.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @My crew and I are ready to battle Odessa! But still...
rows.jp: 「こまかなサーチがカギだな
rows.lit: A careful search is the key.
rows.re: A careful search is the key.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @I wonder if it was right to involve my kid sister, {1}, in all of this.
rows.jp: 「私もクルーも / オデッサとの戦いに信念はできている / だが〜
rows.lit: My crew and I have our resolve set for the fight against Odessa. But...
rows.re: My crew and I have our resolve set / for the fight against Odessa. / But...
rows.speaker: Irving, re sister

rows.en: @I don't want {1} to see the savagery that war brings out in people.
rows.jp: 「我が仲、[0a]おを / <8812>き込んだことだけが / 今なお気がかりである〜
rows.lit: The only thing that still weighs on me is that I dragged {1}, my kin, into this.
rows.re: The one thing that still weighs on / me is that I dragged {1} into this.
rows.speaker: Irving, re sister

rows.en: @Such power would be an invincible weapon to use against Odessa!
rows.jp: 「身の危険よりも、もっと気がかりなこと〜 / 戦いの中で見せる人間のマイナスの面だけは / [0a]おには見せたくないな〜
rows.lit: More than the danger to her, what worries me is this: I don't want her to see the ugly side of people that war brings out.
rows.re: More than the danger, I don't want / her to see the ugly side war brings / out in people.
rows.speaker: Irving, re sister

rows.en: @... But can we control it?
rows.jp: 「その制<89c7>に誓認が無ければ / 我々はオデッサに対する / 強力無比な力を手に入れたといえよう〜
rows.lit: Without a check on that control, we could say we'd have an unmatched power against Odessa.
rows.re: Without a check on it, we'd hold / an unmatched power against Odessa.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @It is the national boundaries that divide Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>だが〜面の相は / オデッサなるテロリストではない
rows.lit: But...
rows.re: But...
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @It serves as a trade route.
rows.jp: 「ファルガイアを分断する / 共通誓認と考えてほしい<b:8a74><89ca>として活<b:8a76>する地辺道だ
rows.lit: Think of it as the borders that divide Filgaia.
rows.re: Think of it as the borders that / divide Filgaia.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @Other cave-ins could occur. Be careful there.
rows.jp: 「さらなる崩落も考えられる / 気をつけて向かってほしい<b:8a77>められた力は他言無用だ / くれぐれも気を付けてくれ味さまから聞いたことがあります
rows.lit: Further cave-ins are possible too. Please be careful heading there.
rows.re: Further cave-ins are possible. / Please be careful heading there.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @about a windswept cave 1far to the northwest, by a Landing Pad no one knows about0.
rows.jp: 「[11]おずっと遠い北東の地〜 / 誰も知らない発着魔法陣の縁り[11]ぉには / 強い<89f9>が支配する魔境があるそうです
rows.lit: Far to the northeast, they say a demon-haunted realm ruled by a powerful force lies near a launch circle no one knows of.
rows.re: Far northeast, near an unknown / launch circle, lies a demon realm / ruled by great power.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @It seems Filgaia still has many mysterious places that are yet unexplored.
rows.jp: 「このファルガイアには / まだまだ不思議な<b:8a7e>が / 遺されているのですね〜味方は / ひどく思い<899e>めているようなのです〜
rows.lit: Filgaia still has strange places left behind, it seems.
rows.re: Filgaia still has strange places / left behind within it, it seems.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @I would do anything to help my brother, even if it meant giving up my very life.
rows.jp: 「私にできることがあれば / この身を<b:8a7f>ててでも / 味方のお役に立ちたいというのに〜<b:8b0b>[14][10]ニ[01]ぜ<8606>[0a]お / 「『幸せ』というもの〜
rows.lit: If there were something I could do, I'd give up my own life to be of use to my brother.
rows.re: If I could do anything, I'd give / my own life to be of use to my / brother.
rows.speaker: Altaecia, re brother/Irving

rows.en: @Sometimes you don't realize how happy you are until you lose something important.
rows.jp: 「何かを失ってから<b:8a81>めて / その存在の大きさに気付くようなモノも / 『幸せ』のひとつなのかもしれません<b:8b0b>[14][10]か[01][09]<8706>[0a]お / 「『強い力』と『強い想い』〜
rows.lit: To realize how great a thing was only after losing it, that too may be a kind of "happiness."
rows.re: To grasp a thing's worth only once / it's lost, that too may be a kind / of happiness.
rows.speaker: Altaecia

rows.en: @With those, you and my brother will someday destroy Odessa. I just know it.
rows.jp: 「味方とあなた方なら / いつかオデッサを駆<b:8a82>することも / できるような気がしてきます〜
rows.lit: With my brother and all of you, I feel someday you could even drive Odessa out.
rows.re: With my brother and you, someday / you could drive Odessa out. I feel / it.
rows.speaker: Altaecia

rows.en: @But will that be the end of my brother's problems? Then again....
rows.jp: 「でもそれは、味方にとって / 終りなのでしょうか？ / それとも〜
rows.lit: But would that be the end for my brother? Or...
rows.re: But would that be the end for my / brother? Or...
rows.speaker: Altaecia

rows.en: @If I had the strength to fight by my brother's side, maybe everything would be alright.
rows.jp: 「私に、味方と共に戦える力があれば / このような中誓を / いだかずにすむのでしょうか〜？<b:8b0b>[14][10]く[01]ツ<8706>[0a]お / 「乾いたファルガイアに生まれいずる / <89d9>悪なモンスターたち〜
rows.lit: If I had the strength to fight beside my brother, could I be spared holding such half-vows?
rows.re: If I could fight at my brother's / side, would I be spared this doubt?
rows.speaker: Altaecia

rows.en: @Just as evil is born in hearts that are barren. There is something sad about them.
rows.jp: 「それは、乾いた心に生まれいずる / 人の心の過ちに / どこか通じる悲しさがあります
rows.lit: There is a sadness in it that somehow connects to the errors of the human heart, born in a barren heart.
rows.re: There is a sadness in it, akin to / the errors born in a barren human / heart.
rows.speaker: Altaecia

rows.en: @Odessa's crime is a stain on the barren human heart.
rows.jp: 「オデッサの<b:8a87>は / 乾いた人の心に落ちた暗い<b:8a88>み
rows.lit: Odessa's crime is a dark stain fallen upon the barren human heart.
rows.re: Odessa's crime is a dark stain / upon the barren human heart.
rows.speaker: Altaecia

rows.en: @But it reflects the barrenness of Filgaia's collective heart.
rows.jp: 「それは、ファルガイアに生きる / すべての人の心の大<b:8a8a>し〜<b:8b0b>[14][10]き[01]ぷ落[0a]お / 「おかえりなさい〜
rows.lit: It is a great reflection of the hearts of all who live in Filgaia.
rows.re: It reflects the hearts of all who / live in Filgaia.
rows.speaker: Altaecia

rows.en: @But only you, who went to the battlefield, have been permitted to return.
rows.jp: 「でも、帰ることが許されたのは / 戦場に<b:8a8b>いた / あなたたちだけ〜
rows.lit: But the only ones permitted to return are you, who went to the battlefield.
rows.re: But only you, who went to the / battlefield, are permitted to / return.
rows.speaker: Altaecia

rows.en: @Who knows when I will be permitted to return to where my brother is.
rows.jp: 「私はいつ〜 / 味方のもとへ / 『帰る』ことができるのでしょう〜
rows.lit: I wonder when I will be able to "return" to my brother's side.
rows.re: I wonder when I'll be able to / "return" to my brother's side.
rows.speaker: Altaecia

rows.en: @I have no wings to flap. No, not even black wings.
rows.jp: 「私は、はばたく<b:8a8c>も持っていない / そう、暗い<b:8a8c>すらも〜<b:8b0b>[14][10]ぎ[01][04]僕[0a]お / 「味方から聞いたことがあります
rows.lit: I have no wings to flap, not even dark ones.
rows.re: I have no wings to flap. Not even / dark ones.
rows.speaker: Altaecia

rows.en: @about a windswept cave 1far to the northwest, by a Landing Pad no one knows about0.
rows.jp: 「[11]おずっと遠い北東の地〜 / 誰も知らない発着魔法陣の縁り[11]ぉには / 強い<89f9>が支配する魔境があるそうです
rows.lit: Far to the northeast, they say a demon-haunted realm ruled by a powerful force lies near a launch circle no one knows of.
rows.re: Far northeast, near an unknown / launch circle, lies a demon realm / ruled by great power.
rows.speaker: crew member; repeat of #1558

rows.en: @It seems Filgaia still has many mysterious places that are yet unexplored.
rows.jp: 「このファルガイアには / まだまだ不思議な<b:8a7e>が / 遺されているのですね〜<b:8b0b>[14][10][14][01]ュ僕[0a]お / 「力を手にしたとき / 誰も、<b:8a8d><b:8a8e>い、政うもの〜
rows.lit: Filgaia still has strange places left behind, it seems.
rows.re: Filgaia still has strange places / left behind within it, it seems.
rows.speaker: crew member; repeat of #1559

rows.en: @But you should consider yourself fortunate.
rows.jp: 「でもそれは / 考えてみれば幸せなことかもしれない
rows.lit: But thinking about it, that might be a fortunate thing.
rows.re: But thinking about it, that might / be a fortunate thing.
rows.speaker: Altaecia

rows.en: @Fortunate to have the option of hesitating, that is.
rows.jp: 「政うだけの選<b:8a8f><b:8a90>という道が / <b:8a91>けるんですもの〜
rows.lit: Because a path remains open, the option that just lets you hesitate.
rows.re: Because a path stays open, the / freedom to hesitate at all.
rows.speaker: Altaecia

rows.en: @Perhaps that is why the powerless look toward the powerful with envy... and fear.
rows.jp: 「だから、力の無い者は / 力を持つ者に<b:8a92>れ / そして、<b:8a93>れるのかもしれません<b:8b0b>[14][10]じ[01]つ眠[0a]お / 「集いし力は、やがて強い輝となり / 奪わんばかりの起を<b:8a94>らしだす〜
rows.lit: That's why the powerless may admire those who have power, and fear them too.
rows.re: So the powerless may admire the / powerful, yet fear them too.
rows.speaker: Altaecia

rows.en: @But do not forget: A bright light also creates a shadow that is that much darker.
rows.jp: 「でも、忘れないで / 輝は同時に / 同じ強さの起を生み出すということを〜
rows.lit: But don't forget, brilliance also creates, at the same time, a shadow of equal strength.
rows.re: But don't forget, brilliance also / casts a shadow of equal strength.
rows.speaker: Altaecia

rows.en: @If I could choose, I would pick a gentle light that envelopes me softly.
rows.jp: 「同じ輝なら / 私は<b:8a95>み込んでくれるような / <89ab>しい輝を望んでいます<b:8b0b>[14][10]<8c00>け<b:8b06>[0a]お / 「事故で戦う力を失った味方は / 以前にも<b:8a97>して力を求めています
rows.lit: If it's the same brilliance, I hope for a gentle one that wraps around me.
rows.re: If it's brilliance either way, I / long for a gentle kind that wraps / around me.
rows.speaker: Altaecia

rows.en: @It's as if he's trying to support not just his own body, but the world itself.
rows.jp: 「まるで、自分の身体だけではなく / この世界そのものを / 支えようとしているみたいに〜
rows.lit: As if he is trying to support not just his own body, but this world itself.
rows.re: As if he's trying to hold up not / just himself, but this world / itself.
rows.speaker: Altaecia

rows.en: @But can our beloved Filgaia be supported by any one person?
rows.jp: 「味方と私の大好きなファルガイア〜 / 人ひとりの力で支えられるモノでしょうか？
rows.lit: My brother, and this Filgaia I love. Can it be held up by the strength of one person?
rows.re: My brother, and this Filgaia I / love. Can one person bear it all?
rows.speaker: Altaecia

rows.en: @Please help my brother! You are strong, unlike me... Nearly as strong as my brother!
rows.jp: 「どうか味方を助けてください / 私には無い、味方と共に<b:8a9a>ぶ力を持つ / あなた方なら、きっと〜<b:8b06>[0a]お / 「味方がお<b:8a9b>方に<b:8a9c>うなんて / 本当にめずらしいこと〜
rows.lit: Please help my brother. You, who have the strength to stand beside him that I lack, surely you can...
rows.re: Please help my brother. You have / the strength to stand at his side. / Surely...
rows.speaker: Altaecia

rows.en: @He has a bad habit of taking everything upon himself.
rows.jp: 「何でもひとりでかかえ込んでしまうのが / 味方の悪いクセなのです
rows.lit: Taking everything on alone is my brother's bad habit.
rows.re: Taking everything on alone is my / brother's bad habit.
rows.speaker: Altaecia

rows.en: @But no one has the strength to do everything all alone.
rows.jp: 「誰も、ひとりで全てをこなすほどの / 力など持っているはずがありません
rows.lit: No one could possibly have the strength to handle everything alone.
rows.re: No one could possibly handle it / all alone.
rows.speaker: Altaecia

rows.en: @Yet everyone has the strength to help others... Isn't it ironic?
rows.jp: 「でも、誰もが / 誰かを助ける力を持っている<f040><f042> / そうではありませんか？<b:8b14>[80]１．いいよ
rows.lit: But everyone has the strength to help someone. Isn't that so?
rows.re: But everyone has the strength to / help someone. Isn't that so?
rows.speaker: Altaecia

rows.en: @Together, we've won victory after victory for ARMS, and I know we can do it again.
rows.jp: 「ＡＲＭＳはいつも / みんなで勝利を勝ち取ってきたんだ / 今度もきっとうまくいくよ
rows.lit: ARMS has always won victory with everyone together. It'll surely work out this time too.
rows.re: ARMS has always won together. / It'll work out this time too.
rows.speaker: Amy / Mee-chan

rows.en: @And even if ARMS can't do it, then the people of Filgaia can ...if we all pull together!
rows.jp: 「それでもうまくいかないときは / ＡＲＭＳだけじゃなくて / ファルガイアのみんなでがんばろうッ！謎した / カイバーベルトの降辺地帯を解<b:8a9f>ッ！
rows.lit: And even if that doesn't work, then not just ARMS, but all of Filgaia can pull together!
rows.re: And if that fails, not just ARMS, / but all of Filgaia, let's pull / together!
rows.speaker: Amy / Mee-chan

rows.en: @The Kuiper Belt crashed in the Land of Death and Destruction.
rows.jp: 「カイバーベルトは滅死の大地〜 / 隣の原野に落辺したものと思われるよ
rows.lit: The Kuiper Belt seems to have crashed onto the neighboring wastes, the Land of Death.
rows.re: The Kuiper Belt crashed in the / Land of Death, out on the / neighboring wastes.
rows.speaker: Amy / Mee-chan, Kuiper Belt report

rows.en: @It's 1northeast of Quartly0, just about halfway between Quartly and Archheim.
rows.jp: 「[11]おクアトリーの北側[11]ぉ〜 / ちょうどクアトリーとアークハイムの / 中間地帯かな？
rows.lit: North of Quartly. Just about the midpoint between Quartly and Archheim, maybe?
rows.re: North of Quartly, about halfway / between Quartly and Archheim.
rows.speaker: Amy / Mee-chan

rows.en: @Good luck, everyone! I've got my fingers crossed!
rows.jp: 「がんばって、みんなッ！ / ミーちゃんからのお願いだよ
rows.lit: Good luck, everyone! It's a wish from Mee-chan.
rows.re: Good luck, everyone! Mee-chan's / counting on you!
rows.speaker: Amy / Mee-chan

rows.en: @I did everything I possibly could, you know.
rows.jp: 「ミーちゃん / いっしょうけんめい / がんばっているよ〜
rows.lit: Mee-chan is trying her very hardest, you know.
rows.re: Mee-chan's been trying her very / hardest, you know.
rows.speaker: Amy / Mee-chan

rows.en: @And K... well, she did her part.
rows.jp: 「ケイちゃんだって / それなりにね
rows.lit: And Kay-chan, well, in her own way too.
rows.re: And Kay-chan, in her own way too.
rows.speaker: Amy / Mee-chan

rows.en: @So why is everyone looking so gloomy even though we all did the best we could?
rows.jp: 「がんばったみんなが / 暗い探しているなんて / ぜったいおかしいよ
rows.lit: Everyone worked so hard, so it's just wrong for them all to look so gloomy.
rows.re: We all worked so hard. It's wrong / for everyone to look so gloomy.
rows.speaker: Amy / Mee-chan

rows.en: @One is near a 1large island far north of Meria0, not far from a Diablo Pillar.
rows.jp: 「まずは、[11]おタウンメリアから / ずっと北の大きな他[11]ぉ〜 / 魔界鍵の一本と<b:8aa0>近いポイントに、ひとつ
rows.lit: First, on a big island far north of Town Meria, one is at a point right near a Diablo Pillar.
rows.re: First, a big island far north of / Meria, one point right by a Diablo / Pillar.
rows.speaker: Amy / Mee-chan, Raypoint report

rows.en: @Another is 1over the sea west of Sylvaland0, apparently in mid-air.
rows.jp: 「更に[11]おシルヴァラントの東方の<b:8aa1>上[11]ぉ〜 / <b:8aa2>知高度から空中だと思われるよ
rows.lit: Next, over the sea east of Sylvaland, apparently up in the air at some unknown altitude.
rows.re: Next, over the sea east of / Sylvaland, seemingly in mid-air.
rows.speaker: Amy / Mee-chan

rows.en: @The third one is fairly near you to the 1southwest of Damzen0!
rows.jp: 「みっつめは / [11]おダムツェンの先東[11]ぉ〜 / わりとすぐ近くにてポイント確認ッ！
rows.lit: The third is southeast of Damzen. A point confirmed fairly close by!
rows.re: The third one, southeast of / Damzen, confirmed fairly close by!
rows.speaker: Amy / Mee-chan

rows.en: @And the last Raypoint... It's on the Coil Island,0 1southeast of Guild Galad0!
rows.jp: 「最後のレイポイントは〜 / [11]おギルドグラードの先側[11]ぉ / ぐるぐる<8812>きの他から反応アリッ！
rows.lit: The last Raypoint, southeast of Guild Galad. A response from the coiled island!
rows.re: The last Raypoint, southeast of / Guild Galad, a signal from the / Coil Island!
rows.speaker: Amy / Mee-chan

rows.en: @A |world| that eats up other worlds? What could that be?
rows.jp: 「ミーちゃんは / ミーちゃんのできることをがんばったよ / 後は、みんなのがんばりに<b:8aa3>待してるからね
rows.lit: Mee-chan did her best at what she could do. The rest, I'm counting on everyone's effort.
rows.re: Mee-chan did all she could. The / rest, I'm counting on all of you.
rows.speaker: Amy / Mee-chan

rows.en: @Even the incredible power of the Dragons couldn't stand a chance against an entire world.
rows.jp: 「世界を食べちゃう『世界』って / いったい何だろう〜
rows.lit: A "world" that eats up worlds, whatever could that be?
rows.re: A "world" that devours worlds. / Whatever could that be?
rows.speaker: Amy / Mee-chan

rows.en: @... Maybe Slayheim or Odessa would have been strong enough to fix this mess.
rows.jp: 「ドラゴンたちのように / 強い力を持っていても / 『世界』には勝てないんだよね〜
rows.lit: Even with power as strong as the dragons', you can't beat a "world," huh.
rows.re: Even power like the dragons' can't / beat a whole "world," huh.
rows.speaker: Amy / Mee-chan

rows.en: @The sky is all crazy... What's going to happen to Filgaia?
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>じゃあ、スレイハイムやオデッサなら / この異世事態を / カイケツできたのかな？
rows.lit: Then, could Slayheim or Odessa have solved this strange-world situation?
rows.re: Could Slayheim or Odessa have / solved this crisis, I wonder?
rows.speaker: Amy / Mee-chan

rows.en: @One is in the 1southeast sea0, in the Devil's Triangle, where the water is dark in color.
rows.jp: 「空は〜 / ファルガイアは / どうなっちゃうんだろうね<b:8aa2>知地帯をピックアップしてみたよ
rows.lit: The sky, Filgaia, what's going to become of them?
rows.re: The sky. Filgaia. What's going / to become of them?
rows.speaker: Amy / Mee-chan

rows.en: @We found another in an area 1southwest of Guild Galad0 separated by a mountain range.
rows.jp: 「まずは、[11]お先側の道[11]ぉにひとつ〜 / ここは、魔の族<894b>道標と言われててね / 道の<8a07>が暗く変<8a07>している道標なんだよ
rows.lit: First, one to the southeast, said to be a demon-clan waymark, a marker where the road's color has darkened.
rows.re: First, one to the southeast, a / demon-clan marker where the road / runs dark.
rows.speaker: Amy / Mee-chan, Raypoint detail

rows.en: @And Numero Tres! 1In the woods southeast of Baskar0! Energy in the forest? How weird!
rows.jp: 「更、少本目ッ！ / [11]おギルドグラードの先東[11]ぉ〜 / 谷地にて<89ae>たれた地標に確認ッ！
rows.lit: And the next one! Southeast of Guild Galad, confirmed at a marker set out in a valley!
rows.re: And the next one! Southeast of / Guild Galad, at a marker in a / valley!
rows.speaker: Amy / Mee-chan

rows.en: @Lastly, number four is on a 1big island far north of here0. Can't get there by sea or land tho.
rows.jp: 「どんどんいくよ、族本目ッ！ / [11]お隠れ里先側の山<b:8aa7>地<89e8>[11]ぉより確認ッ！ / 山でエネルギー反応なんてヘンだよね？
rows.lit: On we go, the next one! Confirmed in the mountains southeast of the hidden village! Energy in the mountains, weird, right?
rows.re: On we go, the next! In the / mountains southeast of the hidden / village. Weird, right?
rows.speaker: Amy / Mee-chan

rows.en: @K reads girls' comic books. You know, the mushy kind!
rows.jp: 「最後の最後、<88d1>本目ッ！ / [11]おここからずっと北にある大きな他[11]ぉにて確認〜 / でも、陸<89ca>も道<89ca>も使えないみたいなんだよ
rows.lit: The very last, the fourth! Confirmed on a big island far north of here, but you can't reach it by land or road.
rows.re: The very last, the fourth! A big / island far north, no land route / to it though.
rows.speaker: Amy / Mee-chan

rows.en: @Sometimes she even cries when she's reading them! Imagine! At her age! Hee, hee!
rows.jp: 「ケイちゃんってさ / 少女まんがオタクなんだよ
rows.lit: You know, Kay-chan is a shoujo-manga geek.
rows.re: You know, Kay-chan's a total / shoujo-manga geek.
rows.speaker: Amy / Mee-chan, re Kate

rows.en: @'Cause the inland sea's current flows toward the beach.
rows.jp: 「いい<b:8aa8>こいて / まんが進みながら、よく描いてるんだよ / ギコハハハッ！
rows.lit: Grown as she is, she's always drawing while reading her manga. Gee-ha-ha-ha!
rows.re: Grown as she is, always drawing / while reading manga. Hee-hee-ha!
rows.speaker: Amy / Mee-chan, re Kate

rows.en: @Like the old saying, |Lost at sea, found at the beach.|
rows.jp: 「街道の<89fc>の流れが / 海岸に向かっているからね
rows.lit: Because the road's current flows toward the coast.
rows.re: Because the road's current flows / toward the coast.
rows.speaker: crew member, coast lore

rows.en: @But I don't see too many rare ones, ya know?
rows.jp: 「『街道の落とし物は海岸で探せ』<f040><f042> / 〜って、<b:8aaa>、何かで聞いた事あるよ<b:8b13>[10][1a]好きミーちゃんが / キミたちの怪獣カードを<b:8aab>定してあげよう[18]か
rows.lit: "Search the coast for what the road drops," or something. I've heard that somewhere.
rows.re: "Search the coast for what the / road drops." Heard that somewhere.
rows.speaker: crew member, coast lore

rows.en: @Some monsters only appear in certain areas or when you use special techniques.
rows.jp: 「でも、レアものの集まりが / もうちょっとかな？
rows.lit: But my collection of rare ones, maybe just a bit more to go?
rows.re: But my collection of rare ones? / Maybe just a bit short still.
rows.speaker: crew member, monster-collector

rows.en: @A true fan should know about those things!
rows.jp: 「限られた地標や / 結単な手段を用いないと / 現われない怪獣もいるからね
rows.lit: Because some monsters won't appear unless you use certain landmarks or simple methods.
rows.re: Some monsters won't appear without / certain spots or methods, you see.
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @It's me, Amy Fairchild! The face behind the voice you know and love so well!
rows.jp: 「マニアなら / そこらへんも押さえとかなきゃッ！
rows.lit: If you're a real fan, you'd better have that covered too!
rows.re: If you're a real fan, you'd better / have that covered too!
rows.speaker: crew member

rows.en: @You can call me |A|.
rows.jp: 「話はすれども、<b:8aaf>は見えず / ウワサのエイミー・フェアチャイルドとは / ボクのことだよ
rows.lit: You hear the voice but never see the face. That rumored Amy Fairchild is me.
rows.re: You hear the voice, never see the / face. That famous Amy Fairchild is / me.
rows.speaker: Amy Fairchild, intro

rows.en: @But it was international teamwork that helped defeat the threats that came after Odessa.
rows.jp: 「ミーちゃんって呼んでね☆<b:8a44>けたのは / わたしたちＡＲＭＳです
rows.lit: Call me Mee-chan, okay? ☆
rows.re: Call me Mee-chan, okay? ☆
rows.speaker: Amy Fairchild

rows.en: @We couldn't have done it alone.
rows.jp: 「ですが、オデッサ以後に / ふりかかった脅威を<b:8a44>けたのは / <b:8ab0>共の協力体制ではないでしょうか〜
rows.lit: But wasn't it a system of shared cooperation that repelled the threats that fell upon us after Odessa?
rows.re: But it was shared, public / cooperation that repelled the / threats after Odessa.
rows.speaker: Kate / telepath, ARMS reflection

rows.en: @If all of Filgaia pulls together, I'm sure we can fight off any threat.
rows.jp: 「わたしたちの力だけではありません
rows.lit: It was not by our strength alone.
rows.re: It was not by our strength alone.
rows.speaker: Kate / telepath

rows.en: @Guild Galad's information and help was a key factor in escaping the nuclear threat.
rows.jp: 「ファルガイアのみんなが力をあわせれば / より大きな脅威に立ち向かえる〜 / そんな気がしませんか？勝因は / <b:8ab0>共の協力にあったといえるでしょう
rows.lit: If all of Filgaia joins strength, we can face an even greater threat. Don't you feel that?
rows.re: If all Filgaia joins strength, we / can face any greater threat. Don't / you feel it?
rows.speaker: Kate / telepath

rows.en: @We have truly changed for the better.
rows.jp: 「結にギルドグラードからの / 情報<b:8ab2>族と協力にて / 理の脅威をまぬがれたのですから〜
rows.lit: In the end it was thanks to Guild Galad's information and cooperation that we escaped that threat.
rows.re: In the end, Guild Galad's intel / and aid let us escape that threat.
rows.speaker: Kate / telepath

rows.en: @I hope that with this power, we can change all of Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「わたしたちは / 確実に変わってきています
rows.lit: We are surely changing.
rows.re: We are surely changing for the / better.
rows.speaker: Kate / telepath

rows.en: @He said that the fight with Odessa was just a warmup...
rows.jp: 「この力で / ファルガイアも変えていければ / いいのですが〜
rows.lit: I only hope we can change Filgaia too with this power.
rows.re: I only hope we can change Filgaia / too with this power.
rows.speaker: Kate / telepath

rows.en: @... that ARMS was formed to combat a much larger, global threat.
rows.jp: 「オデッサとの戦いは / 前<b:8ab3>戦にすぎないと〜
rows.lit: That the fight with Odessa was no more than an opening skirmish...
rows.re: That the fight with Odessa was / only an opening skirmish...
rows.speaker: Kate / telepath

rows.en: @I wonder if the Chief knew about this crisis. Did he know the sky would change like this?
rows.jp: 「ＡＲＭＳは / 来るべき世界<b:8ab4>域の脅威に対して / <b:8ab5><b:8ab6>されたのだと〜
rows.lit: That ARMS was formed to face a coming, world-wide threat...
rows.re: That ARMS was formed to meet a / coming, world-wide threat...
rows.speaker: Kate / telepath

rows.en: @Currently, only 4 Landing Pads are known throughout Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「指揮<899d>は / この空を、今回の異世事態を / あらかじめ期待していたのでしょうか？限定されているので / 運用に難があるヴァレリアシャトーですが〜
rows.lit: Did the Commander foresee this sky, this strange-world crisis, all along?
rows.re: Did the Commander foresee this / sky, this crisis, all along?
rows.speaker: Kate / telepath

rows.en: @As you know, these are in Meria, near the hidden village...
rows.jp: 「ファルガイアには / 現在４ヶ所の降辺ポイント〜 / 発着魔法陣が確認されています
rows.lit: In Filgaia, four landing points, launch circles, are currently confirmed.
rows.re: Filgaia now has four confirmed / landing points, the launch circles.
rows.speaker: Kate / telepath, Landing Pad report

rows.en: @on the island west of the Raline Observatory, and southwest of Guild Galad.
rows.jp: 「まず、ご存知とは思いますが / タウンメリアと隠れ里の付近〜
rows.lit: First, as you likely know, near Town Meria and the hidden village.
rows.re: First, as you likely know, near / Town Meria and the hidden village.
rows.speaker: Kate / telepath

rows.en: @As for Amy, well, that's about all she can do, I'm afraid.
rows.jp: 「そして、レイライン観待<88e4>設より東の他と / ギルドグラードの先東にも / ひとつずつ発着魔法陣があります
rows.lit: And there's one launch circle each on the island east of the Raline Observatory, and southeast of Guild Galad.
