rows.jp: 「私の作戦に<b:8a46>りはない〜 / <b:8a47>念存在を<b:8a48>るには / この作戦以外にはありえないのだ〜
rows.re: There is no mistake in my plan. To / gain what I have craved, there is / no other way.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Isn't there some way for us to harness Mana, the planet's powerful life-energy?
rows.jp: 「彼の地は、レイラインと呼ばれる地<89f4>が / 最大無限に行き交っている地である
rows.re: That land is where the ley-veins / called Raline flow together in / greatest abundance.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @At the cathedral, I said, |You are the cross I gladly bear.|
rows.jp: 「レイラインには / 星の生命エネルギー『マナ』が通い / その終着地帯はレイポイントと呼ばれている
rows.re: Raline carries the planet's / life-energy, Mana. Where it ends, / we call it a Raypoint.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @From that day, our destiny has been to fight together to restore our blue skies.
rows.jp: 「星の生命エネルギー〜 / この強い力を / 我々のモノとする術はないのだろうか〜
rows.re: The planet's life-energy... Is / there no way to make this power our / own?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @The vast records are open only to the Valeria family.
rows.jp: 「私が『お前という<b:8a4d><b:8a4e><b:8a4f>を<89a3><b:8a50>う』と / あの大聖<b:8a52>で言ったことを〜
rows.re: What I said at that cathedral, "I / will bear the cross that is you."
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @I'll get 4 to take over that duty for me. I'm sure she could do it.
rows.jp: 「あの時から / 私たちはいっしょに戦う運命にあったのだ / その戦いこそ、この空を取り戻す戦いなのだ来に保存する渡記<b:8a53>体〜
rows.re: From that moment, our fates were / bound to fight together, to win / back this sky.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @it would never attempt the tactical use of nuclear weapons. However...
rows.jp: 「そこに<89bb>る渡記は最大にして貴重〜 / だが、ヴァレリアの血を招きし者のみが / その恩恵にあずかれるという〜
rows.re: The records sleeping there are vast / and precious, but only Valeria / blood may draw on them.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @If Odessa and Vinsfeld are desperate enough to try something that insane...
rows.jp: 「私に代って、その任〜 / [05]きに任せよう / 彼女ならできるはずである<b:8a59><b:8a5a>者としての理性があるなら〜
rows.re: In my place, I'll leave that duty / to her. She should be able to / handle it.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Then the coming threat could mean Filgaia's destruction.
rows.jp: 「理同時を戦術的に / 用いるなどということはないはずだ / だが〜
rows.re: There shouldn't be any tactical use / of the |nuke|. But...
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @it is time to put a stop to them. If we don't, all of Filgaia will be destroyed.
rows.jp: 「オデッサに、ヴィンスフェルトに / 戦<b:8a5d>を<b:8a5e>じるだけの理性が / 残っていないとするならば〜
rows.re: If Odessa and Vinsfeld no longer / have the sense to hold back from / using it...
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @The Guild Galad Master sent his only son to the salt fields on the pretense of observation.
rows.jp: 「来るべき脅威の前に / ファルガイアは滅びかねない〜理同時まで手に入れようとは〜
rows.re: Filgaia could well be destroyed by / the coming threat. To think they'd / go that far...
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @What could he want with a salty wasteland that is empty but for a few excavation sites?
rows.jp: 「〜そろそろだな / ヤツらをこれ以上野放しにしては / 保るべきファルガイアを失ってしまう
rows.re: It's about time. If we let them run / free any longer, we'll lose Filgaia / for good.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @toward the beach. Unusual but predictably simple.
rows.jp: 「ギルドグラードマスターが / ひとり<89e2>家を視<b:8a61>と<895b>して / 隣の原野に向かわせていたそうだが〜
rows.re: The Guild Galad Master sent his son / to the salt fields, calling it an / inspection.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @There are beaches west of Meria, northwest of Damzen, and on the 1Inland Sea north and west shores0.
rows.jp: 「彼の地は隣に奪われた大地〜 / いくつかの発掘地帯をのぞいて / 無意味な世界に何の用だったのだ〜<b:8a64><b:8a65>なものだ
rows.re: That land is claimed by salt. / Outside a few dig sites, what / business could he have there?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Long ago, I was engaged in research in Sielje.
rows.jp: 「タウンメリアの東や、ダムツェンや北東〜 / それ以外には / [11]お街道外縁部の北や東[11]ぉに海岸があったな去の渡録となったか
rows.re: East of Town Meria, northeast of / Damzen. Also coasts north and east / of the road's rim.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Science, sorcery, contact with the spirit world, and astronomy.
rows.jp: 「かつて私も / シエルジェにて修行に / <b:8a69>ち込んだこともあったのだ〜
rows.re: Once, I too threw myself into / training at Sielje, long ago.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @That's where it all started... Everything.
rows.jp: 「<b:8a6a>神、魔術、異界との搭乗術〜 / そして、大戦神〜
rows.re: Spirit, sorcery, contact with the / other world, and the war-god.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @You must scour the area.
rows.jp: 「すべては〜 / <f040><f042>そう、すべては / そこから始まったのだ〜<b:8a6e>時だぞ[18]か
rows.re: All of it... yes, all of it started / from there.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @My crew and I are ready to battle Odessa! But still...
rows.jp: 「こまかなサーチがカギだな
rows.re: A careful search is the key.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @I wonder if it was right to involve my kid sister, {1}, in all of this.
rows.jp: 「私もクルーも / オデッサとの戦いに信念はできている / だが〜
rows.re: My crew and I have our resolve set / for the fight against Odessa. / But...
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @I don't want {1} to see the savagery that war brings out in people.
rows.jp: 「我が仲、[0a]おを / <8812>き込んだことだけが / 今なお気がかりである〜
rows.re: The one thing that still weighs on / me is that I dragged {1} into this.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Such power would be an invincible weapon to use against Odessa!
rows.jp: 「身の危険よりも、もっと気がかりなこと〜 / 戦いの中で見せる人間のマイナスの面だけは / [0a]おには見せたくないな〜
rows.re: More than the danger, I don't want / her to see the ugly side war brings / out in people.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @... But can we control it?
rows.jp: 「その制<89c7>に誓認が無ければ / 我々はオデッサに対する / 強力無比な力を手に入れたといえよう〜
rows.re: Without a check on it, we'd hold an / unmatched power against Odessa.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @It is the national boundaries that divide Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>だが〜面の相は / オデッサなるテロリストではない
rows.lit: But the true enemy is not the terrorists called Odessa.
rows.re: But the true enemy is not the / terrorists called Odessa.
rows.speaker: Irving

rows.en: @It serves as a trade route.
rows.jp: 「ファルガイアを分断する / 共通誓認と考えてほしい<b:8a74><89ca>として活<b:8a76>する地辺道だ
rows.re: Think of it as the borders that / divide Filgaia.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.jp: 「さらなる崩落も考えられる / 気をつけて向かってほしい<b:8a77>められた力は他言無用だ / くれぐれも気を付けてくれ味さまから聞いたことがあります

rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.jp: 「[11]おずっと遠い北東の地〜 / 誰も知らない発着魔法陣の縁り[11]ぉには / 強い<89f9>が支配する魔境があるそうです
rows.re: Far northeast, near an unknown / launch circle, lies a demon realm / ruled by great power.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @It seems Filgaia still has many mysterious places that are yet unexplored.
rows.jp: 「このファルガイアには / まだまだ不思議な<b:8a7e>が / 遺されているのですね〜味方は / ひどく思い<899e>めているようなのです〜
rows.re: Filgaia still has strange places / left behind within it, it seems.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @I would do anything to help my brother, even if it meant giving up my very life.
rows.jp: 「私にできることがあれば / この身を<b:8a7f>ててでも / 味方のお役に立ちたいというのに〜<b:8b0b>[14][10]ニ[01]ぜ<8606>[0a]お / 「『幸せ』というもの〜
rows.re: If I could do anything, I'd give / my own life to be of use to my / brother.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Sometimes you don't realize how happy you are until you lose something important.
rows.jp: 「何かを失ってから<b:8a81>めて / その存在の大きさに気付くようなモノも / 『幸せ』のひとつなのかもしれません<b:8b0b>[14][10]か[01][09]<8706>[0a]お / 「『強い力』と『強い想い』〜
rows.re: To grasp a thing's worth only once / it's lost, that too may be a kind / of happiness.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @With those, you and my brother will someday destroy Odessa. I just know it.
rows.jp: 「味方とあなた方なら / いつかオデッサを駆<b:8a82>することも / できるような気がしてきます〜
rows.re: With my brother and you, someday / you could drive Odessa out. I feel / it.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @But will that be the end of my brother's problems? Then again....
rows.jp: 「でもそれは、味方にとって / 終りなのでしょうか？ / それとも〜
rows.re: But would that be the end for my / brother? Or...
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @If I had the strength to fight by my brother's side, maybe everything would be alright.
rows.jp: 「私に、味方と共に戦える力があれば / このような中誓を / いだかずにすむのでしょうか〜？<b:8b0b>[14][10]く[01]ツ<8706>[0a]お / 「乾いたファルガイアに生まれいずる / <89d9>悪なモンスターたち〜
rows.re: If I could fight at my brother's / side, would I be spared this doubt?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Just as evil is born in hearts that are barren. There is something sad about them.
rows.jp: 「それは、乾いた心に生まれいずる / 人の心の過ちに / どこか通じる悲しさがあります
rows.re: There is a sadness in it, akin to / the errors born in a barren human / heart.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Odessa's crime is a stain on the barren human heart.
rows.jp: 「オデッサの<b:8a87>は / 乾いた人の心に落ちた暗い<b:8a88>み
rows.re: Odessa's crime is a dark stain / upon the barren human heart.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @But it reflects the barrenness of Filgaia's collective heart.
rows.jp: 「それは、ファルガイアに生きる / すべての人の心の大<b:8a8a>し〜<b:8b0b>[14][10]き[01]ぷ落[0a]お / 「おかえりなさい〜
rows.re: It reflects the hearts of all who / live in Filgaia.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @But only you, who went to the battlefield, have been permitted to return.
rows.jp: 「でも、帰ることが許されたのは / 戦場に<b:8a8b>いた / あなたたちだけ〜
rows.re: But only you, who went to the / battlefield, are permitted to / return.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Who knows when I will be permitted to return to where my brother is.
rows.jp: 「私はいつ〜 / 味方のもとへ / 『帰る』ことができるのでしょう〜
rows.re: I wonder when I'll be able to / "return" to my brother's side.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @I have no wings to flap. No, not even black wings.
rows.jp: 「私は、はばたく<b:8a8c>も持っていない / そう、暗い<b:8a8c>すらも〜<b:8b0b>[14][10]ぎ[01][04]僕[0a]お / 「味方から聞いたことがあります
rows.re: I have no wings to flap. Not even / dark ones.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @about a windswept cave 1far to the northwest, by a Landing Pad no one knows about0.
rows.jp: 「[11]おずっと遠い北東の地〜 / 誰も知らない発着魔法陣の縁り[11]ぉには / 強い<89f9>が支配する魔境があるそうです
rows.re: Far northeast, near an unknown / launch circle, lies a demon realm / ruled by great power.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @It seems Filgaia still has many mysterious places that are yet unexplored.
rows.jp: 「このファルガイアには / まだまだ不思議な<b:8a7e>が / 遺されているのですね〜<b:8b0b>[14][10][14][01]ュ僕[0a]お / 「力を手にしたとき / 誰も、<b:8a8d><b:8a8e>い、政うもの〜
rows.re: Filgaia still has strange places / left behind within it, it seems.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @But you should consider yourself fortunate.
rows.jp: 「でもそれは / 考えてみれば幸せなことかもしれない
rows.re: But thinking about it, that might / be a fortunate thing.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Fortunate to have the option of hesitating, that is.
rows.jp: 「政うだけの選<b:8a8f><b:8a90>という道が / <b:8a91>けるんですもの〜
rows.re: Because a path stays open, the / freedom to hesitate at all.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Perhaps that is why the powerless look toward the powerful with envy... and fear.
rows.jp: 「だから、力の無い者は / 力を持つ者に<b:8a92>れ / そして、<b:8a93>れるのかもしれません<b:8b0b>[14][10]じ[01]つ眠[0a]お / 「集いし力は、やがて強い輝となり / 奪わんばかりの起を<b:8a94>らしだす〜
rows.re: So the powerless may admire the / powerful, yet fear them too.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @But do not forget: A bright light also creates a shadow that is that much darker.
rows.jp: 「でも、忘れないで / 輝は同時に / 同じ強さの起を生み出すということを〜
rows.re: But don't forget, brilliance also / creates a shadow of equal strength.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @If I could choose, I would pick a gentle light that envelopes me softly.
rows.jp: 「同じ輝なら / 私は<b:8a95>み込んでくれるような / <89ab>しい輝を望んでいます<b:8b0b>[14][10]<8c00>け<b:8b06>[0a]お / 「事故で戦う力を失った味方は / 以前にも<b:8a97>して力を求めています
rows.re: If it's brilliance either way, I / long for a gentle kind that wraps / around me.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @It's as if he's trying to support not just his own body, but the world itself.
rows.jp: 「まるで、自分の身体だけではなく / この世界そのものを / 支えようとしているみたいに〜
rows.re: As if he's trying to hold up not / just himself, but this world / itself.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @But can our beloved Filgaia be supported by any one person?
rows.jp: 「味方と私の大好きなファルガイア〜 / 人ひとりの力で支えられるモノでしょうか？
rows.re: My brother, and this Filgaia I / love. Can one person bear it all?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Please help my brother! You are strong, unlike me... Nearly as strong as my brother!
rows.jp: 「どうか味方を助けてください / 私には無い、味方と共に<b:8a9a>ぶ力を持つ / あなた方なら、きっと〜<b:8b06>[0a]お / 「味方がお<b:8a9b>方に<b:8a9c>うなんて / 本当にめずらしいこと〜
rows.re: Please help my brother. You have / the strength to stand at his side. / Surely...
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @He has a bad habit of taking everything upon himself.
rows.jp: 「何でもひとりでかかえ込んでしまうのが / 味方の悪いクセなのです
rows.re: Taking everything on alone is my / brother's bad habit.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @But no one has the strength to do everything all alone.
rows.jp: 「誰も、ひとりで全てをこなすほどの / 力など持っているはずがありません
rows.re: No one could possibly have the / strength to handle it all alone.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Yet everyone has the strength to help others... Isn't it ironic?
rows.jp: 「でも、誰もが / 誰かを助ける力を持っている<f040><f042> / そうではありませんか？<b:8b14>[80]１．いいよ
rows.re: But everyone has the strength to / help someone. Isn't that so?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Together, we've won victory after victory for ARMS, and I know we can do it again.
rows.jp: 「ＡＲＭＳはいつも / みんなで勝利を勝ち取ってきたんだ / 今度もきっとうまくいくよ
rows.re: ARMS has always won together. / It'll work out this time too.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @And even if ARMS can't do it, then the people of Filgaia can ...if we all pull together!
rows.jp: 「それでもうまくいかないときは / ＡＲＭＳだけじゃなくて / ファルガイアのみんなでがんばろうッ！謎した / カイバーベルトの降辺地帯を解<b:8a9f>ッ！
rows.re: And if that's not enough, all of / Filgaia can pitch in! We found the / Kuiper Belt's crash site!
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @The Kuiper Belt crashed in the Land of Death and Destruction.
rows.jp: 「カイバーベルトは滅死の大地〜 / 隣の原野に落辺したものと思われるよ
rows.re: The Kuiper Belt is thought to have / crashed in the Land of Death and / Destruction nearby.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @It's 1northeast of Quartly0, just about halfway between Quartly and Archheim.
rows.jp: 「[11]おクアトリーの北側[11]ぉ〜 / ちょうどクアトリーとアークハイムの / 中間地帯かな？
rows.re: North of Quartly, right about / halfway between Quartly and / Archheim.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Good luck, everyone! I've got my fingers crossed!
rows.jp: 「がんばって、みんなッ！ / ミーちゃんからのお願いだよ
rows.re: Good luck, everyone! This is Amy's / request to you.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @I did everything I possibly could, you know.
rows.jp: 「ミーちゃん / いっしょうけんめい / がんばっているよ〜
rows.re: Amy's trying her very hardest too, / you know.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @And K... well, she did her part.
rows.jp: 「ケイちゃんだって / それなりにね
rows.re: Kate's doing her part too, in her / own way.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @So why is everyone looking so gloomy even though we all did the best we could?
rows.jp: 「がんばったみんなが / 暗い探しているなんて / ぜったいおかしいよ
rows.re: Everyone tried so hard, so why's / everyone still looking so gloomy? / That's weird.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @One is near a 1large island far north of Meria0, not far from a Diablo Pillar.
rows.jp: 「まずは、[11]おタウンメリアから / ずっと北の大きな他[11]ぉ〜 / 魔界鍵の一本と<b:8aa0>近いポイントに、ひとつ
rows.re: First, a big island far north of / Meria, one point right by a Diablo / Pillar.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Another is 1over the sea west of Sylvaland0, apparently in mid-air.
rows.jp: 「更に[11]おシルヴァラントの東方の<b:8aa1>上[11]ぉ〜 / <b:8aa2>知高度から空中だと思われるよ
rows.re: Next, over the sea east of / Sylvaland, seemingly in mid-air.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @The third one is fairly near you to the 1southwest of Damzen0!
rows.jp: 「みっつめは / [11]おダムツェンの先東[11]ぉ〜 / わりとすぐ近くにてポイント確認ッ！
rows.re: Number three's just past Damzen to / the east. Fairly close by, / confirmed!
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @And the last Raypoint... It's on the Coil Island,0 1southeast of Guild Galad0!
rows.jp: 「最後のレイポイントは〜 / [11]おギルドグラードの先側[11]ぉ / ぐるぐる<8812>きの他から反応アリッ！
rows.re: The last one's past Guild Galad, a / reading from a spiral-shaped / island!
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @A |world| that eats up other worlds? What could that be?
rows.jp: 「ミーちゃんは / ミーちゃんのできることをがんばったよ / 後は、みんなのがんばりに<b:8aa3>待してるからね
rows.re: Mee-chan did all she could. The / rest, I'm counting on all of you.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Even the incredible power of the Dragons couldn't stand a chance against an entire world.
rows.jp: 「世界を食べちゃう『世界』って / いったい何だろう〜
rows.re: A "world" that eats up other / worlds... what could that even be?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @... Maybe Slayheim or Odessa would have been strong enough to fix this mess.
rows.jp: 「ドラゴンたちのように / 強い力を持っていても / 『世界』には勝てないんだよね〜
rows.re: Even power like the dragons' can't / beat a whole "world," huh.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @The sky is all crazy... What's going to happen to Filgaia?
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>じゃあ、スレイハイムやオデッサなら / この異世事態を / カイケツできたのかな？
rows.re: So could Slayheim or Odessa have / solved this otherworldly mess, / then?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @One is in the 1southeast sea0, in the Devil's Triangle, where the water is dark in color.
rows.jp: 「空は〜 / ファルガイアは / どうなっちゃうんだろうね<b:8aa2>知地帯をピックアップしてみたよ
rows.re: The sky... Filgaia... What's going / to become of them?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @We found another in an area 1southwest of Guild Galad0 separated by a mountain range.
rows.jp: 「まずは、[11]お先側の道[11]ぉにひとつ〜 / ここは、魔の族<894b>道標と言われててね / 道の<8a07>が暗く変<8a07>している道標なんだよ
rows.re: First, one to the southeast, a / demon-clan marker where the road / runs dark.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @And Numero Tres! 1In the woods southeast of Baskar0! Energy in the forest? How weird!
rows.jp: 「更、少本目ッ！ / [11]おギルドグラードの先東[11]ぉ〜 / 谷地にて<89ae>たれた地標に確認ッ！
rows.re: And the next one! Southeast of / Guild Galad, at a marker in a / valley!
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Lastly, number four is on a 1big island far north of here0. Can't get there by sea or land tho.
rows.jp: 「どんどんいくよ、族本目ッ！ / [11]お隠れ里先側の山<b:8aa7>地<89e8>[11]ぉより確認ッ！ / 山でエネルギー反応なんてヘンだよね？
rows.re: On we go, the next! In the / mountains southeast of the hidden / village. Weird, right?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @K reads girls' comic books. You know, the mushy kind!
rows.jp: 「最後の最後、<88d1>本目ッ！ / [11]おここからずっと北にある大きな他[11]ぉにて確認〜 / でも、陸<89ca>も道<89ca>も使えないみたいなんだよ
rows.re: Very last, number four! On a big / island far north of here. No land / route seems to reach it.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Sometimes she even cries when she's reading them! Imagine! At her age! Hee, hee!
rows.jp: 「ケイちゃんってさ / 少女まんがオタクなんだよ
rows.re: You know, Kate's actually a huge / fan of shoujo manga.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @'Cause the inland sea's current flows toward the beach.
rows.jp: 「いい<b:8aa8>こいて / まんが進みながら、よく描いてるんだよ / ギコハハハッ！
rows.re: Grown as she is, always drawing / while reading manga. Hee-hee-ha!
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Like the old saying, |Lost at sea, found at the beach.|
rows.jp: 「街道の<89fc>の流れが / 海岸に向かっているからね
rows.re: Because the road's current flows / toward the coast.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @But I don't see too many rare ones, ya know?
rows.jp: 「『街道の落とし物は海岸で探せ』<f040><f042> / 〜って、<b:8aaa>、何かで聞いた事あるよ<b:8b13>[10][1a]好きミーちゃんが / キミたちの怪獣カードを<b:8aab>定してあげよう[18]か
rows.re: "Search the coast for what the / road drops." Heard that somewhere.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Some monsters only appear in certain areas or when you use special techniques.
rows.jp: 「でも、レアものの集まりが / もうちょっとかな？
rows.re: But my collection of rare ones? / Maybe just a bit short still.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @A true fan should know about those things!
rows.jp: 「限られた地標や / 結単な手段を用いないと / 現われない怪獣もいるからね
rows.re: Some monsters won't appear without / certain spots or methods, you see.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @It's me, Amy Fairchild! The face behind the voice you know and love so well!
rows.jp: 「マニアなら / そこらへんも押さえとかなきゃッ！
rows.re: If you're a real fan, you'd better / have that covered too!
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @You can call me |A|.
rows.jp: 「話はすれども、<b:8aaf>は見えず / ウワサのエイミー・フェアチャイルドとは / ボクのことだよ
rows.re: You hear the voice, never see the / face. That famous Amy Fairchild is / me.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @But it was international teamwork that helped defeat the threats that came after Odessa.
rows.jp: 「ミーちゃんって呼んでね☆<b:8a44>けたのは / わたしたちＡＲＭＳです
rows.re: Call me Mee-chan, okay? ☆
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @We couldn't have done it alone.
rows.jp: 「ですが、オデッサ以後に / ふりかかった脅威を<b:8a44>けたのは / <b:8ab0>共の協力体制ではないでしょうか〜
rows.re: But it was shared, public / cooperation that repelled the / threats after Odessa.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @If all of Filgaia pulls together, I'm sure we can fight off any threat.
rows.jp: 「わたしたちの力だけではありません
rows.re: It wasn't only our own strength.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Guild Galad's information and help was a key factor in escaping the nuclear threat.
rows.jp: 「ファルガイアのみんなが力をあわせれば / より大きな脅威に立ち向かえる〜 / そんな気がしませんか？勝因は / <b:8ab0>共の協力にあったといえるでしょう
rows.re: If all of Filgaia joins strength, / we can face down bigger threats. / That's what won it, I think.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @We have truly changed for the better.
rows.jp: 「結にギルドグラードからの / 情報<b:8ab2>族と協力にて / 理の脅威をまぬがれたのですから〜
rows.re: In the end, Guild Galad's intel / and aid let us escape that threat.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @I hope that with this power, we can change all of Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「わたしたちは / 確実に変わってきています
rows.re: We are certainly changing, bit by / bit.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @He said that the fight with Odessa was just a warmup...
rows.jp: 「この力で / ファルガイアも変えていければ / いいのですが〜
rows.re: If only we could use this strength / to change Filgaia as well.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @... that ARMS was formed to combat a much larger, global threat.
rows.jp: 「オデッサとの戦いは / 前<b:8ab3>戦にすぎないと〜
rows.re: That the fight with Odessa was / only an opening skirmish...
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @I wonder if the Chief knew about this crisis. Did he know the sky would change like this?
rows.jp: 「ＡＲＭＳは / 来るべき世界<b:8ab4>域の脅威に対して / <b:8ab5><b:8ab6>されたのだと〜
rows.re: That ARMS was formed to meet a / coming, world-wide threat...
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Currently, only 4 Landing Pads are known throughout Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「指揮<899d>は / この空を、今回の異世事態を / あらかじめ期待していたのでしょうか？限定されているので / 運用に難があるヴァレリアシャトーですが〜
rows.re: Did the Commander foresee this sky, / this whole otherworldly mess, all / along?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @As you know, these are in Meria, near the hidden village...
rows.jp: 「ファルガイアには / 現在４ヶ所の降辺ポイント〜 / 発着魔法陣が確認されています
rows.re: Filgaia now has four confirmed / landing points, the launch circles.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @on the island west of the Raline Observatory, and southwest of Guild Galad.
rows.jp: 「まず、ご存知とは思いますが / タウンメリアと隠れ里の付近〜
rows.re: First, as you probably know, near / Town Meria and the hidden village.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @As for Amy, well, that's about all she can do, I'm afraid.
rows.jp: 「そして、レイライン観待<88e4>設より東の他と / ギルドグラードの先東にも / ひとつずつ発着魔法陣があります
rows.re: And one each, east of the Raline / Observatory and southeast of Guild / Galad.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Come to think of it, I think the Chief studied in Sielje, as well.
rows.jp: 「まあ、エイミーは / そんなことくらいにしか / 役に立ちませんが〜共にテレパスマジックを神んだ仲なのです
rows.re: Well, Amy's only good for that / much. We studied Telepath Magic / together, once.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @He applies that vast knowledge to tactics and commanding.
rows.jp: 「たしか、指揮<899d>も / シエルジェにていろいろなことを / 神んでいたとか〜
rows.re: The Commander, too, studied many / things at Sielje, I recall.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @He has such amazing judgment and is so perceptive yet never predictable in battle.
rows.jp: 「<b:8ab9><b:8aba>なところが / 作戦指揮に<b:8abb><b:8abc>されているんですね<b:8abd>と指揮に無くてはなりません
rows.re: His broad knowledge is put to use / in his tactical command.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Amy and I are the operators. We're also both telepaths.
rows.jp: 「緊急事態に対する決断力と意外性 / そして、先を見<b:8a41>した達観力は / 誰よりも<b:8abe>でていると思いませんか？<b:8a9c>いしましたね？
rows.re: His decisiveness in a crisis, and / his farseeing insight, outdo / anyone's, don't they?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @But is she really masterless? Actually, she isn't.
rows.jp: 「エイミーとふたり / オペレート<8847>当している / テレパスメイジです<b:8abf>無き、ヴァレリアシャトーか〜
rows.re: Amy and I handle operations, the / two of us. We're telepath mages.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Valeria Chateau is the symbol of peace in Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「そうかな？ / いいや、そうじゃないさ
rows.re: You think so? No, that's not it.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @All of us who live in Filgaia are her |masters.| Get it?
rows.jp: 「ヴァレリアシャトーは / ファルガイアの注目を<b:8ac2><b:8ac3>する<b:8ac4><8882>
rows.re: Valeria Chateau is a symbol that / draws all Filgaia's eyes.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @When the time comes, she has to take everyone to safety. If such a place exists, that is.
rows.jp: 「<b:8abf>は、ファルガイアに生きる僕たち全体〜 / な、そうだろう？<b:8ac6><b:8ac7>作<b:8ac8>中〜 / つまり、運用できないんだ
rows.re: Her master is all of us who live / in Filgaia. Right?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @We don't want her breaking apart in mid-air 'cause of all the damage she's sustained.
rows.jp: 「いざとなったら民間人を斬殺して / あるのかわからない安全地<89e8>に / 向かう準備をしているのさ
rows.re: When the time comes, she'll bear / civilians to a safe zone, if one / even exists.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @My poor, sweet Val! I wish we could cut down on these raids, but no such luck, eh?
rows.jp: 「その時、今までのダメージが / いっきに<b:8acb>き出したら / シャレにならないだろう？<b:8acc><b:8acd>も無視できないんだ
rows.re: If all that damage bursts out at / once then, it'd be no joke, right?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Let's show 'em what Valeria Chateau can do!
rows.jp: 「可愛いシャトーが悲<b:8ace>をあげちまうぜ / 出撃もできるだけ<b:8acf>えてほしいんだが〜 / そうもいかねぇよな<b:8ad0><b:8ad1>が無くなったわけじゃないぜ
rows.re: My darling Chateau would cry out. / I'd cut back the sorties if I / could, but no such luck.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @All the battles have started to take their toll on the hull.
rows.jp: 「ヴァレリアシャトーを使って / ハデに暴れてやろうぜッ！
rows.re: Let's take Valeria Chateau and / raise some hell!
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @When I take her out on an attack, I treat her VERY gently...
rows.jp: 「<b:8ad3>度<b:8ad3>度の出撃が<89d3>体に<b:8ad4>いて / けっこうガタがきているんのさ
rows.re: All these sorties wear on her / hull. She's getting rickety.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @as gently as I would a lady!
rows.jp: 「出撃があるたびに / 『これが最後』と思って / 大切にあつかっているつもりなんだぜ
rows.re: Every sortie, I tell myself it's / the last, and treat her with care.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Just keeping her running is expensive enough -- not to mention flying her!
rows.jp: 「そりゃもう、女の家なみに<b:8ad5>なのさ
rows.re: Why, as gently as I'd treat a / lady.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @I know Sir Valeria is loaded, but where does Odessa get all that money?
rows.jp: 「そんなもの、飛ばすどころか / 維持するだけで / 最大な費用がかかっちまうんだが〜
rows.re: Never mind flying her. Just / keeping her running costs a / fortune.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @I'm the best in Filgaia at handling flyin' machines and pretty ladies!
rows.jp: 「貴<b:8ad9>方のヴァレリア公はいざしらず / オデッサの連中 / どこから<b:8adb>金を調達しているんだ？<b:8adc><b:8add><8847>当だ
rows.re: Sir Valeria's a noble, sure. But / that Odessa lot, where's their / money come from?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @What can I do for ya?2
rows.jp: 「飛空機艇と / 女の家のあつかいに関しては / ファルガイアじゃ一番のつもりさ
rows.re: When it comes to airships and / ladies, I'm the best in Filgaia.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @To board, touch a Landing Pad and press the 2 button. I'll bring you aboard after the boarding call.
rows.jp: 「そんな僕に何か用かい？[18]か乗り降りは / 発着魔法陣の上のみでおこなわれるのさ
rows.re: Something you need from me?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @To leave Valeria Chateau, you also press the 3 button while over a Landing Pad.
rows.jp: 「ヴァレリアシャトーに乗りたいときは / 発着魔法陣上で[0b]かボタンを押してくれ / <887c>乗コールを聞きつけたら回斬してやるぜ
rows.re: To board, press [0b] over a / Landing Pad. I'll swing round at / the boarding call.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @If you press the 3 button when not over a Landing Pad, the Special Menu comes up.
rows.jp: 「ヴァレリアシャトーから降りたいときは / これまた発着魔法陣上で / [0b]がボタンだ
rows.re: To get off, again press [0b] / over a Landing Pad.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Use the Special Menu to move through Valeria Chateau or have me pilot her.
rows.jp: 「発着魔法陣の上以外の場所で / [0b]がボタンを押すと / <b:8adf>用メニューが開かれる
rows.re: Press [0b] off a Landing Pad / and the Special Menu opens.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @I'm handsome but I still don't get noticed enough, so let me fly whenever you can!2
rows.jp: 「ヴァレリアシャトー街での行動や / 僕に<b:8adc>最を任せるときは / <b:8adf>用メニューを開いてくれよなッ！
rows.re: To move about the Chateau or let / me pilot, open the Special Menu!
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @I can't believe he betrayed us...
rows.jp: 「カオの良さに反比<8943>して / なぜだか目立たない僕からのお願いだッ！ / 出番たのむぜッ！[18]か公がオデッサと / つながっていたって本当なのか？
rows.re: Even good-looking as I am, nobody / notices me! Give me my moment to / shine!
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @I feel like I can't trust anyone anymore...
rows.jp: 「ワシらはやっぱり / 大切られたんだろうか？
rows.re: Have we been cast aside, after / all?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @During the next attack, she's going to be used to take all the civilians to safety.
rows.jp: 「人を信じ続けること / それは、無意味なんだろうか〜？発中だ
rows.re: Continuing to trust people. Is that / meaningless, then?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Is the situation in Filgaia that desperate?
rows.jp: 「今度出撃する時は / 民間人を斬殺して / 危険を回転するつもりらしい
rows.re: Next sortie, the plan is to move / the civilians clear and turn the / danger aside.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Maybe if we all pull together, we'll make it through this...
rows.jp: 「ファルガイアは / そんなにせっぱつまっているのか？
rows.re: Is Filgaia really in that desperate / a situation?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @You can't let this go on! You must trust in Sir Valeria's tactics more! Let us help!
rows.jp: 「ワシたちの力をあわせても / どうにもならないのか？<b:8ae1>に閉ざされたまま？
rows.re: Even if we all join strength, is / there nothing to be done? Sealed / away like this?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Instead of doing everything yourself, share the burden. Let's work together.
rows.jp: 「ダメだダメだ、そんなことじゃダメだ / もっとヴァレリア公の作戦を信じよう / 僕たちを信じてくれよ
rows.re: No, no, that won't do. Trust Sir / Valeria's plan more. Trust us.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @What I want to know is where Miss 5 went, leaving the EMMA motor behind...
rows.jp: 「自分ひとりでしょいこまないで / みんなの力で何とかしようと考えりゃ / <b:8ae2>の力も抜けてくるもんだ
rows.re: Don't shoulder it alone. Lean on / everyone, and the strain eases.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @What's her story, anyway? I wonder if she was a butcher before, like me.
rows.jp: 「そんなことより / エマ・モーターをほったらかして / [05]ぎ<b:8ae3>はいずこへッ！<b:8ae3>がいてくれたおかげで / エマ・モーターは、見事よみがえったのだ
rows.re: More to the point, {3} left the / EMMA motor behind and went, where?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @The hull can barely keep up with all that power!
rows.jp: 「いったい何者なんだろう？ / まさか、ワシと同じく / 前<b:8a3e>は銃乗なのか〜ッ！
rows.re: Who is she, anyway? Don't tell me / she was a gunner before, like me!
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Can't we help out somehow?
rows.jp: 「その出力に / <89d3>体の方が / ついていっておらんくらいだからのう
rows.re: The hull can hardly keep up with / that output.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Odessa's Varukisas must have had a similar engine.
rows.jp: 「何とかならんのか〜？
rows.re: Can't something be done about it?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @I used to be a butcher before I joined the service.
rows.jp: 「オデッサのバルキサスも / 同方の動力機関が / <887c><887d>されていたと思うな<b:8ae4>長 / ガバチョである
rows.re: I bet Odessa's Varukisas had a / similar engine installed too.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @I joined ARMS to help out during this crisis. Pleased to meet ya.
rows.jp: 「ちなみに前<b:8a3e>は / 銃乗だったのだッ！
rows.re: By the way, my old trade? Gunner!
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @He said something about this being the |last supper.|
rows.jp: 「枯急の事態にて / ＡＲＭＳに<b:8ae5>せ任じたのだ / よろしくたのむぞ<b:8ae7>ちゃんが描きながら / おじやのドンブリ渡してくれたんです
rows.re: This dire crisis, I threw in with / ARMS. Good to work with you.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @It's bad luck to say that!
rows.jp: 「『最後の<b:8ae8><b:8ae9>だッ！』 / <f040><f042>なんて言いながら〜
rows.re: Going on about "the last supper," / he was...
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Besides, if it were the last supper, I'd want to have that last meal with everyone.
rows.jp: 「<b:8aea>起でもありませんよ
rows.re: That's dreadful luck to say.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Food is so much better when everyone eats together. Being together is the best!
rows.jp: 「もしも、ホントに / 最後の<b:8ae8><b:8ae9>をしなくちゃならないのなら / ファルガイアのみんなとゴハンを食べたいな
rows.re: If it truly were a last supper, / I'd want to eat it with all of / Filgaia.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Think about it! You can't even get a decent chili cheeseburger in Meria!
rows.jp: 「みんなでいっしょに食べるゴハンは / 少<8913>り<b:8a97>しでウマイからね / やっぱり、みんないっしょが一番だよ
rows.re: A meal shared tastes better. / Being together really is best.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @So how can those brats even appreciate the exquisite taste of my chili cheeseburgers?
rows.jp: 「考えてみれば、タウンメリアじゃ / ソースたぷたぷコロッケは / 手に入らないんだッ！
rows.re: Come to think of it, you can't get / sauce-drenched croquettes in Town / Meria!
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @... Those thieving brats! I'll teach them not to underestimate the son of a butcher!
rows.jp: 「なのに、なぜッ！ / あのジャリどもはソースたぷたぷコロッケの / <b:8aeb>おしいばかりの味を知っているんだッ！
rows.re: So why do those brats know the / maddening taste of my sauce- / drenched croquettes?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Pops is infatuated with that girl in the outfit.
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>コソドロめ〜 / あんまりなめてほしくないな / 銃乗のせがれをよぉッ！
rows.re: Those sneak thieves. Don't / underestimate a gunner's son!
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @As his son, I have never been so shocked in all my life.
rows.jp: 「<b:8ae7>ちゃんが / 着ぐるみの女の家にご中心だったんです
rows.re: My dad was smitten with the lady / in the mascot suit.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @It looks like the case of the purloined chili cheeseburger will go unsolved.
rows.jp: 「せがれとして / こんなショッキングな / 出来事は他にありません協力をもってしても事件は解決できません〜
rows.re: As his son, there's no other event / as shocking as this one.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.jp: 「このまま / ソースたぷたぷコロッケ消失事件は / 政<b:8aed>入りとなってしまうのでしょうか？
rows.re: Will the case of the vanished / croquettes go unsolved, then?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @They're both extremely helpful and we really hit it off.
rows.jp: 「[0a]ぎ様と / [0a]く様です
rows.re: It's {5} and {6}.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @After all, we all love chili cheeseburgers.
rows.jp: 「ふたりとも非世に協力的で / すぐに仲良しになってしまいました
rows.re: They're both so helpful, we hit / it off at once.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @I'm a bit of an engineer, you know, so I wonder what kind of energy Odessa uses.
rows.jp: 「彼らも / ソースたぷたぷコロッケ大好き同僚ですから<b:8aef>料無くては飛べません
rows.re: After all, they love sauce- / drenched croquettes too.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @As for my source of energy, my chili cheeseburger disappeared earlier.
rows.jp: 「機関胞の<b:8af0>くれとして / オデッサのエネルギー事情〜 / 気になりますね
rows.re: As a bit of an engineer, I wonder / about Odessa's energy source.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @You don't suppose those two Odessa infiltrators gobbled them up, do you?
rows.jp: 「ちなみに<b:8af1>人的なエネルギー事情ですが / 以前、ボクのソースたぷたぷコロッケが / ちょっと目を離したスキに消失したのです
rows.re: As for my own energy, my croquette / vanished the moment I looked away.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Before I joined the service, I worked at dad's butcher shop.
rows.jp: 「まさか、シャトー街に侵入してきた / オデッサのふたりが / わきめもふらずにモリモリと〜
rows.re: Don't tell me those two Odessa / infiltrators just gobbled it right / up.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Dad's been alone since Mom left. I wanted to be with him, so I joined ARMS, too.
rows.jp: 「ちなみに前<b:8a3e>は / 銃乗のせがれでしたッ！
rows.re: By the way, before this? A / gunner's son!
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Maybe we're destined to meet... to come together in a sweaty tussle.
rows.jp: 「<b:8af2>ちゃんに逃げられた / <b:8ae7>ちゃんをひとりにしておけないから / こうしてＡＲＭＳに<b:8ae5>せ任じました<b:8af3>に<b:8af4>くお<88f7><b:8af5>は / ニンゲンにも<b:8af4>くわ〜<b:8af5>もいいけど / <8865><b:8af6>も<b:8af7>斬がいいらしいわね<b:8af5>を<88ab>げたのよ〜<b:8af5>でケガを分す人もいれば〜
rows.re: Mom ran off, and I couldn't leave / dad alone, so I joined ARMS.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Sir Valeria must have a good reason for doing what he did. I just know it.
rows.jp: 「う、運命がひかれあい / もつれあって / くんずほぐれつ〜<b:8b07>許や無<b:8adb><b:8afc>が / 危険きわまりないのは〜発と / ナースのお仕事よ〜来ちゃイケナイわ / 早くお逃げなさい〜<b:8af5>になれてないのです<b:8a69>ってます<b:8bb2>[06]リンダ / 「も、もう
rows.re: F-fate, drawn together, tangled, / grappling...
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @On the island is a small village called Palace Village.
rows.jp: 「公のことだ / きっと何かの思<b:8a8e>があるに違いない / 僕はそう、信じている<b:8b0e>ちている星のエネルギーによって / パンに最<b:8b0f>な<b:8b10>が<b:8b11>かに実っているらしい
rows.re: Being Sir Valeria, he surely has / his reasons. That's what I / believe.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Do you think this has anything to do with the Raypoint?
rows.jp: 「他にはパレスヴィレッジと呼ばれる / 小さな国があるそうだ
rows.re: There's also said to be a small / nation called Palace Village / elsewhere.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: =@Ah, Palace Village's famous Palace Wheat.
rows.jp: 「これはやはり / レイポイントの件と / 何か関係あるのではなかろうか？
rows.re: Might this, after all, have some / connection to the Raypoint matter?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @The planet's life-energy also does wondrous things for crops.
rows.jp: [02][09][f8]エ[06]「パレスヴィレッジが<b:8b12>る / パレス<b:8b10>か〜
rows.re: Palace Village's famous Palace / Wheat, is it...
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @But now that the nations have united, ARMS somehow seems less significant...
rows.jp: 「星の命のエネルギーは / <b:8b13>作物にも恩恵を<b:8b14>えているんだな<b:8b15>い戦<b:8b16>に / 共<b:8b17>間にとらわれない行動<88b2>限ってのが / あっただろう？
rows.re: The planet's life energy blesses / the crops as well.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Unity's a good thing, though.
rows.jp: 「でもさ、今はこうして貴族共が / 一<88a8>団結して脅威にあたっているんだ / ありがたみが<b:8b18>ってしまったよな〜
rows.re: But now the nations stand united / against the threat, so it feels / less special somehow.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @... But you wouldn't know that by looking at the sky...
rows.jp: 「まあ、イイコトなんだが〜野望も<b:8b19>えて / 大辺<b:8b1a>れての / ファルガイア<b:8b1a>れッ！
rows.re: Well, it's a good thing. But even / the wilds are coming back, all / across Filgaia!
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Since I doubt they're anywhere you can walk to...
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>とは、この空を見上げる限り / 言えないよな〜
rows.re: ...though you'd never say so, / looking up at this sky.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @You must use Valeria Chateau, the Hovercraft, and everything we have to find the Diablo Pillars!
rows.jp: 「<b:8b1b><b:8a64>に<b:8b1c>いて行ける場所に / あるとは考えにくい〜
rows.re: Hard to think it's anywhere you / could just walk to.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @I've moving the Hovercraft inside your range of operations.
rows.jp: 「ヴァレリアシャトー、ホバークラフト〜 / ありとあらゆる移動手段を駆使してでも / 魔界鍵を発見しなければな〜乗って / 外道を制<b:8b1d>するのもいいが / 少し考え方を変えてみよう
rows.re: Valeria Chateau, Hovercraft, by / every means of travel we must find / the Demon Realm Key.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @The Aport feature has been modified for the TeleportOrb. Put 'em to good use.
rows.jp: 「キミたちの行動<b:8b1e>拠街に / ホバークラフトを / 発移させてみるんだ
rows.re: I'll move the Hovercraft into / your range of operations.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @I'm sure this will lead to something new for you.
rows.jp: 「せっかく、テレポートオーブに対応した / アポーツ機能なんだ / 活用しなきゃ<b:8acc>だぜ<b:8b1e>拠が大きくないが / 上陸できるポイントがたくさんあるからな
rows.re: The Aport feature now works with / the TeleportOrb. Put it to use.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Hey, I think someone on the 2nd floor of the Valeria Chateau was studying terrestrial energy...
rows.jp: 「まだ見ぬ新しい<b:8b20>開が / きっと待っているはずだぜ<b:8a59>するヴァレリアシャトーッ！ / だけど、着陸できるポイントが / あまりにも少なすぎるんだよな〜
rows.re: Some new road you've yet to see / is surely waiting.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Creating innovative devices like this requires creativity. It isn't easy to do.
rows.jp: 「そういえばシャトーの２Ｆに / 以前、地面のエネルギーとかを / 修行していたヤツがいたな<b:8b21>の通信術術のひとつだ
rows.re: Come to think of it, someone on / the Chateau's 2nd floor studied / earth energy.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @But Odessa did it. They are an enemy we must not underestimate, obviously.
rows.jp: 「カタチにとらわれずに / 物事を為していく〜 / <b:8b1b><b:8a64>なようで、難しいことだ
rows.re: Getting things done unbound by / form. Sounds easy, but it's / hard.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @I bet you think you're hot stuff, don't you? Trying to show off with that in there...
rows.jp: 「それをやってのけるんだから / テロリスト・オデッサ〜 / あなどれない相だろう
rows.re: Since they can actually pull that / off, Odessa's not a foe to / underestimate.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @It was once used to transport an amazing crystal that could communicate thoughts.
rows.jp: 「くそッ、僕だって<b:8a50>けてたまるかよッ！ / スゴイの<89db>め込んで / オトコをあげてやらあッ！<b:8a74><89ca>さ
rows.re: Damn it, I won't lose! I'll cook / up something amazing and prove / myself!
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Sir Valeria organized them and sent them all over Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「以前は / 心を伝える不思議な渓谷の / <b:8b23>出に使われていたらしいぞ
rows.re: Long ago, they say these carried / hearts across a strange valley.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @They've been around a lot longer than ARMS, so they kinda have seniority over us.
rows.jp: 「彼らもヴァレリア公に<b:8ab5><b:8ab6>されて / ファルガイア中に派<b:8b24>されているらしい
rows.re: Sir Valeria organized them and / sent them all across Filgaia.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @There must be a good reason for this disappearance.
rows.jp: 「設立は / ＡＲＭＳよりもずっと早いから / 僕たちの味貴分ってトコかもな公は / 本当にファルガイアを愛していました / そして、仲様も同じく〜
rows.re: They were founded long before / ARMS, so they're our seniors, / you might say.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @He would never betray Filgaia or his sister. They were the two most important things to him.
rows.jp: 「今回の失望は / やはり、公に何かの考えが / あってのことです
rows.re: This vanishing act, Sir Valeria / must have his reasons for it.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @... a Prohibited Spell for summoning a strange creature from the spirit world.
rows.jp: 「あのヴァレリア公がファルガイアと仲様〜 / もっとも大切にしていたふたつを / 大切るなんて考えられないことです公は / <b:8b26>世と呼ばれる太古の危険な<b:8a77><b:8b29>を / 修行していたとも聞いています
rows.re: That he'd forsake the two he / treasured most, Filgaia and his / sister, is unthinkable.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Terrible powers, deadly spells... They were by no means peacetime pursuits.
rows.jp: 「その<b:8b26>世とは / ファルガイアとは異なる世界より / 異なる命を呼び込むモノだとか〜公はいろいろなことを修行し / ファルガイアのために / 役立てようとしているのです
rows.re: That other realm draws alien / life from a world unlike our own.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @But perhaps such horrible weapons are needed to fight for justice.
rows.jp: 「ですが、その修行街殺は / 必ずしも注目的なモノだけではないのです
rows.re: But those forbidden arts he / studied were not merely for show.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @I remember Sir Valeria saying something similar once...
rows.jp: 「<88bf>大な力や危険な術儀〜 / 理想に終らない正義を実現するには / あえてこういうのも必要と言いますが〜食われていく〜
rows.re: Vast power, dangerous rites. They / say such things are needed to make / justice real.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @...that the true threat to come would devour the world.
rows.jp: 「そういえば、以前〜 / ヴァレリア公は / そのようなことを口にしていました
rows.re: Come to think of it, Sir Valeria / once said as much.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Did he know that this was going to happen?
rows.jp: 「来るべき<b:8b2b>の脅威とは / 世界が食い<b:8b2c>らされていくことだと〜
rows.re: That the true threat to come / would be the world devoured.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @I heard that after mastering astronomy, he decided to work for peace in Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「このことを / 期待していたのでしょうか〜公は / さまざまな神誓を神んでいました
rows.re: Did he foresee this all along? He / studied so many sacred oaths and / rites.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Did astronomy somehow inspire the creation of ARMS?
rows.jp: 「ですが、大戦神を<b:8ac6>めた後 / ファルガイアの注目維持に / <b:8b2d>めるようになったと聞いています
rows.re: After mastering astronomy, I hear / he turned to keeping Filgaia at / peace.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @But he takes personal responsibility for everything.
rows.jp: 「大戦神が / 今回のＡＲＭＳのきっかけに / なったのでしょうか？公〜
rows.re: Did his astronomy become the / spark that founded ARMS?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Sir Valeria is prepared to sacrifice himself in order to save the life of all Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「ですが、その<b:8b2e>は / すべて自分で受け止める信念なのです
rows.re: Yet he holds to bearing all that / responsibility himself.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @She is his surviving family member. Both she and this land are equally important to him.
rows.jp: 「ファルガイアの生命を保るために / 『自分』を<b:8b30>すことをいとわない〜 / 公はそのように考えています公が仲様を見つめるまなざしは / ファルガイアを<b:8b31>る時とは / 違った<89ab>しさをたたえているのです
rows.re: To save Filgaia's life, he'd not / hesitate to sacrifice himself. / That is his mind.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @They say it is an empty land, buried in salt.
rows.jp: 「たったひとりの銃<8a0e>と / 保るべき、たったひとつの故<b:8b32>〜 / 公にとってはどちらも大切なモノなのです大使同時による輝爆で / 大地のほとんどが過<b:8b34><b:8b35>合され / 滅死してしまいました
rows.re: His one living kin, and the one / homeland he must protect, both / precious to him.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @But if you must go there, Quartly would be your best bet as a way station.
rows.jp: 「現在では隣の中に<89db>もれてしまい / 何も無いところだと聞いていますが〜
rows.re: These days it's buried in salt, / an empty place, so I hear.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Quartly is in a desert in the upper Likikis, a river emptying into the 1southwest Inland Sea0.
rows.jp: 「それでも目指すなら / クアトリーの場を中<b:8b36>地にするのが / まちがいないでしょう
rows.re: Still, if you go, make Quartly / your waystation. You won't / go wrong.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @He studied astronomy last, and now has returned to help preserve peace in Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「クアトリーは、[11]お街道の先東[11]ぉに流れ込む / リキキス<89e7>にそって上った先 / <88db>の道にある場です公は / シエルジェ自分領にて / さまざまな神誓を神んできました
rows.re: Quartly lies on the salt road, / up the Likikis that flows out / to the southeast.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @One that will assure peace in all of Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「最後に大戦神を<b:8ac6>めてから / 今度はファルガイアの注目維持のために / ここに帰ってきたのです公は作戦指揮と同時に / 更なる一手を考えているのです
rows.re: Having mastered astronomy at / last, he came back here to keep / Filgaia at peace.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @But somewhere, somehow, things went awry. How? Why?
rows.jp: 「遠く、ファルガイアのこれからを / 注目に<b:8b37>くために〜剣士から保護せし剣〜 / 『アガートラーム』は / ヴァレリア公が受け<b:8b36>ぐべきだったのです
rows.re: To lead Filgaia's far future / toward peace.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @He doesn't show it, but he also adores his younger sister.
rows.jp: 「いったい〜 / いつから、何が、どのようにして / <b:8b3b>陸が<b:8aeb>いはじめたのでしょうか〜公は / 誰よりも強く / ファルガイアを愛しています
rows.re: When, and how, did this land / first begin to go awry?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @So he may take extreme steps to strengthen ARMS.
rows.jp: 「そして、表にはあまり出しませんが / 仲様もとても大切にしています公は理想と同時に / 現実を見つめることができる方です
rows.re: And though he rarely shows it, / he treasures his sister deeply.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Instead of commanding, I'm sure he wanted to use his sword and spells on the front line.
rows.jp: 「ですから、ＡＲＭＳの戦力アップに / 多少、ムチャな作戦をとることもあるのです公は / 誰よりもファルガイアを愛しています
rows.re: That's why, to raise ARMS's / strength, he sometimes takes / reckless risks.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @If it weren't for that accident...
rows.jp: 「ですから、本当なら指揮<899d>ではなく / 最前線で得意の剣や魔法を / 振るいたかったに違いありません
rows.re: Rather than command, he surely / longed to wield sword and magic / on the front line.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @And he showed such brilliance in swordsmanship and the casting of spells...
rows.jp: 「あの事故さえなければ〜幸な事故が原因で / ヴァレリア公は<b:8b3e>足が / 不自由になってしまったんだ
rows.re: If only that accident hadn't / happened...
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @How truly unfortunate.
rows.jp: 「剣術も魔法も / 誰よりも<89ab>れた<b:8b3f>えをみせた / お人だったのに〜
rows.re: A man who showed greater skill / at sword and spell than anyone, / he was.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @The allure such status holds must be strong indeed.
rows.jp: 「本当に残念です<b:8b17>は / 『英雄』を招きずって生きてきたんだ
rows.re: It's truly a shame.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @I don't know what Sir Valeria tried to do... or is still trying to do.
rows.jp: 「それは、僕たちが考えるよりも / ずっと世謎めいたモノに違いない〜
rows.re: It must be far stranger and more / fateful than we imagine.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @I'm afraid that desire to hold onto his heroic status will have tragic conclusions.
rows.jp: 「ヴァレリア公が何をしようとしたのか〜 / いや、何をしようとしているのか / 僕にはわからない〜
rows.re: What Sir Valeria meant to do, / no, still means to do, I cannot / fathom.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @And now they wield a sword called |ARMS| to defend Filgaia from the danger.
rows.jp: 「だけど、そいつは / 英雄伝説に振り回された / 悲<b:8b42>に斬重していくんじゃないか〜剣の聖女＞の〜 / 伝説の時代の『英雄』の血を / 現在に招いているヴァレリア<b:8b17>〜
rows.re: But perhaps he heads toward a / tragedy driven by the hero / legend.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Is it their destiny? If there is no such thing as destiny...
rows.jp: 「そして、今、ふたたび〜 / ファルガイアを脅威から保るために / 『ＡＲＭＳ』という名の剣を振るっている〜
rows.re: And now, again, he wields a sword / named |ARMS| to shield Filgaia / from the threat.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @They perhaps their bloodline is a curse that binds them.
rows.jp: 「これは、運命なのだろうか？ / 〜いや、運命では無いとしたら〜
rows.re: Is this fate, I wonder? Or, if it's / not fate at all...
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @The Valerias' fate binds them and brings such sadness.
rows.jp: 「これは『英雄』という血に謎りつけられた / 世いそのものといえないか〜？
rows.re: Could this be the very fate bound / to the blood called |hero|?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @That's where their great wealth, which pays for ARMS and Valeria Chateau, comes from.
rows.jp: 「ヴァレリアの血の中に伝えられし / 運命、世謎、悲しみ〜<b:8b17>は、その<b:8aaa>〜 / ＜剣の聖女＞の果<b:8b44>をたたえられ / 年々の恩<b:8b45>を受けたんだ
rows.re: The destiny, the fate, the sorrow / passed down in Valeria blood.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @... What? You didn't know all that?
rows.jp: 「ＡＲＭＳを運<b:8b46>していくだけの<b:8adb>金や / ヴァレリアシャトーをはじめとする遺跡など / 一貴<b:8ad9>に<b:8b47>る力は、そういうワケがあるんだ
rows.re: The funds to run ARMS, ruins / like Valeria Chateau, all that / wealth has its reason.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @But it pales in comparison with the |Blaze of Disaster| of days past!
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>あん？ / もしかして、知らなかったのか？？<b:8b48><b:8b49>させる / 大きな脅威、オデッサ〜
rows.re: Huh? You mean you didn't know?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @When we fight Odessa, at least we fight human beings -- flesh and blood just like us!
rows.jp: 「だが、それは〜 / かつての『剣の剣士』とは / <b:8b4b>本的に異なる脅威なんだッ！
rows.re: But that threat is nothing like / the |Blaze of Disaster| of old!
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @The Guardians once ruled over Filgaia. But with their powers gone, Filgaia is wasting away.
rows.jp: 「僕たちの相は / 僕たちと同じ人間ッ！ / 同じ星に生きる、同じ生命なんだッ！剣の剣士』によって / 銃体を滅ぼされ、意僚を谷に<88fb>えられた / 保護獣ガーディアン〜
rows.re: Our foe is human, just like us! / Life on the same star, same as us!
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @The balance between the <Sword Magess> and the |Blaze of Disaster| has shifted toward the evil side.
rows.jp: 「<b:8b4c>支配者とも呼ばれる彼らの力が / ファルガイアに及ばなくなったために / <b:8b4e>々に世界が<b:8b2c>野合しているということは〜
rows.re: Their power, they were called / rulers, no longer reaches Filgaia, / so the world slowly withers.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @The |Blaze of Disaster| is slowly achieving his goal of destroying the world.
rows.jp: 「＜剣の聖女＞と『剣の剣士』との戦いは / 相<b:8b4f>ち〜 / <f040><f042>なんかではない〜
rows.re: The <Sword Magess> and the |Sword / Wielder|, their battle was no / mutual end.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @When will Filgaia be rid of the |Blaze of Disaster| threat?
rows.jp: 「『剣の剣士』の目的が世界の滅亡ならば / 少しずつ達成されようとしている〜
rows.re: If the |Sword Wielder| seeks the / world's ruin, it is slowly / coming to pass.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Gosh... I mean, damn, I know it's not any of my buddies.
rows.jp: 「そう、『剣の剣士』は / 今もファルガイアを<b:8b50>んでいるんだ〜ッ！催場所〜 / つまり、ヴァレリアシャトーの級置は / 最重要機<b:8b52>事<b:8b53>とされていたのに…
rows.re: Yes, the |Sword Wielder| gnaws / at Filgaia even now!
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @The |Blaze of Disaster| is said to be a renegade Guardian. They were the protectors of Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「いったい、どこからどうやって / オデッサに<b:8b54><b:8b55>したのだろう？来を<b:8b56>けて<88f1>突した / ＜剣の聖女＞と『剣の剣士』〜
rows.re: How on earth did it reach Odessa, / and from where?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @The Guardians also ruled the world, so the |Blaze of Disaster| must have their awesome powers.
rows.jp: 「『剣士』とは / ファルガイアを保護するとされる / ガーディアンの暴<b:8b57>体って話だ
rows.re: They say the |Wielder| is a / Guardian gone berserk, one meant / to protect Filgaia.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @They say comets are a bad omen. Perhaps it was warning of Odessa's threat to Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「ガーディアンとは世界を支える力と聞く / それと同時の力を持つ『剣士』とは / どれほど恐ろしいモノなんだろう〜衛星だったな、あれは〜
rows.re: Guardians uphold the world. A / |Wielder| with equal power, how / fearsome must it be?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @It's the leader of Odessa, the ones who made that declaration. I've seen his face before...
rows.jp: 「衛星は<b:8b59><b:8b5a>を示すというが〜 / ファルガイアを<b:8b5b>がすオデッサの動<8945>〜 / あれをさしているのだろうか？
rows.re: The satellite is said to signal / [?]. Odessa's stirrings that / menace Filgaia, does it mean those?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @I think he was some nation's military leader, or the head of some related organization...
rows.jp: 「決起表次をおこなったテロリスト〜 / オデッサの<888a><b:8b5c>のことなんだが / 渡録のどこかに招っかかるんだよな
rows.re: Those terrorists who rose up, / Odessa. Something in the records / nags at me.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @You are called |hero| because of your extraordinary feats in battle. But that's not all.
rows.jp: 「どこかの共の軍関係者〜 / あるいは、そこに<b:8a38>するような機関〜 / 気になるんだよな〜軍の英雄〜ッ！
rows.re: Some nation's military, or an / agency tied to them. It bothers / me.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @After the civil war, you let yourself be caught so that your friends could escape pursuit.
rows.jp: 「あんたが英雄と呼ばれたのは / <b:8b5e><b:8a41>した戦闘力と果<b:8b44> / だが、それだけじゃないと僕は考える
rows.re: They called you a hero for your / great strength and deeds. But it / was more than that, I think.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @That's why even 5 years later, the people still call you a |hero.|
rows.jp: 「街戦終了後、解放軍を救うために限力し / ひとり、<8965>われることで / 追手の目が他に及ぶことを防いだ〜
rows.re: After the fighting, to save the / Liberation Army you let yourself / be taken, drawing pursuit away.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @One theory is that the SLA leader sold out his comrades to save himself.
rows.jp: 「仲間を保ることを知っているから / あんたは、街戦が終って<88d2>数年っても / 『英雄』と呼ばれるんだ軍は / 街戦の終了と同時に戦<b:8b61>犯<b:8a87>者として / 追われる身になったという
rows.re: Because you know how to shield / your comrades, they still call / you a hero years on.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Now it is our turn to protect Filgaia as members of ARMS.
rows.jp: 「その<b:8b2b>実の多くは<b:8ae1>の中だが / 一説によると、解放軍リーダーが / 保身のために仲間を<b:8b62>ったって話だぜ<b:8aaa>、ファルガイアは / ＜剣の聖女＞に保られたんだ
rows.re: Much of the truth is buried, but / one tale says the Army's leader / sold out his comrades to survive.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @I was observing {1}... as a trained observer, that is.
rows.jp: 「今度は僕たち、ＡＲＭＳが / ファルガイアを保る番だぜ望される前<b:8b63>〜
rows.re: Now it's our turn, ARMS, to / protect Filgaia.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Anyhow, {1} was summoned to {0}'s room. I saw {1} walking towards there.
rows.jp: 「いやらしくない目で / [0a]お方の観待行為を / おこなっていたんだ
rows.re: It wasn't in any bad way. I was / just watching what {1} was doing.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @I don't know what to do. If you can't trust {0}, then who can you trust anymore?
rows.jp: 「その時、[0a]お方が / [0a]ぉ方に呼び出されて / お部乗に向かうのを見てしまったんだ〜
rows.re: At that moment, I saw {1} get / called by {0} and head for the / room.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @They are usually far from any human dwellings.
rows.jp: 「俺は、[0a]ぉ方を / 今まで通り信じられるのだろうか？ / 最度の人間不信におちいりそうだよ〜<b:8b65>りがあるんだ
rows.re: Can I still trust {2} as before? / I feel myself sinking into deep / mistrust.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @But Palace Village, on an 1island north of Meria0, has benefited from a Raypoint.
rows.jp: 「<b:8b66>通は人里離れたところにあるんだけど〜
rows.re: Normally it sits far from any / village.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @There, the ground is full of |Mana,| which makes the Palace Wheat grow plentifully.
rows.jp: 「タウンメリアから[11]お北に、道を<89ae>てた他[11]ぉには / パレスヴィレッジという / レイポイントの恩恵を受けた国があるんだ
rows.re: North of Town Meria, across the / road, lies Palace Village, a land / blessed by a Raypoint.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @But the flow of energy in the Raline veins has stopped!
rows.jp: 「大地を<b:8b0e>たす『マナ』が / パレス<b:8b10>という / 結跡品を生み出しているんだな
rows.re: The |Mana| that fills the land / yields a crystalline crop, the / Palace Wheat.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @It's not just the sky. The whole planet is being drained of energy!
rows.jp: 「レイライン中の生命エネルギーの流れが / <b:8b67>っているみたいなんだッ！
rows.re: The life-energy flow through the / Ley Lines seems to be failing!
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Mana is Filgaia's most important energy. The planet needs it to survive.
rows.jp: 「空だけではない〜 / 見えないところで大地も / この星、全体が何者かに食われているんだ
rows.re: Not just the sky. Unseen, the / land too. This whole star is / being devoured.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @That is why they can rejuvenate our own life-energy.
rows.jp: 「マナはファルガイアが持つ / もっとも大きなエネルギー〜 / そして、無くてはならないモノなんだ<b:8b3e>は / 俺たちの生命力を<b:8b68>してくれる<b:8af4>果がある
rows.re: Mana is Filgaia's greatest energy, / and something the world cannot / do without.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Near Baskar Village is one of the most powerful segments of the Raline veins in all Filgaia!
rows.jp: 「ジェムはレイラインからこぼれた / 生命エネルギーの結<b:8ad5>だからね<b:8b69>っていたんだ / 単に、観待意<b:8b6a>がそがれた<b:8b6b>ではないぞ最大に星を駆け<b:8b6c>る / 生命エネルギーのネットワークだ
rows.re: Gems are crystals of life energy / spilled from the Ley Lines.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @But the area is covered by a deep, beautiful forest.
rows.jp: 「バスカーたちが隠れ住む里の付近は / ファルガイアの中でも / 作年のレイラインが通っているところなんだ
rows.re: Near the village where the Baskar / hide runs one of Filgaia's oldest / Ley Lines.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Prime examples are the Town of Holst and the Raline Observatory, where I once worked.
rows.jp: 「だから、里の縁拠には / 願く険しい山が広がっているんだな太いところから / 掘り出されることが多いんだ
rows.re: That's why steep, forbidding / mountains ring the village.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Both can be reached easily, if you use the Live Reflector.
rows.jp: 「ホルストの場や / 俺が以前<b:8b6f>めていたレイライン観待<88e4>設は / その<b:8b70>型的なパターンだよ
rows.re: The Holst site, and the Ley-Line / station where I once worked, are / typical of it.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @For Aguelite, pick 'Ruins Mine' and for Germatron, pick 'Dragon's Vein' and jump in.
rows.jp: 「どちらも / ライブリフレクターを使えば / それほど遠いものではない
rows.re: Using the Live Reflector, / neither of them is all / that far away.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @From what I hear, they are also powered by life-energy.
rows.jp: 「アグエライト渓谷なら、『遺跡渓谷』行きに / ゲルマトロン渓谷なら、『枯谷<b:8b72><89f4>』行きに / 飛び込めばすぐだよ<b:8af5>システムなんだ
rows.re: For Aguelite Valley, board the / Ruins Valley run; for Germatron, / the Withered Valley run.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @There's one near here, in 1the woods to the southwest0.
rows.jp: 「その<b:8b73>動も / 生命エネルギーによって / 支えられているらしいんだな
rows.re: That system too, it seems, is / sustained by life energy.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @The Raline veins reach there. That's why it's a suitable location for a Live Reflector.
rows.jp: 「シャトーの近くにも一軒あるぞ / [11]お先東の山の中[11]ぉだ
rows.re: There's one near the Chateau too, / up in the southeast mountains.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Such beauty, and so loyal to her brother... Observing her would be a joy.
rows.jp: 「そこにもレイラインが通っているから / ライブリフレクターの<b:8b73>動には / <b:8b0f>しているというわけだ活動に役立ちたいと / ご自分から<898d>食当番をかってでられたんだ
rows.re: A Ley Line runs there too, so / it suits running a Live / Reflector.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @I wish I could observe Valeria Chateau's kitchen... as a trained observer, of course.
rows.jp: 「味のため、<b:8b75>気に戦線に任<b:8b76>する一<b:8b77>の<b:8b78>〜 / ああ、これからも観待したい〜<b:8b79>集される前の俺は / レイラインという / この星のエネルギーの流れを観待してたんだ
rows.re: Those who take cheerfully to the / front for our sake. I hope to / keep seeing it.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @He has fought with us... with ARMS... to save Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「でも今は〜 / ヴァレリアシャトーの<b:8b7a><b:8b7b>を / いやらしくない目で観待したいんだな中うことは<b:8b1b><b:8a64>です / でも、もう一度考えてください〜
rows.re: But for now, I'd like to keep an / honest eye on the Chateau's / goings-on.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @How could that whole thing have been an act?
rows.jp: 「我らＡＲＭＳ、ひとつとなって / ファルガイアのため / いっしょに戦ってきたではありませんか〜
rows.re: Have we of ARMS not fought as one, / together, for Filgaia's sake?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @I believe in {0}. Doubting each other won't bring back our blue skies.
rows.jp: 「あれすらも / <b:8b7c>りだったのでしょうか？
rows.re: Was even that a lie?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @It is dormant, not extinct. It could erupt at any time, so be careful.
rows.jp: 「私は[0a]ぉ方を信じています / 中いからは / この空を<b:8b1a>らす力は生まれてきません
rows.re: I believe in {2}. Doubt will / never birth the power to clear / this sky.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @These ancient wonders were sealed up by {0}, who feared their mighty powers.
rows.jp: 「そう、休枯谷ゆえに / 気をつけてくださいよ / いつ<b:8acb>枯するかわかりませんからね<b:8bd4>[06]「『トラペゾヘドロン』『降魔<b:8b29>儀』〜 / そして、『魔<b:8b7d>ランドルフ』<f040><f042>
rows.re: Yes, it's only dormant, so take / care. No telling when it'll / erupt.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @But I'm more worried about 5! She's been acting so strangely...
rows.jp: 「これらはかつて、[0a]ぉ方が / その大きすぎる力を危<893c>して封<b:8b7e>した / 太古の遺跡なのです〜<b:8b7f>せられているようですが〜
rows.re: These are ancient ruins {2} once / sealed away, fearing their too- / great power.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @She took off her outfit so happily when the sun's rays were blocked out.
rows.jp: 「私<b:8af1>人としては / 空が失われ、<b:8b80>輝が閉ざされた時に / <b:8b81>々として着ぐるみを脱がれた〜
rows.re: Myself, when the sky was lost and / its light shut away, she gladly / shed her mascot suit.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @You'd never know there was a nice-looking girl under there!
rows.jp: 「着ぐるみを脱ぎ<b:8a7f>てられた / [05]ぎ方の跡行の方が / 何だか気になってしまうのです
rows.re: What became of {3}, who cast off / the suit, is what nags at me.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @She's blonde, with a lovely fair complexion, and fiery, red eyes...
rows.jp: 「あの着ぐるみの辺には / ちゃんと女の家が入っていたんですよ
rows.re: There really was a lovely woman / inside that mascot suit.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Wait a minute... Red... eyes? Um...
rows.jp: 「それも、金<b:8b82>で / 抜けるように<b:8b83>が<b:8b84>くて / <b:8b85>は<b:8aef>えるように眠くて〜
rows.re: Blonde, with a dazzling fair / complexion, and eyes red as if / aflame...
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @... I miss the activity.
rows.jp: 「あ、あれ？ / 眠い〜、<b:8b85>〜？<b:8ae4>なんじゃなくて / ちゃんとブリーフィングルームで / 作戦を立てているんですね〜
rows.re: Uh, wait... red... eyes?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @But now it's deserted.
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>さびしいです〜
rows.re: It's lonely now.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @The south room is supposed to be {1}'s room, but she's never there.
rows.jp: 「何だか、最近、サッパリです〜
rows.re: Somehow, lately, it's / all dried up.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @... Huh? Who, me? No, no. I wasn't eavesdropping. No, not me.
rows.jp: 「そして、ここから先にあるのは / [0a]お方のお部乗ですけど〜 / お部乗でお見かけすることは〜
rows.re: And ahead from here is / {1}'s room, though I rarely / see her there.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @... Huh? Who, me? No, no. I wasn't eavesdropping. No, not me.
rows.jp: 「〜あ、いえいえ / けっして立ち聞きしていたわけじゃ / ありませんから〜
rows.re: Ah, no, no. It's not / like I was eavesdropping / or anything.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @... Huh? Who, me? No, no. I wasn't eavesdropping. No, not me.
rows.jp: 「〜あ、いえいえ / けっして立ち聞きしたわけじゃ / ありませんから〜
rows.re: Ah, no, no. It's not / like I was eavesdropping / or anything.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Sir Valeria always busy. If he is not in his room, he may be on another floor.
rows.jp: 「〜あ、いえいえ / けっして立ち聞きしたわけじゃ / ありませんから〜<b:8ae4>と / [0a]ぉ方と[0a]お方の / 私<b:8ae4>が用意されています
rows.re: Ah, no, no. It's not / like I was eavesdropping / or anything.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @To get to other floors, please use the elevator straight ahead.
rows.jp: 「ヴァレリア公はご多少な方です / お部乗にいらっしゃらないようでしたら / 他のフロアかもしれません
rows.re: Sir Valeria is a busy man. If not / in his room, he may be on another / floor.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @According to legend, it's a sea of blue mud that is the origin of all life.
rows.jp: 「他のフロアに向かう場合は / 正面のエレベーターを / ご利用ください理標というのは / この星の心<b:8b87>部〜 / 中心部分をさしているんだ
rows.re: For other floors, please use the / elevator straight ahead.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @What could Sir Valeria want at |Glaive Le Gable,| the sea of mud, the wellspring of life?
rows.jp: 「古い言い伝えで、ファルガイアの中心には / すべての生命の軒となった / <b:8b88>く<b:8b89>く<b:8b8a>の道が広がっているという〜
rows.re: Old legend says a road of blue / mud, the source of all life, lies / at Filgaia's heart.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @It's just like the legendary age when the |Blaze of Disaster| tried to burn up Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「『グラブ・ル・ガブル』〜 / 命の始<8869>、<b:8b8a>の道にて / ヴァレリア公は、いったい何を〜<b:8b50>まれていったように / 人々の心も食いあらされていく / 『殿望』という名に奪われていく〜
rows.re: |Glaive Le Gable|, the mud road / where life began. What could Sir / Valeria want there?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @... Just before that, a huge comet came very close to Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「まるで『剣の剣士』が / ファルガイアを<b:8b8c>き限くそうとした / 伝<b:8b8d>の時代、そのままに〜<b:8b8e>空にポツンと暗い<b:8a88>みが落ち / そこから広がるように / 空が<b:8b50>まれていった〜
rows.re: Just like the legendary age when / the |Sword Wielder| tried to burn / Filgaia away.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Could the comet's approach be somehow related to the devouring of the sky?
rows.jp: 「〜でも、それに先立って / 大きな衛星がファルガイアを / 大切っていったんだ〜
rows.re: But just before that, a great / comet passed close by Filgaia.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @of surveillance: sound, vibration, heat, and visual.
rows.jp: 「空の<b:8b8f>失と衛星の搭近〜 / ふたつの間に / 因果関係は無いのだろうか〜<b:8b0a><b:8ad4>反<b:8af5>のみならず / 駆動<b:8b0a>、<8868>反応、視信的捕<8993>〜
rows.re: The sky's loss and the comet's / approach. Is there no link / between them?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @But the only part that is made invisible is the Heimdal Gazzo itself!
rows.jp: 「あらゆる<887e>相機能から / その存在を消し去る / ウィザードリィステルス〜
rows.re: Wizardry Stealth erases it from / every form of surveillance.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @The Diablo Pillars, the heart of the system, are exposed but their defenses are sure to be tight.
rows.jp: 「だが、存在を消し去れるのは / ステルス対<b:8ac2>である / ヘイムダル・ガッツォーのみだッ！
rows.re: But it only hides the stealth / unit itself, the Heimdal Gazzo!
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @We gotta know what such a huge power plant is being used for.
rows.jp: 「システムを支える魔界鍵は<8991><8992>同部〜 / それだけに、強力な防衛星陣を / <b:8b91>いてくるかもしれないな〜<b:8b92>を<b:8ab5><b:8ab6>して / アルケミックプラントの / 調査をすすめているんだ
rows.re: The Demon Realm Keys behind the / system are exposed, so they may / set strong defenses.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @We're tracing the pipeline right now, but it'll take a little longer.
rows.jp: 「最大<b:8ab4>域のエネルギー<b:8b93>だからな / その使い<b:8b94>が気になるだろう？
rows.re: It's a top-tier power plant. Makes / you wonder what it's for, doesn't / it?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @But you can't use the search system, and only a few Landing Pads exist in all Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「パイプラインの / <89c1>探知をおこなっているんだが〜 / 結果は、もう少しまってくれよ標を<b:8b95>行することが可能だ
rows.re: We're tracing the pipeline now. / Give us a bit longer for results.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @The Hovercraft is better for conducting thorough searches.
rows.jp: 「だけど、その着陸可能ポイントの少なさと / サーチシステムが使えない帯が / 不便といえば不便だな
rows.re: Still, so few Landing Pads, and / zones where search won't work. / Inconvenient, that.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Of Filgaia's 3 nations, only Guild Galad's representatives bitched and moaned.
rows.jp: 「<8a12>やかな探<887e>をおこなうなら / ホバークラフトの方に / 分があるってことだな<b:8ab0>共の領空を<b:8b95>行する<88b2>限が / 緊急手配されたらしい
rows.re: If you want a thorough / search, the Hovercraft / has the advantage there.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @But in the end, Meria Boule and Sylvaland somehow wore them down.
rows.jp: 「ファルガイア貴族共のうち / ギルドグラードが / どうにもこうにもごねていたらしいが〜
rows.re: Of the Filgaian nations, Guild / Galad was said to balk at every / turn.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @... But this time it's different. I feel like I'm fighting... like I'm protecting Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「最終的には / メリアブールとシルヴァラントに / 押し切られるカタチとなったそうだ軍に任<b:8b76>したものの / 戦いはいつも、英雄サマに頼っていたな / だから、どこか空<b:8b97>で、実信が無い
rows.re: In the end, Meria Boule and / Sylvaland wore them down, they / say.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @But no one can simply decide to become a hero.
rows.jp: 「〜でも、今度は違う / 僕もいっしょに戦っているつもりだ / 僕もファルガイアを保っているつもりだ英雄ってのは / その世界に生きる人間がなるもんだ
rows.re: But this time is different. I mean / to fight beside them, to protect / Filgaia too.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Heroes are created when the people decide that they need heroes.
rows.jp: 「だが、そいつひとりの意僚で / 『英雄』になるんじゃない〜
rows.re: But no one becomes a |hero| by / their own will alone.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @A hero has to want to be a hero, but before that, the people have to want him.
rows.jp: 「その世界と / その時代に生きる人間が望むことで / 生み出されていくもんなんだ
rows.re: They're made by the wishes of the / people living in that world, that / age.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @The <Sword Magess> appeared when |Blaze of Disaster| was feared.
rows.jp: 「『英雄』は人間がなるもんだ / でも、望んでなるものじゃない / 望まれて生み出されていくものなんだ<b:8b98>政の時代に人は / 英雄を望み、生み出すもんだ
rows.re: A |hero| is a person made one, / not by wanting it, but by being / wanted.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @In Slayheim's age of tyranny, they created a hero named 1 Evans. And so on.
rows.jp: 「『剣の剣士』におびえた / 伝説の時代には＜剣の聖女＞を〜
rows.re: The age that feared the |Sword / Wielder| brought forth the / <Sword Magess>.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @... Now, Filgaia's sky has been devoured, and again the time is ripe for new heroes.
rows.jp: 「スレイハイムの暴<b:8b99>には / 英雄[05]お・エヴァンスを〜 / <f040><f042>というカンジでな
rows.re: In Slayheim's tyranny, the hero / {1} Evans. That sort of thing.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @He rallies people against some oppression by spouting speeches about revolution.
rows.jp: 「〜空を失った / 現在のファルガイアで / 人はまた英雄を望み、生み出すのだろうか？野<b:8b9a>のはじまりは / いつも同じだ
rows.re: In this sky-less Filgaia, will / people again wish a hero into / being?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Then we get dragged along on his idealistic crusade and end up cleaning up his mess.
rows.jp: 「<b:8b9b>圧された状況から / 『<b:8b9c>命』だの『解放』だの / 理みたいなことを<b:8b9e>んで同僚を<b:8b9f>るのさ
rows.re: From oppression, he spouts / "revolution" and "liberation" to / rally the others.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Why do we have to follow a damned dreamer like that?
rows.jp: 「あいつの理につきあわされて / 最後は、全体で<b:8ba0><b:8ba1>いを / しなくちゃいけない状況になるんだ
rows.re: We get dragged along with his / ideals, then must clean up the / whole mess.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @People must have a weak spot for idealism... even when it's just a smokescreen.
rows.jp: 「なんで、あんな現実味の<b:8ba2>い理想<b:8b17>に / みんなついて行くのだろう〜
rows.re: Why does everyone follow such an / unrealistic dreamer?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @So don't worry. The Might Glove on his left hand will bring about another miracle.
rows.jp: 「やっぱり、自信ありげに理を<b:8b31>られると / たとえメッキでも / <b:8ba3>力を信じてしまうのだろうか？軍の英雄サマは / 『どんな危機をも<b:8a69>ち<b:8ba4>く<b:8ba5><b:8ba6>の<b:8ba7><b:8ba8>』を / 持っているんだ〜

rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Of course, they took it from Slayheim.
rows.jp: 「だいじょうぶだ / 今度もまた、<b:8ba7><b:8ba8>のマイトグローブで / 跡跡を起こしてくれるさ型機？ / いや、そっくりの暗い飛空機艇を / 解放軍は持っていたんだ
rows.re: It'll be fine. He'll work another / miracle with his left-hand Might / Glove.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @The pilot was Mr. Hero's war buddy -- a whiz at machines and flying.
rows.jp: 「もちろん、スレイハイムから / 戦って、<b:8ba9>ったんだがな〜
rows.re: Of course, he won it from / Slayheim by fighting for it.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @They probably never marched in formation.
rows.jp: 「英雄サマの相<b:8baa>に / 機艇の<8a25>いや<b:8adc>最術術に長けたヤツがいて / そいつがパイロットだったらしいぜ軍とはいっても / <8934>輝谷枯作戦が中心の / ゲリラ部隊だからな〜
rows.re: The hero's war buddy was a whiz / with machines and flying. He was / the pilot, they say.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @I was in the SLA myself, but I don't remember what Mr. Hero looked like.
rows.jp: 「みんな置って行軍なんて / 一度も無かったかもしれないな

rows.en: @Who ever thought we'd be fighting side by side again?
rows.jp: 「かく言う僕も、軍に任<b:8b76>していたんだが / 英雄サマのお探を / 録えているわけじゃないしよ
rows.re: I served in the army myself, but / I don't even recall the hero's / face.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Our very future depends on you.
rows.jp: 「まさか、また / いっしょに戦う回が来ようとはな乗って / 失われた空を<b:8bab>駆する<b:8aaf>は / 僕たちに残された、たったひとつの可能性だ
rows.re: To think a day would come to / fight side by side again.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @You represent everyone's hopes to defend our dear Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「みんなあんたたちに / 未来を<b:8bac>している〜
rows.re: Everyone is entrusting the future / to you.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.jp: 「そして、自分たちの中にある / ファルガイアを保りたいという想いを / あんたたちに集めているんだ<b:8a8c>は / あんたたちの行動<b:8b1e>拠を / <b:8afc>段に<b:8a97>やしてくれるはずだ
rows.re: And they gather onto you the wish / within them all, the wish to / protect Filgaia.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.jp: 「だけど、シャトーと同じく / サーチ機能が備わっていないから / 結<b:8bad>のところ、地道な探<887e>は変わらないがな

rows.en: @She can land in more places than Valeria Chateau and will give you a wider range of operations.

rows.jp: 「ヴァレリアシャトーより / 着陸可能ポイントに自由がきくぶん / 行動可能<b:8b1e>拠が<b:8afc>段に広がったはずだ
rows.re: It lands more freely than the / Chateau, so your range should be / far wider.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @It's like everything from the old legends is becoming reality.
rows.jp: 「今後のシャトーは、あんたたちの足ではなく / 民間人の安全確保のために / 解放されることになったぜ理ドラゴン、グラウスヴァイン〜 / まったく<8845>いたよな〜 / だって、ドラゴンが実在したんだぜ
rows.re: From now the Chateau won't ferry / you. It's freed to keep civilians / safe.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @This nightmare that plagues Filgaia is bringing the legends of the past to life!
rows.jp: 「何もかもが / 伝説から / 現実のモノへ変わろうとしている〜
rows.re: Everything is turning / from legend / into reality.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @I hope that means the <Sword Magess> will come to life to protect Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「ファルガイアを攻う脅威が / 更々と伝説を、現実に<b:8bb0>らせていく〜 / そんな気がしてならないぜ
rows.re: The threat on Filgaia keeps / turning legend real. I can't shake / the feeling.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @... is almost certainly loaded aboard Heimdal Gazzo.
rows.jp: 「このままじゃ / ファルガイアを保るために / ＜剣の聖女＞まで<b:8bb0>るんじゃないか？<b:8aba>なことがあるか？隣に奪われた滅死の大地より掘り出した / 『理』と呼ばれる幻同時〜
rows.re: At this rate, might even the / <Sword Magess> return to protect / Filgaia?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @I'm sure Vinsfeld intends to use it as a deterrent...
rows.jp: 「そいつがヘイムダル・ガッツォーに / <887c><887d>されているのは / ほぼ、まちがいないだろう〜
rows.re: That it's loaded aboard / Heimdal Gazzo is almost / beyond doubt.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @But Vinsfeld has his back to the wall. Can we count on him to continue to act rationally?
rows.jp: 「その圧倒的な威力から / 戦<b:8a5d>的にあつかわれることは難くないが〜
rows.re: With such overwhelming power, it's / easily used as a weapon of war.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Guild Galad has advanced machinery because of the Dragon fossils. Still...
rows.jp: 「気がかりなのは / 追いつめられたヴィンスフェルトが / いつまで<b:8bb1><b:8bb2>な判断を辺せるかということだ型機なんてシロモノ / 今の術術じゃ / なかなか<b:8bb3>りだせないぞ
rows.re: What worries me is how long a / cornered Vinsfeld can keep his / judgment sound.
