rows.en: @Only a monster Dragon - a living machine - could become a flying craft that small.
rows.jp: 「ギルドグラードじゃドラゴンの合谷を用いて / 機艇術術が発<b:8b20>しているらしいが〜
rows.re: In Guild Galad, machine-craft has / advanced using Dragon fossils, so / they say.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Remember: If you can't defeat an enemy from the outside, destroy him from the inside.
rows.jp: 「機艇と生命体の中間存在 / 幻獣ドラゴンそのものでもない限り / このサイズに飛空機艇をおさめられないぞ<b:8bb4>されただけのことはある
rows.re: Only a Dragon, half machine and / half living, could fit an airship / this small.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @But there aren't any aircraft. It's like an inn without a pretty proprietress!
rows.jp: 「外からドンパチやって落ちねぇのなら / 中に侵入して、街部から破滅する / 軒本的なことだが、確実な作戦だ型機の / 発<b:8af5>カタパルトなんだ
rows.re: If it won't fall from outside, / get in and wreck it from within. / Basic, but sure.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Of course, if you want to, you can launch yourselves on this thing.
rows.jp: 「でも、中心要の小型機が用意されていない / たとえるなら、そう<f040><f042>〜 / 『険人女<b:8bb6>のいない<b:8b04>』ってとこか？
rows.re: But there's no small craft for / the job. Like an inn with no / pretty hostess, you might say?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @So we can fight off this threat and protect our loved ones!
rows.jp: 「まあ、どうしてもって言うのなら / あんたたちを / 生身で<b:8af5>出しても構わないんだけどな求めていたのは / 『英雄』の血なんかじゃない / この脅威を<b:8bb7>ってくれる力なんだ
rows.re: Well, if you truly insist, I don't / mind launching you out there in / the flesh.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @All they ask of the hero is strength. They don't want the hero to sacrifice himself.
rows.jp: 「それは、僕たちひとりひとりが / 少しずつ持っているはずの / 大切なモノを保る力だぜ剣士を前にして / 『英雄』を求めるという〜
rows.re: That's the power each of us holds / a little of, the power to protect / what we love.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Only kin of the Magess may enter. Frauds pretending to descend from her may not gain entrance.
rows.jp: 「それは、力無きゆえに / 『英雄』の力を求めているんだ / けっして『英雄』の血なんかじゃないぜ剣の聖女＞と『剣の剣士』との戦いの / 渡記を保存したルルドの<89c8>は / 聖女の血を招く者のみに開かれると聞くぜ
rows.re: It's the powerless who seek a / |hero|'s strength. It's never / about a hero's blood.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @They say it's a tough, risky procedure because of the danger of rejection.
rows.jp: 「英雄の<b:8bb8><b:8bb9>を<b:8bba><895b>する<b:8b08>や / 人にあらずモノは / <b:8bbb>殿されるらしいが〜<b:8bbc>する手術は非合法な / <b:8ae1><b:8bbd><b:8bbe>によってのみ行われていると聞く
rows.re: Those who falsely claim the hero's / line, and things not human, are / turned away, they say.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @So anyone who tries to get a bionic implant must be a really shady character.
rows.jp: 「さらに、本体との<b:8bbb>殿反応もあるため / 非世に過去で / リスキーな手術とも聞いているぜ
rows.re: And with the risk of the body / rejecting it, I hear it's a harsh, / risky operation.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @I've never heard of someone having healthy limbs replaced intentionally!
rows.jp: 「それでも / 義体を手に入れようとするってヤツは / 相応のワケ作りってことだろうな来 / ケガや渉気で失った身体の一部を / <b:8bc0>うための術術だぜ
rows.re: Even so, anyone out to get a / bionic body must have quite / a reason for it.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @The heart is the engine. The brain is the cockpit...
rows.jp: 「<89c1>に、生身を一部残して / そっくり<88fb>発するなんてケースは / 聞いた事も無いぜ<b:8bb3>は軒本的に同じようなモノなんだぜ
rows.re: The reverse, keeping some flesh / and building a full replacement, / I've never once heard of.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @In short, it is possible to build a human body from mechanical components.
rows.jp: 「心<b:8b87>は、エンジン / <b:8bc1><b:8bc2>は、コクピットってなカンジだ
rows.re: The heart's the engine, the brain / the cockpit, so to speak.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Ancient Filgaia also had Industrial Sorcery, which was more complex and powerful.
rows.jp: 「言いかえるならば / 人の体も機艇にて構成することも / 可能ってことだぜ<b:8ae3>ちゃんのあつかうクレストソーサーは / もっとも一<b:8bc3>的な魔法の大<b:8bc4>だぜ
rows.re: Put another way, a human body / can be built out of craft / parts too.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @We will use Lost Technology to spice it up a bit for you, out of pity for you.
rows.jp: 「<8995>か<b:8aaa>は、もっと<b:8bc5><b:8bc6>で / さらに強力なインダストリアルソーサーが / ファルガイアにはあったというぜ<b:8bb3>られる機艇同時なんだぜ<b:8abf>ら、相変わらず<b:8bc7>相な / マップスコープを使っているようじゃな
rows.re: Long ago, they say, Filgaia held / far mightier Industrial Sorcerers / than this.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Don't look so skeptical! Leave everything to us!
rows.jp: 「わらわが可理想なお<b:8abf>らのために / ちょっとだけロストテクノロジーを使って / キュートでドキドキな<b:8bc9><b:8bb3>をしてしんぜよう
rows.re: For my darling little ones, I / shall use a touch of Lost Tech / and give you a charming makeover.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @You will see how Guild Galad's technology can't even hold a candle to ours!
rows.jp: 「<f041><f041><f041>なんじゃ、その中いの目は / わらわに任せておけば大<b:8bca><b:8bcb>じゃ
rows.re: What is that doubtful look? Leave / it to me and all shall be well.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @You say it looks the same? Hmph! Amateur!
rows.jp: 「ギルドグラードの術術など / 足元にも及ばないことを / ちょっぴり見せつけるだけじゃよ<b:8afc>段にパワーアップじゃッ！
rows.re: I shall merely show that Guild / Galad's craft cannot hold a / candle to mine.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Now you can view the map in transport by projecting the image onto your retina!
rows.jp: 「なに、あまり変わったように見えない？ / これだからシロウトは……
rows.re: What, it doesn't look any / different? Hmph. This is why / amateurs...
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @They were 1surrounded by a0 1valley, mountains, and the sea0.
rows.jp: 「これはな、マップスコープの<b:8bcc><b:8bcd>を / <b:8bce><b:8bcf>に<8865>搭<88ab>起することで / 移動中でもマップを見られるのじゃッ！<b:8afc>段にパワーアップじゃッ！<b:8bd0>めていたんだけどさ
rows.re: This casts the MapScope onto your / eye, so you can read the map even / on the move!
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @I couldn't help but notice it because of all the sparks. I wonder what it could be.
rows.jp: 「どこかの[11]お願い<b:8bd1>と谷と道に拠まれた[11]ぉ場所で / ちょっとした遺跡みたいのが見えたんだ
rows.re: In a spot ringed by mountains, a / valley, and the sea, I saw a / small ruin.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.jp: 「なんか、バチバチ輝っていたから / 結構目立っててさ / 一体、何があるトコなんだろうな？
rows.re: It was sparking and shining, / so it really stood out. What / on earth could be there?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Why would he do that, anyway?
rows.jp: 「<f040><f041><f042>そういえば、[11]おそこから東の方[11]ぉには / [11]お願い<b:8bd1>にかかった<89ec>の上[11]ぉに / 場があるのが見えたぜッ

rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Did you make her cry? I can't figure you adults out...
rows.jp: 「ロンバルディアってさ / 何食ってんだろう？ / まさか、人間を食べたりしないよな？<b:8bd2>いさんが暗<b:8bd3>だったんだろ？
rows.re: What does Lombardia even eat? / It doesn't eat people, / does it?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Just call on me if you need the help of Young ARMS!
rows.jp: 「でも、なんでこんなことしたのかな？
rows.re: But why would he do / something like this?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @She got excited when I said you liked older women. Hey, why are you looking so upset?
rows.jp: 「[0a]かお<b:8bd4>ちゃんが描いてたけど / 何かあったの？<b:8bd4>ちゃんが描いてたんだ
rows.re: {2}'s big sister was sketching / something. Did something happen?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @In more ways than one...
rows.jp: 「やっぱり、あんちゃんが描かしたのかな？ / 大人はたいへんだよねぇ
rows.re: Did the big guy have her draw it? / Being a grown-up is hard, huh.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @He's not used to combat yet, so take it easy on him, OK?
rows.jp: 「あの爆発じゃ / さすがにダメかと思ったけど / やっぱり僕達の<b:8bd5>望の星だ
rows.re: After that blast I feared the / worst, but they're our guiding / hope after all.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @I have the courage to accept 0 the Black Knight.
rows.jp: 「まあ、少数ＡＲＭＳの力を<b:8bd6>りたくなったら / いつでも言ってくれよ
rows.re: If you ever want to borrow us few / ARMS members' strength, just say / the word.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @So keep your promise and come back again, OK? Remember, you promised!
rows.jp: 「<b:8bbd>務<b:8ae4>の保護衛さんだけどさ / 険人だけどちょっと、恐いんだよな / いろんな意味で〜<b:8bbd>務<b:8ae4>の保護衛さんがさ / お前のこといろいろ聞いてくるんだよな
rows.re: That guard on duty, she's / striking, but a bit scary. In / more ways than one.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @We're counting on you to save Filgaia. May <Sword Magess> protect you.
rows.jp: 「とりあえず、お前は数上のお<b:8bd4>さんタイプが / 好みだって言っておいたら<b:8bd9>んでたぜ / <f040><f041><f042>なに、描きそうな探してるんだよ？<b:8bbd>務<b:8ae4>の保護衛さんだけどさ / 険人だけどちょっと、恐いんだよな
rows.re: I told her you like the older type / and she lit up. What, hunting / someone to sketch?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @I guess I wasn't ready to accept you. I didn't have the courage. I'm sorry.
rows.jp: 「いろんな意味で〜
rows.re: In more ways / than one...
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @It's because of you that 0 and I have been able to get this far.
rows.jp: 「この前、エベチョチョ様っていう家から / クッキーを<b:8bda>ったんだけど / ちょっと、シケってたんだ〜
rows.re: The other day I got cookies from / one Ebechocho, but they'd gone a / bit stale.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: *To survive, you must assume the worst possible scenario and plan accordingly.
rows.jp: 「[05]が、がんばってる？ / まだ戦闘に慣れていないんだから / あんまり、無理させないようになッ！来てやったんだから / ちゃんと活<b:8a76>するんだぞ
rows.re: Is {3} holding up? He's new to / combat, so don't push him too / hard!
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: *Unpreparedness allows a bad situation to grow worse, overwhelming the unprepared.
rows.jp: 「まだ戦闘に慣れていないんだから / あんまり、無理させないようになッ！
rows.re: He's new to combat, so don't push / him too hard!
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: *Precaution and prevention stop disaster from spreading and help minimize the damage.
rows.jp: 「<b:8bdb><b:8bdc>されそうになった[05]がを / 助けてくれて、ありがとなッ！<b:8b52><b:8b95>しちゃったもんねッ！<b:8a5e>といたしましては〜
rows.re: Thanks for saving {3} when he was / nearly overwhelmed!
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: *Filgaia's nations and people are divided by invisible walls called borders.
rows.jp: 「ヴァレリアさんの行いは / 神<b:8bdd>の<b:8bde><b:8bdf>の<b:8be0><b:8a6a>書に<887d>るかもしれませんね<b:8a5e>といたしましては〜
rows.re: Sir Valeria's deeds may yet be / written into the scripture of the / gods.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: *The people are further divided by a longing for security and suspicion of foreign nations.
rows.jp: 「もう、このファルガイアに / あなた方たちを倒せるモノは / いないことでしょう<b:8a5e>といたしましては〜
rows.re: Surely there's no one left in / all Filgaia who could / defeat you now.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: *Will Filgaians ever learn to live together as one people sharing the same planet?
rows.jp: 「[05]ぉさんも / 『スレイハイムの英雄』さんと同じくらい / 強いのではないですか<b:8a5e>といたしましては〜
rows.re: Aren't you as strong as the |Hero / of Slayheim| himself?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: *The next disaster to strike could be a monster - or it could be a natural disaster.
rows.jp: 「『スレイハイムの英雄』は / 配達じゃないと言うことですね<b:8a5e>といたしましては〜
rows.re: So the |Hero of Slayheim| is no / mere reputation, then.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: *We are not prepared to deal with such disasters.
rows.jp: 「エベチョチョ様の<b:8be2>物のクッキーですが / 大事にしまっていた為 / <b:8b45>味<b:8aa3>限を過ぎていたのではないでしょうか<b:8a5e>といたしましては〜
rows.re: Ebechocho's prized cookies, saved / so carefully, had likely gone / past their date.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: *A threat global in scale could overwhelm us.
rows.jp: 「[05]が様にとって / <b:8a81>の活<b:8a76>の場だったのではないでしょうか<b:8a5e>といたしましては〜
rows.re: For {3}, it may have been his / first real taste of the field.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: *We must unite! But can we? Are our beliefs and ideas too different?
rows.jp: 「[05]がくんは / このお館に保護してもらうのが / 正解でしょう<b:8be3><b:8be4>が / <b:8bb2>かに<b:8b84>い輝を放ちはじめる〜
rows.re: It's surely best that {3} be kept / safe here in this manor.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: *Absolute terror? Overpowering force? Common ideals?
rows.jp: 「それは結単なことなんかではなく / 誰にだってできることだったんです体 備品係来いよ来てく
rows.re: That was no simple feat. It wasn't / something just anyone could do.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: *Everyone has different ideas and opinions. Will the world ever unite?
rows.jp: ＊それらに対抗するためには / 世に、最悪の状況を想定し / 対抗方法を確立しておくことである
rows.re: To counter them, assume the worst / and set countermeasures in / advance.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: *In the past, others strove for unity, only to see their achievements vanish like a dream.
rows.jp: ＊対抗が、後手に回ることで / 状況は悪合の一<b:8b94>を<89cb>り / 取り<b:8a8a>しの付かない状況になる
rows.re: When the response lags, things / only worsen, past the point of / undoing.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: *Is it even possible for one ruler to unify the world?
rows.jp: ＊未部に防ぐことができなかったとき / 状況の悪合を防ぎ / <889a><889b>の最小合を<b:8be6>る必要がある共通という名の<b:8be7><b:8ab4>域が大きくなったとき / ひとつの共へと変合する
rows.re: If it can't be prevented, stem / the harm and keep the damage / minimal.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: *Perhaps the world will unite only when all the people of the world desire unity.
rows.jp: ＊ファルガイアにある共々は / 見えない共通という<b:8be7>で押切られ / 人々の心にも<b:8be7>を作る
rows.re: Filgaia's nations are split by / invisible walls called borders, / walls in the heart as well.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: *The Summit is held every two years and during a crisis.
rows.jp: ＊自共を保ろうとしたり / 他共に対し中心暗<b:8be8>になることで / さらに<b:8be9>を願めていくことになる
rows.re: Guarding one's own land and eyeing / others with suspicion only deepens / the rift.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: *During Slayheim's collapse, an emergency summit was held to discuss the world situation.
rows.jp: ＊ファルガイアの全ての人々がわかりあい / この地に住まう同胞として / <b:8bea>重しあえるのはいつの回か…来るべき脅威剣の魔<b:8be4>の脅威は去った、が / 今後、我らを脅かす脅威が / 来ないとも限らない
rows.re: When will all Filgaians understand / and respect each other as kin of / this land?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: *The Treaty of Iscariot, a peace treaty, was also discussed again at this time.
rows.jp: ＊我々は、それに抗する手だてがあるのか？ / 魔物に限ったことではない / 大変地異の可能性もある
rows.re: Do we have any means to counter / it? Not just monsters. A great / disaster too.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: *At the Summit, nations meet to discuss world peace, not their own national interests.
rows.jp: ＊それらに抗する力を / 我々は持っていない
rows.re: We do not have the power to resist / them.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.jp: ＊世界を奪う脅威が来たとき / 我々は滅びるしかないのか

rows.en: @monsters in the 1land to the east0 1across the inlet.0
rows.jp: ＊その前に、我々はまとまらねばならぬ / だが、人の年だけ思いがあり / 人がまとまることなど不可能なのか？統一への道統一させ / そこに住まう者をひとつにまとめるために / 何が必要か？
rows.re: First, we must unite. But each / person holds their own view. Is / unity even possible?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Your mission is to go there and discover the cause of the disturbance. Good luck.
rows.jp: ＊作無もいわせぬ恐<b:8a93>か？ / 抗うことのできない力か？ / 統一された思想か？
rows.re: Terror that allows no dissent? A / power none can resist? One unified / creed?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.jp: ＊人の年だけ思いがある / 果たして / 世界をまとめることは可能なのか
rows.re: Each person holds a thought of / their own. Can the world truly be / united?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @It's hard to believe Meria Boule, Sylvaland, and Guild Galad are all cooperating.
rows.jp: ＊<b:8bde><b:8bdf>において、統一を試みた者たちはいた / しかしながら、その全てが / うたかたの理となりて<b:8bed>っていった
rows.re: In ages past, some sought unity. / Yet all of it faded like fleeting / foam.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Freeing all of the Live Reflectors and fighting together - unthinkable before.
rows.jp: ＊そもそも、一人の支配者のもとに / 統一されることは可能なのか？
rows.re: Is it even possible to unite / under a single ruler?
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Recent enemies working together...
rows.jp: ＊もし、世界がまとまる時が来たとしたら / それは、世界の人々がそれを望む状況に / なったときだろう<b:8ab0>共の王たちが集まり行う / 最高級の式<b:8bee>である
rows.re: If the world ever unites, it will / be when its people themselves / desire it.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @It's because all of Filgaia is threatened. There's no choice but to join forces.
rows.jp: ＊現在は、定<8943>で少数に一度開催されるが / 緊急時には、非世開催も行われる
rows.re: It's held on a set cycle every few / years, with emergency sessions in / a crisis.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @I've got to do my part, too!
rows.jp: ＊スレイハイムの崩滅の<89d2>には / 今後の世界情報について協議されるため / 非世開催されることとなった
rows.re: At Slayheim's fall, an emergency / session was called to weigh the / world's future.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @The Raypoint's telegeo-mixer is operating at 84%. Mana supply proceeding as planned.
rows.jp: ＊この時には、注目<b:8bf0><b:8bf1>でもある / 『イスカリオテ<b:8bf0><b:8bf1>』について / <b:8bc9>めて話し合われた
rows.re: At that time the Treaty of / Iscariot was taken up for / discussion once more.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @Everything seems to be going as well as we could hope.
rows.jp: ＊自共の利<b:8bf2>だけでなく / 世界の注目のためについて話し合われる / それがファルガイアサミットである<b:8b7d>がかかっている / 中を進むことはできない<b:8bf3>入<b:8bf4>式望
rows.re: Not just each land's gain, but the / whole world's good is debated. / That is the Filgaia Summit.
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @What is the capture ratio of the Kuiper Belt in the blockaded region?
rows.lit: (EN only) What is the capture ratio of the Kuiper Belt in the blockaded region?
rows.re: What's the capture ratio of the / Kuiper Belt in the blockaded / region? [?]
rows.speaker: Irving

rows.en: @What!? How can that be?
rows.jp: 「貴様の任務は、現地に急行し / 原因を行次することだ / 〜頼んだぞ
rows.lit: Your mission is to rush to the site and investigate the cause. I'm counting on you.
rows.re: Your mission: rush to the site and / find the cause. I'm counting on / you.
rows.speaker: Irving

rows.en: @It's not my fault.
rows.re: zzz...zzz...zzz
rows.speaker: propagated:exact

rows.en: @What should we do?
rows.jp: 「何だか、まだ信じられません / メリアブール、シルヴァラント / それに、ギルドグラードが〜
rows.lit: It's still hard to believe: Meria Boule, Sylvaland, and Guild Galad...
rows.re: It's still hard to believe. Meria / Boule, Sylvaland, and Guild / Galad...
rows.speaker: Chateau NPC

rows.en: @There may be unforeseen dangers, but there's no choice.
rows.jp: 「族共がお<b:8bf8>いのライブリフレクターを解放し / 共闘しているなんて〜 / 少し前の状況では考えられないことでした
rows.lit: The nations opening their Live Reflectors to each other and fighting together, unthinkable not long ago.
rows.re: The nations sharing their Live / Reflectors and fighting together, / unthinkable not long ago.
rows.speaker: Chateau NPC

rows.en: @Right now the Kuiper Belt is partially imprisoned in a cage of Mana. It is almost alive.
rows.jp: 「みんないっしょにガンバローって信じに / いつのまにかなってたもんね
rows.lit: Before we knew it, everyone came to believe in pulling together.
rows.re: Before we knew it, everyone came / to believe in pulling together.
rows.speaker: Lilka

rows.en: @It is vulnerable because it's not a |World,| but a |Being.| We must attack now!
rows.jp: 「みんなのファルガイアが / 大ピンチなんだもん / そりゃ、みんなでがんばらなくっちゃねッ！
rows.lit: Everyone's Filgaia is in dire straits, so of course we all have to do our best!
rows.re: Everyone's Filgaia is in peril, so / of course we all have to try our / best!
rows.speaker: Lilka

rows.en: @This is our one chance. If we miss it, there will never be another.
rows.jp: 「さて、ミーちゃんも / お仕事がんばらなくっちゃ
rows.lit: Now then, Mee-chan had best get to work too.
rows.re: Now then, Mee-chan had best get / to work too.
rows.speaker: Amy

rows.en: @ARMS must enter the blockaded region and annihilate the Kuiper Belt!
rows.jp: 「レイポイントの / テレジオダイナミクサーの<b:8b73><b:8bf9><b:8bf6>８４％ / マナの族<898d><b:8bf5>調ッ！
rows.lit: The Raypoint's Teleodynamixer is at 84% output; Mana flow steady!
rows.re: Raypoint Teleodynamixer at 84% / output. Mana flow steady!
rows.speaker: Amy

rows.en: @It will be the |Land of Death and Destruction,| at the center of the old Slayheim salt flats.
rows.jp: 「も<f045>、いいカンジで / どんどんいっちゃってます
rows.lit: It's going great, moving right along!
rows.re: It's going great, moving right / along!
rows.speaker: Amy

rows.en: @The sky of Filgaia is still dark, and the hearts of people are just as shadowed.
rows.jp: 「封右領標街の / カイバーベルトの捕謎<b:8bf6>は〜
rows.lit: As for capturing the Kuiper Belt in the sealed zone...
rows.re: As for trapping the Kuiper Belt / in the sealed zone...
rows.speaker: Amy

rows.en: @Did the Trapezohedron avail us not at all? Have we failed, then?
rows.jp: 「あれ？ / あれれれれ？<b:8bf6>、０．０２４％？ / 何だかとってもアレな年<8875>を特待ッ！
rows.lit: Huh? Wh-what?
rows.re: Huh? Wh-what?
rows.speaker: Amy

rows.en: @But even if we were defeated in this battle, we still have the war.
rows.jp: 「ミーちゃんの / 所為じゃありませんよぉ〜<b:8bb3>を切り離したかッ！
rows.lit: It's not Mee-chan's fault!
rows.re: It's not Mee-chan's fault!
rows.speaker: Amy

rows.en: @Even in this darkness, we were able to see one critical thing.
rows.lit: What do we do?
rows.re: What do we do?
rows.speaker: party

rows.en: @Yes, we have found the way to trap the Kuiper Belt!
rows.jp: 「〜未知の危険だが仕方がない
rows.lit: There may be unforeseen danger, but there's no choice.
rows.re: There may be unforeseen danger, / but there's no choice.
rows.speaker: Irving

rows.en: @Treating a |World| like a spirit and trapping it in a live |Vessel| can be effective.
rows.jp: 「現在、カイバーベルトは封右領標の中心にて / ライブエネルギー『マナ』の<b:8bfa>に<8965>われ / <8972><8973>生命体としてマテリアライズされている
rows.lit: Now the Kuiper Belt, caged in Mana at the sealed zone's center, is materialized as a living being.
rows.re: Now the Kuiper Belt, caged in Mana / at the zone's center, is / materialized as a living being.
rows.speaker: Irving

rows.en: @Why don't we try sealing it in the Trapezohedron once more?
rows.jp: 「つまり、『世界』などという / <b:8a47>念存在の<b:8bfb>を<b:8bfc>ぎ取られた状態なのだ / そこに、倒すべき実体があるッ！
rows.lit: In other words, it's stripped of its abstract nature as a "World"; there is a real body to strike!
rows.re: It's stripped of its nature as a / |World|. There is now a real body / to strike!
rows.speaker: Irving

rows.en: @If we can still trap a critical mass of the Kuiper Belt in the Trapezohedron...
rows.jp: 「この機を逃すことは / <b:8bfd>遠にヤツを / 倒す機式を失ってしまうということだ
rows.lit: To miss this chance is to lose forever any means of defeating it.
rows.re: Miss this chance and we lose, for / good, any means to defeat it.
rows.speaker: Irving

rows.en: @We can do better against it this time!
rows.jp: 「ＡＲＭＳは / 封右領標街に<b:8bf3>入 / カイバーベルトを壊滅するッ！
rows.lit: ARMS will enter the sealed zone and annihilate the Kuiper Belt!
rows.re: ARMS will enter the sealed zone / and annihilate the Kuiper Belt!
rows.speaker: Irving

rows.en: @Since the |Pillar| heir appeared, the faint light of the world we've seen has been disappearing.
rows.jp: 「降辺地帯は『滅死の大地』〜 / 元スレイハイム領の隣の原野の / ほぼ中<8c01>付近と思われますッ！
rows.lit: The landing zone is the "Land of Death and Ruin," near the center of the wildlands by old Slayheim.
rows.re: The landing zone is the |Land of / Death and Ruin|, near old / Slayheim's wilds.
rows.speaker: Irving

rows.en: @A large amount of Mana must have been consumed from Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「未だファルガイアの空は / 回<b:8ac7>の<b:8b5a>しを見せず / 人々の心までも、暗く閉ざしている
rows.lit: Filgaia's sky still shows no sign of recovery, and even people's hearts stay dark and closed.
rows.re: Filgaia's sky shows no sign of / recovery, and people's hearts stay / dark and closed.
rows.speaker: Irving

rows.jp: 「トラペゾヘドロンによる / カイバーベルトの<8972><8973>生命合は / すべて失<893d>に終ったのか〜？
rows.lit: Did the Trapezohedron's materialization of the Kuiper Belt end in utter failure?
rows.re: Did the Trapezohedron's plan for / the Kuiper Belt end in utter / failure?
rows.speaker: Irving

rows.en: @It would be hundreds of years before so much Mana accumulated at the Raypoint again.
rows.jp: 「だが、あくまでも『<893d>北』であり / すべてが『失<893d>』に / 終ったわけではない〜
rows.lit: But it was a "defeat," not a total "failure."
rows.re: But it was a defeat, not a total / failure.
rows.speaker: Irving

rows.en: @There must be something. There just has to be something!
rows.jp: 「この暗<b:8ae1>の中〜 / たったひとつ / 我々が手にした成果がある
rows.lit: In this darkness, there is one single result we've gained.
rows.re: In this darkness, we gained one / thing.
rows.speaker: Irving

rows.en: @If we don't try something, everything living in Filgaia will be...
rows.jp: 「そう〜 / カイバーベルトの捕謎方法に / <b:8a46>りはなかったッ！
rows.lit: Yes: there was no error in the method of trapping the Kuiper Belt!
rows.re: Yes. There was no error in the way / we trap the Kuiper Belt!
rows.speaker: Irving

rows.en: @Sometimes it's better to go slowly than quickly. One more error will be fatal.
rows.jp: 「『世界』をひとつの<8c03><8c04>に見立てることで / 生命の『時』に封じること自体は / 対カイバーベルトの作<b:8af4>案だったのだ
rows.lit: Treating a "World" as a vessel, sealing it in the "time" of a life, that itself was the plan against the Kuiper Belt.
rows.re: Treating a |World| as a vessel, / sealing it in a life, that plan / itself was sound.
rows.speaker: Irving

rows.en: @You all must be very weary by now. I cannot ignore that.

rows.en: @Sometimes when you start a fight, you don't know how to back out of it without losing face. I know.
rows.jp: 「ケンカをおっぱじめてから / <b:8a76>り上げた<b:8a77>の降ろす先に / <b:8a78>っちまうことってあるだろ？
rows.lit: Once a fight's started, you can end up stuck with a raised fist and nowhere to bring it down, right?
rows.re: Once a fight's started, you can / end up stuck with a raised fist / and nowhere to swing it, right?
rows.speaker: miner

rows.en: @I bet that was it!
rows.jp: 「そういうもんじゃなかったのかな？<b:8a79>われる』〜
rows.lit: Wasn't that how it went?
rows.re: Wasn't that how it went?
rows.speaker: miner

rows.en: @I forget who it was that said that, but the description fits all too well...
rows.jp: 「どこの誰が / 言い出しっぺなのか忘れたけど / 実に言いえて<8a22>だな〜<b:8a7a>力に<b:8a7b>えてちゃ / できる<b:8a7c>達も、できないぞッ！<b:8a7d>人にとって / 共通の相だぜッ！
rows.lit: I forget who first said it, but it does hit the mark.
rows.re: I forget who first said it, but / it does hit the mark.
rows.speaker: miner

rows.en: @Something I first realized when they came attacking my own village...
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>って、自分の場が攻われて / やっと実信できたな〜来る前に / とっとと帰りな〜
rows.lit: ...Something I finally understood when my own town came under attack.
rows.re: ...Something I finally understood / when my own town came under / attack.
rows.speaker: miner

rows.en: @There are fierce monsters that inhabit the area around Holst.
rows.jp: 「ホルストの渓<89f4>には / おっかないモンスターがいっぱいだ<b:8a39>連中は / 元渡り<b:8a7f>ってヤツがほとんどさ
rows.lit: Holst's mine-valleys are full of fearsome monsters.
rows.re: Holst's mine-valleys are full of / fearsome monsters.
rows.speaker: miner

rows.en: @That's because in Holst you have to be able to deal with monsters.
rows.jp: 「ホルストじゃ / モンスター相手に腕っぷしも / 必要とされるからな
rows.lit: In Holst you need muscle enough to handle monsters too.
rows.re: In Holst you need muscle enough / to handle monsters too.
rows.speaker: miner

rows.en: @The chaos is what people here love about it.
rows.jp: 「ホルストは / 完全自由通掘が大きな結<b:8a80>なのさ
rows.lit: Holst's big draw is its completely free mining.
rows.re: Holst's big draw is its / completely free mining.
rows.speaker: miner

rows.en: @If you can mine and watch your back for monsters at the same time, then you're set in this town!
rows.jp: 「つまり、モンスターがうようよいる渓<89f4>で / 自分の身を守りつつ、通掘ができるヤツに / どーんと開放しているんだ<b:8a82>の<b:8a83>きは失われちゃいませんッ！
rows.lit: Meaning: in valleys crawling with monsters, it's thrown wide open to anyone who can mine and defend himself.
rows.re: Meaning: in valleys crawling with / monsters, it's wide open to any / who can mine and stay alive.
rows.speaker: miner

rows.en: @We can still do something to save ourselves! Now is the time to fight, not to give in!
rows.jp: 「これならまだ / どんな脅威にも立ち向かえますッ！ / あきらめちゃダメですよッ！
rows.lit: With this we can still stand against any threat! You mustn't give up!
rows.re: With this we can still stand / against any threat! You mustn't / give up!
rows.speaker: kid

rows.en: @You all are fighting to protect Filgaia, too?
rows.jp: 「みなさんも / ファルガイアを守る / 正義の味方だったんですね
rows.lit: So you're all Defenders of Justice protecting Filgaia too!
rows.re: So you're all Defenders of / Justice protecting Filgaia too!
rows.speaker: kid

rows.en: @Defenders of Justice like us should stick together, right?
rows.jp: 「これからは / お<b:8a85>い、正義の味方同胞 / <b:8a86>力していきましょうッ！<b:8a87><b:8a88>に思うことがあるんだ〜
rows.lit: From now on, fellow Defenders of Justice, let's work together!
rows.re: From now on, fellow Defenders of / Justice, let's work together!
rows.speaker: kid

rows.en: @...Filgaia is waiting - hoping - for someone to step forward and protect it.
rows.jp: 「ファルガイアは今〜 / 正義の味方の<b:8a89>場を / 望んでいるんじゃないかって
rows.lit: Filgaia right now... I think it's hoping for a Defender of Justice to step forward.
rows.re: Filgaia right now... I think it's / hoping for a Defender of Justice / to step forward.
rows.speaker: kid

rows.en: @Yes... A Defender of Justice like me, right?
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>そう〜 / ボクのような正義の味方を、ね〜<b:8a72>けないよね？ / <b:8a8b><b:8a8c>大怪獣<b:8a8d>団（？）なんかに / <b:8a8e>したりしないよね？
rows.lit: Yes... a Defender of Justice like me!
rows.re: Yes... a Defender of Justice like / me!
rows.speaker: kid

rows.en: @It won't all end like this, right?
rows.jp: 「このまま / 終っちゃうなんてことないよね？活の安定を望んで渓<b:8a39>になるべきか / 正義の味方になって / 冒険<b:8a90><b:8a91>に<b:8a69>いしれるか〜
rows.lit: It won't just end like this, right?
rows.re: It won't just end like this, / right?
rows.speaker: kid

rows.en: @Only children can dream about the future so freely, you know.
rows.jp: 「未来を自由に<b:8a60>見られるのは / 家族だけの結<88b2>なんだよ<b:8a39>になるか / 正義の味方の<b:8a60>を追い続けるか〜 / ボクなりに<b:8a87><b:8a88>に考えているんだよ<b:8a92><b:8a93>も / キミの<b:8a94>せも / 悪の<b:8a8d>団にねらわれているんだって
rows.lit: Dreaming freely of the future is a privilege that belongs to children alone.
rows.re: Dreaming freely of the future is / a privilege that belongs to / children alone.
rows.speaker: townsperson

rows.en: @We must do something now, or regret our inaction later! We boys and girls won't be bullied around!
rows.jp: 「今こそ、いっしょに立ち上がろうッ！ / 正しい、少数少女の心は / 悪者なんかに<b:8a72>けないぞッ！<b:8a92><b:8a93>をおびやかす / 悪の<b:8a95><b:8a96>の魔の手が / ボクたちに<b:8a97>び<b:8a6a>っているんだって
rows.lit: Now's the time to rise up together! The true hearts of boys and girls won't lose to any villain!
rows.re: Now's the time to rise up / together! True boys' and girls' / hearts won't lose to villains!
rows.speaker: kid

rows.en: @Do not fear, though. I will become a Defender of Justice and protect you all!
rows.jp: 「でも、安心して / ボクが正義の味方になって / やっつけてあげるよ<b:8a98><b:8a99>儀の大<b:8a9a><b:8a73><89cd>掘<b:8a9b>機だよ
rows.lit: But don't worry: I'll become a Defender of Justice and beat them for you!
rows.re: But don't worry: I'll become a / Defender of Justice and beat them / for you!
rows.speaker: kid

rows.en: @The force from the explosives drives a metal stake into the stone and splits it apart.
rows.jp: 「発破の<b:8a9c>撃で / <b:8a9d>く、強力な<b:8a9e>の一撃を<b:8a9f>り出して / カッコよく<b:8a73>を<b:8aa0>くんだって<b:8a73>をぶっ飛ばす機艇があるんだって
rows.lit: The blast drives a swift, mighty metal strike and splits the rock; so cool!
rows.re: The blast drives a swift, mighty / metal strike and splits the rock / wide open; so cool!
rows.speaker: kid

rows.en: @That's so cool... I wish I were a grown-up so I could use one...
rows.jp: 「カッコいいよな〜 / オトナだけでひとり<b:8aa1>めするなんて / ズルイや〜
rows.lit: So cool... and the grown-ups keep it all to themselves; no fair!
rows.re: So cool... and the grown-ups keep / it all to themselves. No fair!
rows.speaker: kid

rows.en: @I know it doesn't mean much, but it makes me feel better until the danger passes.
rows.jp: 「そうすれば、少し心が強くなった気がします / 不安や怖れが<b:8aa2>かながら / <b:8aa3>れていくような気がするのです
rows.lit: Doing so, my heart feels a little stronger; the worry and fear seem, just faintly, to recede.
rows.re: Doing so, my heart feels a little / stronger. The worry and fear / seem, just faintly, to recede.
rows.speaker: townswoman

rows.en: @We adults can't even guarantee our children a world to grow up in...
rows.jp: 「わたしたち大人は / これからを生きていく家族たちに / 未来すら<b:8aa4>えられないのでしょうか？来には不安や怖れが / ありませんように〜
rows.lit: Can we adults not grant even a future to the children who must live on after us?
rows.re: Can we adults not grant even a / future to the children who must / live on after us?
rows.speaker: townswoman

rows.en: @That's what I pray for, but when I look up at the sky...
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>そう<b:8aa5>ってきましたが / あの空を見ていると〜<b:8aa6>らした枯<b:8aa7>をかぶるのは誰？
rows.lit: ...So I have prayed; but looking at that sky...
rows.re: ...So I have prayed; but looking / at that sky...
rows.speaker: townswoman

rows.en: @It's the weak people, the bystanders. Am I wrong?
rows.jp: 「それは、弱い人たち / どうすることもできない<b:8aa8>観者たち〜 / <f040><f042>違いますか？
rows.lit: It's the weak ones, the bystanders who can do nothing... am I wrong?
rows.re: It's the weak ones, the / bystanders who can do nothing... / am I wrong?
rows.speaker: townsperson

rows.en: @But it seems to me that the light of your goodness only makes Odessa's shadow blacker...
rows.jp: 「オデッサの起を<b:8aa9>らそうとする / あなたたちの輝が強すぎるから / ヤツらはより、<b:8aaa>い起となるのでは？
rows.lit: Because your light, trying to dispel Odessa's shadow, shines too strong, don't they become a blacker shadow?
rows.re: Your light tries to dispel / Odessa's shadow, but shines so / strong their shadow only deepens.
rows.speaker: townsperson

rows.en: @What happens to us when darkness and light destroy everything in their path?
rows.jp: 「強い輝と起が交<b:8aab>する中 / 何もできない私たちは / どうなっていくのでしょうか〜活に / <b:8aac>足で<b:8aad>み込んでくるテロリスト
rows.lit: Amid the clash of fierce light and shadow, what becomes of us who can do nothing?
rows.re: Amid the clash of fierce light / and shadow, what becomes of us / who can do nothing?
rows.speaker: townsperson

rows.en: @I cannot forgive them, but neither can I do anything against them. What are weak people to do?
rows.jp: 「許すことはできません / 〜でも、<b:8aae>うこともままなりません / 弱い人間は、どうしたらいいのでしょう？
rows.lit: I cannot forgive them; yet neither can I fight them. What are the weak to do?
rows.re: I cannot forgive them; yet / neither can I fight them. What / are the weak to do?
rows.speaker: townsperson

rows.en: @But you can't go unnoticed from Holst to the Aguel Mine Shaft.
rows.jp: 「でも、ホルストの場中にある / アグエル<89cc>道に向かうには / たくさんの人目についてしまいます
rows.lit: But heading for the Aguel shaft in the middle of Holst, you'd be seen by far too many eyes.
rows.re: But heading for the Aguel shaft / in the middle of Holst, you'd be / seen by far too many eyes.
rows.speaker: townsperson

rows.en: @If they were after something, it would more likely be the old unused mine shaft.
rows.jp: 「ねらうとすれば / かつて掘っていた / <b:8a4e><89cc>道なんかではないでしょうか？活動していなければ / 今ごろはあなただって / こんなことをしていなかったはず
rows.lit: If they're after anything, wouldn't it be the old shaft they used to dig?
rows.re: If they're after anything, / wouldn't it be the old shaft they / used to dig?
rows.speaker: townsperson

rows.en: @It's because of adults that children go to war. Something is wrong with the world...
rows.jp: 「家族が戦場に出て行くなんて / やっぱり、大人たちの<b:8aaf>任です / 何かがどこかで、まちがったのですね<b:8ab0>がしているオデッサって / いつか、<8934><88e0>ジャックをおこなった / あのテロリストたちなんでしょ？
rows.lit: Children going off to battlefields; that is the adults' fault. Somewhere, something went wrong.
rows.re: Children going off to / battlefields; that is the adults' / fault. Something went wrong.
rows.speaker: townswoman

rows.en: @I can't do anything but worry about the future of Filgaia. My children, you see...
rows.jp: 「うちの家が<b:8ab1>らしていく / ファルガイアの未来が / 心配でたまりません〜<b:8ab2>び<b:8a7c>達がいなくて<b:8a78>っています
rows.lit: I can't stop worrying about the Filgaia my children will live in.
rows.re: I can't stop worrying about the / Filgaia my children will live in.
rows.speaker: townswoman

rows.en: @I wonder if my son will become a Merc, too? I hope not...
rows.jp: 「まさか、うちの家も / 渡り<b:8a7f>になってしまうんじゃ〜<b:8ab3>で<b:8ab4>古の遺跡と / <b:8ab5>がっているそうです
rows.lit: Surely my own boy won't end up a Drifter too...?
rows.re: Surely my own boy won't end up a / Drifter too...?
rows.speaker: townswoman

rows.en: @That's why Energy Crystals are there in the first place.
rows.jp: 「だからエネルギー渓谷だなんて / 不思議なものが / 通れるんでしょうね〜守れば / ファルガイアを全部守れるよ
rows.lit: That must be why something as strange as energy crystal can be mined here.
rows.re: That must be why something as / strange as energy crystal can be / mined here.
rows.speaker: townsperson

rows.en: @Why doesn't everybody realize this simple thing?
rows.jp: 「どうしてみんな / そんな<b:8ab6><b:8ab7>なことに / 気がつかないのかな？母さんを守ってあげるんだッ！
rows.lit: Why doesn't anyone notice something so simple?
rows.re: Why doesn't anyone notice / something so simple?
rows.speaker: kid

rows.en: @I'm not sure if I can protect anybody besides her, though...
rows.jp: 「〜でも、お母さん以外を / 守りきれる自信は、ちょっと無いかも〜母さんがね / お発方が見つからないって / つぶやいていたんだ
rows.lit: ...Though I might not quite be sure I can protect anyone besides Mama...
rows.re: ...Though I might not quite be / sure I can protect anyone besides / Mama...
rows.speaker: kid

rows.en: @I don't know what to tell her...
rows.jp: 「ボクはね / お母さんに、何て言っていいのかが / 見つからないよ〜怖い人が / やってきてたいへんだったけど / ボク、泣かなかったよッ！
rows.lit: Me, I just can't find what I should say to Mama...
rows.re: Me, I just can't find what I / should say to Mama...
rows.speaker: kid

rows.en: @'Cause...if I started crying...then Mama would too for sure!
rows.jp: 「だって、ボクが泣いちゃうと / お母さんまで / 泣いちゃうかもしれないからね怖い人たちがやってくるから / お外に出ちゃダメなんだって
rows.lit: 'Cause if I start crying, Mama might start crying too.
rows.re: 'Cause if I start crying, Mama / might start crying too.
rows.speaker: kid

rows.en: @Mama worries a lot... It's alright, though. I'll protect her.
rows.jp: 「お母さんは心配性だなぁ〜 / だいじょうぶ / ボクが守ってあげるから怖い人たちが / ホルストをねらっているんだって
rows.lit: Mama's such a worrier... it's all right; I'll protect her.
rows.re: Mama's such a worrier... it's all / right. I'll protect her.
rows.speaker: kid

rows.en: @I guess it's not because they heard I was bad...?
rows.jp: 「ひょっとして / ボクがあんまりかわいいから〜？<b:8aac>の辺には / 渓谷がザクザク<89db>まっているんだって
rows.lit: Could it be... because I'm just that cute?
rows.re: Could it be... because I'm just / that cute?
rows.speaker: kid

rows.en: @But the thing that might be our real treasure isn't buried at all.
rows.jp: 「でも、ボクたちの / <b:8aba>物になりそうなものは / <89db>まっていないみたいなんだよ
rows.lit: But the thing that could be OUR treasure doesn't seem to be buried at all.
rows.re: But the thing that could be OUR / treasure doesn't seem to be / buried at all.
rows.speaker: kid

rows.en: @I want to grow up quick!
rows.jp: 「早くオトナになりたいな<b:8aac>の辺には / 渓谷がザクザク<89db>まっているんだって
rows.lit: I want to grow up quick!
rows.re: I want to grow up quick!
rows.speaker: kid

rows.en: @All the men say they have lots of fun digging for crystal and killing monsters.
rows.jp: 「おじさんたちは、渓谷を掘り出したり / モンスターをぶちのめしたりして / <8945><b:8a7a>者な生活をマンキツしてるんだって<b:8abb><b:8a8e>で、どこまでいっても暗い世界 / いっそ誰かが<b:8abc>やし<b:8abd>くしてくれれば / 僕も楽なんだけどな〜活をしてたヤツらが / うらやましいぜ<b:8aad>み込んでくるヤツ、みんなキライ
rows.lit: The men say they get to dig crystal and clobber monsters, living the good life to the full.
rows.re: The men say they get to dig / crystal and clobber monsters, / living the good life in full.
rows.speaker: kid

rows.en: @There's some Aguelite there to be mined, but not much.
rows.jp: 「そこからは / エネルギー渓谷『アグエライト』が / わずかだけれど通れるぞ<b:8a4e><89cc>道の東[11]ぉに / 古い遺跡があったんですよ
rows.lit: From there you can mine the energy crystal "Aguelite," if only a little.
rows.re: From there you can mine the / energy crystal |Aguelite|, if / only a little.
rows.speaker: miner

rows.en: @It's different than the ruin that lies underneath this town, so it could hold a new discovery...
rows.jp: 「この他の地辺に<89bb>っている遺跡とは / 少し<b:8ac4>が違うので / ひょっとしたら、新しい発見があるかも？
rows.lit: It differs a bit in kind from the ruin lying under this island; perhaps a new discovery awaits?
rows.re: It differs a bit in kind from the / ruin lying under this island. / Perhaps a new discovery awaits?
rows.speaker: scholar

rows.en: @I really want to help!
rows.jp: 「みなさんの / お役に立ちたいんですッ！<b:8b03><b:8a42>の<b:8a38>変地異だなんて〜 / 何も俺が生きているあいだに〜<b:8b03><b:8a88>の<b:8ac5>女＞に関する渡記を保存した / 遺跡があるらしいんだ
rows.lit: I want to be of use to you all!
rows.re: I want to be of use to you all!
rows.speaker: kid

rows.en: @I bet the <Sword Magess> could do something to get rid of this cursed sky!
rows.jp: 「この異世な空〜 / ＜<b:8a88>の<b:8ac5>女＞なら / 何とかしてくれるのだろうか〜<b:8a8c>[03]来るってウワサが流れて以来 / 一部の人たちが<b:8ac6>り上がっているんですよ
rows.lit: This unnatural sky... would the <Sword Magess> be able to do something about it, I wonder?
rows.re: This unnatural sky... would the / <Sword Magess> be able to do / something about it, I wonder?
rows.speaker: townsperson

rows.en: @Some people are easily deceived.
rows.jp: 「<b:8a78>った人たちです<b:8ac7>の遺跡が谷の中にあるそうです
rows.lit: Some people are easily led astray.
rows.re: Some people are easily led / astray.
rows.speaker: townsperson

rows.en: @I can't imagine the whole inside of the mountain being one big ruin!
rows.jp: 「谷の中全体が遺跡だなんて / なんか想<b:8ac8>もつかないですけどね<b:8b8d>[03]<b:8ac7>の遺跡が谷の中にあるそうです
rows.lit: The whole inside of the mountain being a ruin; I can hardly picture it.
rows.re: The whole inside of the mountain / being a ruin; I can hardly / picture it.
rows.speaker: townsperson

rows.en: @They're mining the Energy Crystals from the old ruins as ore. It's like petrified energy.
rows.jp: 「その<b:8ac7>の遺跡にあるエネルギーの結晶を / 渓谷として掘り<b:8ac9>してるらしいです / いうなればエネルギーの合谷ですかねぇ
rows.lit: They mine the energy crystals in those old ruins as ore; call it petrified energy, I suppose.
rows.re: They mine the energy crystals in / those old ruins as ore. Call it / petrified energy, I suppose.
rows.speaker: townsperson

rows.en: @But if you're going to be doing mining in Holst, you'll need some explosives.
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>でも〜 / ホルストで通掘をするつもりなら / 発破のひとつは必要さ爆<b:8a59>のこと / 僕たちはそう呼んでるんだよ<b:8aca>えた道に / とぐろを<8812>いたような他があるらしい
rows.lit: But if you mean to do any mining in Holst, you'll need at least one charge of blasting powder.
rows.re: But if you mean to do any mining / in Holst, you'll need at least / one blasting charge.
rows.speaker: shopkeeper

rows.en: @There are places called Raypoints where the veins and arteries of the earth come together.
rows.jp: 「何でも、地<89f4>の集中しているポイントで / そこは、レイポイントと呼ばれる / ファルガイアのヘソみたいな所と聞くぜ
rows.lit: They say it's a point where the earth's veins gather; a Raypoint, like Filgaia's navel, I hear.
rows.re: They say it's a point where the / earth's veins gather; a Raypoint, / like Filgaia's navel, I hear.
rows.speaker: miner

rows.en: @My life hasn't changed that much.
rows.jp: 「僕の生活は、何も変わらないよ<b:8acb>が起きているみたいだな / 〜この空のように〜<b:8acc>にならねぇよ / <b:8acd>身に<b:8ace>みたぜ腕には自信があったけど / オデッサばかりはいけねぇよ
rows.lit: My life hasn't changed at all.
rows.re: My life hasn't changed at all.
rows.speaker: miner

rows.en: @They're ruthless, you see. They don't follow the rules.
rows.jp: 「あいつら、ルール無用で / ムチャクチャやりやがる〜
rows.lit: Those guys play by no rules; they wreck everything...
rows.re: Those guys play by no rules; they / wreck everything...
rows.speaker: miner

rows.en: @Yes, there was a small one to the 1NE of town0, I think.
rows.jp: 「そう、[11]お場の北側[11]ぉにも / 小さな渓<89f4>があったはずだ
rows.lit: Yes: there should have been a small mine-valley on the [11]north side of town[11] too.
rows.re: Yes: there should have been a / small mine-valley on the / [11]north side of town[11] too.
rows.speaker: miner

rows.en: @But there's not much to be mined, and you have to use a boat, so no one's using it now.
rows.jp: 「でも、あんまりいい渓谷が通れないし / いちいち<89d3>に乗らなきゃいけないので / 今は閉ざされてしまったよ<b:8acf>義の場 / ケンカと<b:8ad0>掘りのうまいヤツが / ここではエライのさ
rows.lit: But the ore there wasn't much good, and you had to take a boat every time, so it's closed now.
rows.re: But the ore there wasn't much / good, and you had to take a boat / every time, so it's closed now.
rows.speaker: miner

rows.en: @Someone once said that the monsters were coming out of the ruins... I wonder if it's true?
rows.jp: 「誰かが、渓<89f4>のモンスターは / 遺跡の中から出て来たって言ってたけど〜 / そういうものなのかな？<b:8ad1><b:8ad2>金を<b:8a60>見た / 発破マニアの渡り<b:8a7f>がやって来たんだ
rows.lit: Someone said the valley monsters came out from inside the ruins... could that be so?
rows.re: Someone said the valley monsters / came out from inside the ruins... / could that be so?
rows.speaker: townsperson

rows.en: @He thought he could do anything with enough explosives...
rows.jp: 「発破があると / 通掘に何かと便利だからな / 活<b:8ad3>を<b:8ad4>待されてたんだが〜
rows.lit: Blasting powder is handy for mining, so we had hopes for him...
rows.re: Blasting powder is handy for / mining, so we had hopes for / him...
rows.speaker: miner

rows.en: @He even exploded some in the inn! Got kicked out for it, of course...
rows.jp: 「そいつ、<b:8a5b><b:8a5c>の中でも / 発破を爆発させるくらいのマニアだったから / あっというまに<b:8a5d>き出されたんだ
rows.lit: That guy was maniac enough to set off charges inside the inn, so he was thrown out in a flash.
rows.re: That guy was maniac enough to set / off charges inside the inn, so he / was thrown out in a flash.
rows.speaker: miner

rows.en: @That's why everyone calls him a maniac.
rows.jp: 「これだから、マニアってよ〜<b:8a5c><b:8ad5>備しているみたいだけど、いいの？<b:8ad5>備していくかい？<b:8ad5>備するのかな？<b:8ad6>対に<b:8ac2>いに来てねッ！<b:8ad6>対に<b:8ac2>いに来てねッ！
rows.lit: That's maniacs for you...
rows.re: That's maniacs for you...
rows.speaker: miner

rows.en: @Our rate is Gella per person a night. For people, that would be Gella.2
rows.jp: 「おひとり方につき一緒[02]ギャラ / [02]人方ですので、[02]ギャラとなります / よろしいですか？[18]か
rows.lit: It's {2} Gella per guest; for {2} people, that's {2} Gella; all right?
rows.re: It's {2} Gella per guest a night. / For your party, that's {2} Gella. / All right?
rows.speaker: innkeeper

rows.en: *Do you want to read it?2
rows.jp: ＊進みますか？[18]か
rows.lit: Do you want to proceed?
rows.re: Do you want to proceed?
rows.speaker: examine prompt

rows.en: *The old civilization was adept at extracting and refining crystals. They're all under the ruins now.
rows.jp: ＊これは、多くの渓谷は / <b:8a4e>世代の<b:8ae8>次によって<b:8ae9>出・概<b:8aea>され / それが遺跡と共に<89db>まったと考えられる
rows.lit: It is thought that much of this crystal was extracted and refined by the prior age, then buried with the ruins.
rows.re: It is thought much of this / crystal was extracted and refined / by the prior age, then buried.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *Thus, we are rapidly approaching the point where the ruins won't yield any crystals to the miners.
rows.jp: ＊それ故に、遺跡<b:8aeb>渓谷で発掘される渓谷は / その<b:8aec>作<886f>も自ずと<b:8aed>界が早く<b:8a64>れる
rows.lit: Hence crystal dug from ruin-mines will, by nature, reach its limit all the sooner.
rows.re: Hence crystal dug from ruin-mines / will, by nature, reach its limit / all the sooner.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *However, since these crystals are already refined, they are up to 100 X purer than the natural kind.
rows.jp: ＊しかし、<b:8aee>に概<b:8aea>されているものだけに / その<b:8aef>度は、自部渓谷での<b:8af0>出物に比べ / 年<b:8a65><b:8af1>から年<b:8af2><b:8af1>といわれる
rows.lit: Yet being already refined, its purity is said to be tens to a hundred times that of naturally mined ore.
rows.re: Yet being already refined, its / purity is said to be up to a / hundredfold that of natural ore.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *Many mines have closed recently, and more face the same fate, so new mines need to be developed.
rows.jp: ＊ここ年数で、いくつもの渓谷が閉谷し / 今後も、閉谷する渓谷も<b:8af3>えていくだろう / <b:8af4>方<b:8af5>から、新<b:8af6>渓谷の開<b:8af7>が望まれている<b:8af8>すことで足元に設置され、 / 一定時間<b:8af9>過すると自動的に爆発します
rows.lit: In recent years many mines have closed, and more will follow; all sides hope for new mines to open.
rows.re: In recent years many mines have / closed, and more will follow. All / hope for new mines to open.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *Bombs may be used to blast open wooden boxes or destroy walls that already have cracks in them.
rows.jp: ＊ボムを爆発させることによって / <b:8afa><b:8afb>やヒビの入った壁などを / 破滅することができます
rows.lit: By detonating bombs, crates and cracked walls and the like can be destroyed.
rows.re: By detonating bombs, crates and / cracked walls and the like can be / destroyed.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: @Her illness is very interesting, uh... I meant severe! I don't want to leave her in anyone else's care.
rows.jp: 「そのような<b:8afd>重な<f040><f042> / もとい、結単な<b:8ae4><8943>を / 他のヤツにはまかせておけぬわ
rows.lit: Such a precious... that is, such a serious case, I could never leave to anyone else.
rows.re: Such a precious... that is, such / a serious case, I could never / leave to anyone else.

rows.jp: 「ヴィクトール<b:8a9a>の義体（シルエット）は / 生体がベースになっておるからな / 過<b:8b01>な無理は<b:8ae3>物じゃぞ〜<b:8b02><b:8b03>を行うには / <b:8b04>外れた力が必要なのだ〜

rows.re: Victor-series prosthetics are / built on living tissue. Excessive / strain is forbidden, mind.
rows.speaker: doctor

rows.en: @As a <Sword Magess> descendant, I needed to get that power even if it meant giving up my own body.
rows.jp: 「たとえ、自分のカラダを<b:8b05>ててでも / 力を手に入れなければならなかった〜 / あたしは＜<b:8a88>の<b:8ac5>女＞の<b:8b06>を招くものだ<b:8b07><b:8b08>』の<b:8b06>を招くからって / ここまでしなければいけなかったのかッ！
rows.lit: Even at the cost of casting away my own body, I had to gain power; I am one who carries the <Sword Magess>'s blood.
rows.re: Even at the cost of my own body, / I had to gain power. I carry the / <Sword Magess>'s blood.
rows.speaker: Kanon

rows.en: @If I didn't do this much, I would not have become self-aware.
rows.jp: 「こうでもしなければ / あたしは、その存在意義が見当たらないのだ
rows.lit: If not for this, I could find no meaning in my own existence.
rows.re: If not for this, I could find no / meaning in my own existence.
rows.speaker: Kanon

rows.jp: 「[05]ぎ、すまないが / 彼女のこと頼んだ

rows.re: {5}, sorry, but I leave her in / your hands.
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @You have Defenders of Justice to protect you, which gives miscreants like me reason to exist.
rows.jp: 「あなた方、正義の味方がいるから / 俺のような、おちゃめさんも / 存在する理由があるのですから〜
rows.lit: It's because you Defenders of Justice exist that a rascal like me has reason to exist too.
rows.re: It's because you Defenders of / Justice exist that a rascal like / me has reason to exist too.
rows.speaker: trickster

rows.jp: [17]<b:8a7d><b:8b0d>のみなさーん〜ッ！ / 俺も悪いけど / こいつらも同<b:8b0e>ですよーッ！<b:8b0f><b:8b10>だな〜
rows.speaker: SKIPPED - no content box in decode

rows.en: @Because of who I am - descendant of the <Sword Magess> - I do need enemies such as you to defeat.
rows.jp: 「そう、あたしがあたしであること〜 / ＜<b:8a88>の<b:8ac5>女＞の<b:8b11><b:8b12>であるためには / お前のように倒すべき存在が必要だ
rows.lit: Yes: for me to be myself, to be the <Sword Magess>'s heir, I need beings like you that must be defeated.
rows.re: Yes: for me to be myself, the / <Sword Magess>'s heir, I need / foes like you to defeat.
rows.speaker: Kanon

rows.en: @A Hero only becomes a Hero in battle, which is where I belong.
rows.jp: 「戦いの中に / 『<b:8b07><b:8b08>』はある〜 / 戦場こそ、あたしの<b:8b13>場所だッ！<b:8b02><b:8b03>のワザは / 悪しき存在を<b:8b14>る<b:8b15>ッ！<b:8b16>物に相応しいッ！<b:8a75>の実力〜 / みせてもらいましょうかッ！
rows.lit: Within battle lies the "hero"; the battlefield is where I belong!
rows.re: Within battle lies the |hero|. / The battlefield is where I / belong!
rows.speaker: Kanon

rows.en: @It will start VERY soon...
rows.jp: 「まもなく / はじまりますよ〜
rows.lit: It will begin very soon...
rows.re: It will begin very soon...
rows.speaker: voice

rows.en: @Ha ha ha...
rows.jp: 「クックック〜<b:8b18>告も無視して / 飛び出すからじゃッ！
rows.lit: Heh heh heh...
rows.re: Heh heh heh...
rows.speaker: voice

rows.jp: 「共に戦おう[05]き / 俺たちは<b:8b19>間なんだ<b:8b19>間などと〜<b:8b1a>うよ / <b:8b02><b:8b03>といえど、『渡り<b:8a7f>』なんだろ？<b:8b1b>は？<b:8b1c>え切れなくなった時〜
rows.lit: Fight with us, {4}; we are comrades.
rows.re: Fight with us, {4}. We are / comrades.
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.jp: 「とにかく、ヴァレリアシャトーまで戻るぞ / ここではまともな分<b:8afc>も<88e4>せぬ

rows.re: ...however, in this trial version, / it unfortunately cannot be used.
rows.speaker: system: demo notice

rows.jp: 「左ずの番で<89bb>いんです / お願いしますから / びっくりさせないでくださいよ

rows.lit: The menace of Odessa; how far can we truly stand against it?
rows.re: The menace of Odessa. How far can / we truly stand against it?

rows.jp: 「意外なところで / 意外な情報が聞けるかもしれませんよ / やはり、情報は足で探すものですね

rows.re: You may hear surprising things in / surprising places. Information is / found on foot.
rows.speaker: guard

rows.jp: 「やはり / あなたたちはただ者じゃないッ！
rows.lit: I knew it: you people are no ordinary folk!
rows.re: I knew it: you people are no / ordinary folk!
rows.speaker: guard

rows.en: @In the future, this bell may ring in the event of a real call-to-arms.
rows.jp: 「今後は、本当に目集のために / この発を灯らすことが / あるかもしれないですねぇ目集の発の光のはずなのに / 飛び込み<b:8a3f>んできたのはオレだけかッ！
rows.lit: From now on, this bell may yet ring for a true muster.
rows.re: From now on, this bell may yet / ring for a true muster.
rows.speaker: bell keeper

rows.en: @I'm glad it was a false alarm, but what if it were a real emergency?
rows.jp: 「イタズラだったからよかったものの / 本当の目集だったらどうなってたんだ？期してから<b:8a41>むことだ / つまらないミスなどで / 命を落とすことのないようにな核ドラゴンを簡単に撃動できたかもな<b:8a46>重過ぎるくらいが<89d5>度いいってものさ / <b:8a46>重過ぎて<b:8a47>することなんてないからな<b:8a48>勢にでるわけですね
rows.lit: Good thing it was a prank; what if it had been a real muster?
rows.re: Good thing it was a prank. What / if it had been a real muster?
rows.speaker: guard

rows.en: @One battle is about to end... That's what I think!
rows.jp: 「ひとつの戦いが終ろうとしている〜 / そんな気がしますッ！<b:8a4a>協力を得られましたね
rows.lit: One battle is about to end; that's the feeling I get!
rows.re: One battle is about to end. / That's the feeling I get!
rows.speaker: guard

rows.en: @The journey to this point was much longer than it needed be... Why do people create borders?
rows.jp: 「ここまでの道のりは / <88a5>いようで長かった〜〜 / 人はなぜ国具なんてつくったんだろう客さんのお戻りを / <888a>を長くして待っています
rows.lit: The road here felt short yet long; why did people ever make borders?
rows.re: The road here felt short yet / long. Why did people ever make / borders?
rows.speaker: guard

rows.en: @I am sure that everyone in Sylvaland knows of your fine exploits.
rows.jp: 「あなた方の活躍を / 我が国のすべての人が / <895b>えることでしょう客さんのお戻りを / <888a>を長くして待っています
rows.lit: All the people of our land will surely sing of your deeds.
rows.re: All the people of our land will / surely sing of your deeds.
rows.speaker: courtier

rows.en: @Please come in and let them know you are back.
rows.jp: 「ぜひ、客のものに / 話をかけてやってください国の国民が救われました
rows.lit: Please, do speak with the guests inside.
rows.re: Please, do speak with the guests / inside.
rows.speaker: courtier

rows.en: @Let us continue to work together for peace by all means.
rows.jp: 「これからも共に力を合わせ / 平和のために力を尽くしましょう
rows.lit: Let us keep joining strength and give our all for peace.
rows.re: Let us keep joining strength and / give our all for peace.
rows.speaker: courtier

rows.jp: 「緑に囲まれたこの美しい館は / 私たちの自慢です<b:8a5a>ったら / 俺を呼んでくださいッ！
rows.lit: This beautiful castle wrapped in green is our pride.
rows.re: This beautiful castle wrapped in / green is our pride.
rows.speaker: courtier

rows.en: @I'll be right off to save you! I know this is not realistic, but I am just that enthusiastic!
rows.jp: 「すぐに助けに行って差し上げますッ！ / <f040><f041><f042>って、現実には無理ですけど / 意気込みはそれぐらいある、ということで<f05b>
rows.lit: I'll rush to your rescue at once! ...Well, realistically I can't, but that's how much spirit I've got!
rows.re: I'll rush to your rescue at once! / Well, realistically I can't, but / that's my spirit!
rows.speaker: eager guard

rows.en: @I am just SO glad. If something happened to you, 2, I don't know what...!
rows.jp: 「いやぁ、良かった良かったぁ / [05]かさんに / もしものコトがあったら俺は〜ッ！
rows.lit: Oh, thank goodness, thank goodness! If anything had happened to {2}, I'd have...!
rows.re: Oh, thank goodness, thank / goodness! If anything had / happened to {2}, I'd have...!
rows.speaker: smitten guard

rows.en: @I see. I am just SO glad. If something happened to 2, I don't know what...!
rows.jp: 「そうですかぁ、良かった良かったぁ / [05]かさんに / もしものコトがあったら俺は〜ッ！
rows.lit: Is that so! Thank goodness! If anything had happened to {2}, I'd have...!
rows.re: Is that so! Thank goodness! If / anything had happened to {2}, I'd / have...!
rows.speaker: smitten guard

rows.en: @Please take care of 2 in the future.
rows.jp: 「これからも / [05]かさんを / 守ってあげてくださいね<b:8a5c><b:8a5d>ですから / 全部、暗くないですよ<b:8a5c><b:8a5d>があるから / 空が暗くなっても平気さッ！ / <b:8a5c><b:8a5d>が何なのかって？ それは<b:8a5e>内です<f04a>
rows.lit: Please keep protecting {2} from here on, won't you?
rows.re: Please keep protecting {2} from / here on, won't you?
rows.speaker: smitten guard

rows.en: @I have heard about your recent exploits. Good luck on your next job.
rows.jp: 「今回の活躍の件、聞いてますよ / またこれからも / 見右ってくださいね客さんの優<b:8a62>さが身に染みました
rows.lit: I've heard of your recent deeds; keep watching over us, won't you?
rows.re: I've heard of your recent deeds. / Keep watching over us, won't you?
rows.speaker: courtier

rows.en: @I cannot tell you of my joy at meeting you again.
rows.jp: 「でもこうしてまた / 無事に帰式できてなによりです
rows.lit: But nothing gladdens me more than your safe return.
rows.re: But nothing gladdens me more than / your safe return.
rows.speaker: courtier

rows.lit: At first, it may be best not to fly too far from land.
rows.re: At first, it may be best not to / fly too far from land.
rows.speaker: courtier

rows.en: @2, you have become the idol of Sylvaland Castle.
rows.jp: 「いまじゃ[05]かさんは / このシルヴァラント館のアイドルですよ
rows.lit: These days {2} is the idol of this Sylvaland Castle.
rows.re: These days {2} is the idol of / this Sylvaland Castle.
rows.speaker: guard

rows.en: @I can give you nothing but words of praise.
rows.jp: 「いやはや / 感賛の言葉しかでませんな
rows.lit: My my; I have nothing but words of admiration.
rows.re: My my. I have nothing but words / of admiration.
rows.speaker: courtier

rows.en: @I see why you were picked for ARMS. Can't judge a book by its cover. We are counting on you from now on.
rows.jp: 「さすがはＡＲＭＳに選ばれただけはある / 人は見かけによらないということか / これからもキミたちの活躍を期待している<b:8a6b>し<b:8a6c>ない
rows.lit: Worthy of being chosen for ARMS indeed; one can't judge by looks, it seems; we expect great things of you.
rows.re: Worthy of ARMS indeed. One can't / judge by looks, it seems. We / expect great things of you.
rows.speaker: knight

rows.en: @I have seen your strength in action quite well. Good to have you as allies.
rows.jp: 「キミたちの実力のほど / しかと見せてもらった / 味方として心強い限りだ環人は〜
rows.lit: I have seen your strength full well; as allies, nothing could hearten me more.
rows.re: I have seen your strength full / well. As allies, nothing could / hearten me more.
rows.speaker: knight

rows.en: @Oh well, don't worry about those Odessa fellows, as our knights will slaughter them.
rows.jp: 「〜まあいい、オデッサなる敵 / 我ら同胞団が守ってみせるから / 大<89d3>に守ったつもりでいたまえ

rows.speaker: pompous knight

rows.en: @...The King of Meria Boule would not send such a person as an envoy.
rows.jp: 「〜〜メリアブール王も / なにもこのような者たちを / 使者として遣わすこともなかろうに<b:8a74>ちゃんがメリアブールからの / 使者だって？
rows.lit: ...That the King of Meria Boule would send such people as envoys, honestly.
rows.re: ...That the King of Meria Boule / would send such people as envoys, / honestly.
