rows.jp: 「それも、ついさっきまで / 確かにこの場で人が生還していたという / 『ぬくもり』が〜
rows.speaker: SKIPPED - no content box in decode

rows.en: @I am a member of |Cocytus,| Odessa's special forces team. You don't need to know that, though.
rows.jp: 「オデッサ結戦隊『コキュートス』がひとり / ジュデッカ〜 / 見知る必要は無いけどね<b:8ac8>ちゃんだ
rows.lit: One of Odessa's special forces "Cocytus," Judecca; not that you need to know it.
rows.re: One of Odessa's special forces / |Cocytus|, Judecca; not that you / need to know it.
rows.speaker: Judecca

rows.en: @I cannot grant your wish, for if I were to fight you myself I might accidentally kill you.
rows.jp: 「だけど、ご要命には応えられないな / 俺が相手だと / キミたちを倒しかねないからね
rows.speaker: SKIPPED - no content box in decode

rows.en: @None of your techniques will have any effect on it.
rows.jp: 「キミたちの攻撃など / これっぽっちも / 利いちゃいないよ〜
rows.speaker: SKIPPED - no content box in decode

rows.en: @Well, enough chit-chat for now. It's time for you all to take a little nap...
rows.jp: 「さて、茶番は終りだ / キミたちには / そろそろ、お休んねしてもらおうかな
rows.speaker: SKIPPED - no content box in decode

rows.en: @Something's coming...
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>何か来るぞッ！届く話 / （いいのか〜 / このままでいいのか〜）届く話 / （[81]
rows.lit: Something's coming!
rows.re: Something's coming!
rows.speaker: Judecca

rows.en: @Aaaahhhh!
rows.jp: 「[14]おおおおおおおおおおおおおッ！
rows.speaker: SKIPPED - no content box in decode

rows.en: @Trask was blown away... And with only one blast from that light!
rows.jp: 「タ、タラスクが / あの剣輝に〜 / 一撃のもとに吹き飛ばされるなんて〜<b:8acd><b:8ace>もバカにできないが〜
rows.lit: T-Trask, blown away by that sword-light... in a single blow...
rows.re: T-Trask, blown away by that / sword-light... in a single / blow...
rows.speaker: party

rows.en: @But still, it looks like I can still capture them as originally planned...
rows.jp: 「とりあえずは期定通り / こいつらを / 捕らえることができそうだな剣輝〜 / この俺が、ゾっとしてしまうなんて〜
rows.lit: For now, it seems I can capture them as planned.
rows.re: For now, it seems I can capture / them as planned.
rows.speaker: Cocytus soldier

rows.en: @The cost is Gella per guest, and with guests, Gella in all. Is that OK?2
rows.jp: 「おひとり方につき一緒[02]ギャラ / [02]人方ですので、[02]ギャラとなります / よろしいですか？[18]か
rows.lit: It's {2} Gella per person; for {2} of you that's {2} Gella. Is that all right?
rows.re: It's {2} Gella per person; for {2} / of you that's {2} Gella. Is that / all right?
rows.speaker: inn keeper

rows.en: *Do you want to read it?2
rows.jp: ＊進みますか？[18]か<b:8b5c><b:8b5c>
rows.lit: Do you want to proceed?
rows.re: Do you want to proceed?
rows.speaker: examine prompt

rows.en: @Unfortunately, this service is unavailable in the Demo Version.
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>でも、今回の体験版では / 残念ながら使用することができません
rows.lit: But in this trial version, it unfortunately cannot be used.
rows.re: But in this trial version, it / unfortunately cannot be used.
rows.speaker: system: demo notice

rows.en: *Unfortunately, this service is unavailable in the Demo Version.
rows.jp: ＊〜ですが、今回の体験版では / 残念ながら使用することができません
rows.lit: ...however, in this trial version it unfortunately cannot be used.
rows.re: ...however, in this trial version, / it unfortunately cannot be used.
rows.speaker: system: demo notice

rows.en: @Let's look around the village a little bit more and see if anything stirs up memories.
rows.jp: 「もうしばらく国の中をまわって / この国にいた頃の / 渡録の手がかりを探してみよう
rows.lit: Let's go around the village a while longer and look for clues to the records from when he lived here.
rows.re: Let's look around the village a / while longer for clues to his / time here.
rows.speaker: party

rows.en: @That way, each |Pillar| doesn't have to do as much work.
rows.jp: 「その方が、一本の『鍵』に / かかる右<8847>が少なくなるからな
rows.lit: That way, the burden falling on a single "Key" is lessened.
rows.re: That way, the burden falling on a / single |Key| is lessened.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @If I too had the |Pillar| talent, then I could help save Filgaia...
rows.jp: 「私にも / 『鍵』の乗があれば / 置にファルガイアを発えていけたのにな〜民は / 資質の大小こそ異なれど / 誰もが『鍵』の後継者であるという
rows.lit: If I too had the gift of the "Key," I could have helped uphold Filgaia.
rows.re: If I too had the gift of the / |Key|, I could have helped uphold / Filgaia.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @My talent is nothing compared to that of 3, but I want to contribute in some way too ...
rows.jp: 「私では[05]がの乗に遠く<b:8a3b>ばぬが / 置に世界を発えることができたなら〜
rows.lit: My gift falls far short of {3}'s, but if only I could help uphold the world alongside him...
rows.re: My gift falls far short of {3}'s, / but if only I could help uphold / the world with him...
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @I would like to take some of the weight off of 3's small shoulders and put it on my own.
rows.jp: 「[05]がの<8a12>い<b:8a3c>から / 少しでも重圧を / 取り<b:8a3d>いてやれるのにな志で決めた未来を / 私も信じてみよう
rows.lit: I could take even a little of the weight from {3}'s small shoulders.
rows.re: I could take even a little of the / weight from {3}'s small / shoulders.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @The people of Baskar support the |Pillars,| which in turn support the world.
rows.jp: 「バスカーは『鍵』を発え / 『鍵』に発えられる世界に生きる民だからな祭壇にて / 何を信じ、これからどう<b:8a42>いていくのか / 私にはわからない〜
rows.lit: The Baskar are a people who uphold the "Key," living in a world upheld by the "Key."
rows.re: The Baskar are a people who / uphold the |Key|, in a world the / |Key| upholds.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @But I will submit to whatever fate the |Pillars| decide. That is the way of the people of Baskar.
rows.jp: 「だが、それが『鍵』の決めたことならば / 私は運命を置にしようと思う / それもまた、バスカーの生き方〜食われる』〜 / これほどまでに / <8865>搭的なモノであったとは〜血が<b:8a45>み取られる』〜 / [0a]ががお前たちに / 伝えたいと言っていた言葉だ
rows.lit: But if that is what the "Key" has decided, I will accept my fate; that too is the Baskar way.
rows.re: But if that is what the |Key| has / decided, I accept my fate. That / too is the Baskar way.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @Since you are a |Pillar| too, maybe you can glean something if you ask him their meaning yourself.
rows.jp: 「[0a]がに<8865>搭誓うがいい / 『鍵』たる身のお前ならば / 何かがつかめるかもしれない〜継ぐ資質を持つ者
rows.lit: Ask {3} yourself; being a "Key" yourself, you may grasp something of it.
rows.re: Ask {3} yourself. Being a |Key| / yourself, you may grasp something / of it.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @{3} has sensed something, and wants to tell you all something.
rows.jp: 「その[0a]がが / 何かを信じ取り / あなた方に伝えたいことがあると〜悲[0b]
rows.lit: {3} has sensed something, and has something he wants to tell you all.
rows.re: {3} has sensed something, and has / something he wants to tell you / all.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @Have you not yet sensed the terror this planet feels at being gnawed away?
rows.jp: 「この星を<b:8a46>む未知なる脅威を / お前はまだ / 信じ取っていないのか？
rows.lit: Have you still not sensed the unknown threat gnawing at this planet?
rows.re: Have you still not sensed the / unknown threat gnawing at this / planet?
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @We live alongside the Guardians, which means living also with the life-force of this planet.
rows.jp: 「我らはガーディアンと置に在り〜 / すなわち / 星の命と置に在るのだ
rows.lit: We dwell alongside the Guardians; that is, alongside the life of the planet itself.
rows.re: We dwell alongside the Guardians. / That is, alongside the life of / the planet itself.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @3, you should know that what was prophesied in the dream is ignored only at your peril!
rows.jp: 「ならばこそ、[05]がよ / 夢見の告げし、その街<b:8a48>〜 / 無視できぬこと理解できるだろう<b:8a49>が / 夢見の告げし脅威であるとは / 未だ言い切れない〜
rows.lit: All the more then, {3}: you must see the dream's telling cannot be ignored.
rows.re: All the more then, {3}. You must / see the dream's telling cannot be / ignored.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @But... Something momentous is definitely about to happen in Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「だが<f040><f042> / 何かが確実に / ファルガイアに起ころうとしているのだ<b:8a4a><b:8a4b>無くして / 大きな目的が果たせるのだろうか？
rows.lit: But something is surely about to happen to Filgaia.
rows.re: But something is surely about to / happen to Filgaia.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @We of Baskar must turn our hearts to stone in order to save Filgaia. It is the only choice.
rows.jp: 「我らバスカーは / ファルガイアの未来を<b:8a4c>い / あえて心を<b:8a4d>とせねばならないのだ<b:8a4e><b:8a4f>で / 女の家みたいね、[05]が〜
rows.lit: We Baskar, for Filgaia's future, must deliberately turn our hearts to stone.
rows.re: We Baskar, for Filgaia's future, / must deliberately turn our hearts / to stone.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @I feel ashamed for making you responsible for all of Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「そんな、あなたひとりに / ファルガイアのすべてを / 押しつけていた自分が<b:8a51>ずかしいわ
rows.lit: I'm ashamed of myself for pushing all of Filgaia onto you alone.
rows.re: I'm ashamed of myself for pushing / all of Filgaia onto you alone.
rows.speaker: village woman

rows.en: @I've finally realized that any one person trying to save the world by themselves is pure folly.
rows.jp: 「やっと気づいたの / 世界はひとりで守ろうとするから / つらくて、たいへんなのよ
rows.lit: I finally realized: trying to protect the world alone is what makes it so painful and hard.
rows.re: I finally realized. Trying to / protect the world alone is what / makes it so hard.
rows.speaker: village woman

rows.en: @If everyone protects just a little piece of it, then your burden will be lessened.
rows.jp: 「みんなで少しずつファルガイアを守れば / あなたひとりに / すべてを押しつけることなんて無かったのよ押しつけてしまうことで / 私たちは誰よりも / 現実から遠ざかっていたのかもしれません
rows.lit: If everyone protected Filgaia a little at a time, we'd never have had to push it all onto you alone.
rows.re: If everyone guarded Filgaia a / little at a time, we'd never have / pushed it all on you.
rows.speaker: village woman

rows.en: @The reality being that we must fight together as well as live together.
rows.jp: 「いっしょに戦い / そして、生きていくという / 現実から〜<b:8a53>〜 / 死ぬのは怖いのよ
rows.lit: From the reality that we fight together, and live on together...
rows.re: From the reality that we fight / together, and live on together...
rows.speaker: village woman

rows.en: @That's why we tried to leave everything up to the |Pillars.|
rows.jp: 「だから、『鍵』に / すべてを<b:8a55>そうとしたの
rows.lit: That's why we tried to entrust everything to the "Key."
rows.re: That's why we tried to entrust / everything to the |Key|.
rows.speaker: village woman

rows.en: @But because of that, something inside of us has died.
rows.jp: 「でもね、そうすることで / 人間として大切な心が死んでいったわ / その<b:8a56>みが、今はとてもつらい〜祭壇は / <b:8a57>険なるウラルトゥの谷間に / 人目を<b:8a58>けて建てられているわ
rows.lit: But in doing so, the heart that matters most in a person died away; that pain is very hard now.
rows.re: But in doing so, the heart that / matters most in us died away. / That pain is hard now.
rows.speaker: village woman

rows.en: @There, those who control the hearts of men, the Guardian Lords, the avatars of the
rows.jp: 「そこでは / ガーディアンが<b:8a59>りし幻意<b:8a5a>体『ガイア』と / そして<f040><f042>
rows.lit: There, the avatar "Gaia" that the Guardians left behind, and...
rows.re: There, the avatar |Gaia| that the / Guardians left behind, and...
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @Guardian Lord, wait for the arrival of the |Pillar| ...
rows.jp: 「人の心を<b:8a5b>る / ガーディアンロードたちが / 『鍵』の<b:8a5c>着を待っていると〜<b:8a5d>かとなってしまった / 星の命『マナ』〜
rows.lit: ...the Guardian Lords who watch over human hearts await the "Key"'s arrival.
rows.re: ...the Guardian Lords who watch / over human hearts await the / |Key|'s arrival.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @If the life-energy that makes the planet alive is used for the wrong purposes...
rows.jp: 「星を輝かせる / 大いなる生命のエネルギーが / もしも、悪用されたなら〜
rows.lit: If the great life energy that makes the planet shine were ever turned to ill use...
rows.re: If the great life energy that / makes the planet shine were / turned to ill use...
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @...it would threaten all of us as well as harm the life force itself.
rows.jp: 「それは、大きな脅威であると同時に / 星の命が<b:8a5f>しく傷つけられてしまうことに / 他ならないのです<b:8a61>になられましたか？
rows.lit: That is at once a great threat and nothing less than a grievous wound to the planet's life.
rows.re: That is at once a great threat / and a grievous wound to the / planet's life.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @We must husband dearly the forest's remaining beauty, just as we must Filgaia's remaining |Mana.|
rows.jp: 「わずかに残る山の<b:8a62>しさ〜 / 私たちはファルガイアに残る『マナ』を / 大切にしなければいけません<b:8a63>び<88f1>しく<b:8a64>やすには / あなたの命が必要なのよ
rows.lit: The little beauty the mountains keep: we must treasure the Mana left in Filgaia.
rows.re: The little beauty the mountains / keep. We must treasure the Mana / left in Filgaia.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @We can use your life to help the Guardians reclaim their power, which they'll use to save Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「あなたの命を得ることで / ガーディアンは力を取り戻して / きっと世界を救ってくださるわ
rows.lit: By receiving your life, the Guardians will regain their power and surely save the world.
rows.re: By receiving your life, the / Guardians will regain their power / and surely save the world.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @The Guardian's waning power may very well seal the doom of all Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「ガーディアンの力が<b:8a65>えるということは / ファルガイアの命運が<b:8a66>きると / 言い<8864>えることができるのです傷ついてほしくはありません / もちろん、倒れてほしくもありません
rows.lit: To say the Guardians' power wanes is to say Filgaia's fate runs out.
rows.re: To say the Guardians' power wanes / is to say Filgaia's fate runs / out.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @You must now face the Sacrificial Altar and open yourself to the will of the stone Guardians.
rows.jp: 「あなたには / 谷と合したガーディアンの意志と置に / 生け左の祭壇に向かってもらわなくては〜
rows.lit: You must go to the Sacrificial Altar, together with the Guardians' will made stone.
rows.re: You must go to the Sacrificial / Altar, with the Guardians' will / made stone.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @...but I am more interested in the unseen threat of the sky being gnawed away.
rows.jp: 「ですが、私は〜 / 『空が食われる』という / 未だ目に<b:8a67>らない脅威が気になります
rows.lit: And yet the unseen threat, "the sky being devoured," troubles me more.
rows.re: And yet the unseen threat, the / sky being devoured, troubles me / more.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @...you all are our only hope. The fate of Filgaia rests with you.
rows.jp: 「私たちがすがるのは / あなたしかいないのよ / わかってちょうだい
rows.lit: You are the only one we can cling to; please understand.
rows.re: You are the only one we can cling / to. Please understand.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @Now...as the |Pillar,| please face the Sacrificial Altar.
rows.jp: 「そして〜 / 『鍵』として / 生け左の祭壇に立ってちょうだい〜
rows.lit: And so, as the "Key," please stand at the Sacrificial Altar.
rows.re: And so, as the |Key|, please / stand at the Sacrificial Altar.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @But we of Baskar are doing more than anybody else to secure Filgaia's fate.
rows.jp: 「でも、私たちバスカーは / 他の誰よりも / ファルガイアの未来を<b:8a68>じているわ
rows.lit: But we Baskar believe in Filgaia's future more than anyone.
rows.re: But we Baskar believe in / Filgaia's future more than / anyone.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @We only expect to be reviled for our actions.
rows.jp: 「だから、どんなにそしりをうけようと / 信念はできているわ母さんにそっくりだわ
rows.lit: So however we may be reviled, our resolve is set.
rows.re: So however we may be reviled, our / resolve is set.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @Kind of a waste on a boy...
rows.jp: 「剣の家にしておくの / もったいないわ
rows.lit: Keeping it in a swordsman's house; what a waste.
rows.re: Keeping it in a swordsman's / house. What a waste.
rows.speaker: village woman

rows.en: @You have inherited much from Sabrina, it seems.
rows.jp: 「やっぱり、あなた / サブリナの血を招いているのね〜
rows.lit: You really do carry Sabrina's blood after all, don't you?
rows.re: You really do carry Sabrina's / blood after all, don't you?
rows.speaker: village woman

rows.en: @Indeed, it is crucial to secure the future of Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「ファルガイアの未来を / 発えるために / 無くてはならない命なんです
rows.lit: It is a life we cannot do without, for the sake of upholding Filgaia's future.
rows.re: It is a life we cannot do / without, for the sake of / Filgaia's future.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @Please look to his training.
rows.jp: 「試練の道中 / よろしくお願いします
rows.lit: Please look after him on the road of trials.
rows.re: Please look after him on the road / of trials.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @It is your fate to shoulder the destiny of Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「ファルガイアを発えるべき / 運命を<89a3>右いし者である〜
rows.lit: He is the one who bears the fate of upholding Filgaia.
rows.re: He is the one who bears the fate / of upholding Filgaia.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @The people of Baskar will support you, so we may fight together.
rows.jp: 「ならば、バスカーの民は / お前を発える『鍵』となろう / そうすれば、いっしょに戦えるじゃろう<b:8a6b>えて / もっと大きな可能性を / 身につけようとしている
rows.lit: Then the Baskar people shall become the "Key" that upholds you; that way we can fight together.
rows.re: Then the Baskar shall become the / |Key| that upholds you. That way / we fight together.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @3 might be able to help us out of this dangerous period.
rows.jp: 「[05]がならば / この脅威を<b:8a6c>けられるかもしれぬ
rows.lit: {3} may be able to turn this threat aside.
rows.re: {3} may be able to turn this / threat aside.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @It might be possible to escape the sad fate of a |Pillar.|
rows.jp: 「悲しき『鍵』の運命を / <b:8a6e>り<b:8a6b>えて行けるかもしれぬ〜<b:8a6f>れし者は / 運命を受け入れるがいい〜
rows.lit: He may be able to overcome the sad fate of the "Key."
rows.re: He may be able to overcome the / sad fate of the |Key|.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @But if you think you have the power to overcome destiny, then there's no reason not to try.
rows.jp: 「だが、運命を切り開く力を / その<b:8a71>に、まだ込められるのならば / <b:8a72>ってみるのも悪くないかもしれぬ〜
rows.lit: But if that hand can still hold the power to carve open fate, it may not be bad to defy it.
rows.re: But if that hand can still hold / the power to carve open fate, / defying it may not be bad.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @That's what I think when I look at you.
rows.jp: 「お前たちを見ていると / そんな<89f9>にも思えてきよる夢見の告げし / ビジョンが現実のものとなって / ファルガイアを<b:8a73>わんとしておる〜
rows.lit: Watching you all, I begin to think it might be so.
rows.re: Watching you all, I begin to / think it might be so.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @The place for a |Pillar| is in front of the Sacrificial Altar.
rows.jp: 「『鍵』の立つべきは、生け左の祭壇〜
rows.lit: Where the "Key" must stand is the Sacrificial Altar.
rows.re: Where the |Key| must stand is the / Sacrificial Altar.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @The time has come for the |Pillar| to save the world at a Sacrificial Altar in the mountains of Urartu.
rows.jp: 「遠く、ウラルトゥの谷地にあるという / 生け左の祭壇にて / 『鍵』が世界を発える時が来たようじゃ守りし意志ある力〜 / それをガーディアンと呼ぶのは知っておろう
rows.lit: At the Sacrificial Altar far in the Urartu mountains, it seems the time has come for the "Key" to uphold the world.
rows.re: At the Sacrificial Altar far in / the Urartu mountains, the |Key|'s / time has come.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @Do you know what we call that which used to be Guardian but is no more?
rows.jp: 「では、かつてはガーディアン / またはガーディアンの一部であったものを / 何と呼ぶか知っておるかの？
rows.lit: Then do you know what we call that which was once a Guardian, or a part of one?
rows.re: Then do you know what we call / that which was once a Guardian, / or a part of one?
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @|Disaster.| Those with the will and the power to destroy Filgaia we call |Disaster.|
rows.jp: 「『<b:8a74><b:8a75>』（ディザスター）〜 / ファルガイアを破滅せんとする / 意志ある力を『<b:8a74><b:8a75>』と呼ぶのじゃ<b:8a76>の山<b:8a77>が広がっておる
rows.lit: "Disaster": a willed power that would destroy Filgaia is what we call "Disaster."
rows.re: |Disaster|. A willed power that / would destroy Filgaia is what we / call |Disaster|.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @It is a land ripe with |Mana.| Indeed, there are few places like it left in Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「ファルガイアでも年少ない / 星の命『マナ』の<b:8a78>かな<b:8a79>地じゃからな<b:8a7a>の<b:8a74><b:8a75>』よりファルガイアを守るため / ガーディアンの力はひとつに集められ / 幻意<b:8a5a>体を生み出したのじゃ
rows.lit: It is one of the few lands left in Filgaia still rich with the planet's life, Mana.
rows.re: It is one of the few lands left / in Filgaia still rich with Mana.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @It's name was |Gaia,| and it was a protector of the earth swathed in holy light.
rows.jp: 「その名は『ガイア』〜 / まばゆき輝に<b:8a7b>まれた / 守護者となるはずであったが〜<b:8a7c>地に / かつて、ガーディアンを<8958>じていた / <b:8a7d><b:8a7e>の名残があるそうですじゃ
rows.lit: Its name was "Gaia"; it was to be a protector wrapped in dazzling light, but...
rows.re: Its name was |Gaia|, meant to be / a protector wrapped in dazzling / light, but...
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @Please gather the Mediums from these fallen Sanctuaries.
rows.jp: 「<b:8a7f>ちてしまった<b:8a80><b:8a81>より / ミーディアムを集めてくだされ
rows.lit: Please gather the Mediums from the fallen sanctuaries.
rows.re: Please gather the Mediums from / the fallen sanctuaries.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @The stone Mediums, which contain the embodied will of the Guardians, will lead us to a brighter future.
rows.jp: 「ガーディアンの意志が / 谷となりしミーディアムは / きっと未来へ導いてくれましょう捧げられし『鍵』の命は / ガーディアンの力を解き放ち / 大いなる脅威を<b:8a6c>けるという
rows.lit: The Mediums, the Guardians' will made stone, will surely guide us to the future.
rows.re: The Mediums, the Guardians' will / made stone, will surely guide us / to the future.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @Do not falter, 3, for neither the planet nor its people could survive an error on our part.
rows.jp: 「政わないでおくれ[05]が〜 / 人も、この星も / これ以上傷つくのは<b:8a84>えられないんじゃよ<b:8a7a>の<b:8a74><b:8a75>』によって / 封印されたと聞いておる
rows.lit: Do not falter, {3}; neither people nor this planet can bear to be wounded further.
rows.re: Do not falter, {3}. Neither / people nor this planet can bear / more wounds.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @And it was none other than this |Blaze of Disaster| that deprived the planet of its life-force.
rows.jp: 「ファルガイアから / 星の命を奪っていったのは / 他ならぬ『<b:8a7a>の<b:8a74><b:8a75>』なんじゃよ
rows.lit: What stole the planet's life from Filgaia was none other than the "Blaze of Disaster."
rows.re: What stole the planet's life from / Filgaia was none other than the / |Blaze of Disaster|.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @Please release the power of the Guardians! You are a good child, are you not?
rows.jp: 「封じられしガーディアンの力を / ここに解放しておくれ〜 / お前は<89ab>しい家なんじゃろう〜？悲しき運命〜 / 誰かが発えねばならない / 世界の運命そのものなんだよ〜
rows.lit: Release the sealed power of the Guardians here; you are a kind child, are you not?
rows.re: Release the sealed power of the / Guardians here. You are a kind / child, are you not?
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @The hearts of the four lost great Guardians still beat in this village.
rows.jp: 「失われし<88d1>大のガーディアンの / <89e2><b:8a87>と意志が / この里には、残っているんだよ<b:8a88>の地
rows.lit: The hearts and wills of the four lost great Guardians still remain in this village.
rows.re: The hearts and wills of the four / lost great Guardians still remain / in this village.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @The Hidden Village of Baskar exists apart from the tawdry ways of the rest of the world.
rows.jp: 「<b:8a89>世とは離れて<b:8a8a>らす / バスカーの隠れ里ですじゃ<b:8a8b>が<b:8a8c>れようとしている〜
rows.lit: This is the hidden village of the Baskar, living apart from the outside world.
rows.re: This is the hidden village of the / Baskar, living apart from the / outside world.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @But just as you all have not given in to it, neither have I...
rows.jp: 「じゃが、お前たちが / すべてをあきらめてないように / わしもまだ、あきらめてはおらぬ
rows.lit: But just as you all have not given up on everything, neither have I given up yet.
rows.re: But just as you all have not / given up, neither have I given up / yet.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @I too desire to protect Filgaia. Let us forge from this desire blades to battle with!
rows.jp: 「わしとて、ファルガイアを護りたい〜 / 護りたいという心を<b:8a8d>に変えて / いっしょに戦いたいのじゃ<b:8a8e>えられしマナの力は / 大いなる力を<b:8a8f>けてくれるじゃろう
rows.lit: I too wish to protect Filgaia; to turn that wish into a blade and fight beside you.
rows.re: I too wish to protect Filgaia. To / turn that wish into a blade and / fight beside you.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @It does not come free, though. The strain on Filgaia will be equally great.
rows.jp: 「じゃが、その反動は / 小さいものではなく / ファルガイアに大きく右<8847>をかける
rows.lit: But the backlash is no small thing; it weighs heavily on Filgaia.
rows.re: But the backlash is no small / thing. It weighs heavily on / Filgaia.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @There will be no second chance. The future of Filgaia rests on our success.
rows.jp: 「チャンスは一度きり〜 / この一戦が / ファルガイアの未来を決めるのじゃ祭壇へ向かうことは / 運命の<b:8a90>の中に定められていたこと〜
rows.lit: There is but one chance; this single battle decides Filgaia's future.
rows.re: There is but one chance. This / single battle decides Filgaia's / future.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @If this is your fate, though... who knows, sometimes it is possible to cheat even fate...
rows.jp: 「じゃが、これが運命ならば〜 / 運命ならば、受け入れるだけではなく / <b:8a6e>り<b:8a6b>えることもできるかもしれない〜祭壇はその名の通り / 『鍵』をガーディアンに捧げし<b:8a80><b:8a81>〜
rows.lit: But if this is fate, then fate may be not only accepted, but overcome.
rows.re: But if this is fate, then fate / may be not only accepted, but / overcome.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @There 3 will free the power of the Guardians and cause the advent of the avatar, |Gaia.|
rows.jp: 「[05]がはそこで / ガーディアンの力を解き放ち / 幻意<b:8a5a>体『ガイア』を降<b:8a91>させねばならぬ
rows.lit: There {3} must release the Guardians' power and call down the avatar "Gaia."
rows.re: There {3} must release the / Guardians' power and call down / the avatar |Gaia|.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @This is the cruel fate to which 3 was born...
rows.jp: 「この時のために / [05]がと、<b:8a92>まわしきさだめは / 今回まで生きてきたのだ〜
rows.lit: For this moment, {3} and his accursed fate have lived until today.
rows.re: For this moment, {3} and his / accursed fate have lived until / today.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @The |Mana| stolen from Filgaia is focused in the 1sky far to the west of here0.
rows.jp: 「ファルガイアより奪われし『マナ』は / ここより[11]お<8995>か東の空[11]ぉに集重しておる
rows.lit: The Mana stolen from Filgaia gathers in the sky far east of here.
rows.re: The Mana stolen from Filgaia / gathers in the sky |far east of / here|.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @It is the duty of a |Pillar| to protect Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「ファルガイアを守りしは / 『鍵』が<89a3>右ったさだめ〜
rows.lit: To protect Filgaia is the fate the "Key" bears.
rows.re: To protect Filgaia is the fate / the |Key| bears.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @In the sky there awaits the battle you are fated to fight.
rows.jp: 「彼の空にて / お前の戦うべき運命が待っておる〜食われつつあるのじゃ〜
rows.lit: In yonder sky waits the fate you must fight.
rows.re: In yonder sky waits the fate you / must fight.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @There is a black tower sticking up like a fang out of the 1forest to the SE of here0.
rows.jp: 「[11]お先側の山[11]ぉに突き立てられた / 高くそびえる暗い<897f>〜 / それはまるで<b:8a93>血の<b:8a94>のごとく〜<b:8a7a>の<b:8a74><b:8a75>』も元はガーディアンの一部〜 / <b:8a95>のさだめより外れしモノ〜
rows.lit: A dark tower thrust high out of the mountains yonder, like a fang of clotted blood.
rows.re: A dark tower thrust high from / the |mountains yonder|, like a / fang of clotted blood.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @All will occur as foreordained by the Wheel of Fate.
rows.jp: 「すべては / 運命の<b:8a90>の中にあって / 正しくあるのじゃ
rows.lit: All things stand right within the wheel of fate.
rows.re: All things stand right within / the wheel of fate.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @3, you must accept your fate, not rebel against it.
rows.jp: 「[05]がよ〜 / 運命に<b:8a72>うことなく / すべてを受け入れるがよい
rows.lit: {3}, do not defy fate; accept all of it.
rows.re: {3}, do not defy fate. Accept all / of it.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @It is the fate of |Pillars| to die and then live forever within Filgaia itself.
rows.jp: 「『鍵』は死して / ファルガイアに<b:8a96><89aa>に / 生きるがさだめ〜<b:8a7c>地には / まだミーディアムが残されているはずじゃ
rows.lit: The "Key"'s fate is to die, and live forever within Filgaia.
rows.re: The |Key|'s fate is to die, and / live forever within Filgaia.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @They are the petrified consciousness of Guardians, sealed away by the |Blaze of Disaster.|
rows.jp: 「『<b:8a7a>の<b:8a74><b:8a75>』によって封印されし / ガーディアンの意<b:8a5a>の合谷 / <f040><f042>ミーディアム〜
rows.lit: The crystallized consciousness of Guardians sealed by the "Blaze of Disaster": the Mediums.
rows.re: The crystallized minds of / Guardians sealed by the |Blaze of / Disaster|: the Mediums.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @They will lead Filgaia to its future just as they will lead the |Pillar| to the Sacrificial Altar.
rows.jp: 「その力は、ファルガイアに未来を<b:8a97>き / 『鍵』を生け左の祭壇へと導くであろう〜
rows.lit: Their power will open a future for Filgaia and guide the "Key" to the Sacrificial Altar.
rows.re: Their power will open Filgaia's / future and guide the |Key| to the / Sacrificial Altar.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @But it is not equal to that of the |Blaze of Disaster,| or that which gnaws away the sky even now...
rows.jp: 「だが、やがて人の手に<b:8a98>る / <b:8a99>の脅威が、空を食らいつつ<b:8a8c>れるはず / かつての『<b:8a7a>の<b:8a74><b:8a75>』に<b:8a9a>相するような〜捧げたくはない
rows.lit: But a true threat beyond human hands will come devouring the sky, one to rival the old "Blaze of Disaster."
rows.re: But a true threat beyond human / hands will come devouring the / sky, to rival the old |Blaze|.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @But as the leader of Baskar, I cannot let personal feelings get in the way.
rows.jp: 「だが、バスカーの民を<b:8a9b>いる者として / 私情をはさむことは許されぬ
rows.lit: But as one who leads the Baskar people, I am not permitted personal feelings.
rows.re: But as one who leads the Baskar / people, I am not permitted / personal feelings.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @Our way must always be one of submission to the Guardians.
rows.jp: 「我らはガーディアンの意志を / 伝え、実<b:8a9d>する者ゆえに〜許してくれたのか〜？
rows.lit: For we are those who convey and carry out the Guardians' will.
rows.re: For we are those who convey and / carry out the Guardians' will.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @Can you really be so strong as to forgive me?
rows.jp: 「私を許すほどに / お前は強い心を持っているのか？許してくれた〜
rows.lit: Do you have a heart strong enough to forgive me?
rows.re: Do you have a heart strong enough / to forgive me?
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @But Sabrina... I don't think she will ever be able to...
rows.jp: 「だが、サブリナは〜 / <b:8a9e>は、こんな私を / やっぱり許してはくれぬのだろうな〜
rows.lit: But Sabrina... she would never forgive me for this after all, would she?
rows.re: But Sabrina... she would never / forgive me for this after all, / would she?
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @...but one bright enough to illuminate our future!
rows.jp: 「じゃが、確実に未来を<b:8a9f>らす / 確かな輝なのじゃよ来を<b:8a9f>らす小さな輝が / かき消されぬよう導いてくだされ〜<b:8aa0><b:8aa1>は / 『鍵』の命、ひとつに発えられるのではない
rows.lit: And yet it is a sure light that will brighten the future.
rows.re: And yet it is a sure light that / will brighten the future.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @But maybe... ...maybe such a fate is not one person's to bear alone.
rows.jp: 「そうだ〜 / 運命はひとりで<89a3>右うのではない / <b:8aa2>で<89a3>右えば、重さも<b:8aa3>くなっていく
rows.lit: Yes: fate is not borne alone; borne by all, its weight grows lighter.
rows.re: Yes. Fate is not borne alone. / Borne by all, its weight grows / lighter.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @...If everyone aided, then perhaps Filgaia could be saved without requiring a sacrifice.
rows.jp: 「生きる命すべてならば / <b:8a4a><b:8a4b>なくしてファルガイアを / <89a3>右っていけるかもしれぬ〜
rows.lit: If all living lives bear it, Filgaia may be upheld without any sacrifice.
rows.re: If all living lives bear it, / Filgaia may be upheld without any / sacrifice.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @I wonder why such a simple idea never occurred to us before...
rows.jp: 「どうして / このような<b:8aa4><b:8aa5>な道理に / 今まで気がつかなかったのか〜食い<b:8a66>くされていく
rows.lit: Why did we never notice so simple a truth until now?
rows.re: Why did we never notice so simple / a truth until now?
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @Could something have happened in the source of all life, |Glaive Le Gable?|
rows.jp: 「よもや、すべての命の始<8869>〜 / 『グラブ・ル・ガブル』に / 何かがあったということではないか〜？<b:8aa6><b:8aa7>とされ / ガーディアンの<b:8a80><b:8a81>があった
rows.lit: Could something have happened to "Glaive Le Gable," the wellspring of all life?
rows.re: Could something have happened to / |Glaive Le Gable|, the wellspring / of all life?
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @But the Guardians' power was sealed by the |Blaze of Disaster,| and the sanctuary desecrated.
rows.jp: 「だが、『<b:8a7a>の<b:8a74><b:8a75>』によって / ガーディアンの力は封印されてしまい / <b:8a80><b:8a81>は<b:8aa8>され、<b:8a7f>ちてしまったという〜
rows.lit: But by the "Blaze of Disaster" the Guardians' power was sealed, and the sanctuary defiled and fallen.
rows.re: But by the |Blaze of Disaster| / the Guardians' power was sealed, / the sanctuary defiled.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @The desecrated sanctuary has become a Sacrificial Altar that awaits the |Pillar.|
rows.jp: 「<b:8a7f>ちた<b:8a80><b:8a81>は / 『鍵』を待つ、生け左の祭壇となり / 今に至っているのだ<b:8a98><88e0>は / 人やファルガイアを / 傷つけるだけではない
rows.lit: The fallen sanctuary became the Sacrificial Altar that awaits the "Key," and so it remains.
rows.re: The fallen sanctuary became the / Sacrificial Altar awaiting the / |Key|, and so it remains.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @What is truly horrible is the negative energy created by battle.
rows.jp: 「<b:8a99>に恐ろしきは / 戦いが生み出す右のエネルギー〜
rows.lit: What is truly fearsome is the negative energy that battle brings forth.
rows.re: What is truly fearsome is the / negative energy that battle / brings forth.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @The negative energy that fed the |Blaze of Disaster| is now about to engulf Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「かつて、『<b:8a7a>の<b:8a74><b:8a75>』に無<b:8aa9>の力を<b:8aaa>えし / 右のエネルギーは今〜 / ファルガイアにに<b:8aab><b:8aac>しつつあるのだ<b:8aad>るうということは / 同時に、どこかに同<b:8aae>の反動を / <b:8aaa>えているということだ
rows.lit: The negative energy that once fed the "Blaze of Disaster" boundless power now swells over Filgaia.
rows.re: The negative energy that once fed / the |Blaze of Disaster| now / swells over Filgaia.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @So remember that even a just war will inevitably harm Filgaia...
rows.jp: 「正義を守る戦いによって / ファルガイアが傷ついているという事実を / 忘れないでほしい〜念が決まらぬのなら / 今すぐ命を捧げよとは / もう言わぬ〜
rows.lit: Do not forget the fact that even a battle to defend justice wounds Filgaia.
rows.re: Do not forget: even a battle to / defend justice wounds Filgaia.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @Go see the state Filgaia is in with your own eyes.
rows.jp: 「ファルガイアの<b:8a7c>地をまわり / その目に世界の<b:8aaf>状を<b:8a67>してこい
rows.lit: Go around Filgaia's lands and see the world's plight with your own eyes.
rows.re: Go around Filgaia's lands and see / the world's plight with your own / eyes.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @After that, you might view your place in the world a little differently.
rows.jp: 「部る後〜 / お前は自分の命について / もう一度考えるがいい<b:8ab0>い命を<b:8a4a><b:8a4b>にして / <b:8aa0>気でいられるほど / 心が強いわけではない
rows.lit: Afterward, you would do well to think once more on your own life.
rows.re: Afterward, you would do well to / think once more on your own life.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @Therefore, they have silenced their hearts...
rows.jp: 「ゆえに、心を<b:8ab1>すのだ〜
rows.lit: Therefore, they still their hearts.
rows.re: Therefore, they still their / hearts.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @They have silenced their hearts so that small sadnesses do not override greater ones.
rows.jp: 「大きな目的を果たすため / 小さき事に心動かされぬよう / 心を<b:8ab1>しているのだ食い<b:8a66>くされぬように / 最<b:8ab2>の手<b:8ab3>を<b:8ab4>めているのだ
rows.lit: To fulfill a great purpose, they still their hearts, that small things may not sway them.
rows.re: To fulfill a great purpose, they / still their hearts, that small / things not sway them.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @We are prepared to accept any cost to secure success.
rows.jp: 「そのために / 人としての道を外れることは / すでに信念の上である夢見は『夢』として受取ったのか〜？
rows.lit: To that end, straying from the human path is a resolve we have already made.
rows.re: To that end, straying from the / human path is a resolve we have / already made.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @No, I am sure that there is an even yet greater, deeper threat.
rows.jp: 「いや、もっと大きな脅威が / 願く、<b:8ab5>かに進行しているに違いない<b:8b0b><b:8b06>「過<b:8ab6>はどうであれ / お前は<b:8ab7>んで / 『鍵』となることを受け入れたのだ
rows.lit: No, a still greater threat must be advancing, deep and unseen.
rows.re: No, a still greater threat must / be advancing, deep and unseen.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @You cannot give up your destiny now. Do not try to go back.
rows.jp: 「もう、後戻りはできぬ〜 / あきらめるのだ<b:8b06>「そうだ〜 / タウンメリアにて[05]がを / <88a7><88a8>しようとしたのは我々だ
rows.lit: There is no turning back now; give it up.
rows.re: There is no turning back now. / Give it up.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @We had been looking for Sabrina, who ran away from us, and her son, 3, for over 10 years.
rows.jp: 「出<b:8ab8>したサブリナと / その血を受け継ぐ[05]がを / １０数に渡って追っていたのだ
rows.lit: We pursued the runaway Sabrina and {3}, heir to her blood, for over ten years.
rows.re: We pursued the runaway Sabrina / and {3}, heir to her blood, for / over ten years.
rows.speaker: elder

rows.en: @Now if you only agree to become |Pillar| after your mother, I will be able to die a happy man.
rows.jp: 「あとはお前が / 『鍵』を受け継いでくれれば / もう、何も<b:8a4c>うことはない<b:8ab9>達なのか〜
rows.lit: Now if you would only inherit the "Key," I would want for nothing more.
rows.re: Now if you would only inherit the / |Key|, I would want for nothing / more.
rows.speaker: elder

rows.en: @Doesn't 3 know that a |Pillar| has no need for friends?
rows.jp: 「『鍵』には / <b:8ab9>達など、必要ないというのに〜捧げて世界を救えば / ファルガイアの『<b:8aba><b:8abb>』になれるんだぞッ！
rows.lit: And yet a "Key" has no need of friends...
rows.re: And yet a |Key| has no need of / friends...
rows.speaker: elder

rows.en: @Don't you want to be a |Hero?|
rows.jp: 「お前は『<b:8aba><b:8abb>』に / なりたくはないのかッ！<b:8abc>は / わずかに命を<b:8abd>すのみである
rows.lit: Do you not wish to become a "hero"?!
rows.re: Do you not wish to become a / |hero|?!
rows.speaker: elder

rows.en: @...but if lots of |Mana| is gathered, then a planet may be formed.
rows.jp: 「だが、たくさんのマナが集まれば / ひとつの大きな星となる〜
rows.lit: But when much Mana gathers, it becomes one great star.
rows.re: But when much Mana gathers, it / becomes one great star.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @Isn't that the like our wish to save our own planet?
rows.jp: 「それは、星を救いたいという / 我らの想いとも同じではなかろうか？
rows.lit: Is that not the same as our own wish to save the planet?
rows.re: Is that not the same as our own / wish to save the planet?
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @If each person - if each fragment - united and became one, then that might equal a planet...
rows.jp: 「ひとりひとりは、小さな欠<b:8abc>でも / ひとつになれば / 星を発える力<f040><f042>
rows.lit: Each alone is a small fragment, but made one, a power to uphold the planet...
rows.re: Each alone is a small fragment, / but made one, a power to uphold / the planet...
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @Would it be enough to substitute for life of the |Pillar?|
rows.jp: 「そう、<b:8abe>しき『鍵』に代れるような / 大きな力になりえないだろうか？<b:8abf>っている
rows.lit: Yes: could it not become a power great enough to replace the sorrowful "Key"?
rows.re: Yes. Could it not become a power / great enough to replace the / sorrowful |Key|?
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @The Ralines converge on four places called the Raypoints, where there's enough Mana to form a planet.
rows.jp: 「レイラインの行きつく場所 / <88d1>つのレイポイントには星を面作るほどの / マナが<b:8a8e>えられているという〜
rows.lit: Where the Ley Lines converge, the four Raypoints are said to hold Mana enough to form a planet.
rows.re: Where the Ley Lines converge, the / four Raypoints hold Mana enough / to form a planet.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @It is said that one Raypoint lies 1far to the SW of this village, on the ocean...0
rows.jp: 「[11]お里の<8995>か先東の<b:8ac0>上[11]ぉには / レイポイントのひとつがあると / 伝えられているが〜
rows.lit: One Raypoint is said to lie on the sea far southeast of the village.
rows.re: One Raypoint is said to lie on / the sea |far southeast of the / village|.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @But it cannot be found from a boat!
rows.jp: 「それは、<89d3>の上からでは / 見つからないとも聞いているぞ祭壇に向かう / 決心がついたみたいだな〜
rows.lit: And I hear it can't be found from the deck of a boat.
rows.re: And I hear it can't be found from / the deck of a boat.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @It's hard not to give up all hope when you look up and see the sky being eaten away...
rows.jp: 「この、食われてしまった空を見上げれば / あきらめてしまうのも / 無理はない〜
rows.lit: Looking up at this devoured sky, it's no wonder some give up.
rows.re: Looking up at this devoured sky, / it's no wonder some give up.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @1Southeast of the village,0 a large amount of |Mana| has been lost all at once.
rows.jp: 「そう、[11]お里の先側[11]ぉより / 急<88f1>に『マナ』が失われているのだ
rows.lit: Yes: from beyond the village, Mana is being lost at a sudden, terrible rate.
rows.re: Yes. |Beyond the village|, Mana / is being lost at a sudden, / terrible rate.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @If this is a part of Odessa's plot, then they must be stopped before the planet withers away!
rows.jp: 「これがオデッサのしわざならば / すぐにでも食い止めないと / ファルガイアは<b:8ac1>からびてしまいかねん<b:8ac2><b:8ac3>が〜 / ファルガイアの生命エネルギーが / 急<88f1>に<b:8ac4>少しているのです
rows.lit: If this is Odessa's doing, it must be stopped at once, or Filgaia may wither dry.
rows.re: If this is Odessa's doing, it / must be stopped at once, or / Filgaia may wither dry.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @If it's Odessa, don't they know that they're damaging the planet that they hope to rule!?
rows.jp: 「それがオデッサのしわざならば / 自分たちが発配を<b:8ab7>む世界そのものが / 傷ついていることに、なぜ気づかないッ！<b:8ac5>をすませば<b:8ac6>こえるはず / そう、ファルガイアの悲<b:8ac7>が〜
rows.lit: If it is Odessa's doing, why don't they see they're wounding the very world they hope to rule?!
rows.re: If it is Odessa's doing, why / can't they see they wound the / very world they'd rule?!
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @You are the only one who can respond this cry for help. Do not falter.
rows.jp: 「キミの命ひとつで / この悲<b:8ac7>を救うことができるのだ / 政わないでほしい〜<b:8ac8><b:8ac9>されてしまいかねない
rows.lit: With your one life, this tragedy can be redeemed; please do not falter.
rows.re: With your one life, this tragedy / can be redeemed. Please do not / falter.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @The enemy we can't see is our own weak hearts as well as that which eats away the very sky...
rows.jp: 「見えざる相とは、<b:8aca>の弱い心〜 / そして、来るべき脅威 / 空を食らい、未来閉ざす『何か』〜<b:8acb>び<b:8acc>ってこようとしている〜
rows.lit: The unseen foe is our own weak hearts, and the coming threat: the "something" that devours the sky and closes the future.
rows.re: The unseen foe is our own weak / hearts, and the coming threat / that devours the sky.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @If we look far into the future, we can see that our true enemy isn't Odessa. Don't you see?
rows.jp: 「遠く未来を見<b:8acd>えてると / 我々の相は、オデッサではない〜 / それは、キミも同じ事だよ<b:8ace>を脅かしている
rows.lit: Looking far into the future, our enemy is not Odessa; and the same is true for you.
rows.re: Looking far into the future, our / enemy is not Odessa. The same is / true for you.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @But are they a great enough menace to threaten the sky? Enough to require 3's life?
rows.jp: 「だが『空が食われる』と表現されたほどの〜 / [05]がの命を必要とするほどの / 脅威といえようか〜導く運命に / <8911>っていただけなのだ
rows.lit: But is it a threat so great as "the sky being devoured," so great as to require {3}'s life?
rows.re: But is it a threat so great as / the devoured sky, so great as to / require {3}'s life?
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @That is what we must think. That is the only thing we must think.
rows.jp: 「そう考えるのだ〜 / それ以上を考えないようにするのだ来る脅威を前にして / 『鍵』の後継者たる / キミが里に戻ってくるとは〜
rows.lit: That is what we think; and we make ourselves think no further.
rows.re: That is what we think. And we / make ourselves think no further.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @...is surely the work of the Guardians!
rows.jp: 「これもすべて / ガーディアンのお導きに違いない〜来を<88cc>えるに / 無くてはならない存在〜
rows.lit: All of this must surely be the Guardians' guidance.
rows.re: All of this must surely be the / Guardians' guidance.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @Please help convince 3 to become the next |Pillar.|
rows.jp: 「どうか、[05]がに / 『鍵』を継がせてやってほしい
rows.lit: Please, help {3} inherit the "Key."
rows.re: Please, help {3} inherit the / |Key|.
rows.speaker: elder

rows.en: @The |Pillar| had companions to help it live through battles normal mortals couldn't have.
rows.jp: 「『鍵』を発える<b:8acf>間がいたから / 人知を<b:8a6b>える / 戦いを<b:8a6e>り<b:8a6b>えてこれたのです
rows.lit: Because the "Key" had companions to uphold it, battles beyond human knowing could be overcome.
rows.re: Because the |Key| had companions / to uphold it, battles beyond / knowing could be overcome.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @Which means that we, too, should come to the aid of the |Pillar.|
rows.jp: 「ならば、私たちも / 『鍵』を発える力となりましょう〜
rows.lit: Then let us too become strength that upholds the "Key."
rows.re: Then let us too become strength / that upholds the |Key|.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @If we all join our strength, then we may be able to save the world without using the |Pillar's| life.
rows.jp: 「<b:8aa2>で力を合わせることで / 『鍵』の命を<b:8a64>やさずとも / 世界を発えていられるように〜
rows.lit: By joining all our strength, may the world be upheld without spending the "Key"'s life.
rows.re: By joining all our strength, may / the world be upheld without / spending the |Key|'s life.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @But that doesn't mean they are all on the ground...
rows.jp: 「でも、そのすべてが / 地上にあるとは<b:8aa9>らないのです
rows.lit: But not all of them are necessarily on the ground.
rows.re: But not all of them are / necessarily on the ground.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @There is a tale of a shrine containing much wind |Mana| that floats on the sea of winds.
rows.jp: 「<89f9>の道には / <89f9>の『マナ』が<b:8a8e>えられし<b:8a7d><b:8a7e>が / たゆたっていると伝えられています勇気』と『<b:8ad1><b:8ab7>』〜 / それは人が誰も持っている / もっとも強い心の輝き〜
rows.lit: On the sea of wind, they say, drifts a shrine holding the wind's Mana.
rows.re: On the sea of wind, they say, / drifts a shrine holding the / wind's Mana.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @Wait...maybe I should say |shined.|
rows.jp: 「いいえ、持っていたと / 言うべきでしょうか〜
rows.lit: No; perhaps I should say it once held them.
rows.re: No. Perhaps I should say it once / held them.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @Those things have disappeared from our hearts, and are disappearing from Filgaia as well.
rows.jp: 「いつしか人の心から輝きは失われ / そして今、ファルガイアから / 輝きが失われようとしています
rows.lit: At some point the light left people's hearts; and now the light is leaving Filgaia itself.
rows.re: The light left people's hearts / long ago. Now the light is / leaving Filgaia itself.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @Raftina of |Love,| Justine of |Courage,| and Zephyr of |Hope.|
rows.jp: 「『愛』のラフティーナ / 『勇気』のジャスティーン / 『<b:8ad1><b:8ab7>』のゼファー〜
rows.lit: Raftina of "Love," Justine of "Courage," Zephyr of "Hope."
rows.re: Raftina of |Love|, Justine of / |Courage|, Zephyr of |Hope|.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @I'm sure the Guardian Lords would do something about this encroachment if they could.
rows.jp: 「ガーディアンロードならば / この空の異世事態を / 何とかしてくれるのでしょうか？<b:8a8b>が<b:8a8c>れたような空〜 / 『鍵』で発えていないと / このまま落ちてきそうな空〜<b:8ad2>々しき<897f>が<b:8ad3>を現して以来 / 大地の輝きが急<8a04>に失われているのです
rows.lit: Could the Guardian Lords do something about this sky's calamity, I wonder?
rows.re: Could the Guardian Lords do / something about this sky's / calamity, I wonder?
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @Maybe that tower is what is depriving the planet of its |Mana.|
rows.jp: 「おそらくは / あの<897f>が、星のエネルギー『マナ』を / 奪っているからでしょう〜<b:8a91>むことがあります
rows.lit: Most likely it is because that tower is stealing the planet's Mana.
rows.re: Most likely it is because that / tower is stealing the planet's / Mana.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @For some reason, the tower just FEELS evil. It looks like a fang sunk into the flesh of the earth.
rows.jp: 「あれは何と<b:8ad2>々しい<897f>でしょうか〜 / まるで大地に突き立てられた / ケモノの<b:8a94>のようです夢見が視（み）たビジョン〜 / 『空が食われる』とは、何とあいまいで / それでいて生々しい表現なのでしょう〜
rows.lit: What a baleful tower that is, like a beast's fang driven into the earth.
rows.re: What a baleful tower that is, / like a beast's fang driven into / the earth.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @Your duty is to protect our planet from that fate.
rows.jp: 「あなたの役<8913>は / そのような未来から / この星を守ることなのですよ食われる』とは / いったいどういうことなのでしょうか？
rows.lit: Your role is to protect this planet from such a future.
rows.re: Your role is to protect this / planet from such a future.
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @Is the old prophesy of |Disaster| coming back to destroy Filgaia at last come to pass?
rows.jp: 「古の伝<b:8ad4>にあるように / 『<b:8a74><b:8a75>』（ディザスター）が / <b:8a63>びファルガイアを<b:8ad5><b:8ad6>するのでしょうか？怖がらないで〜 / あなたは、今あるカタチを脱ぎ<b:8ad7>てて / 未来そのものに生まれ変わるの〜
rows.lit: As in the old prophecy, will "Disaster" once again lay Filgaia to ruin?
rows.re: As in the old prophecy, will / |Disaster| once again lay Filgaia / to ruin?
rows.speaker: villager

rows.en: @You can have the power to protect those you love, and who love you, if you want it...
rows.jp: 「あなたは、あなたの<b:8ad8>きなヒトを〜 / あなたを<b:8ad8>きと言ってくれるヒトを / 守り抜ける力を手にすることができるのよ守ってあげてください / あの家は、ここで死してはいけないのです
rows.lit: You can gain the power to protect the ones you love, and the ones who say they love you.
rows.re: You can gain the power to protect / the ones you love, and the ones / who love you.
rows.speaker: village woman

rows.en: @Those born in Baskar must either accept the fate of the |Pillar| or throw away their own heart.
rows.jp: 「バスカーとして生まれし者は / 『鍵』の運命を<89a3>右うか / 人の心を<b:8ad9>てるしかないのよ〜
rows.lit: One born Baskar must either bear the fate of the "Key," or cast away their human heart.
rows.re: One born Baskar must either bear / the fate of the |Key|, or cast / away their human heart.
rows.speaker: village woman

rows.en: @It's because they feel guilty for making you shoulder the weight of the whole world by yourself.
rows.jp: 「誰も、[05]がひとりに / 世界の命運を<89a3>右わすことに / 後ろめたいものを信じているからなのよ
rows.lit: It's because everyone feels the guilt of laying the world's fate on {3} alone.
rows.re: It's because everyone feels the / guilt of laying the world's fate / on {3} alone.
rows.speaker: village woman

rows.en: @Everyone in this village loves you, as does all life in Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「お前は、この里の人間に〜 / そして、ファルガイアに生きる / すべての命に愛されているんだよ
rows.lit: You are loved by the people of this village, and by every life that lives on Filgaia.
rows.re: You are loved by the people of / this village, and by every life / on Filgaia.
rows.speaker: village woman

rows.en: @Never forget that.
rows.jp: 「そのことを / 忘れないでおくれよ〜血は / <b:8ada>えることはないんだよ〜
rows.lit: Please never forget that.
rows.re: Please never forget that.
rows.speaker: village woman

rows.en: @It will always continue on. It is the very future of Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「いつまでも、いつまでも〜 / ファルガイアの未来となって / 残っていくんだよ食らわんとする脅威は / 今や世界の中心に<b:8a5c>達しようとしておる
rows.lit: Forever and ever, it will remain, becoming Filgaia's future.
rows.re: Forever and ever, it will remain, / becoming Filgaia's future.
rows.speaker: village woman

rows.en: @In the center of the world lies the Guardian of mud, which is the genesis of all life on Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「ファルガイアの中心には / すべての始りとなった / 泥のガーディアンが<b:8adc>たわるという〜
rows.lit: At Filgaia's center, they say, lies the Guardian of mud from which all things began.
rows.re: At Filgaia's center, they say, / lies the Guardian of mud from / which all things began.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @If this Guardian of mud, Glaive Le Gable, is devoured, then all life on Filgaia will truly end.
rows.jp: 「泥のガーディアン『グラブ・ル・ガブル』が / 食われし時こそ / <b:8a99>にファルガイアの命が<b:8ada>たれる時なのじゃ<b:8add><89f9>となって / ファルガイアに<b:8a87>き<b:8ade>れておる
rows.lit: When the mud Guardian "Glaive Le Gable" is devoured, that is when Filgaia's life is truly severed.
rows.re: When the mud Guardian |Glaive Le / Gable| is devoured, Filgaia's / life is truly severed.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @But not even this storm is enough to clear the clouds that threaten both Filgaia's sky and its future.
rows.jp: 「だが、ファルガイアの空と未来を閉ざす / この暗<b:8adf>を<b:8ae0>うこと、<b:8add><89f9>にはかなわず〜
rows.lit: But to sweep away this darkness that closes Filgaia's sky and future is beyond even the storm.
rows.re: But to sweep away this darkness / that closes Filgaia's sky is / beyond even the storm.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @Force of arms will not be enough to protect that which we must protect.
rows.jp: 「力ではない〜 / 力だけでは、本当に大切なモノは / 守れないのじゃ〜夢として視（み）た / ビジョンそのままの空〜
rows.lit: Not power; power alone cannot protect what truly matters.
rows.re: Not power. Power alone cannot / protect what truly matters.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @The Guardians have shown me what the future holds more clearly than any dream ever could.
rows.jp: 「ガーディアンたちは / 暗示する夢などではなく / 来たるべき未来を<b:8ae1>えてくれたのですじゃ夢見として乗を / 開<b:8ae2>させようとしておる
rows.lit: The Guardians showed us not some hinting dream, but the future that is to come.
rows.re: The Guardians showed us not some / hinting dream, but the future / that is to come.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @The dream that both of us saw, of the blood of Filgaia being drained away - what could that mean?
rows.jp: 「あの家と私が視（み）た夢〜 / 『ファルガイアの血が<b:8a45>み取られる』とは / いったい何を意<b:8ae3>するのであろうか？
rows.lit: The dream that child and I both saw: "Filgaia's blood being drained"; what could it mean?
rows.re: The dream that child and I both / saw, Filgaia's blood being / drained, what could it mean?
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @The blood of Filgaia- that must mean the |Mana.|
rows.jp: 「ファルガイアの血〜 / それは、星の生命エネルギー〜 / 『マナ』を指しているのではあるまいか？夢に / 『ファルガイアの血が<b:8a45>み取られる』と / 視（み）えたのじゃ〜
rows.lit: Filgaia's blood: does it not point to the planet's life energy, the Mana?
rows.re: Filgaia's blood. Does it not / point to the planet's life / energy, the |Mana|?
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @What that could mean, as well as the black, evil tower, we have yet to discern...
rows.jp: 「これが意<b:8ae3>するもの〜 / そして、その時いっしょに視えた / 暗く、<b:8ad2>々しい<897f>の起は、いったい〜血<b:8ae4>のようなものじゃ
rows.lit: What this means, and the dark, baleful tower we saw at the same time, what are they?
rows.re: What this means, and the dark, / baleful tower we saw with it, / what are they?
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @Obtaining it could mean possessing great power, but...
rows.jp: 「手にすれば強力なエネルギーを / モノにすることとなろう / じゃが、しかし〜
rows.lit: To seize it would be to command mighty energy; and yet...
rows.re: To seize it would be to command / mighty energy. And yet...
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @...it is so dangerous that any error could also lead to the death of Filgaia itself!
rows.jp: 「まかりまちがえば / ファルガイアの死に至るやもしれぬ / 危険なモノじゃて〜
rows.lit: One misstep and it could bring Filgaia's death; a dangerous thing it is.
rows.re: One misstep and it could bring / Filgaia's death. A dangerous / thing it is.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @That means they wouldn't hesitate to steal the life-force of the planet, |Mana.|
rows.jp: 「いずれヤツらは / 星の生命エネルギー『マナ』にまで / 手を出すのやもしれぬな〜
rows.lit: In time they may reach even for the planet's life energy, the Mana.
rows.re: In time they may reach even for / the planet's life energy, the / |Mana|.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @This will happen as you also come into your own as a |Pillar,| until one day your destiny leads you...
rows.jp: 「それは、同時に『鍵』としての乗を / みがいていることでもあるのだ
rows.lit: That is, at the same time, the polishing of your gift as the "Key."
rows.re: That is, at the same time, the / polishing of your gift as the / |Key|.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @... inevitably to the Sacrificial Altar, where you will realize your true purpose in this life.
rows.jp: 「やがて導かれるじゃろう / 生け左の祭壇にて / その命を<b:8a64>やし<b:8a66>くすその時まで〜夢に視（み）たビジョン〜 / 『空が食われる』とは / オデッサを指しておるのじゃろうか？
rows.lit: In time you will be led to the Sacrificial Altar, until the moment you spend your life utterly.
rows.re: In time you will be led to the / Sacrificial Altar, until you / spend your life utterly.
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @I don't think so... I have the feeling it is something at once bigger and more vague...
rows.jp: 「そうは思えぬ〜 / もっと、<88bf>大であいまいな / 脅威としかいい表せぬナニかではあるまいか捧げられることで / ファルガイアの未来は〜 / すべての命は守られるのじゃ
rows.lit: I think not; is it not something vaster and more shapeless, describable only as a threat?
rows.re: I think not. Is it not something / vaster, more shapeless, only / describable as a threat?
rows.speaker: chief

rows.en: @Thus you will not truly be ending your life...you will live on eternally in ALL life hereafter!
rows.jp: 「お前は命を<b:8ad9>てるのではない / そう、未来に<b:8ae5>げるのじゃ〜 / カタチを変えて、<b:8a96>遠に生きるのじゃ〜<b:8a4a><b:8a4b>によって / さらなる生を受けておるのじゃ

rows.lit: He must be shouldering something enormous all alone, as he always does.

rows.jp: 「だが、研行はいつもひとりで<b:8aef><b:8af0>していた〜 / まるで他者を<b:8af1><b:8af2>するような / <b:8af3><b:8aaa>気だったとおぼえている<b:8af4>みこまれる』と / 言っていたんだが〜

rows.re: But he always researched alone. I / remember an air about him that / shut others out.
rows.speaker: observatory keeper

rows.lit: Watching the lost sky, he spoke almost as if he'd been expecting this day.
rows.re: Watching the lost sky, he spoke / almost as if he'd been expecting / this day.
rows.speaker: observatory keeper

rows.re: Tell him: don't try to solve / everything alone.
rows.speaker: observatory keeper

rows.lit: Around him there are always companions who act alongside him.
rows.re: Around him there are always / companions who act alongside him.
rows.speaker: observatory keeper

rows.jp: 「なのに、中心のあいつが / 気づいていないだけなんだ<b:8ad4>表<b:8a5a>を<b:8af8>めた後 / メリアブールに戻っているんだ

rows.re: And yet the man himself is the / only one who hasn't noticed.
rows.speaker: observatory keeper

rows.re: He didn't form ARMS on a whim, / nor, of course, merely because of / Odessa.
