rows.jp: 「<b:8a4e>備しなおすだけで / 戦術に<b:8a4f>ができるんだから / <b:8a50>利なもんだよな<b:8a51><b:8a52>の<b:8a53><b:8a54>は知らねぇが / こう見えても、僕は<b:8a55>同あがりなんだ

rows.speaker: soldier

rows.re: Where in the world are they all / coming from?
rows.speaker: soldier

rows.jp: 「僕なんて、生まれてこのかた / そんなメンドーなモンは / 一度たりともできたこたぁねぇよッ！

rows.re: Me, my whole life long I've never / once managed anything so / troublesome!
rows.speaker: soldier

rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>で、おめぇはどうなのよ？<b:8a65>部隊ってことらしいな
rows.lit: So, what about you?
rows.re: So, what about you?
rows.speaker: soldier

rows.en: @In other words, we're being assigned to the most dangerous front.
rows.jp: 「つまりは / 一番危険な戦場に配備されるってことだ
rows.lit: In short, it means we're being posted to the most dangerous battlefield.
rows.re: In short, it means we're being / posted to the most dangerous / battlefield.
rows.speaker: soldier

rows.en: @I wonder how many of us will still be alive 6 months from now.
rows.jp: 「さあて、<89a7>数後までに / 何人生き残っていることやら〜<b:8a66>人の<b:8a53><b:8a54>は / 重要視されていないんだ〜

rows.re: Well, I wonder how many of us / will still be alive six months / from now.
rows.speaker: soldier

rows.speaker: soldier

rows.lit: The soldiers picked for here come from all over the place.
rows.re: The soldiers picked for here come / from all over the place.
rows.speaker: soldier

rows.en: @They're more interested in your skills than your nationality.
rows.jp: 「結定の<b:8a43><b:8a4c>にとらわれることなく / <b:8a6e>動することを強調しているからな<b:8a6e><b:8a6f>に<b:8a70>待しています / がんばってください<b:8a4a>しています / 単にワタシが緊<b:8a4a>する必要は / これっぽっちも無いんですけどね

rows.re: They stress acting free of any / fixed nationality.
rows.speaker: soldier

rows.en: *Since then, the lineage of the <Sword Magess> is seen as the lineage of a |hero.|
rows.jp: ＊これにより、＜<b:8a3b>の少女＞の血筋を / 『勇者』の血筋を見なす / <89f9><89fc>が高まっていくことになる
rows.lit: Thereafter, the belief grew that the <Sword Magess>'s line was the line of the "hero."
rows.re: Thereafter grew the belief that / the <Sword Magess>'s line was the / line of the |hero|.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *But no one on the planet is directly descended from the <Sword Magess>.
rows.jp: ＊しかし、＜<b:8a3b>の少女＞自身の / 血を招きし者は / この世には存在しない
rows.lit: Yet no one in this world carries the <Sword Magess>'s own direct blood.
rows.re: Yet no one in this world carries / the <Sword Magess>'s own direct / blood.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *The family line was carried on, but the blood got diluted and the |hero's| ancestors spread.
rows.jp: ＊<b:8a4c>としての血筋を招く者は多く / 血は<b:8a79>れ、年多の『勇者』の家<b:8a7a>を / 地に<b:8a7b>れさせた
rows.lit: Many carried on the family line, the blood thinning and scattering many "hero" houses across the land.
rows.re: Many carried on the line, the / blood thinning and scattering / many |hero| houses across the land.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *How much value is placed on |blood?| The <Sword Magess> herself said blood doesn't make a |hero.|
rows.jp: ＊『血』にいかほどの<b:8a7c><8875>があろうか / ＜<b:8a3b>の少女＞自身がそれを物<b:8a7d>っている / 血によって『勇者』は為らず勇者と災厄勇者』は / 戦うべき『災厄』がありて / 『勇者』たりえる
rows.lit: What worth is there in "blood"? The <Sword Magess> herself proves it: blood does not make a "hero."
rows.re: What worth is in |blood|? The / <Sword Magess> herself proves it: / blood does not make a |hero|.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *The reverse is also true. When a |hero| appears, |disaster| follows. They are 2 sides of the same coin.
rows.jp: ＊その<89c1>も部り / 『勇者』現れるるとき、『災厄』あり / 『勇者』と『災厄』は表<b:8a80>一体
rows.lit: The reverse holds too: where a "hero" appears, "disaster" is; hero and disaster are two sides of one body.
rows.re: The reverse holds too: where a / |hero| appears, |disaster| is. / They are two sides of one coin.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *A |hero| isn't born. It's something you know as a result of actions.
rows.jp: ＊『勇者』は生まれついてのものでなし / 何を為したかによってあるものと知れ<b:8a60><8860><b:8a81>の魔神を事<b:8a83>の彼方へ封<b:8a84>し / 力尽きた＜<b:8a3b>の少女＞は / アガートラームを大地に刺す
rows.lit: Know that a "hero" is not born, but is made by what he does.
rows.re: Know that a |hero| is not born, / but is made by what he does.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *Many knights and heroes have vied for the Argetlahm, but all have failed.
rows.jp: ＊<b:8a87>多の<b:8a88>胞、<b:8a89>者が / アガートラームを手にすべく<897b>み / ことごとく<b:8a8a>わず

rows.re: Countless knights and heroes / strove to take up the Argetlahm, / and every one failed.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *Even blood relatives of the <Sword Magess> couldn't retake the sword.
rows.jp: ＊＜<b:8a3b>の少女＞の血筋のものですら / 抜くことは不可能であった
rows.lit: Even those of the <Sword Magess>'s own line found it impossible to draw.
rows.re: Even those of the <Sword / Magess>'s own line found it / impossible to draw.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *The Argetlahm thrust into stone acts as if it rejects all but the <Sword Magess>.
rows.jp: ＊大地に刺さりしアガートラームは / ＜<b:8a3b>の少女＞以外を<b:8a8b>むかのように / 大地に<b:8a8c>む
rows.lit: The Argetlahm thrust into the earth clings to it, as if refusing all but the <Sword Magess>.
rows.re: The Argetlahm thrust into the / earth clings there, refusing all / but the <Sword Magess>.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *The cathedral of the <Sword Magess> had the pedestal enshrined. Even the stone itself was removed.
rows.jp: ＊＜<b:8a3b>の少女＞を<b:8a8d>りし大少<b:8a8e>に安置すべく / <b:8a60><8860>となりし<b:8a8f><89cd>ごと / 大地より切り取られることになった少地への<b:8a90>礼<b:8a3b>の大少<b:8a8e>のある地は / ＜<b:8a3b>の少女＞の少地とされている
rows.lit: To enshrine it in the great cathedral of the <Sword Magess>, the pedestal-stone itself was cut from the earth.
rows.re: To enshrine it in the <Sword / Magess>'s cathedral, the pedestal / stone was cut from the earth.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *This is land the <Sword Magess> acquired under the direction of Argetlahm.
rows.jp: ＊＜<b:8a3b>の少女＞が / アガートラームに<b:8a91>かれて / 手にした地
rows.lit: This is the land the <Sword Magess> gained, drawn on by the Argetlahm.
rows.re: This is the land the <Sword / Magess> gained, drawn on by the / Argetlahm.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *To exorcise the disasters covering the earth, a ray of hope was directed toward us.
rows.jp: ＊世界を<b:8a92>う災厄を<b:8a93>うべく / 希望の輝が世界に向かって / 放たれた地である
rows.lit: It is the land from which a light of hope was loosed toward a world veiled in disaster.
rows.re: It is the land from which a light / of hope was loosed toward a world / veiled in disaster.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *Many worshippers visit here, where the hero who saved Earth was born.
rows.jp: ＊世界を救った『勇者』<890c>生の地として / 多くの礼<b:8a95>者たちが<b:8a96>れている
rows.lit: As the birthplace of the "hero" who saved the world, many pilgrims visit here.
rows.re: As the birthplace of the |hero| / who saved the world, many / pilgrims visit here.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *The Argetlahm is publicly displayed a few times a year for worshippers.
rows.jp: ＊礼<b:8a95>者のために、数に年度 / アガートラームが一<b:8a97><b:8a98>開される<b:8a99>げられし<b:8a9a><b:8a9b>望』に<b:8a92>われし世界に / 一筋の輝次が<b:8a9c>した / それが＜<b:8a3b>の少女＞である
rows.lit: For the pilgrims, the Argetlahm is put on public display a few times a year.
rows.re: For the pilgrims, the Argetlahm / is put on public display a few / times a year.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *Alone, the <Sword Magess> confronted the Demon. She alone shouldered the burden.
rows.jp: ＊<b:8a9d>一人、魔神と対<b:8a9e>し / ＜<b:8a3b>の少女＞は / 一人で全てを<89a3>負ったのである
rows.lit: Alone she faced the demon; the <Sword Magess> shouldered it all by herself.
rows.re: Alone she faced the demon; the / <Sword Magess> shouldered it all / by herself.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *But the <Sword Magess> wasn't able to destroy the Blazing Demon, only contain it.
rows.jp: ＊しかし、<b:8a81>の魔神を / 倒すに至らなかった＜<b:8a3b>の少女＞は / その命を以て封じた
rows.lit: But unable to destroy the Blaze demon, the <Sword Magess> sealed it away with her own life.
rows.re: But unable to destroy the Blaze / of Disaster, the <Sword Magess> / sealed it away with her own life.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *In exchange for world peace, the <Sword Magess> was offered as a |sacrifice.|
rows.jp: ＊＜<b:8a3b>の少女＞は / 世界の平和と招き<8864>えに / <b:8a99>げられた『生け<b:8aa2>』である<b:8a81>の魔神と<b:8a3b>の少女<b:8a3b>の少女＞出現前 / 年多の<b:8a88>胞、<b:8a89>者たちが / <b:8a81>の魔神に<897b>んで消えていった
rows.lit: The <Sword Magess> was a "living sacrifice" offered in exchange for the world's peace.
rows.re: The <Sword Magess> was a |living / sacrifice| offered in exchange / for the world's peace.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *Even the weapons developed with the lost technology were a cool breeze on the Blazing Demon.
rows.jp: ＊ロストテクノロジーを以て / 作られた幻同<b:8aa3>でさえ / <b:8a81>の魔神には<b:8aa4><89f9>のごとし
rows.lit: Even the fabled weapons made with Lost Technology were like a cool breeze to the Blaze demon.
rows.re: Even the fabled weapons of Lost / Technology were like a cool / breeze to the Blaze of Disaster.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *The <Sword Magess>, armed with the Argetlahm, was the entire resistance.
rows.jp: ＊アガートラームを携えし / ＜<b:8a3b>の少女＞だけが / その対抗しうる全て
rows.lit: Only the <Sword Magess>, bearing the Argetlahm, was the whole of what could stand against it.
rows.re: Only the <Sword Magess>, bearing / the Argetlahm, could stand / against it at all.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *It is still a mystery why only the <Sword Magess> was able to battle the Blazing Demon on equal footing.
rows.jp: ＊なぜ、＜<b:8a3b>の少女＞のみが / <b:8a81>の魔神と対<b:8a52>に戦えたのか / それはいま以て<b:8aa6>とされている<b:8a83>の地平に封されし魔神<b:8a81>の魔神において / 忘れてならぬことがある
rows.lit: Why only the <Sword Magess> could fight the Blaze demon on equal terms remains a mystery to this day.
rows.re: Why only the <Sword Magess> could / fight the Blaze of Disaster as an / equal remains a mystery.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *He wasn't |destroyed| but was only |contained.|
rows.jp: ＊彼のものは / 『倒された』のではなく / 『封じられた』ことである
rows.lit: That being was not "destroyed" but only "sealed."
rows.re: That being was not |destroyed| / but only |sealed|.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *The seal will eventually be broken.
rows.jp: ＊封<b:8a84>はいずれ解き放たれる…
rows.lit: The seal will one day be undone...
rows.re: The seal will one day be / undone...
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *The Blazing Demon will crush the <Sword Magess>, then Filgaia.
rows.jp: ＊＜<b:8a3b>の少女＞亡きファルガイアは / <b:8a81>の魔神に<b:8aa7><b:8aa8>される
rows.lit: A Filgaia without the <Sword Magess> will be crushed beneath the Blaze demon.
rows.re: A Filgaia without the <Sword / Magess> will be crushed beneath / the Blaze of Disaster.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *No one knows when the seal will be broken.
rows.jp: ＊その封<b:8a84>がいつ破られるかなど / 何人もしらない
rows.lit: When that seal will break, no one knows.
rows.re: When that seal will break, no one / knows.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *Whether it will be 100 years or 1000 years or tomorrow, we have no magic to resist.
rows.jp: ＊１００数後か１０００数後 / それとも次回か / 我々に抗う術はない災厄の<8869>災厄』は負の信情を<b:8aa9>に / さらなる『災厄』を呼び込む
rows.lit: A hundred years hence, a thousand, or tomorrow; we have no means to resist.
rows.re: A hundred years hence, a / thousand, or tomorrow; we have no / means to resist.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *The spreading negativity knows no limits.
rows.jp: ＊広がる負の信情は / とどまることを知らず
rows.lit: The spreading tide of negative feeling knows no stopping.
rows.re: The spreading tide of negative / feeling knows no stopping.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *|Disasters| continue to spread without end.
rows.jp: ＊ゆえに、尽きることなく / 『災厄』は広がり続ける
rows.lit: And so, without end, "disaster" keeps on spreading.
rows.re: And so, without end, |disaster| / keeps on spreading.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *When a ray of light doesn't shine, beyond negativity is only a road to |destruction.|
rows.jp: ＊希望の輝が<b:8a9c>さぬ / 負の信情のその先には / 待つは『破滅』への道のみ
rows.lit: Where no light of hope shines, beyond the negative feeling waits only the road to "ruin."
rows.re: Where no light of hope shines, / beyond that darkness waits only / the road to |ruin|.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *Know that what strangles you in the end is your negativity.
rows.jp: ＊<b:8aaa>が<888a>を<b:8aab>めるのは / 負の信情と知れ<b:8a3b>の少女＞は / <b:8a3b>に乗れたこともなかった<b:8a75>だという
rows.lit: Know that what strangles you in the end is your own negative feeling.
rows.re: Know that what strangles you in / the end is your own negative / feeling.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *She wasn't a prominent soldier, nor a knight who'd sworn loyalty to her country. She was just a girl.
rows.jp: ＊戦いに概通した<b:8aac>指の戦胞でもない / <b:8a43>に<b:8aad><b:8aae>を<b:8aaf>った<b:8a88>胞でもない / ただの<b:8a75>、それが＜<b:8a3b>の少女＞

rows.re: Not a peerless soldier, not a / knight sworn to a nation; just a / girl. That was the <Sword Magess>.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *That the Argetlahm couldn't be retrieved only deepens the mystery.
rows.jp: ＊アガートラームが抜けぬ事実が / 『選ばれし者』の<b:8ab0>質の<b:8aa6>を願める
rows.lit: The fact that the Argetlahm cannot be drawn deepens the mystery of the "chosen one's" nature.
rows.re: The fact the Argetlahm cannot be / drawn deepens the mystery of the / |chosen one|.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *When someone who can hold the Argetlahm appears again, the mystery will be solved.
rows.jp: ＊<b:8ab1>び、アガートラームを / 手にする者が現れたとき / その<b:8aa6>も解けるだろう<b:8ab2>の世界<b:8a81>』は破滅の力… / <b:8a81>を身に<b:8ab3>いし魔神の過ぎしあと / 残るは破滅の<b:8ab4><b:8ab5>のみ
rows.lit: When once more someone appears who can take up the Argetlahm, that mystery too will be solved.
rows.re: When once more someone can take / up the Argetlahm, that mystery / too will be solved.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *Nothing lives in the dying earth.
rows.jp: ＊生きる者のいない / 死せる大地へ
rows.lit: To a dead land where no living thing remains.
rows.re: To a dead land where no living / thing remains.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *The earth is colored red by blood. Flames of the red lotus will burn everything into a world dyed red.

rows.re: The earth stained deep with / blood, crimson-lotus flames / burning all; a world dyed red.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *Not one ray of hope left in the world. What waits is |death,| the journey to the other side.

rows.re: In that world not one ray of / hope; what waits is |death|, the / journey to the far shore.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *Without |hope,| it is a dark world. People's cries echo, dark clouds circle. Souls are locked in grief.

rows.lit: Without "hope," a world of darkness; people's cries echo, dark clouds gather, and hearts are sealed in grief.
rows.re: Without |hope|, a world of dark: / cries echo, dark clouds gather, / and hearts seal shut in grief.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *The Argetlahm diverts all possible disasters.
rows.jp: ＊アガートラームは / あらゆる災厄を<b:8abf>け
rows.lit: The Argetlahm wards off every disaster.
rows.re: The Argetlahm wards off every / disaster.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *The Black Wolf Lucied shields the <Sword Magess> from all possible disasters.

rows.lit: The dark demon-wolf Lucied became the shield guarding the girl from every disaster.
rows.re: The dark demon-wolf Lucied became / the shield guarding the girl from / every disaster.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: *To watch the <Sword Magess> fight is to watch the queen of war. She gives the people a glimmer of hope.
rows.jp: ＊＜<b:8a3b>の少女＞の戦う<b:8a61> / それはまさに、戦の女神さながらに / 人々に希望の輝を与えたもうた<b:8b88>[08][10][01]
rows.lit: The <Sword Magess> in battle, like the very goddess of war, gave the people a light of hope.
rows.re: The <Sword Magess> in battle, / like the very goddess of war, / gave the people a light of hope.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.en: @Thank you very much. I'm fine now.
rows.jp: 「ありがとうございます / もう、だいじょうぶです<b:8a42>えないなんてこともあるかもし[16]おぎ[0c]れないってのにわたしったらボケっとつっ立っ / てていいのかしら？いいわけないじゃないの何 / かホラ言うことあるでしょこんな時に気の利い[16]おぎ[0c]たことくらい言えないとダメだって本に書いて / あったような無いようなって今さら思っ<f040>
rows.re: Thank you. I'm all right now.

rows.jp: [17]<b:8a43><b:8a44>が<f040><f042> / あ、あれ、何言ってるのかな、わたし〜

rows.en: @When we get back, I'd like you to show me the flowers.
rows.jp: 「帰ってきたら / お<b:8a43><b:8a44>を見せてほしいな〜
rows.re: When we're back, show me the / flowers.

rows.en: @Yes, then I'll be waiting. I'll be waiting right here for you to come back.
rows.jp: 「〜うん、じゃあ、わたし待っている / [05]がくんが帰ってくるの / ここで待っているから
rows.re: Yes. I'll wait right here for you / to return.

rows.en: @You know.
rows.jp: 「わかるのダ
rows.re: You know.

rows.en: @You can get your soul to communicate with the sleeping |Old Ruler| Guardians.
rows.jp: 「キミなら心を通わせることができるのダ / <89bb>りにつきし『<b:8a48>右配者』<f040><f042> / ガーディアンたちと、ね<b:8a45>概<b:8a46> / 「〜〜？ / そうだったのダ
rows.re: You can let your soul commune with / the sleeping |Old Ruler| Guardians.

rows.en: @You all find it inconvenient when there's no clear name for an existent being.
rows.jp: 「キミたちからすれば / 次確な存在呼<895b>が無いというのは / 不<b:8a49>なものだったのダ<b:8a45>概<b:8a46><b:8a4a>のなかでも / [0a]ぜは結単なのダ
rows.re: You find it awkward when a being / has no clear name.

rows.en: @The sense of |self| is weak. Hmm...I can't explain it well. In other words...
rows.jp: 「『<b:8a4b>』という認識が<b:8a4d><b:8a4e>〜 / う<f045>ん、うまく言えないのダ / つまり<f040><f042>
rows.re: Its sense of |self| is weak. Hmm, / hard to put it well. In other / words...

rows.en: @C is C. And at the same time, there's something else.
rows.jp: 「[0a]ぜは[0a]ぜであり / それと同時に / 単の何かでもあるというわけなのダ
rows.re: C is C. And at the same time, / something more.

rows.en: @Do you understand?
rows.jp: 「わかったかい？<b:8a45>概<b:8a46><b:8a4a>[0a]ぜ〜
rows.re: Do you follow?

rows.en: @Because the sense of |self| is weak by taking on other information matrixes, one can copy other forms.
rows.jp: 「『<b:8a4b>』という意識レベルが<b:8a4f>いために / 他の情報マトリクスを取り込むことで / その<b:8a50>、結性をコピーできるという、あの〜
rows.re: With a weak sense of |self,| it can / take on other patterns and change.

rows.en: @That one is none other than C!
rows.jp: 「人呼んで、変身<b:8a45>概<b:8a46>とは / [0a]ぜのことなのダッ！
rows.re: That one is none other than C!

rows.en: @Why was the Sub-Spirit waiting for me?
rows.jp: 「その変身<b:8a45>概<b:8a46>が / どうしてボクを待っていたんだい<b:8a51>くのが役目なのダ
rows.re: Why was the Sub-Spirit waiting for / me?

rows.en: @Come with us, 3. The Guardians want you before it's too late!
rows.jp: 「いっしょに行くのダ、[05]が / ガーディアンはキミを<b:8a52>している / すべてが手<8a0d>れにならないうちにッ！
rows.re: Come with us, {3}. The Guardians / want you, before it's too late!

rows.en: @When C's power is needed, use 1 to call him.
rows.jp: 「[0a]ぜの力が必要な時は / [0b]おで呼び出してほしいのダ
rows.re: When you need C's power, use 1 to / call him.

rows.en: @For places you can't get to, C can search it for you.
rows.jp: 「キミの手が続かない場所でも / [0a]ぜが代りに / 調べることができるのダ<b:8a53><b:8a54>させてください
rows.re: For places you can't reach, C can / scout them for you.

rows.en: @Last night, I heard from the Village Chief that I'm a Zoa Priest just like my mother.
rows.jp: 「<b:8a55>回の<b:8a56> / 里長さんに聞いたんです / ボクも、母さんと同じゾアプリーストだって
rows.re: Last night the Village Chief told / me I'm a Zoa Priest, like my / mother.

rows.en: @By defeating monsters, I'm able to extract power from the Medium I'm equipped with.
rows.jp: 「ボクがモンスターをやっつけることで / 装備しているミーディアムから / パワーを招き出せるようになるんです
rows.re: By beating monsters, I draw power / from the Medium I've equipped.

rows.en: @I want to pass the trial. I want to be strong too! So please, give me a chance.
rows.jp: 「ボクは試練を果たしたい〜 / ボクも強くなりたいんですッ！ / だから、お願いしますッ！
rows.re: I want to pass the trial. I want to / be strong too! So please, a chance.

rows.en: @I feel like I've been pierced. It feels as if all the wills here on the grounds are gathering.
rows.jp: 「〜突き動かされるような信信〜 / この試練場に<b:8a59>ちている / 意志のようなモノが集まっていくような〜
rows.re: I feel pierced through. As if every / will on these grounds is gathering.

rows.en: @Their wills turn into vibrations searching for powerful shapes. This is one of the trials too!
rows.jp: 「彼らの意志は<88e0>動となって / 力あるカタチをとろうとしている〜 / これも、ひとつの試練なのダッ！
rows.re: Their wills become tremors seeking / powerful forms. This is one trial.

rows.en: @But! Watch out. They're testing us.
rows.jp: 「〜でもッ！ / 気をつけてください / ボクたちを試そうとしていますッ！
rows.re: But watch out. They're testing us.

rows.en: @The old rulers of Filgaia, the first Guardians, had absolutely no power in the physical world.
rows.jp: 「今や、意識体を残すのみとなった / ファルガイアの<b:8a48>右配者、ガーディアンは / 自身の力では実体合することはできないのダ
rows.re: Filgaia's old rulers, the first / Guardians, had no physical power at / all.

rows.en: @Even we were attacked by it!
rows.jp: 「わたしたちまで / 攻われちゃったのよッ！
rows.re: Even we were attacked by it!

rows.en: ...not only the |Pillar| but also the strength of the knights protecting the |Pillar.|
rows.jp: 「『鍵』のみならず / 『鍵』を守る / 戦胞たちの力<886f>もいっしょに〜受けたんだ / 試練は<f040><f042>
rows.re: ...not just the |Pillar,| but the / strength of the knights guarding / it.

rows.en: @There's a voice calling to me.
rows.jp: 「ボクに / 呼びかけてくる話があります
rows.re: A voice is calling to me.

rows.en: @In order for me to become the |Pillar,| I guess I have to go even further.
rows.jp: 「ボクが『鍵』を<b:8a3b>け方ぐには / さらに、この<892a>を / めざさなくてはいけないみたいです〜
rows.re: To become the |Pillar,| I think I / have to go further still.

rows.en: @What waits on the other side is...
rows.jp: 「この向こう<89f5>に / 待ち<b:8a3b>けているのが<f040><f042>
rows.re: What waits beyond is...

rows.en: @The ability to materialize the powers of the Guardians which are now only consciousness.
rows.jp: 「意識体であるガーディアンの力を / <8a1b>現合させる能力<f040><f042>
rows.re: The power to give form to Guardians / that are now only consciousness.

rows.en: @For your trial, you must get hold of the |Combine.|
rows.jp: 「キミは『コンバイン』を / 試練の果てに / 手に入れなければいけないのダ
rows.re: For your trial, you must obtain the / |Combine.|

rows.en: @With C.
rows.jp: 「[0a]ぜといっしょにね
rows.re: With C.

rows.en: @3 and C must be together at all times.
rows.jp: 「[05]がと[0a]ぜは / ずっといっしょでなきゃダメなのダ
rows.re: {3} and C must stay together / always.

rows.en: @The Medium is the petrified version of the Guardian's information matrix.
rows.jp: 「ミーディアムは / ガーディアンの情報マトリクスが / 谷合したもの〜
rows.re: A Medium is a Guardian's / information pattern, turned to / stone.

rows.en: @For the |Combine,| it's essential to have a Medium.
rows.jp: 「『コンバイン』には / ミーディアムが必要不可欠なのダ
rows.re: For the |Combine,| a Medium is / essential.

rows.en: @So this is the other power concealed in the Medium which mom told me about.
rows.jp: 「ずっと前に母さんが言ってた / ミーディアムに<b:8a5c>められた / もうひとつの力って、これだったんだね〜
rows.re: So this is the other power in the / Medium that Mom told me of.

rows.en: @The Medium |Odoryuk| is shining again.
rows.jp: 「『オードリューク』のミーディアムが / また<b:8a5d>いている〜<b:8a5e>を<b:8a5f>けるのダ / [05]が、キミならできる〜
rows.re: The Medium |Odoryuk| is shining / again.

rows.en: @You are the |heir.|
rows.jp: 「キミは、『後方者』なのダ汝、我らが意志を力と<b:8a61>に / <8a1b>現合せしものよ〜
rows.re: You are the |heir.|

rows.en: @You, designated as |heir,| state your name.
rows.jp: 「『後方者』たりうるものよ〜 / 汝が名を我らに<b:8a62>げよ
rows.re: You, named |heir,| speak your name.

rows.en: @My name is 3 Rhymeless!
rows.jp: 「ボクの名前は / [05]が・ライムレスですッ！汝の<b:8a63>は、我らの意志となり / 汝の<b:8a64>は、我らの力となろう<b:8a63>〜？ <b:8a64>〜？ / <f040><f042>いったい、それは〜〜運命を<89a3><b:8a66>いし者よ / さあ、<b:8a67>り発えるがいいッ！
rows.re: My name is {3} Rhymeless!

rows.en: @The unending trial has awakened us!
rows.jp: 「終なる試練は / 我らを呼び信ますことにありッ！
rows.re: The unending trial has awakened us!

rows.en: @The information matrix of the Medium will let C change into a powerful shape.
rows.jp: 「キミが装備しているミーディアムの / 情報マトリクスを[0a]ぜが / カタチあるチカラに昇<b:8a68>してあげるのダ
rows.re: The Medium's pattern lets C take a / powerful form.

rows.en: @The user's force and C's ability to transform, released together, form a |Combine.|
rows.jp: 「使用者のフォースと / [0a]ぜの変身能力〜 / ひとつに放つのが『コンバイン』なのダ
rows.re: Your force and C's shifting, / released as one, form a |Combine.|

rows.en: @First take the Guardians who have offensive powers like |Grudiev|-- and equip them in the GUARD slot.
rows.jp: 「まずは、『グルジエフ』など / <b:8a69>撃能力を持つガーディアンを / ＧＵＡＲＤに装備するのダ
rows.re: First equip Guardians with attack / power, like |Grudiev.|

rows.en: @Pooka and 3 can put in motion a |Combine.| Just leap over any trial that's in the way!
rows.jp: 「プーカと[05]がのふたりで / 『コンバイン』を発動させて / 立ちはだかる試練を<b:8a6a>ね<b:8a6b>けるのダッ！<b:8a6c><b:8a6d>を受けしは / まごうこと無き『後方者』の力〜
rows.re: Pooka and {3} can trigger a / |Combine.| Leap over any trial in / your way!

rows.en: @3, you cheated death. The proof is here. Thou art the |heir.|
rows.jp: 「[05]がよ、死する運命の者よ〜 / <b:8a6e>はここにたてられた / 汝こそが『後方者』〜
rows.re: {3}, you cheated death. Here is the / proof. Thou art the |heir.|

rows.en: @By releasing us, the |Pillar| becomes an offering proffered soundly, very soundly.
rows.jp: 「我らを解き放てし、『鍵』たる身よ / 族物となりて、<b:8a62>げられし<89c2>まで / いく<b:8a6f>やかに、<b:8a6f>やかに〜
rows.re: By freeing us, the |Pillar| is / offered up, soundly, very soundly.

rows.en: @We await thy next |Pillar.|
rows.jp: 「我らは待つ〜 / 『鍵』たる身よ〜
rows.re: We await thy next |Pillar.|

rows.en: @An eclipse will fill Filgaia's sky. Thou wilt stand at the Sacrificial Altar to deter this menace.
rows.jp: 「ファルガイアの空を<b:8a70>まんとする / <b:8a71>るべき<b:8a72>の脅威を受けるため / 生け<b:8a73>の<b:8a74><b:8a75>に、汝の意志で立つことを〜納得した
rows.re: An eclipse will fill Filgaia's sky. / Thou shalt stand at the Sacrificial / Altar to stop it.

rows.en: @I actually passed the trial, didn't I?! I can't believe it.
rows.jp: 「このボクが / 試練を果たせたんですねッ！ / 〜信じられないよ〜
rows.re: I really passed the trial?! I can't / believe it.

rows.en: @Make no mistake, your power of belief guided reality. You realized |truth.|
rows.jp: 「それは、まちがいなく / キミの信じる力が<b:8a51>いた現実 / キミが成し<89d8>げた『本当』なのダ<b:8a77>みたいです
rows.re: Make no mistake: your belief shaped / reality. You reached |truth.|

rows.en: @But...
rows.re: But...

rows.en: @It's as if Pooka caught 3's excitement. I'm so excited!
rows.jp: 「まるで、[05]がのドキドキが / プーカにもうつったみたいなのダ / すごく、うれしいのダ
rows.re: It's as if Pooka caught {3}'s / excitement. I'm thrilled!

rows.en: @I want the others to feel my excitement!
rows.jp: 「みんなにも / ボクのドキドキを / 伝えてみたいんですッ！
rows.re: I want the others to feel it too!

rows.en: @We were all nervous waiting here.
rows.jp: 「待っているこっちは / ホント、ドキドキだったんだよ方者』の試練〜 / 果たせたのか〜？
rows.re: We were all on edge waiting here.

rows.en: @But it still doesn't feel real. My pounding heart is the only thing that feels different.
rows.jp: 「でも、まだ実信がわかなくて〜 / <89e5>がドキドキしていることくらいが / 変わったことくらいです<b:8a78>けるのダ
rows.re: It still doesn't feel real. Only my / pounding heart feels different.

rows.en: @Part of the power sustaining Filgaia, the Guardian's power, can be realized through Pooka.
rows.jp: 「ファルガイアを右える力の一部〜 / ガーディアンの力を / みんなとプーカで<8a1b>現合する力
rows.re: Part of the power upholding / Filgaia, the Guardians', can take / form through Pooka.

rows.en: @This is the |Combine|!
rows.jp: 「これが『コンバイン』なのダッ！
rows.re: This is the |Combine|!

rows.en: @It's a joint effort which, using our force, allows Pooka to duplicate the Guardian's shape and abilities.
rows.jp: 「フォースを使って / プーカが、ガーディアンの<b:8a50>と能力を / コピーする合体ワザなのダ
rows.re: A joint effort: with our force, / Pooka copies a Guardian's shape.

rows.en: @So, we need to remember that this trick can be used only when Pooka's with us.
rows.jp: 「だから、プーカが / いっしょにいない時には / 使えないことも気をつけてほしいのダ納得した
rows.re: So remember, this trick works only / when Pooka's with us.

rows.en: *Do you want to read it?2
rows.jp: ＊進みますか？[18]か
rows.lit: Do you want to proceed?
rows.re: Do you want to proceed?
rows.speaker: examine prompt

rows.en: @Unfortunately, this service is unavailable in the Demo Version.
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>でも、今回の体験版では / 残念ながら使用することができません
rows.lit: But in this trial version, it unfortunately cannot be used.
rows.re: But in this trial version, it / unfortunately cannot be used.
rows.speaker: system: demo notice

rows.en: *Unfortunately, this service is unavailable in the Demo Version.
rows.jp: ＊〜ですが、今回の体験版では / 残念ながら使用することができません
rows.lit: ...however, in this trial version it unfortunately cannot be used.
rows.re: ...however, in this trial version, / it unfortunately cannot be used.
rows.speaker: system: demo notice

rows.en: >Now for the next mission-- You have two tasks.
rows.jp: ＞さて、ミッションの説次だ / 貴様らに<b:8a41>えられた任務はふたつある
rows.lit: Now for the mission briefing; you've been given two tasks.
rows.re: Now for the mission briefing; / you've been given two tasks.
rows.speaker: radio

rows.en: >One is to silence the enemy's Flying Machine Varukisas. The other is...
rows.jp: ＞ひとつは、相性飛空機艇バルキサスの<898f><8990> / もうひとつは<f040><f042>
rows.lit: One: silence the enemy flying machine Varukisas. The other...
rows.re: One: silence the enemy flying / machine Varukisas. The other...
rows.speaker: radio

rows.en: >...for all of you to safely escape out of there.
rows.jp: ＞貴様らが / そこから無事に脱出することである<b:8a42>のはともかく / ２番めの任務はぜひ<89d8>行したいな<b:8a43>動力部分の機能を<8996>止させた後 / すみやかに現在地帯まで帰還してほしい
rows.lit: ...is for all of you to escape from there safely.
rows.re: ...is for all of you to escape / from there safely.
rows.speaker: radio

rows.en: >Winding back the assault anchor will help us retrieve you guys.
rows.jp: ＞アサルトアンカーを<8812>き戻すことで / 貴様らの回斬を行う乗るってことだな？
rows.lit: By winding back the assault anchor, we'll retrieve you.
rows.re: By winding back the assault / anchor, we'll retrieve you.
rows.speaker: radio

rows.en: @OK. OK. After completing the mission, return here. And be sure to recover the anchor.
rows.jp: 「〜ＯＫ、わかったよ / 任務<89d8>行後、現在地帯まで帰還 / アンカーの回斬をたのむよ乗り心地も考<b:8a45>するとしよう
rows.lit: Okay, understood; after the mission, we return here; count on you for the anchor recovery.
rows.re: Okay, understood; after the / mission we return here. Count on / you for the anchor recovery.
rows.speaker: party

rows.en: >Over and Out.
rows.lit: Over and out.
rows.re: Over and out.
rows.speaker: radio

rows.en: @They say you beat Judecca. Is this guy the real thing?
rows.jp: 「ジュデッカのヤツを<b:8a46>けたっていうし / こいつは、いよいよホンモノか？<b:8a47>しないッ！
rows.lit: They say you beat Judecca; so is this one the real deal at last?
rows.re: They say you beat Judecca; so is / this one the real deal at last?
rows.speaker: Odessa officer

rows.en: @I don't know who came up with that but, |Justice| can be found on any corner.
rows.jp: 「どこのどいつが決めたのか知らねぇけどよ / 『正義』なんてモンは / そこら岸に<b:8a48>がっているもんだぜ
rows.lit: I don't know who decided it, but "justice" is a thing you'll find lying around on any street corner.
rows.re: I don't know who decided it, but / |justice| is a thing you'll find / on any street corner.
rows.speaker: Odessa officer

rows.en: @I've got a little in my heart.
rows.jp: 「この僕方の<89e5>にもな<b:8a49>き放認してくれたんだ
rows.lit: Even here in this heart of mine.
rows.re: Even here in this heart of mine.
rows.speaker: Odessa officer

rows.en: @We have far too many reasons why our swords should cross, right?
rows.jp: 「僕方とお前たち / <b:8a4a>を交えるには充分すぎる理由がある / そうだろう？<b:8a4b>よぉッ！ / 見せてみろや / お前たちの『正義』とやらをッ！乗<b:8a3e>の<b:8a46><b:8a4c>が / そろそろ終わったということだよ
rows.lit: You and I have more than reason enough to cross swords; don't we?
rows.re: You and I have more than reason / enough to cross swords; don't we?
rows.speaker: Odessa officer

rows.en: @You were buying time until all the passengers were off, weren't you?
rows.jp: 「乗<b:8a3e>の<b:8a46><b:8a4c>が完了するまでの / 時間<b:8a4d>ぎを<b:8a4e>って出てたのかッ！
rows.lit: So you were out there buying time until the evacuation of the passengers was done!
rows.re: So you were out there buying time / until the passengers were all / evacuated!
rows.speaker: Odessa officer

rows.en: @I was fond of the Varukisas, but it's perfect to bury you all in.
rows.jp: 「バルキサスはお気に入りだったけどよ / お前たちを<b:8a4f>るのには / <b:8a50><b:8a49>の<b:8a51><8861>となってくれそうだぜ<b:8b15>[10]<8c10>[0f][10]
rows.lit: The Varukisas was a favorite of mine, but it'll make a fine grave to bury you all in.
rows.re: The Varukisas was a favorite of / mine, but it'll make a fine grave / to bury you all in.
rows.speaker: Odessa officer

rows.en: @The Varukisas looks like it's not going to last much longer.
rows.jp: 「どうやらこのバルキサス / そう長く持ちそうもない
rows.lit: This Varukisas doesn't look like it'll hold together much longer.
rows.re: This Varukisas doesn't look like / it'll hold together much longer.
rows.speaker: party

rows.en: @One danger passes, only to have another danger surface.
rows.jp: 「一<b:8a52><b:8a53>ってまた一<b:8a52>なのぉッ！
rows.lit: One peril passes, and here comes another!
rows.re: One peril passes, and here comes / another!
rows.speaker: party

rows.en: @If the plane crashes, the Valeria Chateau connected by the anchor will fall too.
rows.jp: 「このまま、この飛空機艇が墜落すれば / アンカーで<b:8a54>がっている / ヴァレリアシャトーだっていっしょに〜<b:8a55>けてほしい
rows.lit: If this flying machine crashes as it is, Valeria Chateau, linked by the anchor, goes down with it...
rows.re: If this machine crashes as it is, / Valeria Chateau, linked by the / anchor, goes down with it...
rows.speaker: party

rows.en: @One danger passes, only to have another danger surface.
rows.jp: 「一<b:8a52><b:8a53>ってまた一<b:8a52>なのぉッ！
rows.lit: One peril passes, and here comes another!
rows.re: One peril passes, and here comes / another!
rows.speaker: party

rows.en: @As it is, we won't be able to reach the location of the anchor. We've got bigger problems.
rows.jp: 「このままでは / アンカーの場所までたどりつけません / それどころか<f040><f042>
rows.lit: At this rate we won't even reach the anchor; and worse than that...
rows.re: At this rate we won't even reach / the anchor; and worse than / that...
rows.speaker: Tim

rows.en: @If the plane crashes, the Valeria Chateau connected by the anchor will fall too..
rows.jp: 「この飛空機艇が墜落すれば / アンカーで<b:8a54>がっている / ヴァレリアシャトーだっていっしょに〜<b:8a55>けてほしい
rows.lit: If this flying machine crashes, Valeria Chateau, linked by the anchor, goes down with it...
rows.re: If this machine crashes, Valeria / Chateau, linked by the anchor, / goes down with it...
rows.speaker: party

rows.en: @You've got to trust me with your lives.
rows.jp: 「それにこいつは / テロリストの駆るものじゃない / そう、こいつは<f040><f042>
rows.lit: Besides, this thing isn't something terrorists pilot; no, this is...
rows.re: Besides, this thing isn't / something terrorists pilot; no, / this is...
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @This plane isn't a plane for terrorists. This plane is...
rows.jp: 「俺ひとりの判断で / みんなを<8812>き込んでしまった
rows.lit: By my own call alone, I dragged everyone into this.
rows.re: By my own call alone, I dragged / everyone into this.
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @My judgement got you guys into this.
rows.jp: 「僕たちだけの方が / 危険は回<b:8a4c>しやすいからな<b:8a57>そうよッ！
rows.lit: It's easier to steer clear of danger with just us.
rows.re: It's easier to steer clear of / danger with just us.
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @It's easier if it's only us to get out of danger.
rows.jp: 「もう、あまり時間もなさそうだ
rows.lit: We don't seem to have much time left.
rows.re: We don't seem to have much time / left.
rows.speaker: party

rows.en: @We don't have much time.
rows.jp: 「このタイプの飛空機艇のコクピットは / たしか…
rows.lit: The cockpit on this type of flying machine is, if I recall...
rows.re: The cockpit on this type of / flying machine is, if I recall...
rows.speaker: party

rows.en: @These planes have the cockpits over...
rows.jp: 「この先って、さっき行ったはずだよね / 単の所を探さないとッ！
rows.lit: We've already been up ahead here, haven't we? We need to search somewhere else!
rows.re: We've already been up ahead here, / haven't we? We need to search / somewhere else!
rows.speaker: party

rows.en: @We've already been this way. Let's look somewhere else!
rows.lit: (EN only) We've already been this way. Let's look somewhere else!
rows.re: We've already been this way. / Let's look somewhere else! [?]
rows.speaker: party

rows.lit: Do you want to proceed?
rows.re: Do you want to proceed?
rows.speaker: examine prompt

rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>でも、今回の体験版では / 残念ながら使用することができません
rows.lit: But in this trial version, it unfortunately cannot be used.
rows.re: But in this trial version, it / unfortunately cannot be used.
rows.speaker: system: demo notice

rows.en: *Unfortunately, this service is unavailable in the Demo Version.
rows.jp: ＊〜ですが、今回の体験版では / 残念ながら使用することができません
rows.lit: ...however, in this trial version it unfortunately cannot be used.
rows.re: ...however, in this trial version, / it unfortunately cannot be used.
rows.speaker: system: demo notice

rows.en: @Does this mean I have to go back and redo the control panel?
rows.jp: 「またコントロールパネルを / 右作しなくちゃいけないってことか
rows.lit: Does this mean I have to go work the control panel all over again?
rows.re: Does this mean I have to go work / the control panel all over again?
rows.speaker: party

rows.en: @Oh well... I guess I have to go redo the control panel.
rows.jp: 「しかたがない / コントロールパネルまで戻って / 右作し<8865>しだな
rows.lit: Nothing for it; back to the control panel to redo it.
rows.re: Nothing for it; back to the / control panel to redo it.
rows.speaker: party

rows.en: @Why is the bridge up! Do I have to return to the control panel?
rows.jp: 「なんで<89ec>が上がってるのよッ！ / またコントロールパネルまで / 戻らなきゃならないの？
rows.lit: Why is the bridge up?! Do I have to go all the way back to the control panel again?
rows.re: Why is the bridge up?! Do I have / to go all the way back to the / control panel again?
rows.speaker: Lilka

rows.en: @It can't be helped. I'm going back to the control panel.
rows.jp: 「仕方ありません / また、コントロールパネルを / 右作しに行きましょう
rows.lit: It can't be helped; let's go work the control panel again.
rows.re: It can't be helped; let's go work / the control panel again.
rows.speaker: party

rows.en: @If the bridge was up I don't know what I'd do.
rows.jp: 「<89ec>が上がってたら / どうしようかと思っちゃったもんね<b:8a38>している<b:8a39><b:8a3a>はない
rows.lit: If the bridge were up, I really wouldn't know what to do.
rows.re: If the bridge were up, I really / wouldn't know what to do.
rows.speaker: Lilka

rows.en: @Let's go on!
rows.jp: 「先に進むぞッ！
rows.lit: Let's go on ahead!
rows.re: Let's go on ahead!
rows.speaker: party

rows.en: @The hidden powers spreading the terrorists' spell |Odessa| through the land are Liz & Ard. That's us.
rows.jp: 「今や全<b:8a3d><b:8a3e>々<b:8a3f>々にとどろきわたる / 魔法のテロリスト『オデッサ』の隠し<b:8a40> / トカとゲーとは、我々らのことよ
rows.lit: The magic terrorists "Odessa," whose name thunders across the whole land; their hidden blades, Toka and Gě, are us!
rows.re: The magic terrorists |Odessa|, / thundering across the land; / their hidden blades, us: Toka & Gě!
rows.speaker: Toka

rows.en: @I'm not anyone suspicious.
rows.jp: 「けして怪しい者ではない<b:8a40>』じゃなくて / 『危険<b:8a40>』のまちがいじゃないのか〜？
rows.lit: We are by no means anyone suspicious.
rows.re: We are by no means anyone / suspicious.
rows.speaker: Toka

rows.en: @That sweet smell of danger can't be hidden from us.
rows.jp: 「やっぱり我々たちには / 隠しても隠しきれない / <b:8a42>く危険な<b:8a43>りがつきものだトカ
rows.lit: As ever, that sweet, dangerous scent clings to us, hide it as we might, ...or so it goes.
rows.re: As ever, that sweet, dangerous / scent clings to us, hide it as we / might, or so it goes.
rows.speaker: Toka

rows.en: @I'm the brains! Ard's the power! And, I'm cool!
rows.jp: 「我々の<b:8a44><b:8a45>とッ！ / ゲーのパワーッ！ / さらに加えて、我々のカッコ良さッ！
rows.lit: My genius! And Gě's power! And on top of that, my dashing good looks!
rows.re: My genius! And Gě's power! And on / top of that, my dashing good / looks!
rows.speaker: Toka

rows.en: @No matter how you look, we're first rate. You Filgaia guys are second rate.
rows.jp: 「どこをとっても一流の我々たちが / ファルガイアじゃ<b:8a47>流の貴様らに渡す / 見たことの無い最後の招<b:8a48>ッ！[10]
rows.lit: First-rate in every way, we present you second-rate Filgaians a final invitation you've never seen!
rows.re: First-rate in every way, we grant / you second-rate Filgaians a final / invitation you've never seen!
rows.speaker: Toka

rows.en: @If you're going to confront us, you'll have to destroy us! Here goes.
rows.jp: 「立ちはだかるなら / 突き崩すのみッ！ / ゆくぞッ！
rows.lit: If you stand in our way, we'll just break through! Here we go!
rows.re: If you stand in our way, we'll / just break through! Here we go!
rows.speaker: party

rows.en: @My calculations show something vital missing? Could it be |poetry?|
rows.jp: 「我々の特<b:8a4f>儀に / 何か大切なモノが欠けてたトカ？ / もしかして『<b:8a50><b:8a51>』？<b:8a52>んでいるヒマは無いッ！<b:8a53>、我々らは<b:8a54>て<b:8a55>よ〜<b:8a56>、失<b:8a56>〜 / さっきのノーカンね[10]<b:8a57>いの
rows.lit: Was something vital missing from my grand performance? Could it be... "poetry," ...or something?
rows.re: Was something vital missing from / my grand performance? Could it / be... |poetry|, or something?
rows.speaker: Toka

rows.en: @One look and you'll be going home!
rows.jp: 「お代は、見てのお帰りだトカッ！
rows.lit: One look and the price is: off you go home, ...or something!
rows.re: One look and the price is: off / you go home, or something!
rows.speaker: Toka

rows.en: @Surprisingly, even the Monster Regeneration Unit responded, as if yielding to a baby.
rows.jp: 「ビックリドッキリ<8872>の / <b:8a5b>生<b:8a5c><b:8a5d>怪獣<b:8a5e>団（？）までもが / 眠家の手にサブミッションかのごとくッ！[10]<b:8a5b>生<b:8a5c><b:8a5d>』がマズかったトカ？
rows.lit: Even the astonishing Monster-Regeneration Squad (?) went down as if submitting to a mere babe!
rows.re: Even the astonishing / Monster-Regeneration Squad (?) / went down as if yielding to a babe!
rows.speaker: Toka

rows.en: @You...If I only had Bulkogidon everyone would be paralyzed. If only it was finished.
rows.jp: 「おのれ〜 ブルコギドンさえあれば / 誰もがしびれる / ブルコギドンさえ完成していれば〜
rows.lit: Curse it; if only I had Bulkogidon, all would be spellbound; if only Bulkogidon were finished...
rows.re: Curse it; with Bulkogidon all / would be spellbound. If only it / were finished...
rows.speaker: Toka

rows.en: @There's nothing more maddening than to be delayed by hoodlums I only just met!
rows.jp: 「<b:8a5f>回今回<b:8a60>った / <b:8a61>辺どもに<8a0d>れをとることなど / ムダ<b:8a62>ほどもありはしないのにッ！
rows.lit: To be held up by hoodlums we only just met; that's not worth even the tiniest scrap of trouble!
rows.re: To be held up by hoodlums we only / just met isn't worth the tiniest / scrap of trouble!
rows.speaker: Toka

rows.en: @It makes me shake with anger.
rows.jp: 「身<b:8a63>いするほど<b:8a64>が立つッ<f059>々らのあすなろ伝説は / 今、始まったばかりだトカ〜
rows.lit: I'm shaking with rage!
rows.re: I'm shaking with rage!
rows.speaker: Toka

rows.en: @Today's scientific know-how will lead us to the Land of Promise.
rows.jp: 「今回の<b:8a65><b:8a66>的ノウハウは / きっと我々らを<b:8a67>重の地に<b:8a48>くこと必至
rows.lit: This day's scientific know-how is sure to lead us to the Promised Land, no doubt about it.
rows.re: This day's scientific know-how is / sure to lead us to the Promised / Land, no doubt about it.
rows.speaker: Toka

rows.en: @While I was waiting for that day to come with great anticipation, we morphed into this new shape.
rows.jp: 「その回を楽しみに / <888a>を長くして待っていたら / こんな姿に〜
rows.lit: While I waited eagerly, neck craned for that day, we ended up in this shape...
rows.re: While I waited eagerly, neck / craned for that day, we ended up / in this shape...
rows.speaker: Toka

rows.en: @We've proudly looked like this since birth. Bluntly put, we're in our |birthday suits.|
rows.jp: 「我々らは、生まれた時より<b:8a69>り高きこの姿 / <b:8a6a>に言う / 『生まれたまんまの姿』というヤツだトカ
rows.lit: We've worn this proud form since birth; bluntly put, we're in our "birthday suits," ...or something.
rows.re: We've worn this proud form since / birth; bluntly put, we're in our / |birthday suits|, or something.
rows.speaker: Toka

rows.en: @Either way, we've managed to successfully delay you all on a grand scale never seen before.
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>どっちにせよ / 我々らは貴様らの足止めに / かつて無いほど見事に成<b:8a6b>をおさめた
rows.lit: Either way, we've succeeded in delaying you on a grander scale than ever before.
rows.re: Either way, we've succeeded in / delaying you on a grander scale / than ever before.
rows.speaker: Toka

rows.en: @Listen. Thanks. Thanks.
rows.lit: Now then; thanks, thanks.
rows.re: Now then; thanks, thanks.
rows.speaker: Toka

rows.en: @We ungrudgingly exposed our brilliance. Vin is probably delighted by this!
rows.jp: 「我々のおしげもなくさらした / まばゆいばかりの<b:8a70><b:8a71>っぷりに / ヴィンちゃんもきっとご<b:8a72><b:8a73>の方家？
rows.lit: With the dazzling brilliance we so freely displayed, surely Vinny himself would be delighted?
rows.re: With the dazzling brilliance we / so freely displayed, surely Vinny / himself would be delighted?
rows.speaker: Toka

rows.en: @Me and my images of youth will never, ever be caught.
rows.jp: 「<b:8a74><b:8a75>の<b:8a76><b:8a77>と我々には / どこまで行っても追いつけぬものトカ
rows.lit: My youthful visions and I can never be caught, no matter how far you chase, ...or something.
rows.re: My youthful visions and I can / never be caught, no matter how / far you chase, or something.
rows.speaker: Toka

rows.en: @As your last memory in your teens, let the sight of our departure burn your goggle-eyes.
rows.jp: 「１０代最後の思い出に / <b:8a78>り行く我々らの姿を / <b:8a79><b:8a7a>同部のドングリまなこに<b:8a7b>きつけたまえ
rows.lit: As your last memory of your teens, sear the sight of our departing figures into your goggling little eyes.
rows.re: As your last teen memory, sear / the sight of our departure into / your goggling little eyes.
rows.speaker: Toka

rows.en: @Adieu!
rows.jp: 「アデュー〜ッ！<b:8a7c>らよりも / オデッサ本隊の追跡を<89ab>先するぞッ！
rows.lit: Adieu!
rows.re: Adieu!
rows.speaker: Toka

rows.jp: ＊アイテムとして使用することで / バイアネットに新たな<b:8a7d><b:8a7e>を / 追加します

rows.re: Using it as an item adds new / ammunition to the bayonet.

rows.jp: ＊<b:8a7f>撃<88e0>を広<b:8a80><b:8a81><b:8a82>にて発<b:8a83>し / 相全体に対して<b:8a84>撃を行います
rows.lit: It looses shockwaves over a wide area, striking the entire enemy line.
rows.re: It looses shockwaves over a wide / area, striking the entire enemy / line.
rows.speaker: lore panel

rows.jp: ＊ゲートブリッジを辺げて、閉鎖しますか？ / １．ブリッジを辺げて閉鎖する / ２．閉鎖しない[1a]か鎖されています / 開くには、東<89f5>のコントロールパネルを / 右作してください

rows.en: @Sooo smart! And we're soooo cooolll!
rows.jp: 「あったまい〜ッ！ / そして我々、カッチョええ〜ッ！
rows.lit: So smaaart! And we're so cooool!
rows.re: So smaaart! And we're so cooool!
rows.speaker: Toka

rows.en: @If we raise the gate, it'll all be ours.
rows.jp: 「ゲートを上げてしまえば / もうこっちのものだトカ
rows.lit: Once we raise the gate, it's all ours, ...or something.
rows.re: Once we raise the gate, it's all / ours, or something.
rows.speaker: Toka

rows.en: @I'm a gentleman. As a gentleman I know no means no.
rows.jp: 「我々は同胞だよ〜 / 同胞だったら知っている / <b:8a8f>事はヒツジと知っているモノだトカ同胞は<b:8a90>力を<b:8a91>まない / でも、言葉の<b:8a90>力はだーい<b:8a91>きだトカ
rows.lit: I'm a gentleman; a gentleman knows that no means no, ...or something.
rows.re: I'm a gentleman; and a gentleman / knows that no means no, or / something.
rows.speaker: Toka

rows.en: @Prepare for word torture! I can't keep quiet. I'm full of dangerous phrases that should be censored.
rows.jp: 「さっそく言葉<b:8a92>めの準備だトカッ！ / お上も<8990>っちゃいられない / <b:8a93><b:8a94>安地の危険なセリフが、やあ、<b:8a72><887d>
rows.lit: Time to prep the word-torture, ...or something! Even the censors can't keep up; oh, my dangerous lines abound!
rows.re: Time to prep the word-torture, or / something! Even the censors can't / keep up with my dangerous lines!
rows.speaker: Toka

rows.en: @You ask what am I going to do if they don't flinch. That's obvious.
rows.jp: 「それでも連中が<b:8a95>まなければ / どうするんだってッ！ / 〜知れたことだトカ〜
rows.lit: And if that still doesn't make them flinch, what then, you ask? ...Isn't it obvious, ...or something.
rows.re: And if that still doesn't make / them flinch, what then? ...Isn't / it obvious, or something.
rows.speaker: Toka

rows.en: @I'll hit and hit until they do as I say!
rows.jp: 「ブって、ブって / 言うこと聞くまで / ブチのめすッ！
rows.lit: Smack 'em, smack 'em, pound 'em till they do as they're told!
rows.re: Smack 'em, smack 'em, pound 'em / till they do as they're told!
rows.speaker: Gě

rows.en: @I'll throw off the gentleman disguise. The era of the intellectual gangster is over.
rows.jp: 「同胞の<b:8a96><b:8a97>をかなぐり<b:8a54>てて / インテリヤクザの時代はもう終ったトカ〜
rows.lit: Casting off the gentleman's mask; the age of the intellectual gangster is over, ...or something.
rows.re: Casting off the gentleman's mask; / the age of the intellectual / gangster is over, or something.
rows.speaker: Toka

rows.lit: Do you want to proceed?
rows.re: Do you want to proceed?

rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>でも、今回の体験版では / 残念ながら使用することができません

rows.re: But in this trial version, it / unfortunately cannot be used.

rows.speaker: inscription

rows.en: *Data analysis reveals they can, in a split second turn an entire continent to scorched earth.
rows.jp: ＊解<b:8a42>データによれば / その威力は大陸を一<b:8a43>にして / <b:8a44><b:8a45>と合すことさえ可能であった
rows.lit: By analysis data, its power could turn a whole continent to scorched earth in an instant.
rows.re: By analysis data, its power could / turn a whole continent to / scorched earth in an instant.
rows.speaker: inscription

rows.en: *In the past, this power was used not as a weapon, but as a military bargaining tool.
rows.jp: ＊その威力故に、同時としてでなく / 戦<b:8a46>的交<b:8a47>手<b:8a48>とされたのではないかと / <88c1>待されている
rows.lit: For that power, it's thought to have been used not as a weapon but as a strategic bargaining tool.
rows.re: For that power, it's thought to / have served not as a weapon but a / strategic bargaining chip.
rows.speaker: inscription

rows.en: @Regardless, it's not well-suited to the world of the living.
rows.jp: 「それでも / 生者の世界には / <8973>つかわしくないもの<b:8a4c>めってわけッ！
rows.lit: Even so, it's a thing that has no place in the world of the living.
rows.re: Even so, it's a thing that has no / place in the world of the living.
rows.speaker: Lilka

rows.en: @I'll destroy it for you, so promise me you won't show up again.
rows.jp: 「やっつけてあげるから / <b:8a4d>度とバケて出てこないでよね
rows.lit: I'll destroy it for you, so promise you won't come haunting back ever again.
rows.re: I'll destroy it for you, so / promise you won't come haunting / back ever again.
rows.speaker: Lilka

rows.en: *Do you want to read it?2
rows.jp: ＊進みますか？[18]か
rows.lit: Do you want to proceed?
rows.re: Do you want to proceed?
rows.speaker: system/prompt

rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>でも、今回の体験版では / 残念ながら使用することができません
rows.lit: But in this trial version, it unfortunately cannot be used.
rows.re: But in this trial version, it / unfortunately cannot be used.

rows.lit: ...however, in this trial version it unfortunately cannot be used.
rows.re: ...however, in this trial version, / it unfortunately cannot be used.

rows.en: @Aren't you coming? I don't get it. I just don't get it.

rows.speaker: Liz

rows.jp: 「げげげ、げげげげ / げーげーげー / げっげげげー げっげっげ

rows.jp: <b:8ab6>えているみたいだけど〜

rows.jp: 「どうしてアンタは / こうも見事に発倒を呼び込んでくるんだ<b:8ac2>だるま儀』だ / 不<b:8ab3>当なんだから<b:8ac3>んでくれよ〜

rows.speaker: Lilka

rows.jp: 「それに、名バイプレイヤーってのは / 自分の出番を心得て / なおかつキッチリこなすもんだと思うけど

rows.jp: 「現代注目の<b:8ac7>達帯は / 見る者にあまねく / <b:8ac8>と<b:8a77><b:8a78>を<b:8ac9>えてますかーッ！注目に街<b:8aca>された危険性を / 目の当たりにしているのかもしれない〜注目というより<b:8acb><b:8a68>団よね<b:8acc><b:8acd>も高らかにィ<f045><f045>〜

rows.lit: Strange, isn't it? If there were a pattern, he'd blurt something needless.

rows.speaker: Ard

rows.jp: 「いまわの<89d2>に / 『死んでも死にきれぬわ』と / 自<b:8ad4>暗示をかけたゆえ、これこのとおり
rows.lit: On my deathbed I hypnotized myself. |I cannot die now|, and look at me.
rows.re: On my deathbed I hypnotized myself. / |I cannot die now|, and look at me.

rows.re: I was told only that destiny would / rule once the |Pillar| was chosen.
rows.speaker: Gaia

rows.en: @Everything is a part of destiny spinning on a wheel. It's a planned accord.
rows.jp: 「すべては運命を<8961>ぐ / <b:8a65>陸の中に<b:8a66>み込まれた / 期定調<b:8a67>なのです
rows.re: All is a part of destiny turning on / a wheel. A planned accord.
rows.speaker: Gaia

rows.en: @Accept your fate, as the |Pillar.| Filgaia is now being confronted by an unprecedented crisis.
rows.jp: 「さあ、『鍵』としての運命を<b:8a68>け入れなさい / ファルガイアは今、未<b:8a69>作の危機に / さらされているのです
rows.re: Accept your fate as the |Pillar.| / Filgaia faces a crisis without / precedent.
rows.speaker: Gaia

rows.en: @The only ones who can stop it are us, Gaia, and...
rows.jp: 「それを阻止できるのは / 我々ガイアと<f040><f042>
rows.re: The only ones who can stop it are / us, Gaia, and...
rows.speaker: Gaia

rows.en: @one who can deliver our power. The boy of the |Pillar.| You, 3.
rows.jp: 「我々の力を解き放つことができる / 『鍵』の少数<f040><f042> / [05]が、あなたなのです〜
rows.re: ...one who can deliver our power. / The child of the |Pillar.| You, / {3}.
rows.speaker: Gaia

rows.en: @What in the world is going on in Filgaia now with the sky being devoured...?
rows.jp: 「今、ファルガイアに / いったい何が起こっているんですか？ / 空が食べられてしまうなんて<f040><f042>
rows.re: What on earth is happening to / Filgaia, its sky being devoured...?
rows.speaker: Marina

rows.en: @It's not fair for you to become a human Pillar without knowing. All right, I shall tell you.
rows.jp: 「何も知らずに / 人鍵となるのは不<b:8a6a>なこと / よろしい、<b:8a6b>えましょう〜
rows.re: It's not fair to make you a human / Pillar in ignorance. Very well, / I'll tell you.
rows.speaker: Gaia

rows.en: @The invading presence in the world is none other than |The Other World.|
rows.jp: 「世界を侵す存在 / それは〜 / 『異世界』に他なりません
rows.re: The presence invading the world is / none other than |the Other World.|
rows.speaker: Gaia

rows.en: @Just like us, the world is a collection of small lives that is one big |spirit.|
rows.jp: 「我々がそうであるように / 世界とは、小さな生命の集合体 / ひとつの大きな『<b:8a6c><b:8a6d>』なのです
rows.re: Like us, a world is a gathering of / small lives that form one great / |spirit.|
rows.speaker: Gaia

rows.en: @That world has overstepped its boundaries and is devouring other worlds.
rows.jp: 「その世界が、<b:8a6e>が<b:8a6f>界を<b:8a70>えて / 他の世界を<b:8a71>み込もうとしているのです<b:8a72>を<b:8a73>している〜 / そんなバカなことが〜<b:8a74><b:8a75>のわずかな侵食時においては / 小さな生命体を取り込んでいきました
rows.re: That world has overstepped its / bounds and devours other worlds.
rows.speaker: Gaia

rows.en: @They were monsters and were the first arrival of beings to oppose Filgaia's Paradigm.
rows.jp: 「これが、モンスターと呼ばれる / ファルガイアのパラダイムに反する / 生物の<890c>生なのです
rows.re: They were monsters, the first to / come and oppose Filgaia's Paradigm.
rows.speaker: Gaia

rows.en: @But the fray in the world's boundaries grew and soon a larger vessel was needed.
rows.jp: 「ですが、世界の<b:8a6f>界に生じたほつれは / 更<88f9>に大きくなり / やがては、より大きな器を<b:8a77>めました
rows.re: But the rift at the world's edge / grew, and soon a larger vessel was / needed.
rows.speaker: Gaia

rows.en: @A larger vessel to obtain another spirit... In other words, Filgaia itself.
rows.jp: 「異なる<b:8a6c><b:8a6d>を斬めるための / 大きな器〜 / すなわち、ファルガイアそのものを〜<b:8a78>つ手は / 存在しないのか〜ッ！<b:8a79>無です
rows.re: A larger vessel to take another / spirit... Filgaia itself.
rows.speaker: Gaia

rows.en: @Your physical power can't really harm this conceptual |world.|
rows.jp: 「あなた方の振るう物理的な力では / 概念存在である『世界』に対して / <b:8a7c>ばくかの<b:8a7d><889b>も<b:8a7e>えることかないません
rows.re: Your physical power can't truly / harm this conceptual |world.|
rows.speaker: Gaia

rows.en: @Think about it. Even if we use weapons, there is no effect.
rows.jp: 「考えてもご<b:8a7f>なさい / 今この場で<b:8a80>器を振るっても / 何の手応えがないでしょう
rows.re: Think. Even weapons have no effect.
rows.speaker: Gaia

rows.en: @That's what it means to have a conceptual |world| as an opponent.
rows.jp: 「概念存在『世界』を相手にするということは / つまり、そういうことなのです<b:8a81>を相手にするということか
rows.re: That is what it means to face a / conceptual |world.|
rows.speaker: Gaia

rows.en: @To fight |the other world,| we, as similar conceptual beings, must be released.
rows.jp: 「『異世界』に対<b:8a82>するには / 同じく概念存在である我々を / 解放するしかないのです
rows.re: To fight |the Other World,| we, as / like conceptual beings, must be set / free.
rows.speaker: Gaia

rows.en: @When you have something of value, the path you must choose will become naturally clear.
rows.jp: 「あなたに、大切なモノがあるなら / 選ぶべき道は / 自ずと決まってくるはずです
rows.re: When you hold something of worth, / the path to choose becomes clear.
rows.speaker: Gaia

rows.en: @When life is held out before us, we can protect anything.
rows.jp: 「我らが前に生命を<b:8a83>し出せば / すべてを守ることができましょう
rows.re: When life is held out before us, we / can protect anything.
rows.speaker: Gaia

rows.en: @I don't want to.
rows.jp: 「〜〜ボクは、イヤだ
rows.re: I don't want to.
rows.speaker: Marina

rows.en: @For the |Pillar| to be given as an offering for Filgaia...
rows.jp: 「『鍵』が / ファルガイアのために<b:8a85>げられるのは<f040><f042>納得できないッ！
rows.re: For the |Pillar| to be offered up / for Filgaia...
rows.speaker: Marina

rows.en: @I'm not afraid of dying! I just don't want to give my life to something I doubt.
rows.jp: 「死ぬことが<b:8a87>いんじゃないッ！ / 納得できないことに / 生命をかけられないだけだッ！
rows.re: I'm not afraid to die! I just won't / give my life to something I doubt.
rows.speaker: Marina

rows.en: @Even if I protect Filgaia as the |Pillar| now, the doubts in my heart won't be resolved!
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>今、ボクが『鍵』として / ファルガイアを守ったとしても / 心の中にある<b:8a88>誓は解決できないんだッ！
rows.re: Even if I shield Filgaia as the / |Pillar| now, the doubt won't leave / my heart.
rows.speaker: Marina

rows.en: @To die as a sacrificial offering is an easy choice.
rows.jp: 「生け<b:8a89>として死ぬのは<f040><f042> / いちばん<b:8a8a><b:8a8b>な選<b:8a8c><b:8a8d>なんだ〜守るために / 生命をかける〜
rows.re: To die as a sacrifice is the easy / choice.
rows.speaker: Gaia

rows.en: @How can you object to that? Boy of the |Pillar.|
rows.jp: 「そのことに / どうして<b:8a88>誓など持てるのですか？ / 『鍵』の少数よ
rows.re: How can you refuse it? Child of the / |Pillar.|
rows.speaker: Gaia

rows.en: @Pooka will search for answers to the |Pillar's| doubts.
rows.jp: 「プーカは、『鍵』といっしょに / <b:8a88>誓の<883a>えを探したいと思うのダ導き手』プーカ〜 / それは、お前の意旨なのか？
rows.re: Pooka will seek answers to the / |Pillar's| doubts.
rows.speaker: Pooka

rows.en: @That's it.
rows.jp: 「〜〜なのダ
rows.re: That's it.
rows.speaker: Marina

rows.en: @Then, all right.
rows.jp: 「〜いいでしょう
rows.re: Then, all right.
rows.speaker: Marina

rows.en: @|Pillar,| the choice is yours.
rows.jp: 「『鍵』の少数よ / 選<b:8a8c>は、あなたにまかせます
rows.re: |Pillar,| the choice is yours.
rows.speaker: Gaia

rows.en: @But be sure to make your decision before it's too late.
rows.jp: 「でも、すべてが手<8a0d>れになる前に / 決断を辺すことを忘れないよう〜<b:8a8e>概<b:8a8f>プーカ
rows.re: But decide before it's too late.
rows.speaker: Gaia

rows.en: @You have not forgotten, have you?
rows.jp: 「そのことを / 忘れてはいませんか？
rows.re: You haven't forgotten, have you?
rows.speaker: Gaia

rows.jp: <b:8a90>得した<b:8a91>です

rows.en: *With the Guardian's powers, all enemies' powers will be cut in half.
rows.jp: ＊ガーディアンの力により / 相全体のパワーを / <89a7>分に<b:8a92><b:8a93>させることができます<b:8a94><b:8a95><8860>の域方が / <89c2>み込まれている<b:8a94>[8a]
rows.re: *With a Guardian's power, all / enemies' power is cut in half.
rows.speaker: panel

rows.en: *Do you want to read it?2
rows.jp: ＊進みますか？[18]か
rows.lit: Do you want to proceed?
rows.re: Do you want to proceed?
rows.speaker: system/prompt

rows.en: @Unfortunately, this service is unavailable in the Demo Version.
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>でも、今回の体験版では / 残念ながら使用することができません
rows.lit: But in this trial version, it unfortunately cannot be used.
rows.re: But in this trial version, it / unfortunately cannot be used.
rows.speaker: system/prompt

rows.en: *Unfortunately, this service is unavailable in the Demo Version.
rows.jp: ＊〜ですが、今回の体験版では / 残念ながら使用することができません
rows.lit: ...however, in this trial version it unfortunately cannot be used.
rows.re: ...however, in this trial version, / it unfortunately cannot be used.
rows.speaker: system/prompt

rows.en: *Press 1 to use the Rad Blades to erase any damage you receive from the ground and allow rapid motion.
rows.jp: ＊ローラーダッシュは[0b]おを乗すことで / 置から発けるダメージなどを無<b:8a38>にして / 高<8a04>移動することができます
rows.re: *Press 1 for the Rad Blades to / cancel ground damage and dash fast.
rows.speaker: panel

rows.en: *Once used, you cannot change direction or stop until you've made contact with something.
rows.jp: ＊ただし一度作動させると / なにかに<b:8a39>突するまで進行方向を変えたり / <8996>止することは出<b:8a3a>ません
rows.re: *Once used, you can't turn or stop / until you hit something.
rows.speaker: panel

rows.jp: [17]<b:8a3b><b:8a3c>ぱたーん<b:8a3d>合完了

rows.en: >WELCOME, YOU WITH MAGESS BLOOD. THIS IS WHERE YOUR SLEEPING MEMORY WILL WAKE.
rows.jp: ＞ヨウコソ、少女ノ血ヲ招ク者ヨ / ココハ、アナタノ血ヨリ / <89bb>リシ渡録ヲ呼ビ信マス<89c8>
rows.re: >WELCOME, YOU OF MAGESS BLOOD. HERE / YOUR SLEEPING MEMORY WILL WAKE.
rows.speaker: inscription

rows.jp: [17]<b:8a3b><b:8a3c>ぱたーん<b:8a3d>合不可

rows.en: >ENTRY BEYOND THIS POINT IS PROHIBITED.
rows.jp: ＞ココヨリ先ノ進入ヲ<b:8a40>止シマス
rows.re: >ENTRY BEYOND THIS POINT IS / PROHIBITED.
rows.speaker: inscription

rows.en: @At my house... Hm.... There's no place for me.
rows.jp: 「お家には〜 / ううん / どこにもあたしの<b:8a45>場所なんて無いの
rows.re: At my house... hm. There's no place / for me.
rows.speaker: Kanon

rows.en: @It'll be fine.
rows.jp: 「だいじょうぶだ<b:8a41>さん〜<b:8a41><8a0e> / 「アイシャ〜 / いいかい、よくお聞き〜
rows.re: It'll be fine.
rows.speaker: Kanon

rows.en: @Regardless of the kind of life you're living, we have the blood of the <Sword Magess>.
rows.jp: 「今はどんな<b:8a46>らしをしていようと / わたしたちには / ＜剣の少女＞の血が流れているんだよ〜<b:8a41><8a0e> / 「どんなに苦しくても / ＜少女＞の血を忘れないで〜
rows.re: Whatever life you lead, the <Sword / Magess> blood is in us.
rows.speaker: Kanon

rows.en: @Descended from the <Sword Magess> and related to the Valerias, the Bernadettes are having hard times.
rows.jp: 「ヴァレリア家の<b:8a48>流とはいえ〜 / 落ちぶれたとはいえ、ベルナデット家も / ＜剣の少女＞の<b:8a49><b:8a4a>〜
rows.re: Kin to the Valerias, descended from / the Magess, the Bernadettes have / fallen on hard times.
rows.speaker: Kanon

rows.en: @If I can provide proof of the blood in me, I can live the life of nobility.
rows.jp: 「この身に流れる血の<b:8a4b>をたてられれば / <b:8a4c><b:8a4d>の生<b:8a4e>ができるんだよ
rows.re: Prove the blood in me, and I can / live a noble's life.
rows.speaker: Kanon

rows.jp: <b:8a4f>てた『あたし』の渡録ではないッ！

rows.en: @If I have the blood of the <Sword Magess> in me, then awaken that |memory.|
rows.jp: 「この身に / ＜剣の少女＞の血が流れているならば / その『渡録』を呼び信ましてくれッ！
rows.re: If the <Sword Magess> blood is in / me, then wake that |memory.|
rows.speaker: Kanon

rows.en: @I will awaken memories regarding Lord Blazer.
rows.jp: 「ロードブレイザーに関する渡録は / 必ず呼び信ましてみせる
rows.re: I will wake the memories of Lord / Blazer.
rows.speaker: Kanon

rows.en: @Be careful you don't get killed by me then.
rows.jp: 「お前はその時に / あたしに<b:8a50>られないよう / 用心しておくがいい
rows.re: Take care I don't kill you when I / do.
rows.speaker: Kanon

rows.en: @They were killed. They were killed, right? And I survived.
rows.jp: 「<b:8a51>った〜 / <b:8a51>ったんだよね〜 / そして、あたしは生き残っている〜
rows.re: They were killed. They were, / weren't they? And I survived.
rows.speaker: Kanon

rows.en: @If I exorcise the monsters, I can become a |hero.|
rows.jp: 「モンスターを<b:8a52>っていけば / あたしは『英雄』になれるんだ
rows.re: If I exorcise the monsters, I can / become a |hero.|
rows.speaker: Kanon

rows.en: @I can become a |hero,| fitting to the blood of the <Sword Magess> flowing in me.
rows.jp: 「身体に流れる＜少女＞の血に / ふさわしい『英雄』に / なれるんだ〜<b:8a55>目〜 / 見えないな〜
rows.re: A |hero| worthy of the <Sword / Magess> blood that flows in me.
rows.speaker: Kanon

rows.en: @Parts of my body won't move. But...I can manage with an artificial arm and leg.
rows.jp: 「身体のあちこちも動かない〜 / いいや〜 / 義手や義足で何とかなる
rows.re: Parts of my body won't move. But I / can manage with an artificial arm / and leg.
rows.speaker: Kanon

rows.en: @I got it. I'll get reborn into a body that knows no pain.
rows.jp: 「そうだ / <b:8a56>みを知らない身体に生まれかわろう
rows.re: I understand. I'll be reborn in a / body that knows no pain.
rows.speaker: Kanon

rows.en: @My body and my name... I will throw away my old self.
rows.jp: 「身体も、名前も〜 / 今までのあたしは / 全部<b:8a4f>ててしまおう〜
rows.re: My body, my name... I cast off my / old self.
rows.speaker: Kanon

rows.en: @This is me. I won't deny it. It's a fact.
rows.jp: 「これが、あたしだ / <b:8a57>定はしない〜 / すべて事実〜
rows.re: This is me. I won't deny it. It's a / fact.
rows.speaker: Kanon

rows.en: @But! The <Sword Magess> blood in my body is a fact too.
rows.jp: 「だがッ！ / この身に流れる＜少女＞の血も / また事実ッ！剣の少女＞の渡録よッ！
rows.re: But! The <Sword Magess> blood in me / is a fact too.
rows.speaker: Kanon

rows.en: @No problem.
rows.re: No problem.
rows.speaker: Kanon

rows.en: @It's been awakened in me, the memory of the <Sword Magess>.
rows.jp: 「だが、あたしの街に呼び信ましたぞ〜 / ＜剣の少女＞の渡録を〜血より呼び信ました / [13]＜剣の少女＞の渡録、それは〜
rows.re: It has woken in me, the memory of / the <Sword Magess.>
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: ...were of the Guardian Blade, the |Argetlahm| in the hands of the goddess.
rows.jp: [13]<8a3e>女の手にしたガーディアンブレード / [13]『アガートラーム』についてであった〜
rows.re: ...concerned the Guardian Blade, / the |Argetlahm,| in the goddess's / hands.
rows.speaker: memory

rows.en: From the |Future| rulers, the Guardian's body was born the sword, the Argetlahm.
rows.jp: [13]『未<b:8a3a>』を<b:8a58>るガーディアンの / [13]身体の一部より生まれし剣 / [13]アガートラーム〜
rows.re: From the |Future| rulers, from a / Guardian's body, the sword / Argetlahm was born.
rows.speaker: memory

rows.en: The sword is a type of spirit response weapon that changes the user's will to battle strength.
rows.jp: [13]<8a59>るう者の意<b:8a5a>を戦う力に<88fb>える / [13]ある<b:8a5b>の概念信応同<b:8a5d>
rows.re: The sword is a spirit-response / weapon that turns the user's will / into fighting strength.
rows.speaker: memory

rows.en: The oppressive power consumes the user's spirit, so one with a strong spirit is chosen.
rows.jp: [13]その圧倒的な力は / [13]使用者の概念を<b:8a5e>らい、<b:8a5f>むため / [13]強<b:8a60>な概念力を作する者を選ぶという
rows.re: Its crushing power consumes the / wielder's spirit, so one of strong / spirit is chosen.
rows.speaker: memory

rows.en: 6 plied the Guardian Blade, Argetlahm, with the strongest of human wills, |desire.|
rows.jp: [13][05]くは / [13]人の持つ最も大きな意<b:8a5a>の力 / [13]『<b:8a61><b:8a62>』をもって / [13]ガーディアンブレード・アガートラームを / [13]<8a59>るったのである欲<b:8a64>だ
rows.re: The Magess wielded the Argetlahm / with the strongest of human wills: / |desire.|
rows.speaker: memory

rows.en: @Sorry to have worried you.
rows.jp: 「心配かけたな
rows.re: Sorry to have worried you.
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.jp: 血より呼び信ました / [13]＜剣の少女＞の渡録、それは〜

rows.en: ...was about the far distant past when Filgaia was burned by the Blaze of Disaster, |Lord Blazer.|
rows.jp: [13]<8995>かな過<b:8a65>において / [13]ファルガイアを焼き尽くさんとした<b:8a68>の<b:8a69><b:8a6a> / [13]『ロードブレイザー』についてであった
rows.re: ...the far distant past, when / Filgaia burned in the Blaze of / Disaster, |Lord Blazer.|
rows.speaker: memory

rows.en: The Demon, Lord Blazer who plies the scorching hell fire by thought, takes in all the wrath, sorrow and negative feelings of people and grows fat as a curse called |God.|
rows.jp: [13]<8a6b><8868>の<b:8a6c>枯を意のままに<b:8a6d>る / [13][89]<b:8b8a>ふロードブレイザー〜 / [13]人の持つ、<b:8a6e>りや<b:8a6f>しみ / [13]あらゆる欲の信情を取り込んで無<b:8a70><b:8a71>大する / [13]『念』と<895b>される<b:8a72>（わざわい）のひとつ
rows.re: Lord Blazer wields hellfire by / thought, feeding on human wrath and / sorrow, swelling into a curse.
rows.speaker: memory

rows.en: Each time the hell fire is waved, 100 wraths, and 1000 sorrows are born surpassing a new threshold.
rows.jp: [13]<8a6c>枯を<b:8a59>るうたびに / [13]<8a73>の<b:8a6e>りと、<b:8a74>の<b:8a6f>しみを生み出し / [13]それを取り込むことで / [13]さらなる<b:8a75><b:8a76>へと幻<b:8a77>していくという
rows.re: Each time the hellfire sweeps, a / hundred wraths and a thousand / sorrows are born anew.
rows.speaker: memory

rows.en: Those possessing flesh and blood, consume flesh and blood to come into being. Those who consume emotions, in other words, |hearts,| take shape that way.
rows.jp: [13]<8a3f><b:8a78>を備えし者は / [13]<8a3f><b:8a78>を<b:8a5e>らい、カタチ為していくのに対し / [13]信情を<b:8a5e>らいし者は / [13]信情<f040><f042> すなわち『心』をもって / [13]カタチを為していく
rows.re: Things of flesh consume flesh to / form. Things of emotion, of / |heart,| take shape the same way.
rows.speaker: memory

rows.en: They destroy beings of similar substance.
rows.jp: [13]そして、そのカタチを<b:8a79>くのは同質の存在<f040><f042>
rows.re: They destroy beings of like / substance.
rows.speaker: memory

rows.en: Physical forms taken by spirits and forms of similar substance also need to be cut by the |Spirit's Blade.|
rows.jp: [13]物質にてカタチ為す者には、同じく物質にて / [13]概念にてカタチ為す者には、やはり<f040><f042> / [13]『概念の<b:8a7a>』にて<b:8a50>りつけるしかない

rows.jp: 「ここは、お前たちのような存在が / <b:8a41>るところではない<b:8a3e>く話 / 「我は、この地の<b:8a42>配者にして / <b:8a43>空を切り<b:8a44>く伝説の<b:8a45>と<895b>されし存在
rows.re: This is no place for inferior / beings like you.
rows.speaker: Lombardia

rows.jp: <b:8a46>数<890a>ぶりであろうか〜

rows.en: @Of course, it appears there are a few non-humans among you as well.
rows.jp: 「〜中には / ニンゲンでないのも / <b:8a47>じっているようだが〜<b:8a48>って / 言葉しゃべれるんだ〜<b:8a49>のみと思うはニンゲンのおごりよ〜
rows.re: Though it seems a few non-humans / stand among you as well.
rows.speaker: Lombardia

rows.en: @Lombardia! Filgaia is currently being...
rows.jp: 「ロンバルディアッ！ / 今、このファルガイアは<f040><f042>
rows.re: Lombardia! Filgaia is even now / being consumed...
rows.speaker: refugee

rows.en: @It's the same as when the Dragon Dimension we lived in was consumed.
rows.jp: 「そう、我らがすまう / ドラゴン更元が<b:8a4a>まれた / あの時と〜<b:8a48>
rows.re: It's the same as when the Dragon / Dimension we lived in was devoured.
rows.speaker: refugee

rows.en: @Our homeland was originally a different |universe.|
rows.jp: 「その故<b:8a4b>は、単の更元に存在する / 『世界』である
rows.re: Our homeland was once a different / |universe.|
rows.speaker: refugee

rows.en: @But our world was swallowed in a wave of consumption and many were lost forever.
rows.jp: 「だが、我らの世界もまた / 侵食のうねりにのみこまれ / <b:8a4c>間の多くを<b:8a4d>遠に失うこととなった〜
rows.re: But our world was swallowed by a / wave of consumption, and many were / lost forever.
rows.speaker: refugee

rows.en: @The few who were able to change dimensions arrived but couldn't adapt, and simply rotted away.
rows.jp: 「更元を飛び<b:8a4e>えることのできた / <b:8a4f>かな同<b:8a50>が、単の世界に逃げ<b:8a51>びたものの / <b:8a52><b:8a53>に<b:8a54>応できずに<b:8a55>ちていった〜<b:8a56>してほしいッ！
rows.re: The few who crossed dimensions here / couldn't adapt, and simply withered / away.
rows.speaker: refugee

rows.en: @We are fighting to stop the encroachment on this universe.
rows.jp: 「俺たちは / 世界が侵食されていくのを阻止するために / 戦っているんだッ！
rows.re: We fight to halt the encroachment / on this universe.
rows.speaker: refugee

rows.en: @...much less human beings, a lower lifeform.
rows.jp: 「ましてや / 矮小なるニンゲンの存在などが / そのようなこと<f040><f042><b:8a57>小確<b:8a58>だ<b:8a59>力更<88f9>で / いくらでも広がるッ！
rows.re: ...let alone humans, a lower / lifeform.
rows.speaker: Lombardia

rows.en: @Right?
rows.jp: 「そうだよね？
rows.re: Right?
rows.speaker: refugee

rows.en: @We want your help, Lombardia!
rows.jp: 「手を<b:8a56>してほしい / ロンバルディアッ！<b:8a5a>件がある
rows.re: We ask for your help, Lombardia!
rows.speaker: refugee

rows.en: @I want to witness with my own eyes the power of humans struggling to overcome the odds.
rows.jp: 「<b:8a57>小確<b:8a58>を手にしようとする / ニンゲンの力を / この目に見させてもらうとしよう
rows.re: I would see with my own eyes the / power of humans who struggle / against the odds.
rows.speaker: Lombardia

rows.en: @If I see a glimmer of possibility, a light, in your strength, you may use my wings as you wish.
rows.jp: 「その力の向こうに / 我が可能性という輝を見出せたなら / この<b:8a45>、自由にするがよい
rows.re: Show me a glimmer of possibility, / and you may use my wings as you / wish.
rows.speaker: Lombardia

rows.en: @I am Lombardia. No matter what powers you display, they'll never reach me.
rows.jp: 「我はロンバルディア / どれほどの力を示そうと / 続きはせぬ〜
rows.re: I am Lombardia. Whatever power you / show, it will never reach me.
rows.speaker: Lombardia

rows.en: @But why? Why?
rows.jp: 「なのに、なぜなのだッ！
rows.re: But why? Why?
rows.speaker: Lilka

rows.en: @If I gave up so easily, Sis would laugh at me.
rows.jp: 「カンタンにあきらめたら / お<b:8a5b>ちゃんに<b:8a5c>われちゃう<b:8a5d><88e0>が / 休枯谷を<b:8a5e><88f1>したかッ！<b:8a5f>ッ！
rows.re: If I gave up so easily, Sis would / laugh at me.
rows.speaker: Lilka

rows.lit: Do you want to proceed?
rows.re: Do you want to proceed?

rows.en: @Unfortunately, this service is unavailable in the Demo Version.
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>でも、今回の体験版では / 残念ながら使用することができません<b:8b60>[01][03]に[06]＊この不思議な物体は / セーブポイントと呼ば
rows.lit: But in this trial version, it unfortunately cannot be used.
rows.re: But in this trial version, it / unfortunately cannot be used.
