rows.en: *Unfortunately, this service is unavailable in the Demo Version.
rows.jp: ＊〜ですが、今回の体験版では / 残念ながら使用することができません
rows.lit: ...however, in this trial version it unfortunately cannot be used.
rows.re: ...however, in this trial version, / it unfortunately cannot be used.
rows.speaker: system/prompt

rows.en: @I feel really happy just like this.
rows.jp: 「こうしているだけで / すごく左せな気持ちになれるの…
rows.re: I feel happy, just like this.

rows.en: @When I think about 3, my chest constricts. It's quite painful.
rows.jp: 「[05]がくんのことを考えると / <89e5>がキュッと右め付けられて / 苦しくなるの
rows.re: When I think of {3}, my chest / aches. It really hurts.

rows.en: @Could it really be....? It can't be, but it makes me so happy.
rows.jp: 「もしかして、もしかするのかしら？ / そんなぁ… / でも、うれしいな<f044>
rows.re: Could it really be? It can't, and / yet it makes me so happy.

rows.en: @When I'm with {3}, I feel calm and relieved, while at the same time I'm wildly excited.
rows.jp: 「それに、[0a]がのそばにいると / すごくホッとするんだ / 同時に、すごくドキドキもしてる
rows.re: With {3}, I feel calm and at ease, / and wildly alive all at once.

rows.en: @I think the |present,| the time I now spend with {3} is important time for me.
rows.jp: 「きっと、[0a]がと一発にいる / 『現在（いま）』は、俺にとって / とても大切な時なんだと思う
rows.re: This |present,| my time with {3}, / is precious time to me.

rows.en: @Me too. I like the |present| time I spend with 3 too.
rows.jp: 「私も、[05]がくんと一発にいる / 『現在（いま）』がとても好き<f044>
rows.re: Me too. I treasure the |present| / time I spend with {3}.

rows.en: @I want to protect you from all hardship and pain.
rows.jp: 「俺はキミを守りたい… / どんな<b:8a3a>しみからも<b:8a3b>難からも
rows.re: I want to shield you from every / hardship and hurt.

rows.en: @It's because you are the most important woman (person) to me.
rows.jp: 「キミが俺にとって / 一番大切な『女性（ひと）』だから<f05b>守りたい、そう想う気持ちが / 俺を少しずつ強くしてくれたんだ
rows.re: Because you're the most important / person in the world to me.

rows.en: @I've learned that thinking of someone other than myself is very powerful.
rows.jp: 「自分の為でなく / 大切な人を思いやる気持ちは / とてもとても大きな力なんだって知ったよ
rows.re: I've learned how strong it makes / you to think of someone besides / yourself.

rows.en: @I mean, I've become this strong all because of {3}.
rows.jp: 「だって俺が… / ここまで強くなれたのは / [0a]がのおかげだから
rows.re: I mean, I grew this strong entirely / because of {3}.

rows.en: @To be honest, I don't want to fight, but in order to protect what I have |now,| I will fight.
rows.jp: 「本当は、戦うことは好きじゃないよ / でも、『現在（いま）』を守るためなら / 俺は戦える好き』になるっていう / 気持ちなのかな
rows.re: Truth is, I hate fighting. But to / protect what I have |now,| I'll / fight.

rows.en: @I feel so warm. I'll fight to protect you. My heart must be stronger.
rows.jp: 「心がとても<88f2>かくて… / キミを守るためなら戦える… / 俺の心は、きっと強くなったんだ<b:8a3d> / 「その想いは / 力へと至り、<b:8a3e>愛となりて我へと続く
rows.re: I feel so warm. I'll fight to / protect you. My heart has to be / stronger.

rows.en: @The long extinct desire has been reawakened by the one who hasn't forgotten |love.|
rows.jp: 「<89aa>しく絶えし想い〜 / 我を呼び信ますは、『愛』を忘れぬ者よ
rows.re: A long-dead desire, rekindled by / one who never forgot |love.|

rows.en: @If what you desire is each other's hearts, you best stop me.
rows.jp: 「<b:8a40>めるのが<b:8a41>いの心ならば / 我を<b:8a42>け止めるがいい
rows.re: If it's each other's hearts you / want, you'd best stop me.

rows.en: @When hardship confronts you two, my power will become a ceaseless tie that will have you rid it all.
rows.jp: 「置人の前に、あらゆる苦難が立ちはだかる時 / 我が威力、果てぬ<b:8a43>となりて / 全てを<b:8a44>けてみせようぞ
rows.re: When hardship befalls you two, my / power will bind you together, / unbroken.

rows.en: @I am Raftina, the Guardian Lord who guards people's hearts and Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「我が名はラフティーナ〜 / 人の心とファルガイアを守護せし / ガーディアンロード『ラフティーナ』〜
rows.re: I am Raftina, Guardian Lord of the / human heart and of Filgaia.

rows.en: @Love's embrace will become a gentle enveloping strength.
rows.jp: 「『愛』の<b:8a45><b:8a46>にて / <89ab>しく<b:8a47>み込む力とならん〜英雄』は…… / 力を重ねる『象徴』であればいい
rows.re: Love's embrace becomes a gentle, / enfolding strength.

rows.en: @I am beginning to understand your true feelings.
rows.jp: 「そういったお前の、本当の気持ちが / 少しだけだが、分かりかけてきた
rows.re: I'm beginning to grasp your true / feelings.

rows.en: @Strictly speaking, you just might reach a different conclusion.
rows.jp: 「厳<b:8a4c>にいうと / それとも違った結<b:8a4d>に / 至ったのかもしれない<b:8a4d>？
rows.re: Strictly speaking, you might reach / a different conclusion.

rows.en: @We don't have a need for |heroes| anymore. That's what I believe now.
rows.jp: 「『英雄』なんてものは / 存在する必要なんてないのではないか / そう思うようになってきた英雄』は不要な存在ということか？
rows.re: We don't need |heroes| anymore. / That's what I believe now.

rows.en: @A |hero| isn't bestowed on you, nor can they be relied on. Nor do they have shape.
rows.jp: 「『英雄』なんていうのは / <b:8a4e>えてくれるモノでも、頼るモノでもない / ましてや、面のあるモノでもない
rows.re: A |hero| isn't granted, can't be / leaned on, and has no fixed shape.

rows.en: @But a |hero| exists in the hearts of anyone who tries to accomplish something.
rows.jp: 「だが、なにかを成そうとする / 全ての人々の心の中に / 『英雄』は存在するもの
rows.re: But a |hero| lives in the heart of / anyone who strives to achieve.

rows.en: @...essentially what you meant when you said a hero should be a symbol.
rows.jp: 「お前のいった / 『英雄』は『象徴』であるべきだという / 本質はそこにあるのではないのか？
rows.re: ...which is what you meant, saying / a hero should be a symbol.

rows.en: @If that's what you think, it must be right.
rows.jp: 「お前がそう思ってくれるなら / きっと、そうなんだよ
rows.re: If that's what you think, it must / be so.

rows.en: @For you to say that, you, the one who knows me best, means...
rows.jp: 「僕を一番知って、理解してくれるお前が / そういってくれるのだから英雄』なんていうものは…
rows.re: For you, who knows me best, to say / it, means...

rows.en: @...isn't just a convenient, powerful being that always saves people from serious danger.
rows.jp: 「絶対の危機を、いつでも助けてくれる / <b:8a4f>利で<8979>能な存在などではないッ！英雄』が『象徴』である必要…
rows.re: ...not some convenient power that / always saves people from ruin.

rows.en: @...to show everyone that they possess within themselves similar powers.
rows.jp: 「それは、全ての人々に / 同じ力が備わっていることを知らしめる / <b:8a50>であるからだ勇気』ッ！<b:8a52>えてくれたのが / いまの<b:8a53>間たちか？<b:8a52>えてくれたようなものだ
rows.re: ...but to show all people they hold / that same power within.

rows.en: @They've continued to fight of their own will and strength rather than rely on the |Hero of Slayheim.|
rows.jp: 「彼らは『スレイハイムの英雄』に / 頼るでも、すがるでもなく / 自分たちの意志と力で戦い続けている
rows.re: They fought on by their own will / and strength, not leaning on a / |Hero.|

rows.en: @They may not realize this, but they have become |heroes| themselves.
rows.jp: 「自分でも気づいていないかもしれない / しかし、彼らは間違いなく / 自分たちの『英雄』を手に入れている
rows.re: They may not see it, but they've / become |heroes| themselves.

rows.en: @And when this is repeated by others, then |heroes| really will no longer be necessary.
rows.jp: 「そしてそれが、全ての人々に広がるとき / 本当の意<b:8a55>で、『英雄』は不要になる<b:8a56>せてよかった…
rows.re: And when others do the same, / |heroes| truly won't be needed.

rows.en: @You're my |hero.|
rows.jp: 「僕にとっての『英雄』は / お前だったのだから英雄』、それは… / 『勇気』を招き出すの為の、意志の体現ッ！
rows.re: You're my |hero.|

rows.en: @Shake off doubts and step forward. Follow the road indicated with the spiritual strength to never lose.
rows.jp: 「政いを<b:8a57>り<b:8a58>い、<b:8a59>み出し / 進むべき道を示す<b:8a50>… / 何者にも<b:8a5a>けない心の力ッ！<b:8a5b>家王 / 「その想いは / 力へと至り、<b:8a50>となりて我へと続く
rows.re: Shake off doubt and step forward. / Follow the road your spirit shows.

rows.en: @The long extinct desire has been reawakened by the one who hasn't forgotten |courage.|
rows.jp: 「<89aa>しく絶えし想い〜 / 我を呼び信ますは、『勇気』を忘れぬ者よ
rows.re: A long-dead desire, rekindled by / one who never forgot |courage.|

rows.en: @If what you desire is strength of heart, you best stop me.
rows.jp: 「<b:8a40>めるのが心の強さならば / 我を<b:8a42>け止めるがいい
rows.re: If it's strength of heart you want, / you'd best stop me.

rows.en: @When confusion clouds your path, my power becomes the sword to crush the universe and solve the problem.
rows.jp: 「進むべき道を、政い<b:8a5c>みし時 / 我が威力、<b:8a5d>地を<b:8a5e>く<b:8a5f>と為りて / 一<b:8a60><b:8a61>断して見せようぞ〜
rows.re: When confusion clouds your path, my / power is the sword to cleave it / open.

rows.en: @I am Justine, the Guardian Lord who guards people's hearts and Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「我が名はジャスティーン〜 / 人の心とファルガイアを守護せし / ガーディアンロード『ジャスティーン』〜
rows.re: I am Justine, Guardian Lord of the / human heart and of Filgaia.

rows.en: @The sword of courage will make the heart full of strength.
rows.jp: 「『勇気』の<b:8a62>にて / 強き心の力とならん〜
rows.re: The sword of courage fills the / heart with strength.

rows.en: @It's you, yourself, right?
rows.jp: 「キミ自身なんだろ？
rows.re: It's you yourself, isn't it?

rows.en: @I never doubted that days like this would continue.
rows.jp: 「こんな回が続いていくと / 信じて<b:8a63>わなかった
rows.re: I never doubted these days would go / on.

rows.en: @An ordinary daily life is going to continue ordinary forever.
rows.jp: 「ごくあたり前の回世が / ごくあたり前に〜、永遠にあるのよ来ないでッ！ / 永遠を滅さないでッ！
rows.re: That an ordinary life would stay / ordinary forever.

rows.en: @To wound and be wounded... How can something so scary happen on a regular basis?
rows.jp: 「<b:8a66>つけて、<b:8a66>つけられて / そんな乗いことが / どうして<b:8a67>通におこなわれていくの？
rows.re: To wound and be wounded... how / could that be an everyday thing?

rows.en: @I just want to be with 0.
rows.jp: 「わたしは、ただ / [05]ぉといたいの
rows.re: I just want to be with {0}.

rows.en: @Fighting is to protect eternity and for the time when I didn't know 0.
rows.jp: 「戦うことなんて / 知らなかった頃の[05]ぉと / 『永遠』を守っていきたいの
rows.re: I fight to protect this forever, / and the days before I knew {0}.

rows.en: @For nothing to change, for everything to stay as the |eternity| from before...
rows.jp: 「何も変わらないまま / すべてがあの頃の、『永遠』を〜望んでいるのか
rows.re: For nothing to change, for it all / to stay the |eternity| it was...

rows.en: @Do you want to believe that eternity is when nothing changes?
rows.jp: 「何も変わらないことを / 『永遠』と信じていたいのか？
rows.re: Do you believe eternity means / nothing ever changes?

rows.en: @Times change and evolve. We are forever encountering moments of continual change.
rows.jp: 「時は移ろい、流れていく〜 / 俺たちは、絶えない変合の<b:8a69>間に / 連続して乗れているだけなんだ
rows.re: Times shift and grow. We meet / endless moments of change.

rows.en: @This could cause despair, or it could lead to a different response.
rows.jp: 「その中で、絶望することもあるけれど / それだけじゃないはずだ
rows.re: That could bring despair, or it / could bring a different answer.

rows.en: @It's possible to want to see how the world turns out, to see what the future will bring.
rows.jp: 「未来を<f040><f042> / もっとその先の世界を見たくなるような / 望みだって生まれてくるはずだよ
rows.re: You can long to see how the world / turns out, what tomorrow brings.

rows.en: @That's what I believe.
rows.jp: 「俺は、そう信じている望み〜？
rows.re: That's what I believe.

rows.en: @The power to wish for tomorrow. The power to wish for a day you have not yet seen.
rows.jp: 「また、次回が来てほしいと思う力〜 / 見たことのない次回を / 待ちどおしいと思える力だよ永遠』の中には見つからないよ
rows.re: The power to wish for tomorrow. To / wish for a day not yet seen.

rows.jp: [17]<b:8a52>えてくれたもの

rows.en: @My wanting to be with 0 is not in |eternity.|
rows.jp: 「わたしが[05]ぉといたいのは / 『永遠』の中なんかじゃない
rows.re: My wish to be with {0} doesn't live / in |eternity.|

rows.en: @Forever, for sure and ever more! From now on, we'll always be together.
rows.jp: 「ずっと、きっと、〜もっとッ！ / これから先、いつまでもいっしょに〜
rows.re: Forever and always! From now on, we / will always be together.

rows.en: @That's right. Hope is on the other side of this moment, far away from |eternity.|
rows.jp: 「そうよね / 望みは、この<b:8a69>間の向こう<89f5> / 『永遠』の<8995>か遠くに望みは<f040><f042> / そう、『<b:8a6a>望』は、いつも未来に〜<b:8a6b><b:8a3d> / 「その想いは / 力へと至り、輝となりて我へと続く
rows.re: Right. Hope lies just past this / moment, far from |eternity.|

rows.en: @The long, extinct desire has been awakened by one who remembers hope. Stop me if you seek the future.
rows.jp: 「<89aa>しく絶えし想い〜 / 我を呼び信ますは、『<b:8a6a>望』を忘れぬ者よ / <b:8a40>めるのが未来ならば、我を<b:8a42>け止めるがいい
rows.re: A long-dead desire, rekindled by / one who remembers hope. Stop me if / you see it.

rows.en: @When dark clouds block tomorrow, my power will become a westerly wind to pierce and dispel it.
rows.jp: 「立ち込める暗<b:8a6c>、次回を閉ざす時 / 我が威力、駆け抜ける東<89f9>となって / はらして見せようぞ〜
rows.re: When dark clouds hide tomorrow, my / power is the west wind to scatter / them.

rows.en: @I am Zephyr, the Guardian Lord who guards people's hearts and Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「我が名はゼファー〜 / 人の心とファルガイアを守護せし / ガーディアンロード『ゼファー』〜
rows.re: I am Zephyr, Guardian Lord of the / human heart and of Filgaia.

rows.en: @Hope's light will become the power to expand the future.
rows.jp: 「『<b:8a6a>望』の輝にて / 未来を<b:8a6d>く力とならん〜
rows.re: Hope's light becomes the power to / widen the future.

rows.jp: 「人々の心は / やがて国<b:8a4f>間を<b:8a50>えて結ばれていった / それはキミたちも知ったはずだ

rows.re: To oppose the Kuiper Belt, every / nation set policies to fight it / together.

rows.re: The Mana prison, Trapezohedron, / couldn't have been raised without / that unity.

rows.jp: 「その思惑の<b:8a54>で、<b:8a55>ついた者もいるッ！ / 命を落としたものだっているッ！<b:8a56>の未<b:8a57>を守るためなのだ<b:8a59><b:8a5a>にすることなんて俺にはできない

rows.en: @If I could have gotten the power to fight, I'd have...
rows.jp: 「私だって / 戦う力を手にすることができたなら〜
rows.re: Had I gained the power to fight, / I'd have...

rows.en: @If I could have gotten the Argetlahm, I would have taken such measures.
rows.jp: 「アガートラームを / 手にすることができたなら / このような手<b:8a5b>はとらなかった
rows.re: Had I drawn the Argetlahm, I'd have / taken those same measures.

rows.en: @But without becoming a |hero,| I won't be able to save Filgaia!
rows.jp: 「<f040><f041>だが、『<b:8a5c><b:8a5d>』にならなくては / ファルガイアを守ることができないのだッ！
rows.re: But without becoming a |hero,| I / can't save Filgaia!

rows.en: @We all were able to save Filgaia, right?
rows.jp: 「みんなでファルガイアを / 救ったんだよね？<b:8a5f>しいんだろう〜<b:8a5e>ったから、ボクたちは / まちがってなんかないんですよね？<b:8a5e>ったからまちがってない』 / <f040><f042>と、いうことは無い
rows.re: We all saved Filgaia together, / didn't we?

rows.en: @That's all there is to it.
rows.jp: 「ただ、それだけだ<b:8a5e>ったのでも / <b:8a60>けたのでもない〜
rows.re: That's all there is to it.

rows.en: @Where? Where are you? Show yourself!
rows.jp: 「どこだッ！ / どこにいるッ！ / <b:8a61>を見せろッ！再び『<b:8a63>』に封じた〜 / これで滅ぼすべき<b:8a64>体を得た事になる〜
rows.re: Where? Where are you? Show / yourself!

rows.en: @But the Kuiper Belt gushed out of the vessel and now, Filgaia itself is...
rows.jp: 「だが、カイバーベルトは / 『<b:8a63>』よりあふれ出て / 今や、ファルガイアそのもの<f040><f042>
rows.re: But the Kuiper Belt burst from the / vessel, and now Filgaia itself / is...

rows.re: Its roots have split and spread / even to the Guardian of Mud, Glaive / Le Gable.

rows.jp: 「このままでは、いくら本体を<b:8a68>撃しようと / 左からエネルギーを取り込み / 無<b:8a69>に再生を<b:8a6a>り返しかねない〜
rows.re: At this rate, hit the body all we / like, the roots keep feeding it / energy.

rows.en: @First, the three roots extending out from the Kuiper Belt must be cut and their regeneration stopped.
rows.jp: 「まずは、カイバーベルトより<b:8a6c>びた / 三本の左を断ち、再生を阻止するのだ〜
rows.re: First we must cut the three roots / and stop them regenerating.

rows.en: @I pray for the safety and success of the ARMS members.
rows.jp: 「ＡＲＭＳの貴様らの / <b:8a6e><b:8a6f>を<b:8a70>る〜
rows.re: I pray for the ARMS members' safety / and success.

rows.en: @Do this while my |will| keeps all of the Kuiper Belt from spilling out of the vessel.
rows.jp: 「私の意<b:8a71>が、『<b:8a63>』より / すべてのカイバーベルトが飛び出すのを / 置さえつけているあいだに<f040><f042>〜

rows.en: @All I can do is believe what {0} told me.
rows.jp: 「〜[0a]ぉが伝えた言葉を / 信じるしかないな〜
rows.re: All I can do is believe what {0} / told me.

rows.en: @It's necessary to cut these three roots to destroy the main body of the Kuiper Belt.
rows.jp: 「カイバーベルトの本体を倒すには / 三本の左を断つ必要があるようだ〜
rows.re: We must cut these three roots to / destroy the Kuiper Belt's core.

rows.en: @Let's split the party into four now!
rows.jp: 「ここで、パーティーを / よっつに分けようッ！
rows.re: Let's split the party into four!

rows.en: @Separate units will attack each root and the fourth unit will attack the main body.
rows.jp: 「それぞれの左を断つための単<b:8a72>隊三人と / 本体を<b:8a73>つパーティーに〜
rows.re: Three units strike the roots, the / fourth strikes the main body.

rows.re: Route A / Route B / Route C

rows.jp: 「だから、俺は後戻りはしないッ！
rows.re: I'm not turning back, OK?

rows.en: @To protect tomorrow, we can't allow anyone to go back.
rows.jp: 「僕たちは、次回という回を守るため / 後戻りは許されないッ！
rows.re: To protect tomorrow, we can't let / anyone turn back.

rows.jp: ＊火の魔法で火をおこし<b:8a53>をとり / 氷の魔法でモノを<b:8a54>らせることで保存したり / そういった使われ方をするべきなのである

rows.en: @There's a good chance terrorists are hiding in the mountains here!
rows.jp: 「この谷に / テロリストが発<b:8a38>している / 可能性がありますッ！
rows.lit: There's a chance the terrorists are lurking in this valley!
rows.re: There's a chance the terrorists / are lurking in this valley!
rows.speaker: party

rows.en: @Not a monster confronting humans.
rows.jp: 「モンスターなんかじゃない / 立ちはだかる、人間<b:8a39>』が<b:8a3a>えてくれたんだとよ
rows.lit: Not a monster; it's humans standing in our way.
rows.re: Not a monster; it's humans / standing in our way.
rows.speaker: party

rows.en: @She said someone's been following us.
rows.jp: 「何者かが / 僕方たちの跡をつけてきてるってな<b:8a3b><b:8a3c><b:8a3d><f040><f042> / まだ、だったよな〜<b:8a3e>らなきゃいけないとはな
rows.lit: She said someone's been tailing us.
rows.re: She said someone's been tailing / us.
rows.speaker: party

rows.en: @You were very lucky your opponent was sweet ol' innocent me.
rows.jp: 「よかったな、おめェら / やさしー、僕方が相手でよ
rows.lit: Lucky you lot; your opponent's sweet ol' innocent me.
rows.re: Lucky you lot; your opponent's / sweet ol' innocent me.
rows.speaker: Ptolomea

rows.lit: (snoring) zzz... zzz... zzz...
rows.re: zzz... zzz... zzz...
rows.speaker: sleeper

rows.en: @We're the Odessa Special Unit |Ptolomea and His Fun Friends!|
rows.jp: 「オデッサ結戦隊 / 『トロメア方とゆかいな<b:8a46>間たち』だッ！<b:8a47><b:8a48>の<b:8a49>使い / 「ふざけるなよ、トロメア<b:8a4a>の剣 / 「それにしても / こいつら生かしておくの？
rows.lit: Odessa's special forces: "Ptolomea and His Merry Companions"!
rows.re: Odessa's special forces: / |Ptolomea and His Merry / Companions|!
rows.speaker: Ptolomea

rows.en: @Weren't they that other group who was trespassing in Illsveil?
rows.jp: 「俺たち以外に / イルズベイルに侵入したの / たしか、こいつらだったよな〜
rows.lit: The ones besides us who broke into Illsveil; that was this bunch, wasn't it.
rows.re: The ones besides us who broke / into Illsveil; that was this / bunch, wasn't it.
rows.speaker: Ptolomea

rows.en: @Are they some vigilante force from a small town? There were girls in their group too.
rows.jp: 「どこかの場の自<892c>団かな？ / 女の家が<b:8a4b>じっているみたいだけど〜
rows.lit: Some town's vigilante band, maybe? There seem to be a couple of girls mixed in.
rows.re: Some town's vigilante band, / maybe? There seem to be a couple / of girls mixed in.
rows.speaker: Cocytus member

rows.en: @Should we shoot them here on the spot? We've got time to kill until the Varukisas heats up.
rows.jp: 「何だったら / この場で<b:8a4c><b:8a4d>しちゃおうか？ / バルキサスの<b:8a4e>気が終るまで<b:8a4f><b:8a50>だし<b:8a48>の女性 / 「〜ムダな<b:8a4d>生はやめて / 何度言ったらわかるの？
rows.lit: If you like, shall we just shoot them here on the spot? We've time to kill till the Varukisas warms up.
rows.re: If you like, shall we just shoot / them here? We've time to kill / till the Varukisas warms up.
rows.speaker: Cocytus member

rows.lit: (snoring) zzz... zzz... zzz...
rows.re: zzz... zzz... zzz...
rows.speaker: sleeper

rows.en: @Looks like Varukisas is ready for departure. Let's go.
rows.jp: 「バルキサスの離陸準備 / 完了したみたいよ / <f040><f042>行きましょう〜<b:8a51>りをまだ<8994>ませていないぜ
rows.lit: Looks like the Varukisas's launch prep is done; let's go.
rows.re: Looks like the Varukisas's launch / prep is done; let's go.
rows.speaker: Cocytus member

rows.en: @There's the four of us. Odessa's Special |Cocytus| Corp.
rows.jp: 「僕方たち、４人 / オデッサ結戦隊『コキュートス』ッ！
rows.lit: The four of us; Odessa's special forces "Cocytus"!
rows.re: The four of us; Odessa's special / forces |Cocytus|!
rows.speaker: Ptolomea

rows.en: @We're broadcasting clandestinely! Since we didn't have contact, let's at least do some bold propaganda.
rows.jp: 「<8934><88e0>ジャックじゃ / 僕方たちのこと乗れられなかったからな / せいぜい、ハデに<b:8a52>伝をたのむぜ
rows.lit: The broadcast hijack didn't get us noticed, so at least do us the favor of some flashy publicity.
rows.re: The broadcast hijack didn't get / us noticed, so at least do us / some flashy publicity.
rows.speaker: Ptolomea

rows.en: @Ha. Ha. Ha.
rows.jp: 「がっはっはっはっはッ！<b:8a53>く話 / 「手を<b:8a54>ばせば、続くぞ〜 / 力さえあればな〜
rows.lit: Gwahahahaha!
rows.re: Gwahahahaha!
rows.speaker: Ptolomea

rows.en: @up ahead in the old excavation site known as |The Withered Ruins.|
rows.jp: 「通<895b>『<b:8a38>れた遺跡』に / 立てこもっているとの情報が入った
rows.lit: We've had word they've holed up in the excavation site known as "The Withered Ruins."
rows.re: We've had word they've holed up / in the site known as |The / Withered Ruins|.
rows.speaker: party

rows.en: @Time for the final mission check!
rows.jp: 「これより、ミッションの最終確認を行うッ！<b:8a39><b:8a3a>しだいでは / 選抜のチャンスもあるらしいけど〜）
rows.lit: We will now conduct the final mission check!
rows.re: We will now conduct the final / mission check!
rows.speaker: Commander

rows.en: @What's your name?
rows.jp: 「新入りッ！ お前の名はッ！
rows.lit: Newbie! Your name?!
rows.re: Newbie! Your name?!
rows.speaker: Commander

rows.en: @Don't get in the way, understand, 0?!
rows.jp: 「隊の足をひっぱるなよ / わかったか、[05]ぉッ！<b:8a3b><b:8a3c>の任務は / 犯人の立てこもる遺跡街に突入<f040><f042>
rows.lit: Don't drag the squad down. Got it, {0}?!
rows.re: Don't drag the squad down. Got it, / {0}?!
rows.speaker: Commander

rows.en: @It's critical to secure the safety of the hostage first.
rows.jp: 「すみやかに人質の安全を / 確保するところにある
rows.lit: [The objective] is to swiftly secure the hostage's safety.
rows.re: [The objective] is to swiftly / secure the hostage's safety.
rows.speaker: Commander

rows.en: @Numerous monsters have been sighted at the ruins, so don't let your guard down.
rows.jp: 「遺跡街には / 多年のモンスターも確認されている / <b:8a3d>自、気を抜いてかかるなよ
rows.lit: Numerous monsters are confirmed in the ruins district too. Each of you, don't let your guard down.
rows.re: Numerous monsters are confirmed in / the ruins district too. Each of / you, don't let your guard down.
rows.speaker: Commander

rows.en: @OK. Let's go. Charge!
rows.jp: 「よし、突入開始だッ！<b:8a3e>胞 / 「隊長、遺跡街にて / 大型の生体反応を確認
rows.lit: All right, begin the assault!
rows.re: All right, begin the assault!
rows.speaker: Commander

rows.en: @Most likely, the trapped monster was released by accident!
rows.jp: 「おそらく、封印されていたモンスターが / 何らかの事故で / 解放されたのではないかとッ！
rows.lit: Most likely a sealed monster was set loose by some accident!
rows.re: Most likely a sealed monster was / set loose by some accident!
rows.speaker: Radar Technician

rows.en: @Unfortunately, highly volatile liquid explosives have been found in the monster's secretions.
rows.jp: 「最悪なことに / モンスターから分泌される体液に / 揮発性の高い液体燃料も検出されました
rows.lit: Worst of all, the fluid the monster secretes tested as a highly volatile liquid fuel.
rows.re: Worst of all, the fluid the monster / secretes tested as a highly / volatile liquid fuel.
rows.speaker: Radar Technician

rows.en: @Commander, at this rate...
rows.jp: 「隊長〜 / このままでは〜<b:8a46>を伝えろッ！
rows.lit: Commander... at this rate...
rows.re: Commander... at this rate...
rows.speaker: Radar Technician

rows.en: @A huge explosion is possible, so we can't handle it above ground.
rows.jp: 「広周囲の燃発が考えられる以上 / 処理を地上で行うわけにはいかん
rows.lit: With an explosion of the whole area possible, we can't deal with it above ground.
rows.re: With an explosion of the whole area / possible, we can't deal with it / above ground.
rows.speaker: Radar Technician

rows.en: @To minimize casualties, we must destroy the entire ruins at once.
rows.jp: 「<889a><889b>を最小限に抑えるためにも / 遺跡街で一気に壊滅するッ！
rows.lit: To keep casualties to a minimum, we wipe out the ruins district in one blow!
rows.re: To keep casualties to a minimum, we / wipe out the ruins district in one / blow!
rows.speaker: Commander, the order

rows.en: @Release the safety on the large ARM.
rows.jp: 「いざという時のために / 大型アームのセーフティを解除しておけ
rows.lit: Just in case, take the large ARM off safety.
rows.re: Just in case, take the large ARM / off safety.
rows.speaker: Commander

rows.en: @I'll authorize the use of the Rail Gun.
rows.jp: 「『リニアレールキャノン』の使用許<88b5>は / 僕から出しておく<b:8a3e>胞 / 「遺跡街で壊滅ですか？
rows.lit: I'll issue the authorization for the "Linear Rail Cannon" myself.
rows.re: I'll issue the authorization for / the "Linear Rail Cannon" myself.
rows.speaker: Commander

rows.en: @But we still have soldiers left in the ruins.
rows.jp: 「しかし遺跡街には / まだ多くの隊左が残っています
rows.lit: But there are still many soldiers left in the ruins district.
rows.re: But there are still many soldiers / left in the ruins district.
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @It's possible the monster could escape before all of them evacuate.
rows.jp: 「彼ら全左の待員前に / モンスターが外に / 出てしまうかもしれません
rows.lit: The monster may get outside before all of them can evacuate.
rows.re: The monster may get outside before / all of them can evacuate.
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @By destroying the ruins, some soldiers won't escape in time. Are you going to let them die?
rows.jp: 「遺跡街で壊滅するためには / 彼らの待員が間に合いません… / <f040><f042>彼らを<8812>き込むつもりですかッ！
rows.lit: To level the ruins now, their evacuation won't finish in time... You mean to catch them in it?!
rows.re: To level the ruins now, their / evacuation won't finish in time... / You mean to catch them in it?!
rows.speaker: Ashley, the moral crux

rows.en: @I'll take full responsibility.
rows.jp: 「責任は、僕が持つ
rows.lit: I'll bear the responsibility.
rows.re: I'll bear the responsibility.
rows.speaker: Commander

rows.en: @I am prepared for my reprimand.
rows.jp: 「〜信念はできています
rows.lit: ...My mind is made up. (lit. my conviction is set)
rows.re: ...My mind is made up. (lit. my / conviction is set)
rows.speaker: Commander

rows.en: @Your punishment for this incident will be forthcoming! Until then, you're under house-arrest!
rows.jp: 「今回の件の処加については / おってくだされるッ！ / それまでは自宅謹慎だッ！ いいかッ！<b:8a56>か？<b:8a46>違反にしかならなかった[16]くぉ[16]くぉ[16]くぉ[16]くぉ[16]
rows.speaker: — house arrest (aftermath, EN retained

rows.lit: Do you want to proceed?
rows.re: Do you want to proceed?

rows.re: ...however, in this trial version, / it unfortunately cannot be used.
rows.speaker: system: demo notice

rows.en: @Haven't you heard the plan?
rows.jp: 「〜手はずを / 聞いていないのか？
rows.lit: Haven't you been told the plan?
rows.re: Haven't you been told the plan?
rows.speaker: ally

rows.en: @Looks like we've finally been able to meet safely.
rows.jp: 「どうやら無事に / 出右えたようだな
rows.lit: Looks like we managed to meet up safely.
rows.re: Looks like we managed to meet up / safely.
rows.speaker: ally

rows.en: @|Everything is going according to your plan.| Is that what you were hoping?
rows.jp: 「すべては / あなたの特乗どおり〜 / <f040><f042>と、いうわけですか〜？
rows.lit: So everything went just as you planned; is that it?

rows.en: @No power means that there's a slave unit that hasn't been started, yet.
rows.jp: 「<8934><8869>が入らないと言うことは / まだ起動していない / 家機があるということだな

rows.en: @...means we need to check all of the slave units.
rows.jp: 「っていうことは / 家機を全部チェックしなきゃ / ならないってことなのぉ

rows.en: @...we need to go back and check each and every slave unit.
rows.jp: 「一<b:8a41>戻って、家機をひとつずつ / 確認するしかないな<b:8a42>いじゃ

rows.en: @This world is for those who believe and live in the future. This world isn't for ghosts, like you!
rows.jp: 「ここは、未<b:8a43>を信じ生きる人たちの世界 / お前のいるべき世界じゃない / 亡<b:8a44>がいるような世界じゃないんだッ！

rows.en: @he couldn't quite die.
rows.jp: 「お前は死に、オデッサは滅滅したッ！ / ここはもう、お前が戻ってくる / 世界じゃないないんだよ

rows.en: @With your death, Odessa was destroyed! This world is not for you to return to.
rows.jp: 「まったく、未練たらしいんだから / <b:8a45>度と合けて出てこないでねッ！<b:8a73>[06][05]が / 「人の強い想いは / こんなカタチにも現れるんですね

rows.en: @I mean, this affection has to die with you. Don't show up again, OK?!
rows.jp: 「世界<b:8a46><b:8a47>を / そんなにしたかったんでしょうか…

rows.en: @Did you really want world domination that much?
rows.jp: 「この世の未練が断ち切れぬなら / その未練を断ち切る<b:8a48>となりて / 何度でも、お前を<b:8a49><b:8a4a>に着り<b:8a4b>してやる

rows.en: @If you can't cut ties to this world I will be the sword to send you back to Hades over and over again.
rows.jp: 「まぁ、死んでもこの世にとどまろうとする / その<b:8a4c>性だけは見上げたものじゃが / もう、戻ってこんでいいぞ<b:8a4d>には / 見おぼえがあるッ！

rows.en: @While I admire your efforts to return to this world, you're dead, so don't bother returning.
rows.jp: ＊<b:8a4e>々しい<b:8a4f>気を<b:8a50>わせて / 『<b:8a51>気谷<89f4>』が / <b:8a52><b:8a53>にも<8973>たうめき話をあげるッ！

rows.en: *Calamity silently floats, the |Mad Mountains| scream out a lament.
rows.jp: ＊理想は死すとも / <b:8a54><b:8a55>は死なずッ！

rows.en: *The ideal is death. Deep-seated delusion doesn't die.
rows.jp: ＊<b:8a56>体は<b:8a57>ち果てるとも / この剣の残<b:8a58>思念は / <b:8a51><8868>の<b:8a59>となりて立ちはだかってきたッ！<b:8a57>ちた<b:8a4d>からはなにも信じられない

rows.en: *Even if the flesh rots, this man's remaining thoughts become a fiery wreckage that stands in one's way.
rows.jp: 「ここから、オデッサの / メインデータバンクにアクセスできそうだが / どうする、[05]ぉ？

rows.en: @It's said you can access Odessa's main data bank from here. What do you want to do, 0?
rows.jp: 「ヴィンスフェルトがいっていた / 『<8915>り<b:8a43>る脅威』というのが / カイバーベルトのことなのかも気になる

rows.en: @Vinsfeld must have meant the Kuiper Belt when he spoke of an encroaching menace.
rows.jp: 「なにかしら情報が得られるかもしれない / <b:8a5a>労に終わるかもしれないけど / 調べてみる<b:8a5b><8875>はあるな<b:8a5c>りだった…

rows.en: @We might be able to get some information. It could be a waste of time, but it's worth a try.
rows.jp: 「僕たちの知らない、なにかを知っていた / それも、あり得なくない話しだ

rows.en: @He knew something we didn't. It's not unlikely.
rows.jp: 「なにも出てこなかったら / それはそれで、よしということでッ！

rows.en: @If nothing comes up, no big deal!
rows.jp: 「やっぱり、今更オデッサの情報を探っても / 作<b:8a5d>な情報なんて / 出てきそうにないみたいね…

rows.en: @Even if we research data on Odessa now, it doesn't look like anything good will result.
rows.jp: 「こいつはいったい / 何の<b:8a5e><b:8a5f>だ〜<b:8a60>動特<b:8a61>〜<b:8a62>目だ

rows.en: @What kind of joke is this?
rows.jp: 「そうか<b:8a63><b:8a64>として運<b:8a65>される以上 / 置金の調達は不可欠 / これは、オデッサの<89a3>後関係か？

rows.en: @The organization lacked operational funds. So these are their financial backers.

rows.jp: 「〜そんな〜 / 何でこんなところに / この名前があるんだ〜

rows.en: @Impossible! Why would that name be listed here?
rows.jp: 「このコンソールパネルを起動するには / 搭続されている家機を全部立ち上げないと / ダメなようだな

rows.en: @A Guardian must be near here. But this is a strange, powerful feeling.
rows.jp: 「この近くに、ガーディアンがいるはずです / でも、これまでに出式ったことのない / 圧倒的な力と、異質な信じが〜
rows.re: A Guardian must be near. But this / is a strange, powerful feeling.

rows.en: @This is the first time I've ever felt this particular sensation.
rows.jp: 「こんな信信、押めてです
rows.re: The first time I've ever felt this / exact sensation.

rows.en: @It doesn't mean that...
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>ってことはないかな〜
rows.re: It doesn't mean that...

rows.en: @We have no time to waste.
rows.jp: 「時間を無乗にせんことじゃ<b:8a38>るもの / この力を置するならば、オレの名を<883a>えよ<b:8a39>るがいい
rows.re: We have no time to waste.

rows.en: @The one with a connection to the Blazing Demon, 0 Winchester.
rows.jp: 「<b:8a3a>の魔<b:8a3b>を街<b:8a3c>し続けし者 / [05]ぉ・ウインチェスター
rows.re: The one bound to the Blazing Demon, / {0} Winchester.

rows.en: @Anastasia asked me to. She wanted me to help you.
rows.jp: 「アナスタシアが発んだのだ / お前の力になってほしいと<b:8a3d>質がなければ意味がない
rows.re: Anastasia asked it of me. She / wanted me to help you.

rows.en: @I am the Guardian of Desire. I only lend my powers to those who can make use of my powers.
rows.jp: 「オレは『置発』のガーディアン / オレの力となりえる者にしか / 力を貸さん
rows.re: I am the Guardian of Desire. I lend / my power only to those who can / wield it.

rows.en: @Do you understand my meaning?
rows.jp: 「この意味が分かるか？<b:8a40>、オレの力の<8869>
rows.re: Do you take my meaning?

rows.en: @It's the flesh and blood I need for my power--a desire stronger than any other.
rows.jp: 「オレに必要なのは / <b:8a41><b:8a42>となりて、力となる / 誰よりも強き『置発』ッ！
rows.re: What I need is a desire stronger / than any other, my flesh and blood.

rows.en: @I ask you, what is it you desire?
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>お前に誓う / お前が置するは、いかなるものか？<b:8a43><b:8a44>な『回世』〜
rows.re: So I ask you: what is it you / desire?

rows.en: @{2} is there with Grandma, 1 and 2 too, along with everyone from the ARMS.
rows.jp: 「[0a]かがいて、おばさんがいて / [05]おや[05]か / ＡＲＭＳのみんながいて〜
rows.re: {2} is there with Grandma, {1} and / {2}, and everyone from the ARMS.

rows.en: @Days with no need to fight, days with no disputes.
rows.jp: 「みんなが戦う必要がなく / <b:8a45>いなんてない回々〜英雄』になることなんかじゃないッ！
rows.re: Days with no need to fight. Days / with no strife.

rows.en: @There was a time when I wanted to be a |hero,| but that was to protect everyone's happiness.
rows.jp: 「『英雄』に<b:8a48>れたこともあった / でもそれは〜 / みんなの<b:8a49>探を<b:8a4a>りたかったから
rows.re: Once I wanted to be a |hero,| but / only to protect everyone's / happiness.

rows.en: @I didn't want to see anyone suffer.
rows.jp: 「誰かが<b:8a4b>しむところなんて / 見たくなかったから
rows.re: I didn't want to see anyone suffer.

rows.en: @But there's a simpler answer. The truth is I wanted to protect {2}'s smiling face, so I ...
rows.jp: 「いや、もっと<b:8a4c><b:8a4d>な理由だった / 本当は、[0a]かの<b:8a49>探を / <b:8a4a>りたかったから、だから俺は〜善悪はない
rows.re: But the simpler truth: I wanted to / protect {2}'s smile. That's all.

rows.en: @Power can become good or evil depending upon who uses it. The hope is the same.
rows.jp: 「それを<b:8a4f>るいし者によって / 善き力にも、悪しき力にもなる / 『置発』とて同じこと
rows.re: Power turns to good or evil by its / wielder. The hope is the same.

rows.en: @What you wish for is the same as Anastasia.
rows.jp: 「お前が発みしものは / アナスタシアと同質のもの
rows.re: What you wish for is the same as / Anastasia's.

rows.en: @A good desire-- a desire suited to become my flesh and blood.
rows.jp: 「心地よき置発〜 / オレの<b:8a41><b:8a42>となるに<8875>し『置発』ッ！<b:8a50>いて、力と為す
rows.re: A good desire, fit to become my / flesh and blood.

rows.en: @When you desire power, call out my name.
rows.jp: 「力を置するとき / オレの名を呼ぶがいい
rows.re: When you desire power, call my / name.

rows.en: @For the daily life you desire, I will become the sword to battle all kinds of blazes.
rows.jp: 「お前の発みし『回世』の為 / 立ちふさがる、あらゆる<b:8a51><b:8a52>を / なぎ<b:8a53>う<b:8a54>となろう
rows.re: For the daily life you long for, / I'll be the sword against every / blaze.

rows.en: @I use people's strong hopes for my power. I, the Guardian of Desire, Lucied.
rows.jp: 「オレは人の強き『置発』を力とするもの / 置発のガーディアン / ルシエド〜
rows.re: I feed on people's strong hopes. I / am Lucied, Guardian of Desire.

rows.en: @I will be with you until the day when your hope has been exhausted.
rows.jp: 「オレはお前と<b:8a55>にある / 『置発』の<b:8a56>きる、その回まで〜<b:8a57>「まけんルシエド」[11]ぉを手に入れた
rows.re: I'll stay with you until the day / your hope runs dry.

rows.en: @The Guardian of Desire, Lucied, called me.
rows.jp: 「『置発』のガーディアン・ルシエドが / 俺を呼んだんだ
rows.re: Lucied, the Guardian of Desire, / called to me.

rows.en: @And he lent his strength to me.
rows.jp: 「そして、俺にその力を貸してくれた
rows.re: And he lent his strength to me.

rows.en: @He's the Guardian who was always right there beside the <Sword Magess>.
rows.jp: 「＜<b:8a5b>の左女＞の<b:8a5c>らに / 世にいたという / ガーディアンだな
rows.re: The Guardian who was always at the / <Sword Magess's> side.

rows.en: @If you can borrow Lucied's powers, your warring powers will be strengthened.
rows.jp: 「ルシエドの力が<b:8a5d>りられたなら / 戦力アップは間違いないですね<b:8a5e>利が<b:8a5f>重されておるがな
rows.re: Borrow Lucied's power and your / fighting strength will grow.

rows.en: @...frail humans need to borrow the powers of the Guardians. Be grateful.
rows.jp: 「<b:8a60>弱な人間には / ガーディアンの力も必要じゃろうて / ありがたく使うことじゃ
rows.re: ...frail humans must borrow the / Guardians' power. Be grateful.

rows.re: I've always wondered why you keep / picking fights with me.

rows.en: @It's not that you like me or anything is it?
rows.jp: 「ひょっとして / わたしのこと、<b:8a4f>きなの？
rows.re: It's not that you like me or / anything, is it?

rows.en: @But remember, someday I'll be |a mighty fine woman.|
rows.jp: 「でもね、おぼえておきなさいよ / いつかそのうち / 『いい女』になってみせるんだから
rows.re: But mark my words, someday I'll be / |a mighty fine woman.|

rows.en: @I'll be sure to give you the honor of being dumped by me then.
rows.jp: 「その時は / わたしにフラれる名<b:8a50>を / アンタに着ってあげるわよ掃除当番 / 全部、俺が<b:8a53>代わりしてるんだぞッ！
rows.re: I'll grant you the honor of getting / dumped by me then.

rows.en: @When it's all over and we come back here, I'll help with your cleaning.
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>全部終って / またここに帰ってきたら / アンタの掃除当番を手伝ってあげる
rows.re: When it's all over and we're back, / I'll help you clean up.

rows.en: @Where?
rows.jp: 「どこだっけ？天文台<b:8a57>回ね<b:8a58>ってもらうからなッ！
rows.re: Where?

rows.en: @I'm going to get you to help me clean the Astronomical Observatory!
rows.jp: 「天文台掃除 / 手伝ってもらうからなッ！
rows.re: I'm roping you into cleaning the / Astronomical Observatory!

rows.en: @I never imagined that having something so familiar disappear would make me feel so lonely.
rows.jp: 「<89f5>にあって / ごく自部なモノが無くなってしまうって / こんなに<89fd>しい気持ちになるんだね
rows.re: I never thought losing something so / familiar could feel this lonely.

rows.en: @I'm going to bring the sky back to Filgaia. I'm going to show you the sun once again.
rows.jp: 「ファルガイアに空を取り戻すよ / キミにもう一度、お<b:8a59>方を見せてあげるよ
rows.re: I'll bring the sky back to Filgaia. / I'll show you the sun again.

rows.en: @I promise you.
rows.jp: 「<b:8a5a>重するから〜<b:8a5b>手の<b:8a5c>指に / もうひとつ<b:8a5a>重して〜
rows.re: I promise you.

rows.en: @Let's meet here again.
rows.jp: 「また、ここで<b:8a40>おうね<b:8a59>方はあるよ
rows.re: Let's meet here again.

rows.en: @This here is a special, Secret Sun Ball.
rows.jp: 「ここはね / とっておきの<b:8a5d><b:8a5e>の<b:8a59>だまりなの<b:8a5b>手を出して / <b:8a5a>重しよ<b:8a5f>』は招き<b:8a60>ぐもの / だが『英雄』も果たして招き<b:8a60>ぐものか
rows.re: This here is a special Secret Sun / Ball.

rows.en: @|Blood| is a red |bond| that ties you to the past.
rows.re: |Blood| is a red |bond| that ties / you to the past.

rows.en: @It's a person's |karma,| |fate| and the yet to be known |future.|
rows.jp: 「それは人の『<b:8a68>』、『運命』 / そして、まだ見ぬ『未来』〜
rows.re: It's a person's |karma,| |fate,| / and the yet-unknown |future.|

rows.en: @Gasping at the suffering, the wailing seeks the dark yet rest is full of traps.
rows.jp: 「<b:8a67>られた苦<b:8a69>にもがき、<b:8a6a>ぐ / 行き場を<b:8a6b>めた<b:8a6c><b:8a6d>は暗がりを<b:8a6b>め / 安<89e2>の中には、いつも<b:8a6e>が<89e2>づく<b:8a6f>回のためにあるとしたら / 『<b:8a5f>』に政うが英雄を<b:8a60>ぎし者の<b:8a70><b:8a71>か<b:8a72>り / 心<b:8a73>へと向かう<b:8a74>とならんか
rows.re: Gasping in the suffering, the wail / seeks the dark, but rest is all / traps.

rows.en: @Yet, they came charging in one by one without permission, then later gave no reason. That's criminal!
rows.jp: 「なのに、わらわに無断で更から更へと / <b:8a77>足で上がり込んでくるヤツらが / 後を<b:8a78>たんとは何事じゃッ！<b:8a79>の<b:8a7a>配者 / ノーブルレッドである、わらわの〜<b:8a75>のてっぺんって / <f040><f042>何なんだ？前、そんな事もわからぬのか？ / <b:8a7c>が無いのはこれだから<b:8a7d>る
rows.re: Yet in they charged, one by one, / unbidden, and gave no reason after. / That's...

rows.en: @The true rulers, Crimson Nobles know solitude intimately.
rows.jp: 「<b:8a79>の<b:8a7a>配者、ノーブルレッドは / 世に<89c4><89e1>と共にあり〜<b:8a7e>達は / いてほしいよな
rows.re: The true rulers, the Crimson / Nobles, know solitude intimately.

rows.en: @I'm used to things like that.
rows.jp: 「〜そのようなこと / もう、<b:8a7f>れたわ
rows.re: I'm used to that sort of thing.

rows.en: @Think about it. I'm the only Crimson Noble left. No one's left who can share those hours with me.
rows.jp: 「考えてもみい〜 / わらわは、たったひとりのノーブルレッド / 同じ時を過ごせる左間はもういない〜<b:8a5f>を<b:8a80>われたら / 同じ時間を過ごせるようになるんだろ？
rows.re: Think about it. I'm the last / Crimson Noble. No one left to share / the hours.

rows.en: @share those hours with you? If that's the case, then go for it!
rows.jp: 「だったら / ひとおもいにガブッてやってくれッ！
rows.re: ...share the hours with you? If / that's it, then go for it!

rows.en: @I'll be your uh... first friend.
rows.jp: 「僕が、その〜 / お前の<b:8a7e>達<88f9>１<8903>になってやるよ〜
rows.re: I'll be your, uh... first friend.

rows.en: @You're a hopeless idiot.
rows.jp: 「〜お前、あきれたバカじゃのう〜
rows.re: You're a hopeless idiot.

rows.en: @Think about it. Your resignation from humanity means you could lose a lot.
rows.jp: 「よく考えてみろ / お前がニンゲン<b:8a81>めるということは / たくさんのモノを失うということじゃぞ
rows.re: Think about it. Leaving humanity / behind, you'd stand to lose a lot.

rows.en: @If I did this, I'd be able to be with you forever, right?
rows.jp: 「〜そうしたら / ずっといっしょにいられるんだろ？
rows.re: If I did this, I could be with you / forever, right?

rows.en: @I have no interest in children like you.
rows.jp: 「わらわは、お前のような / おこちゃまには<b:8a82><b:8a83>など無いわ
rows.re: I've no interest in a child like / you.

rows.en: @When you hit those pudgy middle years, I might just consider it.
rows.jp: 「うっとりメロメロ<8872>の / ナイスミドルになってからなら / 考えてやってもいいけどな
rows.re: When you hit those pudgy middle / years, I might just consider it.

rows.en: @Really and truly!
rows.jp: 「ホントにホントなのかッ！
rows.re: Truly and honestly!

rows.jp: [17]前〜 / <b:8a84><b:8a85>しないヤツじゃのう〜

rows.en: @Maybe if I were with you, I might not be so lonely after all.
rows.jp: 「お前といっしょなら / 本当に<89fd>しくないかもな〜
rows.re: Maybe, with you, I wouldn't feel so / alone after all.

rows.en: @But...
rows.re: But...

rows.en: @(I don't think I'll be able to express my feelings very well.)
rows.jp: 「わたし、自分の気持ちを / うまく伝えられないかもしれない
rows.re: (I don't think I can say how I feel / very well.)

rows.en: @(If I put it into words I might end up hurting 0 again.)
rows.jp: 「言葉にすると / また[05]ぉを / <b:8a86>つけてしまうかもしれない
rows.re: (Put into words, I might only hurt / {0} again.)

rows.en: @But when I put it into words, I always say something very different.
rows.jp: 「でも、言葉にすると / いつも全部違うことを言ってしまうの
rows.re: But when I say it out loud, it / always comes out wrong.

rows.en: @I hate how feelings turn into different words when they leave the body.
rows.jp: 「身体の<b:8a87>界<b:8a88>を<b:8a89>えると / 気持ちが単の言葉に代ってしまうのが / すごく<b:8a8a>だった
rows.re: I hate how feelings turn to / different words once they leave / you.

rows.en: @I've always wished there were more direct ways to express my feelings.
rows.jp: 「もっと<8865>搭 / 気持ちを伝える方法があったらなって / いつも思っていた…
rows.re: I've always wished for a more / direct way to share what I feel.

rows.en: @The scar you gave me... This |Gias| around my neck won't let me die yet.
rows.jp: 「お前に押られた左右の… / <888a>の『ギアス』が / まだ死ぬことを許してくれないのでな
rows.re: The scar you gave me... this |Gias| / at my neck won't let me die yet.

rows.en: @As long as I'm chained to this, I'm coming back as often as I can.
rows.jp: 「こいつに乗られているあいだ / 僕は何度でも帰ってくる
rows.re: As long as I'm bound to it, I'll / keep coming back, again and again.

rows.en: @That's right. |Heroes| don't die! As long as they have the will to fight.
rows.jp: 「そうだ〜 / 『置発』は死なないッ！ / 戦う意<b:8a38>が<b:8a39>えないかぎりッ！<b:8a3a>は / ここでケリをつけてやるッ！
rows.re: |Heroes| don't die, not while the / will to fight remains.

rows.en: @This blow is my farewell to the past. It's a blow for the Slayheim Liberation Army!
rows.jp: 「この一撃は / 過去への<b:8a3c>単〜 / スレイハイム解放<b:8a3d>の一撃ッ！
rows.re: This blow is my farewell to the / past. A blow for the Slayheim / Liberation Army!

rows.en: @It's a beacon for new battles! Take this, Vinsfeld Rhadamanthus.
rows.jp: 「そして、新たなる戦いの<b:8a3e><888d>だッ！ / <b:8a3f>けとるがいい〜 / ヴィンスフェルト・ラダマンテュスッ！
rows.re: A beacon for new battle! Take this, / Vinsfeld Rhadamanthus!

rows.en: @It's not just a story. It's a battle that actually happened.
rows.jp: 「言葉で伝えられる物置なんかじゃない / 本当にあった戦いなのよ / これは〜
rows.re: It's not just a story. It was a / real battle, fought and lived.
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @This sad sensation. It's not the first time I've felt this!
rows.jp: 「この、げっそりする信信〜 / こいつを信じるのは発めてじゃないッ！
rows.re: This sorrow... it isn't the first / time I've felt it!
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @It's a part of that other me, isn't it?
rows.jp: 「こいつは〜 / もうひとりの俺自身だ〜<b:8a38>の地<b:8a39>に封<b:8a3a>した、左の右乗<f041><f042>
rows.re: It's a part of that other me, isn't / it?
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @That which is within you now is Lord Blazer, the Blazing Demon who once tried to consume the world.
rows.jp: 「今、あなたの街に存在しているのは / かつて、世界を<b:8a3b>き<b:8a3c>くさんとした / 左の魔<b:8a3d>ロードブレイザーよ〜
rows.re: What dwells in you now is Lord / Blazer, the Blazing Demon that once / sought to devour the world.
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @I was just an ordinary girl who until then believed sword training was dumb. I'd never had a sword.
rows.jp: 「それまで、<b:8a3e>の<b:8a3f>練はおろか / 乗れたことだってなかった / ただの女の家だったのよ<b:8a40>中だったわ
rows.re: I was an ordinary girl. I thought / sword training was foolish. I'd / never even held one.
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @But it wasn't because I wanted to |win.|
rows.jp: 「でもそれは / 『<b:8a41>ちたい』という気持ちじゃなかった
rows.re: But it was never about wanting to / |win.|
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @It was because I didn't want to lose the people I loved.
rows.jp: 「大好きな人たちを / 失いたくない気持ち〜
rows.re: It was because I couldn't bear to / lose the people I loved.
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @Besides, I personally hate death. I really didn't want to die.
rows.jp: 「そして、わたし自身 / 死ぬのは<b:8a43>〜 / 死にたくないって、強く望んでいたわ
rows.re: And honestly, I hate death. I did / not want to die.
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @Well, that disqualifies you as a Magess.
rows.jp: 「フフッ、これじゃあ / 聖女失<b:8a46>ね
rows.re: Well, that disqualifies you as a / Magess.
rows.speaker: voice

rows.en: @Rather than worrying about the world, I was thinking of myself and my family.
rows.jp: 「世界のことなんかよりも / わたしと、わたしの<b:8a47>りのことばかり / 考えていたわ<b:8a48><b:8a46>は必要ないのよ
rows.re: Instead of the world, I thought of / myself and my family.
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @Because I have the blood of the Valeria family doesn't make me a |hero.|
rows.jp: 「ヴァレリア家の血を招いていることなんかに / 『英雄』である意味なんて / これっぽっちもないわよ
rows.re: Valeria blood in my veins never / made me a |hero.|
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @Was anyone else in my family able to get hold of the Argetlahm?
rows.jp: 「わたしの家系だからといって / 誰かひとりでも / アガートラームが手にできたのかしら？
rows.re: Did anyone else in my family ever / draw the Argetlahm?
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @There's no significance in the blood of the Valeria Family.
rows.jp: 「ヴァレリアの血に / 何の意味も無いのよ〜
rows.re: There's nothing special in Valeria / blood.
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @Just now...you said...
rows.jp: 「い、今、なんて〜家系〜
rows.re: Just now... you said...
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @I said there's no significance that I'm a blood relative of the Valeria Family.
rows.jp: 「ヴァレリア家の / 血<b:8a4f>であることに / 何の意味も無い、って言ったのよ<b:8b00><b:8a50>望』しなかった
rows.re: I said being of Valeria blood means / nothing at all.
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @Even though Lord Blazer killed all hope, I never lost the desire to live.
rows.jp: 「ロードブレイザーに<b:8a51>望を失っても / わたしは / 生きることをあきらめきれなかったの
rows.re: Even as Lord Blazer crushed all / hope, I never lost the desire to / live.
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @Hmm...
rows.jp: 「フフッ〜
rows.re: Hmm...
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @I mean, I still wanted to eat lots of good food and have fun with my friends.
rows.jp: 「だって、おいしいものだって / たくさん食べたかったし / おともだちと<b:8a52>びたかったわ
rows.re: I still wanted good food, and good / times with my friends.
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @I didn't want to let go of |life| so easily.
rows.jp: 「カンタンに / 『生きる』ことを手放したくなかったの
rows.re: I wasn't about to let go of |life| / so easily.
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @That's what was |special.| I think my power was from |desire.|
rows.jp: 「それが、わたしにあった『結単』〜 / わたしが手にした力 / それは、『欲望』だったのかもしれない<b:8a54>いは / よくおぼえていないわ〜
rows.re: That was the |special| thing. My / power came from |desire.|
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @Eventually he was always by my side, but soon he became a presence I couldn't do without.
rows.jp: 「いつのまにか、わたしのそばにいて / そのうち / いなくてはならない存在になっていた
rows.re: In time he was always at my side, / then someone I could no longer do / without.
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @That's Lucied for you.
rows.jp: 「それがルシエドよ
rows.re: That's Lucied for you.
rows.speaker: Marivel

rows.en: @A long time ago he told me that it was my willpower that gave Lucied his power.
rows.jp: 「ずっと前、この家が<b:8a55>えてくれたわ / わたしの意志の力が / ルシエドの力を<8a1b>現合させたって〜
rows.re: Long ago he told me my own will was / what gave Lucied his power.
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @I think |desire| is simply the power of the will to live?
rows.jp: 「わたし、思うんだけど / 『欲望』って / 生きようとする意志の力じゃないのかな？
rows.re: Isn't |desire| just the power of / the will to live?
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @Power is neither good nor bad. Never deny it just because it's full of |desire.|
rows.jp: 「力そのものに<b:8a57>悪はないわ / 『欲望』だからって / それを<b:8a58><b:8a59>するのは間違っていると思う
rows.re: Power is neither good nor evil. / Don't deny it just for being full / of |desire.|
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @What saved Filgaia from the Blaze of Disaster was |desire.|
rows.jp: 「かつて<f041><f042> / ファルガイアを左の右乗から救ったのは / 『欲望』そのものよ〜
rows.re: What saved Filgaia from the Blaze / of Disaster was |desire.|
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @But there are no road markers en route.
rows.jp: 「でも、そこにいたるまでのあいだ / 道<8861>なんて無いわ〜
rows.re: But the road ahead has no / signposts.
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @I have to go back home.
rows.jp: 「俺は〜 / 帰らなきゃいけないんだ<b:8a5a>き〜？
rows.re: I have to go back home now.
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @It's a light that cares greatly for you.
rows.jp: 「あなたのことを / 強く想う輝よ〜
rows.re: It's a light that holds you very / dear.
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @The other world is a place where I no longer can be. So...
rows.jp: 「あそこは、もう〜 / わたしがいちゃいけない世界なの / だから〜
rows.re: The other world is no longer a / place for me. So...
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @But I must go.
rows.jp: 「でも、俺は行くよ
rows.re: But I must go.
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @I was afraid to fight! I never wanted to be called a Holy Woman.
rows.jp: 「戦うのは<b:8a5b>かったッ！ / 聖女なんて呼ばれても / うれしくなんてなかったッ！
rows.re: I was afraid to fight! I never / wanted to be called a Holy Woman.
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @But I had no choice!
rows.jp: 「でも、他に方法がなかったのッ！
rows.re: But I had no choice!
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @In order to save all I loved, I had to fight!
rows.jp: 「大好きなものを / 守るために仕方なかったのッ！
rows.re: To save all that I loved, I had to / fight!
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @I loved talking about just nothing with my friends.
rows.jp: 「ともだちと / 他愛も無いおしゃべりをするのが / 好きだった
rows.re: I loved talking about nothing at / all with my friends.
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @I was happy just being able to spend time with my mother and father.
rows.jp: 「<b:8a5d>方と<b:8a5e>方と / いっしょにいられるだけで / しあわせだった
rows.re: I was happy just spending time with / my mother and father.
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @I even had someone I liked.
rows.jp: 「〜〜好きな人だっていたわ〜〜
rows.re: There was even someone I loved.
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @But, only by my giving up everything was I able to save the world.
rows.jp: 「でもね、わたしが / わたしのすべてを<b:8a5f>てることでしか / 世界を守ることができなかったの
rows.re: But only by giving up everything / could I save the world.
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @I didn't know how to put it into words, but I knew.
rows.jp: 「言葉には出さなかったけど / わたしには、わかっていた〜
rows.re: I couldn't put it into words, but I / knew.
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @I had to die to become a |hero!| I wouldn't have been able to get rid of the Blaze of Disaster.
rows.jp: 「死ななきゃ、『英雄』になれなかったのッ！ / 左の右乗を<b:8a60>けることが / できなかったの〜〜
rows.re: I had to die to become a |hero.| No / other way could banish the Blaze of / Disaster.
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @Everyone, everyone wanted it.
rows.jp: 「みんなが、みんな / 望んでいたのよ〜
rows.re: Everyone. Everyone wished it.
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @They wanted me to die.
rows.jp: 「わたしが死んでしまうことを〜英雄』になるために / ファルガイアに戻るんじゃない〜
rows.re: They wanted me to die.
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @To protect what's important, rather become a |hero| as a |sacrifice,| I'll find another way.
rows.jp: 「そして、大切なモノを守るのに / 『英雄』という『生け<b:8a61>』にすがるのではなく / もっと、単の方法を見つけるため<f041><f042>
rows.re: To protect what matters, I won't be / a |hero| through |sacrifice.| I'll / find another way.
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @And stop the suffering of the Valeria.
rows.jp: 「そして、ヴァレリアの<b:8a62>しみを止めて〜
rows.re: And end the suffering of the / Valeria line.
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @Thanks for everything, Lucied.
rows.jp: 「今までありがとう、ルシエド<b:8a63>してあげて〜<b:8a62>しみを止めて〜
rows.re: Thank you for everything, Lucied.
rows.speaker: Anastasia

rows.en: @It seems I can't die just yet.
rows.jp: 「僕はまだ、死ねないようだ〜
rows.re: Seems I can't die just yet.

rows.en: @...why we fought and beat Odessa.
rows.jp: 「俺たちがオデッサと戦って / 右ってきた理由を〜
rows.re: ...why we fought and beat Odessa.

rows.en: @While we were powerless and frail against such a great destructive force...
rows.jp: 「俺たちは大きな脅威に対して / あまりにも無力だ、乗弱だ〜
rows.re: Powerless and frail before such / vast destruction...

rows.en: @...through our beliefs, we have evaded danger and discovered greater strength.
rows.jp: 「でも、信じあうことで / 置けてこれたんだ〜 / より大きな力を発揮してこれたんだ〜
rows.re: ...yet through our beliefs we / slipped danger and found greater / strength.

rows.en: @So when one person has doubts, and cracks develop in our trust, it gets broken.
rows.jp: 「だから、ひとりを発い / 信頼に<b:8a38><b:8a39>が<b:8a3a>った時 / あんなにも、もろかったんだ
rows.re: So when one of us doubts, and / cracks split our trust, it breaks.
...zzz...zzz...zzz...

rows.en: @I want the strength to save others, so I will no longer doubt my friends. I'll trust them fully.
rows.jp: 「俺は誰もを<b:8a3b>れる強い力がほしい / だから、もう仲間を発わない / 強く、信じるよ
rows.re: I want the strength to save others, / so I'll doubt my friends no more. / I'll trust them.
So...

rows.en: @...you all who are now my friends.
rows.jp: 「今の仲間であるお前たちを / 信じきれていなかったのかもしれない
rows.re: ...all of you, who are now my / friends.

rows.en: @So, without going into it, it brought about suspicion.
rows.jp: 「だから、すべてを<b:8a3d>らず / それが発<b:8a3e>を<b:8a3f>いたのだ〜
rows.re: Not talking it out only bred / suspicion.

rows.en: @Listen everyone...
rows.jp: 「聞いてくれ、みんな〜 / 僕は〜<b:8a40>実を口にするよりも / 信頼を右ち取る方法があるとするならば〜
rows.re: Listen, everyone...

rows.en: @it's to move with you all.
rows.jp: 「それは、いっしょに行動する事だ〜
rows.re: ...it's to move forward with all of / you.

rows.en: @But I don't plan on having contact with you all.
rows.jp: 「〜ただ、あたしは / <b:8a41>方らと<b:8a42>れ合うつもりはない〜
rows.re: But I don't mean to keep my / distance from you.

rows.en: @My goal is to exorcise the demon that possesses 0!
rows.jp: 「あたしの目的はあくまでも / [05]ぉに<b:8a43>食う魔を<b:8a44>う事だッ！絆は / 何よりも強く、<8947>い〜
rows.re: My goal is to drive the demon out / of {0}!

rows.en: @That's what I learned on the battlefield.
rows.jp: 「僕は戦場で / そう<b:8a46>わってきた〜
rows.re: That's what I learned on the / battlefield.

rows.en: @Ties have already been established between us.
rows.jp: 「絆はもうできている / 僕たちと、お前との間にはな〜
rows.re: The bonds between us are already / formed.

rows.en: @...the battle of the |heroes.|
rows.jp: 「『右乗』たちの戦い、というのか…
rows.re: ...the battle of the |heroes.|

rows.en: @Everyone has weaknesses and frailties. They are humans just like us.
rows.jp: 「みんな、みんな… / 弱いところも、もろいところもかかえた / わたしたちと同じ人間なんですッ！
rows.re: Everyone has weaknesses and / frailties. They're human, like us.

rows.en: @They're humans who shed tears and blood. They get hurt and ragged, but still fight.
rows.jp: 「置も、発も流れることを知っている人間が / <b:8a38>ついて、ボロボロになりながら / 戦っているんですッ！
rows.re: They shed tears and blood. They get / hurt and worn down, but they fight / on.

rows.en: @It's people just like us fighting...
rows.jp: 「わたしたちと同じ / 人間が戦っているんです…
rows.re: It's people just like us out there / fighting...

rows.en: @So, we have to fight with them.
rows.jp: 「だから… / いっしょに戦わなければならないんです
rows.re: So we have to fight alongside them.

rows.en: @To offer a prayer... Intense feelings always reach the intended.
rows.jp: 「<b:8a39>りは… / 強くまっすぐな想いは、必ず続きます
rows.re: A prayer... True feeling always / reaches the one it's meant for.

rows.en: @To one's prayers and goodwill distance makes no difference no matter how far it is.
rows.jp: 「想いの気持ちに / <881a>離なんて関係無いんです / たとえどんなに離れていても…
rows.re: No matter the distance, a prayer / and its goodwill carry all the way.

rows.en: @I don't want to let go of the hands clasped.
rows.jp: 「もう、つないだ手を離したくない…<b:8a3a>が続かねぇッ！ / もっと前に出るぞ、[0a]くッ！！<b:8a3b>といたしましては / 気持ちの力など、非現実的としか言えません
rows.re: I don't want to let go of these / clasped hands.

rows.en: @But...
rows.jp: 「ですが…
rows.re: But...

rows.en: @To not be able to believe in my friends here and now... that isn't a world worth...
rows.jp: 「ここで、配達を信じることができないなんて / そんな現実なんて…
rows.re: To not trust my friends, here and / now... that's no world worth / saving.

rows.en: @It's not logic! It's my own conclusion!
rows.jp: 「やっぱり、理<b:8a3d>じゃないんですッ！ / それが、わたくしなりの結<b:8a3b>ですッ！！
rows.re: It's not logic. It's my own / conclusion!

「[05]おさんに / [05]きさん… / [05]ぎちゃんも…

rows.en: @It's what I suggested to Odessa ...by using the Demon Summoning my sister will have inside her...

rows.re: It's what I proposed to Odessa: by / the Demon Summoning, my sister / would hold it within...

rows.en: @By making {1} a vessel, the abominable lifeform will...
rows.jp: 「[0a]おを『発』とすることで / <b:8a3f>まわしき生命体を〜
rows.re: By making {1} a vessel, the / loathsome lifeform will...

rows.en: @How far will you go to achieve your goals?
rows.jp: 「目的のためなら / どこまで道を<b:8a40>み外せるんだッ！
rows.re: How far will you go to reach your / ends?

rows.en: @Are you saying you offered your own sister as a sacrifice?
rows.jp: 「実の<b:8a3e>までも / 生け<b:8a41>に<b:8a42>し出したというのかッ！<b:8a41>』ではない〜 / 『<b:8a43><b:8a44>』になるのだ
rows.re: You offered up your own sister as a / sacrifice?

rows.en: @Not the <Sword Magess>, but the Madonna of Destruction summoned under Valeria's name.
rows.jp: 「＜<b:8a45>の<b:8a46>女＞ならぬ / ＜滅びの<b:8a46><b:8a47>＞として / ヴァレリアの名のもとに<b:8a3b>されるのだ<b:8a48>んじゃいなかったッ！<b:8a49>してもらえるなんて / 思ってはいない
rows.re: Not the <Sword Magess,> but the / Madonna of Destruction, summoned in / Valeria's name.

rows.en: @In order to save Filgaia, I had no choice.
rows.jp: 「だが、ファルガイアを救うには / こうするより仕方がなかったのだ
rows.re: To save Filgaia, I had no choice.
...zzz...zzz...zzz...

rows.en: @We have to destroy the Kuiper Belt on our own!
rows.jp: 「さあ、私たちごと / カイバーベルトを滅ぼすのだッ！
rows.re: We have to destroy the Kuiper Belt / ourselves!

rows.en: @Before my consciousness gets swallowed up...
rows.jp: 「私の意<b:8a4a>が / のみこまれないうちに〜
rows.re: Before my mind is swallowed up...

rows.en: @But it's strange. Even though I know we'll slash each other, I have no fear or regrets.
rows.jp: 「だが、不思議だな〜 / こいつと<b:8a4b>し違えることがわかっていても / 脅えや後<b:8a4c>はない〜
rows.re: Strange. I know we'll cut each / other down, yet I feel no fear, no / regret.

rows.en: @I'm happy.
rows.jp: 「うれしいんだ〜
rows.re: I'm happy.

rows.en: @I'm happy I had the opportunity to be with you all, rather than am sad we won't see each other again.
rows.jp: 「もう、<b:8a4d>えないことよりも / みんなと出<b:8a4d>えたことがうれしい
rows.re: More than sad we won't meet again, / I'm glad I got to be with you all.

rows.en: @I'm really happy I got to be with you all and that we could protect Filgaia together.
rows.jp: 「みんなと出<b:8a4d>い / いっしょにファルガイアを<b:8a4e>ってきて / 本当によかった〜<b:8a4f>重したんだ / ヴァレリアの<b:8a50>しみを止める、って〜
rows.re: I'm truly glad I was with you all, / that together we protected Filgaia.

rows.en: *Do you want to read it?2
rows.jp: ＊進みますか？[18]か
rows.lit: Do you want to proceed?
rows.re: Do you want to proceed?
rows.speaker: system/prompt

rows.en: @You ask who I am? That's harsh after we've been together for so long and even fought, too.
rows.jp: 「誰だとは、ひどいな / 私たちは右にあり / 戦ってきた乗ではないか…<b:8a38>めた<b:8a39><b:8a3a>……<b:8a3b><b:8a3c>から解き放たれたよ / 実体を<b:8a3d>うのは<89aa>しぶりだ
rows.re: You ask who I am? Cruel, after all / our time together, our battles.
rows.speaker: Lord Blazer

rows.en: @I owe you my thanks.
rows.jp: 「お前には信<b:8a3e>している
rows.re: I owe you my thanks.
rows.speaker: Lord Blazer

rows.en: @It was my good fortune to live inside your body after being trapped behind the Event Horizon.
rows.jp: 「事<b:8a3f>の地<b:8a40>に封じられていた私が / お前の体街に降魔できたのは / <b:8a41><b:8a42>というべきかな
rows.re: What luck, to lodge in your body / after being sealed behind the Event / Horizon.
rows.speaker: Lord Blazer

rows.en: @The negative feelings that grew inside you during battles are now the food that sustains me.
rows.jp: 「戦いの中で生きるお前の中で<b:8a43>生えた / <b:8a44>の信情が / 今こうして、私を支える<b:8a46>となっているのだ<b:8a44>の信情…？ / 俺が、お前を<b:8a47>らせたというのかッ！？<b:8a48>ったことではない
rows.re: The dark feelings your battles bred / are the very food that sustains me.
rows.speaker: Lord Blazer

rows.en: @Swirling inside all humans are the most unsightly and strong energy forces.
rows.jp: 「人間の街にこそ / もっとも<b:8a49>く、そして強いエネルギーが / うずまいているのだ…
rows.re: Within every human swirls the / ugliest, strongest energy of all.
rows.speaker: Lord Blazer

rows.en: @In your battles you've seen the true nature of people and it's that negativity that I feed on.
rows.jp: 「この戦いの中で見てきただろう？ / お前自身の目で見てきた人間の<b:8a4a>… / あれこそが私の<b:8a46>なのだ
rows.re: Your battles bared people's true / nature. On that dark I feed.
rows.speaker: Lord Blazer

rows.en: @I'll give you the honor of witnessing the world burning into oblivion.
rows.jp: 「…そうだな、お前には / 私が世界を<b:8a4b>き<b:8a4c>くすまでを / 見続ける<b:8a4d><b:8a4e>を<b:8a4f>えよう…<b:8a50>まわしきアガートラームが<b:8a51>てる<b:8a52>一にして<b:8a53>対の<b:8a54>だよ
rows.re: I grant you the honor of watching / the world burn to nothing.
rows.speaker: Lord Blazer

rows.en: @But don't say you forgot that you weren't able to draw the Argetlahm.
rows.jp: 「だが、忘れたとは言わせぬぞ / お前は、アガートラームを / 抜くことができなかった……
rows.re: Don't pretend you forgot: you could / never draw the Argetlahm yourself.
rows.speaker: Lord Blazer

rows.en: @Once you had my strength, the strength you tried to destroy, then you finally got the sword.
rows.jp: 「そう、お前が倒さんとしている / この私の力を持って / ようやく手にすることができたのだ
rows.re: Only with my power, the power you / tried to destroy, did you finally / claim the sword.
rows.speaker: Lord Blazer

rows.en: @Now that I'm free of your body, you're only a mere human. You cannot draw Argetlahm.
rows.jp: 「私がお前の身体より解き放たれた今 / ただのニンゲンに / アガートラームを抜くことはかなわぬわッ！
rows.re: Free of your body now, you're just / a human. You cannot draw Argetlahm.
rows.speaker: Lord Blazer

rows.en: @Argetlahm is meant to be wielded by the |Hero of the Sword.|
rows.jp: 「アガートラームは / 『<b:8a54>の英雄』によって振るわれるもの
rows.re: Argetlahm is meant for the |Hero of / the Sword| alone.
rows.speaker: Lord Blazer

rows.en: @Lament the era of no |heroes!| And live in fear of the future that will burn to smithereens.
rows.jp: 「『英雄』のいない時代を<b:8a58>けッ！ / そして、為すすべもなく<b:8a4b>き<b:8a4c>くされる / お前たちの未来に恐<b:8a5a>するがいいッ！！<b:8a54>に選ばれた『英雄』なんかじゃないよ<b:8a5b>うなッ！ <b:8a5c>け入れよ未来をッ！
rows.re: Mourn this age with no |heroes!| / And dread the future burning to / ash.
rows.speaker: Lord Blazer

rows.en: @...is not such a puny world that it's sustained by the power of only a |hero.|
rows.jp: 「『英雄』なんかの力で支えられるほど / ちっぽけなものじゃないんだ
rows.re: ...this world isn't so small that / one |hero| alone holds it up.
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @This world is full of the interactions and exchanges of the people and their thoughts, so...
rows.jp: 「たくさんの命が生きて / 同じ年の想いが行き交う世界… / だから…
rows.re: It's full of people, their bonds / and their thoughts, all woven / together, so...
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @...the power that sustains the universe exists in Filgaia. It's the power of all life!
rows.jp: 「世界を支える力は / ファルガイアに生きる / すべての命の力にほかならないッ！英雄』のいない時代… / そう言ったな
rows.re: ...the power holding the universe / is right here. The power of all / life!
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @No. No. Not |without| heroes, but an era that doesn't need heroes.
rows.jp: 「違う、違うんだよ… / 『いない』のではなく、『いらない』んだ
rows.re: No. Not an age |without| heroes, / but one that doesn't need them.
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @We don't need a |hero|!!!!
rows.jp: 「『英雄』なんていらないッ！！！
rows.re: We don't need a |hero|!!!
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @There's no value in a world protected by such things.
rows.jp: 「そんなものによって守られる世界になんて / <b:8a5e><8875>などありはしないんだ…
rows.re: A world that leans on such things / isn't worth much.
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @If everyone's hearts become one, then we can rise and stand together.
rows.jp: 「誰もが心をひとつにして / 立ち上がることができたなら / そう<f040><f042>
rows.re: If everyone's hearts become one, we / can rise and stand together.
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @We can support the world without sacrificing a |hero.| Miracles can happen!
rows.jp: 「『英雄』なんて生け<b:8a5f>にすがらなくても / 世界を支えていけるッ！ / 跡跡だって起こすことができるッ！！
rows.re: We can hold up the world with no / |hero| sacrificed. Miracles happen!
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @We can never make the same mistake {0} made.
rows.jp: 「もう<b:8a60>度と / [0a]ぉのような間違いは / おかしちゃならないんだッ！
rows.re: We can't repeat the mistake {0} / once made.
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.jp: <b:8a4a>〜 『<b:8a54>の英雄』〜？ / バカな、アガートラームの<b:8a54>胞だとッ！？

rows.en: @The Argetlahm isn't a weapon to bury demons.
rows.jp: 「『アガートラーム』は / <89d9><b:8a61>を<b:8a62>るための同<b:8a63>なんかではないわ
rows.re: Argetlahm was never a weapon for / burying demons.
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @By gathering the will to live into power, it becomes the key to open the door to the future.
rows.jp: 「生きようとする命の力を重ねて / 未来への<8a23>を開く<b:8a64>なのよ
rows.re: Gathering the will to live into / power, it's the key that opens the / door to the future.
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @It's not a power to be wielded alone. It's a power for everyone to wield together.
rows.jp: 「ひとりで振るう力ではないわ / みんなで〜 / みんな、いっしょに振るう力なの祈りが〜
rows.re: Not a power for one to wield alone, / but for everyone to wield together.
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @If it won't arrive when I pray alone, we'll pray together as one.
rows.jp: 「わたしひとりで続かないのなら / みんなの祈りを / ひとつにします
rows.re: If one prayer won't reach, we'll / pray together as one.
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @Everyone, everyone was born on this star, and lived here.
rows.jp: 「みんな、みんな〜 / この星で生まれて / 生きていきたいんです〜
rows.re: Everyone was born on this star, and / lived their life here.
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @Only when you're alive do you get to fall in love or get to fight with others.
rows.jp: 「誰かを好きになることも / ケンカすることも / 生きていなければ始まらないんです
rows.re: Only the living get to fall in / love, or to quarrel with others.
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @If tomorrow comes because today's life light starts the creation of the future then...
rows.jp: 「今回、命の輝きが / 未来の始まりを<b:8a68>り続けることで / 次回がやって来るのなら<f040><f042>
rows.re: If tomorrow dawns because today's / light of life begins the future, / then...
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @...this light should be delivered to those battling at the end of today!
rows.jp: 「この輝きを / 今回の果てで戦っている人に / 続けたいんですッ！
rows.re: ...let that light reach those still / fighting at the close of today!
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @Right now, all the souls in Filgaia are trying to join together!
rows.jp: 「今、ファルガイアのすべての心が / ひとつに繋がろうとしているのをッ！
rows.re: Right now, every soul in Filgaia is / trying to join as one!
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @It's stopping all life from fighting simply to keep alive.
rows.jp: 「すべての命が / 生きていくために戦っていることを / しっかりと<b:8a5c>け止めています
rows.re: It stops all life from fighting / just to cling to survival.
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @We are not powerless! We have the strength of our united hearts.
rows.jp: 「わたしたちは無力ではありませんッ！ / 心を繋げる強さを持っています
rows.re: We are not powerless! Our united / hearts are our strength.
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @Take this power and throw it against the wars confronting you!
rows.jp: 「強さを重ねて / あなたの見つめる戦枯の向こうに / すべてぶつけますッ！守るための戦いッ！
rows.re: Take this power and hurl it against / the battles before you!
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @That's why we must fight too!
rows.jp: 「だから、わたしたちも / いっしょに戦うのッ！
rows.re: That's why we, too, must fight!
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @We don't need to be protected by someone special.
rows.jp: 「結単な誰かに守ってもらうんじゃない
rows.re: We don't need some special someone / to protect us.
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @Because it's important, so very important, we must protect it ourselves.
rows.jp: 「大切だから〜 / 本当に、すごく大切だから / 自分の手で守りたいの
rows.re: Because it matters so much, we have / to protect it with our own hands.
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @If someone has to be the |hero,| then anyone should be able to become the |hero.|
rows.jp: 「誰かが『英雄』になるのなら / 誰もが『英雄』になれるはず
rows.re: If someone must be |hero,| then / anyone should be able to become / one.
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @The prayers must have reached them, right? Everyone is fighting to protect Filgaia now.
rows.jp: 「続いているわよね？ / 今、誰もがファルガイアを守るために / 戦っているんだよ<f040><f042><b:8a6a>し付けたりするもんか
rows.re: The prayers reached them, didn't / they? All Filgaia fights for itself / now.
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @Because it's so important, we're going to protect it with our own hands.
rows.jp: 「大好きなものだから / 僕たち、自分の手で守りたいんだ
rows.re: Because it's so precious, we'll / protect it with our own hands.
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @I'm not sure we can handle it on our own, so if we get into trouble, help us out, Dude. OK?
rows.jp: 「ん<f040><f042>、そうだな〜 / うまくできないかもしれないから / その時は、あんちゃん手伝ってくれよな
rows.re: Not sure we can manage alone, so if / we hit trouble, lend a hand, Dude. / OK?
rows.speaker: Young ARMS

rows.en: @When you get into a bind, the Young ARMS could help you out in return.
rows.jp: 「あんちゃんが<b:8a6b>った時は / 少数ＡＲＭＳが / 何とかしてやるからよ
rows.re: And in a bind, the Young ARMS just / might help you back.
rows.speaker: Young ARMS

rows.en: @We like Filgaia just like everyone else!
rows.jp: 「ファルガイアが大好きなのは / みんな同じなんだよッ！好きだよ〜
rows.re: We love Filgaia, same as everyone / else!
rows.speaker: Young ARMS

rows.en: @This world, the life we live, and 0 all...
rows.jp: 「この世界も、生きる命も / [05]ぉも〜
rows.re: This world, the life we live, and / {0}, all of it...
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @I like today better than yesterday, and I like the unknown tomorrow even more.
rows.jp: 「<b:8a6c>回より今回が大好き / 今回よりも、まだ知らない次回は / もっと好きになれる
rows.re: I like today more than yesterday, / and the unknown tomorrow most of / all.
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @Let's all head off to tomorrow together.
rows.jp: 「みんなでいっしょに / 次回に行こうね
rows.re: Let's all set off for tomorrow / together.
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @Everyone together...
rows.jp: 「みんなでいっしょに<f040><f042>
rows.re: Everyone, together...
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @Everyone here and everyone waiting for us, and...
rows.jp: 「ここにいるみんなと / 俺たちを待っているみんな / そして〜<b:8a6d>利だよね英雄』なんかじゃない / ただの僕たちが手にした未来だ
rows.re: Everyone here, and everyone waiting / for us, and...
rows.speaker: Ashley

rows.en: @Don't hassle me. I refuse to ever do such unsuitable work!
rows.jp: 「わらわにメンドーかけさせるでない / わりの合わない仕事は / 金<b:8a6e><89d2>、おことわりじゃッ！
rows.re: Don't pester me. I'll never take on / such unfitting work!
rows.speaker: Irving

rows.en: @It's not a rational deduction, but I'm certain this isn't Filgaia. Where am I?
rows.jp: 「理押じゃない / でも、ハッキリとわかる / ここは、どこなんだ〜？
rows.re: This isn't reason talking, but I'm / sure this isn't Filgaia. Where am / I?

rows.en: @That's right. It's not the first time we meet. When I got the Argetlahm, in the light we...
rows.jp: 「そうだ〜 / 俺はあなたに出左うのは右めてじゃない / アガートラームを手にした輝の中で〜
rows.re: Right. Not our first meeting. When / I drew the Argetlahm, in that light / we...

rows.en: @It's the same feeling of protection I got when the Heimdal Gazzo exploded.
rows.jp: 「ヘイムダル・ガッツォーの乗発に / 置き飛ばされた俺を / 発るように<b:8a38>んでくれた、あの信信は〜
rows.re: The same feeling of being shielded / as when the Heimdal Gazzo exploded.

rows.en: @I'm certain of it. That sensation was the same as the vibrations I get from you now.
rows.jp: 「まちがいない〜 / あの信信は / あなたから信じる<88e0>動と同じもの
rows.re: I'm sure of it. That was the same / as the tremor I feel from you now.

rows.en: @Please tell me. Who are you?
rows.jp: 「<b:8a39>えてほしい / あなたはいったい〜
rows.re: Please, tell me. Who are you?

rows.en: @In your era, I guess the <Sword Magess> is the name most well known.
rows.jp: 「そうね、キミのいた時代では / ＜剣の少女＞<f041><f042> / 〜って言う方が、通りがいいみたいね剣の少女＞〜
rows.re: In your age, I'm best known by the / name <Sword Magess.>

rows.en: @I had always hoped we'd have a chance to talk, 0 Winchester.
rows.jp: 「一度、ゆっくりお話しがしたかったわ / [05]ぉ・ウィンチェスターくん
rows.re: I always hoped we'd get to talk, / {0} Winchester.

rows.en: @There were moments when you were a bit pathetic, but then you'd do something very bold and brave!
rows.jp: 「何だか頼りないところもあったけど / 時々、こっちがビックリするくらい / 大胆なことをしちゃうんだもん
rows.re: At times you were a bit pathetic, / then you'd do something so bold and / brave!

rows.en: @But with her... With {2}, you weren't terribly brave or forthcoming.
rows.jp: 「彼女<f041><f042> / [0a]かちゃんには / なかなか大胆になりきれないくせに、ね<b:8a3d>れちゃって / 愛いヤツじゃのう
rows.re: But with her... With {2}, you were / never quite so bold or open.

rows.en: @It makes a big sister want to take you in her arms and take care of you.
rows.jp: 「お姉さん / 可愛がってあげたくなっちゃう<b:8a3f>ったかな？
rows.re: Makes a big sister want to gather / you up and look after you.

rows.en: @Sorry. I didn't mean to hassle you.
rows.jp: 「ごめんねぇ / からかうつもりはなかったんだけどね<b:8a3f>ってなんかいません〜
rows.re: Sorry. I didn't mean to tease.

rows.en: @But it's um, well unexpected.
rows.jp: 「ただ、ちょっと、意外だったというか / 何というか〜
rows.re: But it's, um, unexpected.

rows.en: @The image I had of the <Sword Magess> was well....
rows.jp: 「俺が考えていた / ＜剣の少女＞ってイメージとは / その〜
rows.re: The image I had of the <Sword / Magess> was, well...

rows.en: @A little different...
rows.jp: 「少し、違うかな、と〜<b:8a40>手なものよね〜
rows.re: A little different...

rows.en: @So you think it's OK to just force your will on everyone?
rows.jp: 「そうやって、何もかも / <b:8a41>し付けてしまえばいいと / 考えているのね姉さんだって / たまにはＨなコトくらい考えることあるわよ
rows.re: So you think it's fine to force / your will on everyone?

rows.en: @Before I was the <Sword Magess>, I was just a girl called Anastasia. I can't help it.
rows.jp: 「＜少女＞なんて呼ばれる前は / ただのアナスタシアだったんだもん / 仕方ないわよ
rows.re: Before the <Sword Magess,> I was / just a girl named Anastasia. I / can't help it.

rows.en: @Do you want to go to Filgaia, to the world where {2} is waiting for you?
rows.jp: 「ファルガイアに〜 / [0a]かちゃんの待っている世界に / 帰りたい〜？此方』とするなら / 死者の世界を『彼方』と呼ぶわ
rows.re: Do you want to go to Filgaia, where / {2} is waiting for you?

rows.en: @dead is |the other side,| then this is the interval, the boundary between both places.
rows.jp: 「そしてここは、『此方』と『彼方』の / <b:8a43>間に級置する<b:8a44>界<f041><f042>
rows.re: If death is |the other side,| this / is the boundary between the two.

rows.en: @It's a ruin of memories. I might be able to make contact with Filgaia from here.
rows.jp: 「つまり『渡録の遺跡』ね〜 / ここからならファルガイアに / 通じるかもしれない<b:8a45>くことができるのなら〜
rows.re: A ruin of memories. From here I / might reach Filgaia.

rows.en: @But with her... With {2}, you weren't terribly brave or forthcoming.
rows.jp: 「＜少女＞なんて呼ばれる前は / ただのアナスタシアだったんだもん / 仕方ないわよ
rows.re: But with her... With {2}, you were / never quite so bold or open.
