rows.en: *Do you want to read it?2
rows.jp: ＊進みますか？[18]か
rows.lit: Do you want to proceed?
rows.re: Do you want to proceed?
rows.speaker: system/prompt

rows.en: @my big sister who I so adore. I had always believed that, but it's not true.
rows.jp: 「ずっと、そう思ってきた / でも、ホントは違ったんだ
rows.re: ...my big sister, whom I so adore. / I always believed that, but it's / not true.

rows.en: @My Crest Sorcery can't do everything.
rows.jp: 「わたしのクレストソーサーじゃ / 何もできないんだ〜
rows.re: My Crest Sorcery can't do / everything.

rows.en: @Where are you?
rows.jp: 「どこにいるのッ！
rows.re: Where are you?

rows.en: @Why do you belittle yourself? You are you.
rows.jp: 「どうして、自分で自分を右定するの？ / あなたは、あなたじゃない
rows.re: Why belittle yourself? You are you.

rows.en: @You don't have magic so you can become someone else. Right?
rows.jp: 「他の誰かに代わるために / あなたの魔法はあるわけじゃないわ / ね、そうでしょ？
rows.re: You don't do magic to become / someone else. Right?

rows.en: @The person everyone wants to have here is you, my older sister.
rows.jp: 「みんなが / ここにいてほしいと思っているのは / お左ちゃんなんだよ〜
rows.re: The one everyone wants here is you, / my big sister.

rows.en: @That's why I've always tried to fill in for you by going all out.
rows.jp: 「だから、わたしは / お左ちゃんの代りになるために / がんばってきたんだよ
rows.re: That's why I always went all out, / trying to fill in for you.

rows.en: @I mean, come on. There are things only you can do.
rows.jp: 「だって、そうでしょ？ / あなたには、あなたにしかできないことが / あるのだから〜
rows.re: Come on. There are things only you / can do.

rows.en: @At the Millennium Puzzle, didn't you stay to the finish?
rows.jp: 「ミレニアム・パズルでも / あなたは最後までがんばったじゃない
rows.re: At the Millennium Puzzle, didn't / you stay to the very end?

rows.en: @You didn't give up like I did.
rows.jp: 「お左ちゃんみたいに / あきらめなかったじゃない〜
rows.re: You didn't give up the way I did.

rows.en: @Yet, I wasn't able to do anything.
rows.jp: 「それに〜 / 何もできなかった〜
rows.re: And yet, I couldn't do a thing.

rows.en: @I remember. I almost gave up.
rows.jp: 「そうよ、あの時 / わたし、あきらめていたのよ〜
rows.re: I remember. I nearly gave up.

rows.en: @I wasn't able to do anything with my magic.
rows.jp: 「わたしの魔法の力じゃ / 何もできないって〜
rows.re: My magic couldn't do anything.

rows.en: @Your magic can be used by anyone, and can do anything...
rows.jp: 「魔法は誰にでも使えて / そして<f040><f042> / 何でもできる力だということを
rows.re: Your magic can be used by anyone, / and can do anything...

rows.en: @Your magic isn't Crest Sorcery.
rows.jp: 「あなたが使う魔法は / クレストソーサーなんかじゃないわ
rows.re: Your magic isn't Crest Sorcery.

rows.en: @Try to remember the special spell I taught you.
rows.jp: 「思い出して / お左ちゃんがあなたに乗えた / とっておきのおまじないを〜
rows.re: Remember the special spell I taught / you.

rows.en: @Hocus Pocus Fizzipocus.
rows.jp: 「〜ホクスポクスフィジポス〜<b:8a38>探を呼ぶおまじない
rows.re: Hocus Pocus Fizzipocus.

rows.en: @I'm sure you can use it.
rows.jp: 「あなたなら / きっと使えるわ
rows.re: I'm sure you can use it.

rows.en: @There's someone I like, someone I want to protect.
rows.jp: 「大押きな人がいるの / 守りたい人がいるの〜
rows.re: There's someone I love, someone I / want to protect.

rows.en: @I want to see their laughter.
rows.jp: 「その人の<b:8a38>探が見たいんだ〜
rows.re: I want to see them laugh.

rows.en: @But there's one thing you need to be careful about.
rows.jp: 「そのために / あなたが<88f7>意しなければいけないことは / たったのひとつ〜
rows.re: But there's one thing to be careful / of.

rows.en: @Don't cry anymore. Come on, laugh, 2.
rows.re: Don't cry anymore. Come on, {2}, / smile.

rows.en: @Until you reveal your true self to me, the Raypoint won't be released.
rows.jp: 「我が前に、真実の姿をさらさぬかぎり / レイポイントの解放はならぬ真実〜？
rows.re: Until you show me your true self, / the Raypoint won't open.

rows.en: @I am still myself. Nothing's changed. And my truth is me myself!
rows.jp: 「僕は僕だ / そこに何も偽りはない / この僕の真実は、僕自身だッ！
rows.re: I'm still me. Nothing's changed. / And my truth is me, myself!

rows.en: @You are the hero from the past, are now an ARMS member, and are our future possibility.
rows.jp: 「お前は、過<b:8a3f>（かつて）の英雄であり / 現在（いま）のＡＲＭＳであり / 未来（ゆくすえ）の可能性である〜
rows.re: You're the hero of old, now an ARMS / member, and our future's promise.

rows.en: @But those are |facts,| and not the |truth.|
rows.jp: 「だがそれは〜 / 『事実』であって、『真実』にあらず〜真実』〜偽りの起は / 真実の輝をさえぎる
rows.re: But those are |facts,| not the / |truth.|

rows.en: @When I said before that unless you reveal your true self, the Raypoint won't be released...
rows.jp: 「我が前に、真実の姿をさらさぬかぎり / レイポイントの解放はならぬ
rows.re: When I said the Raypoint won't open / until you show your true self...

rows.en: @...it's not |facts,| but |truth| that expels the shadows of lies. The truth releases the Raypoint.
rows.jp: 「『事実』ではなく、『真実』を〜 / 偽りの起を<b:8a43>りはらい / レイポイントを解放する真実の輝を〜偽りがある…
rows.re: ...it's |truth,| not |facts,| that / drives off the shadows of lies. / Truth opens the Raypoint.

rows.en: @Yes, I carry the lie that I am |me,| 1 Evans.
rows.jp: 「たしかに僕は『僕』であること… / 『[05]お・エヴァンス』という / 偽りを<b:8a44>いている
rows.re: Yes, I carry the lie that I am / |me,| {1} Evans.

rows.en: @So, it was necessary to do this for the liberation and future of Slayheim.
rows.jp: 「だが、あの<b:8a45><b:8a46>の解放戦では / そして、スレイハイムの未来のためには / こうすることが必要なことだった
rows.re: It had to be done, for Slayheim's / liberation and its future.

rows.en: @For the future of the liberated Slayheim, 1 Evans was necessary!
rows.jp: 「解放戦後のスレイハイムの未来には / 『[05]お・エヴァンス』が / 必要だったッ！
rows.re: For a free Slayheim's future, |{1} / Evans| was needed!

rows.en: @So I threw myself out and became another |me.|
rows.jp: 「だからこそ僕は僕であることを捨て / 『僕』であることを選んだッ！
rows.re: So I cast myself aside and became / another |me.|

rows.en: @That was my promise to |him.|
rows.jp: 「そうすることが / 『あいつ』との<b:8a48>重だった…<b:8a48>重をもって『英雄』になったと…勝利すること以前に / もっと重要なことがあった
rows.re: That was my promise to |him.|

rows.en: @the battle of liberation. It was to unite the people of Slayheim.
rows.jp: 「それは、スレイハイムのみんなが / ひとつになること<f040><f042>
rows.re: ...the war of liberation. It was to / unite the people of Slayheim.

rows.en: @That was more important.
rows.jp: 「これがいちばん大切なことだった
rows.re: That mattered more.

rows.en: @If we had only won we wouldn't have been any different from the enemy, the Slayheim throne.
rows.jp: 「ただ勝利するだけでは / 僕たちが相としていた / スレイハイム王<b:8a4a>と何ら変わりはない
rows.re: Winning alone would make us no / different from the Slayheim throne / we fought.

rows.en: @If we only threw power around, nothing would change.
rows.jp: 「力でねじ<b:8a4b>せるだけじゃ / そこから何も変わらない
rows.re: Just throwing power around changes / nothing.

rows.en: @I am...
rows.re: I am...

rows.en: @The Slayheim Liberation Army is a unit that took on the silly ideals |I| professed.
rows.jp: 「いや、僕たちスレイハイム解放軍は / そう語った『僕』の / バカげた理想を真に受けた軍隊なのさ
rows.re: The Liberation Army took up the / foolish ideals |I| once professed.

rows.en: @That's why the Liberation Army couldn't lose |me.|
rows.jp: 「だからこそ、僕たち解放軍は / 『僕』を失うわけにはいかなかったッ！英雄』は力ではないというのか？
rows.re: That's why the Army couldn't lose / |me.|

rows.en: @A |hero| isn't just power, but a symbol of power.
rows.jp: 「『英雄』は力そのものではなく / 力を重ねる<b:8a4f><b:8a50>であるべきだ、と
rows.re: A |hero| isn't just power, but a / symbol of it.

rows.en: @Like the <Sword Magess>, peace isn't delivered by the |hero.|
rows.jp: 「＜<b:8a51>の少女＞のように / 『英雄』から平和を / <b:8a55>えられるものではなく
rows.re: Like the <Sword Magess,> peace / isn't handed down by a |hero.|

rows.en: @A |hero| should be a symbol for people to emulate and create their own peace.
rows.jp: 「自分たちの手で平和をつかみ取るため / 『英雄』はそのための / <b:8a4f><b:8a50>であればいい
rows.re: A |hero| is a symbol for people to / follow, to build their own peace.

rows.en: @A |hero| isn't bestowed upon anyone nor is it something to cling to.
rows.jp: 「『英雄』は、<b:8a55>えてくれるモノでなく / すがりつくモノでもない
rows.re: A |hero| is neither granted to / anyone nor something to cling to.

rows.en: @For the purpose of peace, the people joined together to achieve a common goal.
rows.jp: 「平和という目的の為に人々はまとまり / ひとつの目的を共にする
rows.re: For peace, the people joined and / worked toward one goal.

rows.en: @And once you grab it with your own hands, real peace will come.
rows.jp: 「そうして手に入れてこそ / 本当の平和が<b:8a57>れる
rows.re: And once you grasp it yourself, / real peace will come.

rows.en: @That was |my| hope for the future.
rows.jp: 「そんな未来が、『僕』にとっての / 願いでもあった偽りの『英雄』よ / ならば誓う〜
rows.re: That was |my| hope for the future.

rows.en: @Why are you still a |hero?| Your battle should be over.
rows.jp: 「何故にお前は / 未だ『英雄』なのだ？ / お前の戦いは終っているはずだ
rows.re: Why are you still a |hero?| Your / battle should be over.

rows.en: @That I am |me| means that my ties to |him| are the ties to keep fighting.
rows.jp: 「僕が『僕』であること / それは『あいつ』との絆 / 共に戦い続ける絆、ただそれだけだ
rows.re: Being |me| means my ties to |him| / are the ties that keep me fighting.

rows.en: @By me being |me,| |his| ideals have become a part of me.
rows.jp: 「そして、僕が『僕』であることで / 『あいつ』の語った理想が / 身に<b:8a59>みてわかってきた
rows.re: By my being |me,| |his| ideals have / become part of me.

rows.en: @The guys from ARMS don't rely on |me| to be their |hero,| but fight with their own power.
rows.jp: 「ＡＲＭＳの仲間たちは / 『英雄』である『僕』に頼ることなく / 自分たちの力で共に戦ってきた
rows.re: The ARMS don't lean on |me| for a / |hero.| They fight by their own / power.

rows.en: @|I| am a person from the past as opposed to the future which must be obtained.
rows.jp: 「『僕』は過<b:8a3f>の存在 / 対して、勝ち取るのは未来だからな
rows.re: |I| am of the past, set against the / future that must be won.

rows.en: @I don't rely on |myself.| I'm fighting together with them for the future, for tomorrow.
rows.jp: 「そして、僕も『僕』に頼ることなく / 次回という未来を勝ち取るために / いっしょに戦っているつもりだ<b:8a5b>める未来を勝ち取るために / レイポイントの解放を<b:8a5c>むか〜
rows.re: I don't lean on |myself.| I fight / with them, for the future, for / tomorrow.

rows.en: @Very well. Then, in my presence I want you to disclose the unchanging eternal truth.
rows.jp: 「よかろう〜 / ならば我が前に / 偽りなき、真実をさらすがよい英雄』なんかではない
rows.re: Very well. Then before me, lay bare / the unchanging, eternal truth.

rows.en: @But I'll fight to save the people and bring peace to the world. That will never change.
rows.jp: 「だが僕は / 世界の平和を、人々を守るために戦う / そこに偽りはないッ！偽りのない真実だッ！
rows.re: But I'll fight to save people and / bring peace. That will never / change.

rows.en: @And, the other truth is...
rows.jp: 「そして、もうひとつの真実〜真実？偽りッ！
rows.re: And the other truth is...

rows.en: @You are not an obstacle. You're only a test to bring out our hidden potential.
rows.jp: 「<88f6><889b>などではない〜 / 僕たちの街に<b:8a5d>めた可能性を / 招き出そうとする試練
rows.re: You're no obstacle. You're only a / test to draw out our hidden power.

rows.en: @That's the other truth!
rows.jp: 「それが、もうひとつの真実ッ！
rows.re: That's the other truth!

rows.en: @You certainly showed me your truth. There are no changes or shadows to the truth you spoke of.
rows.jp: 「<b:8a5e>の真実 / たしかに見せてもらった / 語りし真実に、偽りも起もない
rows.re: You've shown me your truth. No / shift, no shadow in what you spoke.

rows.en: @I'll release the Raypoint for the future you desire, the future you want!
rows.jp: 「<b:8a5e>の<b:8a5b>め、<b:8a5c>む未来のために / 我がレイポイントを解放しようッ！
rows.re: I'll open the Raypoint for the / future you desire, the future you / want!

rows.en: @I wonder what it is? Gaia asked me the same thing at the Sacrificial Altar. The reason I fight...
rows.jp: 「何だろう〜 / 生け<b:8a5f>の<b:8a60><b:8a61>でガイアにも誓われた / ボクが戦う理由〜<b:8a62>からは外れられないのだ
rows.re: What is it, I wonder? Gaia asked / the same at the Sacrificial Altar. / Why I fight...

rows.en: @I could never risk my own life for something like that!
rows.jp: 「ボクはそんなモノのために / 自分の命を / かけたりできないよッ！<b:8a63>だから / <b:8a64>いからだよ〜<b:8a65>はそうだった〜
rows.re: I could never stake my life on / something like that!

rows.en: @But that's no longer it. When I thought of someone beside myself, I came into my powers.
rows.jp: 「でも、違ったんだ〜 / 自分以外の誰かを考えて / はじめて出る力に気がついたんだ守りたかった
rows.re: But not anymore. When I thought of / another, my power awoke.

rows.en: @And in order to protect you, I decided to work really hard.
rows.jp: 「キミを守るために / がんばるって決めたんだッ！
rows.re: And to protect you, I chose to give / it everything.

rows.en: @If 3 dies, Filgaia will be saved.
rows.jp: 「[05]がくんが死ぬことで / ファルガイアが助かるの
rows.re: If {3} dies, Filgaia will be saved.

rows.en: @Not just me, but everyone will be saved.
rows.jp: 「わたしだけじゃない / みんなが助かるの
rows.re: Not just me, but everyone will be / saved.

rows.en: @I am the |Pillar.| I have the power to protect what is important.
rows.jp: 「ボクは『鍵』なんだ / 大切なモノを守る力がある
rows.re: I am the |Pillar.| I have the power / to protect what matters.

rows.en: @It's easy. Just go on and die.
rows.jp: 「カンタンだよ / 死んじゃえばいいんだよ〜<b:8b14>[80]
rows.re: It's easy. Just go and die.

rows.en: @That's the destiny you were handed. But the answer 3'd find is a different answer if you looked.
rows.jp: 「それは<b:8a66>しつけられた運命ッ！ / [05]がが考えて / 見つけた<883a>えではないのダッ！
rows.re: That's the fate you were dealt. But / {3} could find a different answer, / if she looked.

rows.en: @I'll think about it too. Find it yourself. That'll be your real answer.
rows.jp: 「プーカもいっしょに考える / だから『自分』で見つけよう / それが『<883a>え』なんダッ！守りたい〜 / それは、まちがいないよ
rows.re: I'll think on it too. Find it / yourself. That's your real answer.

rows.en: @That part is true. And in order to do that, I'm willing to risk my life.
rows.jp: 「そのために / 命をかけたっていいと思っている守りたい人は / 守れないんだ〜
rows.re: That part is true. And for it, I'm / willing to risk my life.

rows.en: @That's what I think!
rows.jp: 「そう、思うんだよッ！守れたとしても〜
rows.re: That's what I believe!

rows.en: @...if something happens again later, it's {3} who will be the Sacrificial Pillar.
rows.jp: 「この更、何かが起こったら / 『生け<b:8a5f>の鍵』にされるのは / [0a]がだよ
rows.re: ...if it happens again, it's {3} / who becomes the Sacrificial Pillar.

rows.en: @To not be able to do anything when a person close to you is facing a life threatening danger...
rows.jp: 「大切な人が / 命の危険にさらされているのに / その時、何もできないなんて〜
rows.re: To stand helpless while someone / dear faces mortal danger...

rows.en: @The reason I risk my life in battle is not to save the world! That's not the only reason.
rows.jp: 「ボクが命をかけて戦えるのは / 世界を守ることなんかじゃないッ！ / それだけじゃないッ！
rows.re: I don't risk my life just to save / the world. That's not the only / reason.

rows.en: @It's also to create a future where no one else has to be sacrificed.
rows.jp: 「誰かの<b:8a67><b:8a68>の上にたつ / 未来を<b:8a69>らないためにッ！
rows.re: It's to build a future where no one / else must be sacrificed.

rows.en: @To save the ones I care about, I need to prove that the world can be saved without a Sacrificial Pillar.
rows.jp: 「大切な人のために〜 / 『生け<b:8a5f>の鍵』に頼らなくても / 世界を守れることを<b:8a6a>次するためにッ！
rows.re: To protect those I love, I'll prove / the world can be saved with no / Pillar.

rows.en: @I won't die. I am going to live and still protect the world.
rows.jp: 「ボクは死なない / 生きて、守り抜くッ！
rows.re: I won't die. I'll live and still / protect the world.

rows.en: @This is the reason I fight.
rows.jp: 「ボクが見つけた / 戦う理由は、それなんだッ！
rows.re: This is why I fight.

rows.en: @You thought about it and found the answer. It's important to do that.
rows.jp: 「自分で考え / <883a>えを見つける〜 / これは大変なことなのダ
rows.re: You thought it through and found / your answer. That matters.

rows.en: @But is this really OK? Pooka's orders from Gaia were to turn me into the |Pillar| right?
rows.jp: 「でも、いいのかな？ / プーカはボクを『鍵』にすることが / ガイアから<b:8a6b>わされた使命なんだろ？<b:8a6c>はしていないのダ〜志で考えたのダ
rows.re: But is this really OK? Pooka's / orders from Gaia were to make me / the |Pillar,| right?

rows.en: @And I guided you to a future other than the one you were dealt.
rows.jp: 「そしてキミを / 定められた運命ではなく / 単の未来へ導いたのダ
rows.re: And I led you to a future other / than the one you were dealt.
...zzz...zzz...zzz...

rows.en: @Pookas are meant to have no will themselves. They are to act only according to orders.
rows.jp: 「自分の意志を持たず / 命じられたままに動くことで / 存在を許されたのが、プーカなのダ姿をとることができるのダ
rows.re: Pookas are meant to have no will, / to act only on orders.

rows.en: @But being with you, I was able to think and act on my own.
rows.jp: 「でも、キミと一<b:8a6f>にいて / プーカも自分で考えて行動したのダ
rows.re: But with you, I learned to think / and act on my own.

rows.en: @Leading you to a different future wasn't anyone else's idea, but my own. I have found my own |self.|
rows.jp: 「キミを単の未来に導いたのは / 誰の意志でもない、プーカなのダ / プーカは『自分』見つけたのダ〜
rows.re: Leading you elsewhere was no one's / idea but mine. I've found my own / |self.|

rows.en: @So, this is good-bye.
rows.jp: 「ここで / お単れなのダ〜<b:8a63>だよッ！ / プーカッ！
rows.re: So, this is goodbye.

rows.en: @I who gave up everything... but the one and only thing I can't give up is the |confusion.|
rows.jp: 「すべてを捨ててきたあたしが / <b:8a71>一捨て切れないもの〜 / それが『政い』〜捨ててみせるさ
rows.re: I gave up everything... yet the one / thing I can't give up is the / |confusion.|

rows.en: @That's how I became strong. That's how I got powerful.
rows.jp: 「そうすることで / あたしは強くなってきた / 力を手に入れてきたんだ捨ててしまったの？
rows.re: That's how I grew strong. That's / how I gained power.

rows.en: @That's it. If I don't do it, I'll never be able to be a |hero.|
rows.jp: 「そうだ〜 / そうしなければ / 『英雄』になれないのだ
rows.re: That's it. If I don't, I'll never / be a |hero.|

rows.en: @I wasn't able to acquire the power to exorcise evil!
rows.jp: 「<b:8a72><b:8a73>（まがばらい）の力を / 手にすることは / できなかったのだッ！
rows.re: I never gained the power to drive / out evil!

rows.en: @But if you've got the blood of the <Sword Magess> flowing within you, why did you throw away your body?
rows.jp: 「＜<b:8a51>の少女＞の血が流れているんでしょ？ / なのに、どうして / その身体を捨ててしまったの？<b:8b14>[80]
rows.re: But if <Sword Magess> blood runs in / you, why did you cast off your / body?

rows.en: @All those years past, if I had endured the abuses of a bionic body, I would have become a |hero?|
rows.jp: 「<b:8a75>用数年もとうに過ぎた / 義体（シルエット）を<b:8a76>使して / あたしは『英雄』になれたのかな？
rows.re: Back then, had I endured a bionic / body's torments, would I have / become a |hero?|

rows.en: @Am I somehow different from the other Mercs?
rows.jp: 「他の『渡り<b:8a77>』と / どこか違うところがあるのかな？英雄』になることを<b:8a5b>めたのだろう〜
rows.re: Am I any different from the other / Mercs?

rows.en: @I was raised hearing my mother tell stories about the <Sword Magess>.
rows.jp: 「ずっとお<b:8a78>さんに / ＜<b:8a51>の少女＞のことを / 聞かされて<b:8a79>ったあたし〜
rows.re: I grew up on my mother's tales of / the <Sword Magess.>

rows.en: @I always hoped that I had the blood of the <Sword Magess> within me.
rows.jp: 「自分の中に / ＜<b:8a51>の少女＞の血が流れていることを / 願ってきたあたし〜
rows.re: I always hoped her blood ran in me.

rows.en: @I always thought that if I were a |hero,| I'd be able to get out of this situation.
rows.jp: 「『英雄』と呼ばれれば / 今の状況から、きっと抜け出せると / 信じてきたあたし〜
rows.re: I always thought that as a |hero,| / I could escape this.

rows.en: @I always thought about how to escape from that dark slum. And I...
rows.jp: 「あの暗いスラムから / 脱け出すことをいつも考えて / あたしは〜英雄』を<88e6>り所にした<f040><f042> / そうだったよね？
rows.re: I only ever thought of fleeing that / dark slum. And I...

rows.en: @A world just like that slum had spread everywhere.
rows.jp: 「あのスラムと / 同じ世界がどこまでも / 広がっていたのだ〜<b:8a5b>めていたのは / 『英雄』なんかじゃない
rows.re: A world just like that slum had / spread everywhere.

rows.en: @I wanted a group of friends who needed me.
rows.jp: 「あなたを必要としてくれる / 『仲間』が<b:8a7a>しかった
rows.re: I wanted friends who needed me.

rows.en: @So you wanted to be needed. That's why you tried to be a |hero,| right?
rows.jp: 「だから、必要とされる存在<f040><f042> / 『英雄』になろうとした / そうよね？英雄』を<b:8a5b>める理由〜受け入れてくれる場所〜 / 『仲間』という場所が<b:8a7a>しかった
rows.re: So you wanted to be needed. That's / why you tried to be a |hero,| / right?

rows.en: @But...
rows.jp: 「だが〜〜<b:8a7b>外信を信じている理由？
rows.re: But...

rows.en: @You should know...
rows.jp: 「それはわかっているはず<b:8a7c><b:8a7d>している、から〜<b:8a7e>気を出して / 手を<b:8a7f>しのべて〜
rows.re: You should know...

rows.en: @If I do that, they'll probably accept me.
rows.jp: 「そうすれば / あの人たちは / きっとあたしを受け入れてくれるわ絆』になるの / 『絆』は仲間を<b:8a80>ぐ<b:8a81>なのよ受け入れて / 仲間だと認<b:8a82>して
rows.re: If I do that, they'll surely accept / me.

rows.en: @Broken bionic implants can only shorten one's life.
rows.jp: 「滅れかけた義体（シルエット）は / 命を<b:8a83>めかねない
rows.re: Broken bionic implants only shorten / a life.

rows.en: @Don't refuse me. It'll help me get back my original body of living flesh.
rows.jp: 「あたしを右定しないで / そうすれば、義体なんかじゃない / 生身の身体を取り戻すことができるわ〜
rows.re: Don't refuse me. It'll help me / regain my body of living flesh.

rows.en: *Do you want to read it?2
rows.jp: ＊進みますか？[18]か
rows.lit: Do you want to proceed?
rows.re: Do you want to proceed?
rows.speaker: system/prompt

rows.en: @Unfortunately, this service is unavailable in the Demo Version.
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>でも、今回の体験版では / 残念ながら使用することができません
rows.lit: But in this trial version, it unfortunately cannot be used.
rows.re: But in this trial version, it / unfortunately cannot be used.
rows.speaker: system/prompt

rows.en: *Unfortunately, this service is unavailable in the Demo Version.
rows.jp: ＊〜ですが、今回の体験版では / 残念ながら使用することができません
rows.lit: ...however, in this trial version it unfortunately cannot be used.
rows.re: ...however, in this trial version, / it unfortunately cannot be used.
rows.speaker: system/prompt

rows.en: @The country's resource called a |Fossil| was used to develop mechanical techniques.
rows.jp: 「あの<b:8a38>は、『合谷』と呼ばれる / 古代の遺<b:8a39>を用いて / <89e1>自の機艇<b:8a3a>術を発<b:8a3c>させたのさ<b:8a38>の<b:8a3d>備を一気に<b:8a3e><b:8a3f>してしまえば / モンスターなど、あっという間に壊滅だ<b:8a40>』をモチーフにしているらしいぞ
rows.re: A national resource called |Fossil| / was used to build our machines.

rows.en: @It's not right. It feels like we're the |National Pet| What do you think?
rows.jp: 「なーんか、ヤなんだよな / 『<b:8a38><b:8a41>の<b:8a40>』ってなカンジでさ / キミはどう思う？
rows.re: It's not right. Feels like we're / the |National Pet.| Don't you / think?

rows.en: @But it won't be long before some booming voice calls us.
rows.jp: 「だけどまあ〜 / すぐにお話はかかるだろう
rows.re: It won't be long before some / booming voice calls us up.

rows.en: @I mean, it's almost guaranteed we'll be assigned to the front line.
rows.jp: 「何たって僕たちは / 最前<b:8a42>に配備されるのが / 決まっているようなモンだからな
rows.re: We're all but certain to be sent to / the front line.

rows.en: Just by re-outfitting us, our tactic options increase. How very convenient.
rows.jp: <b:8a43>備しなおすだけで / 戦術に<b:8a44>ができるんだから / <b:8a45>利なもんだよな<b:8a46><b:8a47>の<b:8a48><b:8a49>は知らねぇが / こう見えても、僕は<b:8a4a>同あがりなんだ
rows.re: Just re-outfit us and our tactics / multiply. How convenient for them.

rows.en: @I was involved in the Slayheim War 5 years ago. Of course I fought for the Liberation Army.
rows.jp: 「５数前の / スレイハイム解放戦にも<b:8a4b><b:8a4c>したんだぜ / もちろん解放<b:8a3d>としてだ<b:8a4d>空を見ていたら / <88bf>大な<b:8a4e>星が / <b:8a4f>空を<b:8a50>切っていったんだ
rows.re: I was in the Slayheim War five / years back. Fought for the / Liberation Army, of course.

rows.en: @I recall my grandmother saying comets were an omen of evil.
rows.jp: 「そういやあ、うちのバア方が / <b:8a4e>星は<b:8a51><b:8a52>の現れだって / 言ってたっけな〜
rows.re: My grandmother used to call comets / an omen of evil.

rows.en: @But the monsters just keep multiplying.
rows.jp: 「だけど、モンスターは / どんどん<b:8a53><b:8a4c>しているんだ
rows.re: But the monsters just keep / multiplying.

rows.en: @Where in the world are they all coming from?
rows.jp: 「やつらはいったい / どこからやってきているんだ〜<b:8a54><b:8a55>に緊<b:8a3f>しているでアリマス / 今回の自分の<b:8a56>を / <89de><b:8a57>のお<b:8a58>にみせてやりたいでアリマス<b:8a59>いちまったんだ / 彼女のいる<b:8a46>ぁ、カワイソーだね
rows.re: Where in the world are they all / coming from?

rows.en: @For me, ever since I was born, I never once managed such troublesome things!
rows.jp: 「僕なんて、生まれてこのかた / そんなメンドーなモンは / 一度たりともできたこたぁねぇよッ！
rows.re: Me, since the day I was born I / never once pulled off anything so / tricky!

rows.en: @So, what about you?
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>で、おめぇはどうなのよ？<b:8a5a>部隊ってことらしいな
rows.re: So, what about you?

rows.en: @In other words, we're being assigned to the most dangerous front.
rows.jp: 「つまりは / 一番危険な戦場に配備されるってことだ
rows.re: In other words, we're bound for the / most dangerous front.

rows.en: @I wonder how many of us will still be alive 6 months from now.
rows.jp: 「さあて、<89a7>数後までに / 何人生き残っていることやら〜<b:8a5b>人の<b:8a48><b:8a49>は / 重要視されていないんだ〜
rows.re: I wonder how many of us will still / be alive six months from now.

rows.en: @Look around you. Aren't there a lot of shady-looking guys here?
rows.jp: 「だから、<b:8a5c>りを見渡してみろよ / <b:8a5d><b:8a5e><b:8a5f>そうな連中が / けっこう<b:8a60>じっているだろう？
rows.re: Look around. Plenty of shady types / here, aren't there?

rows.en: @The soldiers here are from all over.
rows.jp: 「ここに選抜された隊<b:8a61>は / <b:8a62>、出身がバラバラなんだ
rows.re: The soldiers here come from / everywhere.

rows.en: @They're more interested in your skills than your nationality.
rows.jp: 「結定の<b:8a38><b:8a41>にとらわれることなく / <b:8a63>動することを強調しているからな<b:8a63><b:8a64>に<b:8a65>待しています / がんばってください<b:8a3f>しています / 単にワタシが緊<b:8a3f>する必要は / これっぽっちも無いんですけどね
rows.re: They care more about your skill / than your homeland.

rows.en: *Since then, the lineage of the <Sword Magess> is seen as the lineage of a |hero.|
rows.jp: ＊これにより、＜置の少女＞の血筋を / 『勇者』の血筋を見なす / <89f9><89fc>が高まっていくことになる
rows.re: *Since then, the <Sword Magess> / line has been seen as a |hero's| / line.

rows.en: *But no one on the planet is directly descended from the <Sword Magess>.
rows.jp: ＊しかし、＜置の少女＞自身の / 血を招きし者は / この世には存在しない
rows.re: *But no one alive descends directly / from the <Sword Magess.>

rows.en: *The family line was carried on, but the blood got diluted and the |hero's| ancestors spread.
rows.jp: ＊<b:8a41>としての血筋を招く者は多く / 血は<b:8a70>れ、年多の『勇者』の家<b:8a71>を / 地に<b:8a72>れさせた
rows.re: *The line went on, but the blood / thinned and the |hero's| kin / scattered.

rows.en: *How much value is placed on |blood?| The <Sword Magess> herself said blood doesn't make a |hero.|
rows.jp: ＊『血』にいかほどの<b:8a73><8875>があろうか / ＜置の少女＞自身がそれを物<b:8a74>っている / 血によって『勇者』は為らず勇者と災厄勇者』は / 戦うべき『災厄』がありて / 『勇者』たりえる
rows.re: *How much is |blood| worth? The / Magess herself said blood makes no / |hero.|

rows.en: *The reverse is also true. When a |hero| appears, |disaster| follows. They are 2 sides of the same coin.
rows.jp: ＊その<89c1>も部り / 『勇者』現れるるとき、『災厄』あり / 『勇者』と『災厄』は表<b:8a77>一体
rows.re: *And the reverse: where a |hero| / appears, |disaster| follows. Two / sides of one coin.

rows.en: *A |hero| isn't born. It's something you know as a result of actions.
rows.jp: ＊『勇者』は生まれついてのものでなし / 何を為したかによってあるものと知れ<b:8a55><8860><b:8a78>の魔神を事<b:8a7a>の彼方へ封<b:8a7b>し / 力尽きた＜置の少女＞は / アガートラームを大地に刺す
rows.re: *A |hero| isn't born. It's known by / what one does.

rows.en: *Many knights and heroes have vied for the Argetlahm, but all have failed.
rows.jp: ＊<b:8a7e>多の<b:8a7f>胞、<b:8a80>者が / アガートラームを手にすべく<897b>み / ことごとく<b:8a81>わず
rows.re: *Many knights and heroes vied for / the Argetlahm. All failed.

rows.en: *Even blood relatives of the <Sword Magess> couldn't retake the sword.
rows.jp: ＊＜置の少女＞の血筋のものですら / 抜くことは不可能であった
rows.re: *Even Magess kin could not reclaim / the sword.

rows.en: *The Argetlahm thrust in the earth acts as if it rejects all but the <Sword Magess>.
rows.jp: ＊大地に刺さりしアガートラームは / ＜置の少女＞以外を<b:8a82>むかのように / 大地に<b:8a83>む
rows.re: *Thrust in the earth, the Argetlahm / rejects all but the <Sword Magess.>

rows.en: *The cathedral devoted to the <Sword Magess> had the pedestal enshrined. Even the stone itself was removed.
rows.jp: ＊＜置の少女＞を<b:8a84>りし大少<b:8a85>に安置すべく / <b:8a55><8860>となりし<b:8a86><89cd>ごと / 大地より切り取られることになった少地への<b:8a87>礼少<b:8a85>のある地は / ＜置の少女＞の少地とされている
rows.re: *In the Magess's cathedral, even / the enshrined pedestal stone was / carried off.

rows.en: *This is land the <Sword Magess> acquired under the direction of Argetlahm.
rows.jp: ＊＜置の少女＞が / アガートラームに<b:8a88>かれて / 手にした地
rows.re: *This is land the Magess won at the / Argetlahm's guidance.

rows.en: *To exorcise the disasters covering the earth, a ray of hope was directed toward us.
rows.jp: ＊世界を<b:8a89>う災厄を<b:8a8a>うべく / 希望の輝が世界に向かって / 放たれた地である

rows.en: *Many worshippers visit here, where the hero who saved Earth was born.
rows.jp: ＊世界を救った『勇者』<890c>生の地として / 多くの礼<b:8a8d>者たちが<b:8a8e>れている
rows.re: *Many pilgrims come here, where the / hero who saved the world was born.

rows.en: *The Argetlahm is publicly displayed a few times a year for worshippers.
rows.jp: ＊礼<b:8a8d>者のために、数に年度 / アガートラームが一<b:8a8f><b:8a90>開される<b:8a91>げられし<b:8a92><b:8a93>望』に<b:8a89>われし世界に / 一筋の輝次が差した / それが＜置の少女＞である
rows.re: *The Argetlahm is shown to / worshippers a few times a year.

rows.en: *Alone, the <Sword Magess> confronted the Demon. She alone shouldered the burden.
rows.jp: ＊<b:8a95>一人、魔神と対<b:8a96>し / ＜置の少女＞は / 一人で全てを<89a3>負ったのである
rows.re: *Alone the Magess faced the Demon. / Alone she bore the burden.

rows.en: *But the <Sword Magess> wasn't able to destroy the Blazing Demon, only contain it.
rows.jp: ＊しかし、<b:8a78>の魔神を / 倒すに至らなかった＜置の少女＞は / その命を以て封じた
rows.re: *But she couldn't destroy the / Blazing Demon, only seal it.

rows.en: *In exchange for world peace, the <Sword Magess> was offered as a |sacrifice.|
rows.jp: ＊＜置の少女＞は / 世界の平<b:8a99>と招き<8864>えに / <b:8a91>げられた『生け<b:8a9a>』である<b:8a78>の魔神と置の少女少女＞出現前 / 年多の<b:8a7f>胞、<b:8a80>者たちが / <b:8a78>の魔神に<897b>んで消えていった
rows.re: *For the world's peace, the Magess / was offered as a |sacrifice.|

rows.en: *Even the weapons developed with the lost technology were a cool breeze on the Blazing Demon.
rows.jp: ＊ロストテクノロジーを以て / 作られた幻同<b:8a9b>でさえ / <b:8a78>の魔神には<b:8a9c><89f9>のごとし
rows.re: *Even weapons from the lost tech / were a mere breeze to the Blazing / Demon.

rows.en: *The <Sword Magess>, armed with the Argetlahm, was the entire resistance.
rows.jp: ＊アガートラームを右えし / ＜置の少女＞だけが / その対抗しうる全て
rows.re: *Armed with Argetlahm, the Magess / was the whole of the resistance.

rows.en: *It is still a mystery why only the <Sword Magess> was able to battle the Blazing Demon on equal footing.
rows.jp: ＊なぜ、＜置の少女＞のみが / <b:8a78>の魔神と対<b:8a47>に戦えたのか / それはいま以て<b:8a9e>とされている<b:8a7a>の地平に封されし魔神<b:8a78>の魔神において / 忘れてならぬことがある

rows.en: *He wasn't |destroyed| but was only |contained.|
rows.jp: ＊彼のものは / 『倒された』のではなく / 『封じられた』ことである
rows.re: *He was not |destroyed,| only / |contained.|

rows.en: *The seal will eventually be broken.
rows.jp: ＊封<b:8a7b>はいずれ解き放たれる…
rows.re: *The seal will break in time.

rows.en: *The Blazing Demon will crush the <Sword Magess>, then Filgaia.
rows.jp: ＊＜置の少女＞亡きファルガイアは / <b:8a78>の魔神に<b:8a9f><b:8aa0>される
rows.re: *The Blazing Demon will crush the / Magess, then Filgaia.

rows.en: *No one knows when the seal will be broken.
rows.jp: ＊その封<b:8a7b>がいつ破られるかなど / 何人もしらない
rows.re: *No one knows when the seal will / break.

rows.en: *Whether it will be 100 years or 1000 years or tomorrow, we have no magic to resist.
rows.jp: ＊１００数後か１０００数後 / それとも次回か / 我々に抗う術はない災厄の<8869>災厄』は負の信情を<b:8aa1>に / さらなる『災厄』を呼び込む
rows.re: *A hundred years, a thousand, or / tomorrow. We have no magic to / resist.

rows.en: *The spreading negativity knows no limits.
rows.jp: ＊広がる負の信情は / とどまることを知らず
rows.re: *The spreading negativity knows no / bounds.

rows.en: *The |disasters| continue to spread without end.
rows.jp: ＊ゆえに、尽きることなく / 『災厄』は広がり続ける
rows.re: *The |disasters| spread on without / end.

rows.en: *When a ray of light doesn't shine, beyond negativity is only a road to |destruction.|
rows.jp: ＊希望の輝が差さぬ / 負の信情のその先には / 待つは『破滅』への道のみ
rows.re: *Where no light shines, past the / darkness lies only |destruction.|

rows.en: *Know that what strangles you in the end is your negativity.
rows.jp: ＊<b:8aa2>が<888a>を<b:8aa3>めるのは / 負の信情と知れ少女＞は / 置に乗れたこともなかった<b:8a6a>だという
rows.re: *Know that what strangles you in / the end is your own negativity.

rows.en: *She wasn't a prominent soldier, nor a knight who'd sworn loyalty to her country. She was just a girl.
rows.jp: ＊戦いに概通した<b:8aa4>指の戦胞でもない / <b:8a38>に<b:8aa5><b:8aa6>を<b:8aa7>った<b:8a7f>胞でもない / ただの<b:8a6a>、それが＜置の少女＞
rows.re: *No famed soldier, no sworn knight. / She was only a girl.

rows.en: *That the Argetlahm couldn't be retrieved only deepens the mystery.
rows.jp: ＊アガートラームが抜けぬ事実が / 『選ばれし者』の<b:8aa8>質の<b:8a9e>を願める
rows.re: *That the Argetlahm can't be / reclaimed only deepens the mystery.

rows.en: *When someone who can hold the Argetlahm appears again, the mystery will be solved.
rows.jp: ＊<b:8aa9>び、アガートラームを / 手にする者が現れたとき / その<b:8a9e>も解けるだろう<b:8aaa>の世界<b:8a78>』は破滅の力… / <b:8a78>を身に<b:8aab>いし魔神の過ぎしあと / 残るは破滅の<b:8aac><b:8aad>のみ
rows.re: *When one who can hold it appears / again, the mystery will be solved.

rows.en: *Nothing lives in the dying earth.
rows.jp: ＊生きる者のいない / 死せる大地へ
rows.re: *Nothing lives on the dying earth.

rows.en: *The earth is colored red by blood. Flames of the red lotus will burn everything into a world dyed red.
rows.jp: ＊大地は血に眠く<b:8aae>られ / <b:8aaa><b:8aaf>の<b:8ab0>が全てを<b:8ab1>き尽くす / さながら、<b:8aaa>に<b:8ab2>まりし世界
rows.re: *The earth runs red with blood. Red / lotus flames will burn all to a / crimson world.

rows.en: *In the world not one ray of hope. What waits is |death,| the journey to the other side.
rows.jp: ＊その世界に一帯の希望の輝も無し / 待つは『死』という / 彼方への<b:8ab3>立ち

rows.en: *Without |hope,| the world is dark. People's cries echo, dark clouds circle. Souls are locked in grief.
rows.jp: ＊『希望』なきは暗暗の世界 / 人の<b:8ab4>きが<b:8ab5>き、暗<b:8ab6>立ちこめ / 人の心を<b:8ab7>に閉ざす少女の力少女＞の力の<8869>は / ガーディアンブレード・アガートラームと / 暗き魔<b:8a6b>・ルシエド

rows.en: *The Argetlahm diverts all possible disasters.
rows.jp: ＊アガートラームは / あらゆる災厄を<b:8ab8>け
rows.re: *The Argetlahm turns aside every / possible disaster.

rows.en: *The Black Wolf Lucied shields the <Sword Magess> from all possible disasters.
rows.jp: ＊暗き魔<b:8a6b>・ルシエドは / あらゆる災厄より / 少女の身を<b:8ab9>る<b:8aba>となる
rows.re: *The Black Wolf Lucied shields the / Magess from all possible disaster.

rows.en: *To watch the <Sword Magess> fight is to watch the queen of war. She gives the people a glimmer of hope.
rows.jp: ＊＜置の少女＞の戦う<b:8a56> / それはまさに、戦の女神さながらに / 人々に希望の輝を<b:8abb>えたもうた
<b:8a82><b:8a93>する、アガートラーム〜

rows.en: @I am a true descendant of the <Sword Magess>. I am a Valeria.
rows.jp: 「私こそは / ＜置の少女＞の血を<b:8abc>け<b:8abd>ぎし者 / ヴァレリアの人間だぞ〜
rows.re: I'm a true descendant of the <Sword / Magess.> I am a Valeria.

rows.en: @Then you'll be OK.
rows.jp: 「なら、だいじょうぶだよ
rows.re: Then you'll be fine.

rows.en: @Everyone's here. I'm gonna do my best because..
rows.jp: 「ここにはみんながいる / 俺もがんばる / そして<f040><f042>
rows.re: Everyone's here. I'll give it my / all, because..

rows.en: @You're here to help fight too.
rows.jp: 「あなたもいっしょに / 戦ってくれるから〜
rows.re: You're here to help us fight, too.

rows.jp: 刺さっていた<b:8a55><8860>だ
